(6,5).

lefic significators. 


Running DBA of Venus- Saturn- Mercury.

Conclusion 


5. The significations patterns are found different for promise and timing of winning the competitive award; for 
promise houses 9" & 5" houses are more important than 11°" & 10" houses; and for timing 6 house is more 
important than 2°¢ & 5" houses. 

6. Out of 20 charts of the Oscar winning actors/actresses, the 5th CSL is found to be the karaka Venus in 4 
charts only, and connected to Venus in 12 charts, i.e. generally connected to the karaka Venus in 16 charts (80 
percent). Similarly in a study of 100 prisoner charts, the 12th CSL is found to be the karaka Rahu in 19 charts 
only, and connected to Rahu tn 57 charts, |.e. generally connected to the karaka Rahu in 76 charts (76 percent). 
Thus the concerned CSL's “connection” to the relevant karaka_ is found valid other than being the karaka planet.

Hong Kong protesters demand China release Nobel laureate Sun, Dec 5 07:35 PM 
Hong Kong, Dec 5 (DPA) Hundreds of protesters marched to Beijing's de facto embassy in Hong Kong Sunday 
calling for the release of jailed dissident and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Liu Xiaobo. 


The group also called on China to free the laureate's wife Liu Xia who has been under house arrest since the 
award was announced in October. 

The march, jointly organised by ten groups, was one of a number scheduled to take part all over the world 
ahead of the awards ceremony in Oslo Friday. 

Liu, 54, is serving 11 years for subversion for co-writing a paper appealing for political reform in China. 

During the protest, supporters erected a huge banner calling for his release outside the Beijing's liaison office. 
They also carried photos of Liu and tied ribbons to the gates of the office to show their support. 

Speaking on government run radio RTHK, lawmaker Lee Cheuk-yan said China's image would be seriously dam- 
aged If the couple were not released. 

‘Such oppressive power will not be accepted universally and so it will really damage China's image if it continues 
to detain Liu Xiaobo and continues with the house arrest of Liu Xia,' Lee said. 

‘We are calling on them to be released so China can improve its image.’ 

Hong Kong, a former British colony which reverted to Chinese rule in 1997 with a mini-constitution guaranteeing 
limited political freedom, is the only place on Chinese soil where anti-China protests can take place.

Vitiligo: 


Vitiligo is a chronic disorder that causes depigmentation of patches of skin. It occurs when melanocytes, the cells 
responsible for skin pigmentation, die or are unable to function. The cause of vitiligo is unknown, but research 
suggests that it may arise from autoimmune, genetic, oxidative stress, neural, or viral causes. The incidence 
worldwide is less than 1%. The most common form is non-segmental vitiligo. 


Signs and symptoms: 


The most notable symptom of vitiligo is depigmentation of patches of skin that occurs on the extremities. Al- 
though patches are initially small, they often enlarge and change shape. When skin lesions occur, they are most 
prominent on the face, hands and wrists. Depigmentation is particularly noticeable around body orifices, such as 
the mouth, eyes, nostrils, genitalia and umbilicus. Some lesions have hyperpigmentation around the edges. Pa- 
tients who are stigmatised for their condition may experience depression and similar mood disorders.

The Guru of Krishnamurti Padhdhati and many modern day astrologers, Shri P.V.K. Punneswara Rao ji ascended 
his heavenly abode on 23rd October 2010 in Hyderabad leaving behind bereaved wife Smt. P. Saraswati Devi, 
four sons, two daughters, nine grand children along with thousands of KP students. 


Guru Rao ji was born on 14-10-1924 in Vijaywada, A.P., in a traditional, cultured Brahmin family. He passed his 
B.Com. from Osmania University in 1953 while in service with scholarship as ex-serviceman. He served in the 
Defense Department during the Second World War and joined the State Bank of Hyderabad on 10-03-1947 
where he served for the next 38 years till his retirement as the Auditor in the Inspection Department on 31st 
October 1984. 


Guru Rao ji’s interest in astrology started from the age of 24 and he avidly read, authored books and articles and 
mentored thousands of students till his last day, making him an astrology savant having more than six decades 
of astrology practice, 40 years for Vedic and over 25 years for KP. He founded the ‘Universal Research Institute 
of Astrology and Occult Sciences’ in 1986 in Chikkadapally, Hyderabad to propagate astrology through astrologi- 
cal courses, seminars and conferences. He also conducted special programmes of astrology in Malaysia, Anmed- 
abad and Jaipur. Today thousands of his students spread across the globe who are not only well established in 
their own fields but are also practicing astrology and KP techniques. He received innumerable astrology titles 
from various organizations such as Jyothisha Vachaspati (Kerala), J yothisha Vidya Bhaskara (Tirupati), K.P. 
Siddhanta Shiromani (Tirupati), Daivagna Shiromani (Orissa and Hyderabad ), Abhinava J yothisha Vidya Paran- 
gatha ( Malaysia ) etc. 


His Gurus in astrology were first Sri Machiraju Venkateswarlu of Narsapur (East Godavari district), second Sri 
Karavadi Hari Hara Rao of Hyderabad, and third Sri V. B. N. Sarma garu of Warangal, who was the direct disciple 
of Prof. K. S. Krishnamurti. His spiritual Guru was Sri Koduru Venkata Ratnam, who was a disciple of Sri Ra- 
mana Maharshi of Thiruvannamalai. His fifth and Yoga Guru was Sri Anjanananda Yogi of Kakani, Guntur. Being 
blessed and infused with spirituality by so many Maha Yogis, Guru Rao ji was not only an astrologer but also a 
spiritual guide and master to hundreds and thousands of people. 


Although Guru Rao ji will be greatly missed, it is fortunate that his youngest son, Sri. P.S. Chiranjeevi, had been 
coached to carry the baton handed over by his beloved father to keep the astrological legacy alive. 


May his soul rest in eternal peace in the greatest of all Loka --- the Vishnu Loka. 


Om Shanti, Om Shanti, Om_ Shanti

After a iene veriod of reading the news and watching events unfold on television in the Shrien Dewani case, my 
curiosity has got the better of me. | finally had sat down to look at the various aspects of the Annie Dewani mur- 
a case astrologically. In particular, had 3 questions in mind:

2. Will Shnen Dewani be extradited to South Africa from the UK? and 

3. Will Shnen Dewani be imprisoned by way of punishment for his crime? 


With these composite and related questions, | took a random horary number of 173 (between 1 and 249). The 
chart appended herewith Is the result for this number at Pretoria (South Africa) on 11 December 2010 at 
16:13:46 (Saturday). Latitude 25 Deg 44 Min North; Longitude 28 Deg 13 East (Google Earth), Time Zone 
+02:00. The Horary chart is attached herewith. 


This is a difficult analysis as all issues are interlinked, and would, obviously, yield a response in a composite way. 
The astrologer would be called upon to use his sharp sense of discrimination to sift through the various indica- 
tions and arrive at a correct result. 


Moon's indications: 


As with any horary analysis, let us look at the Moon. It is in the 3rd and owns 8th and 9" houses. This touches 
on the three issues quite clearly, 3rd for allegations (ala rumours), 8th for crime and punishment, and 9th for 
the Courts of law (judiciary). It would also be noted that the combination of 3 and 9 involving the 8th also 
touches on the question of extradition to South Africa for reasons of crime and punishment. The query is well 
reflected (Please note Moon in star of Mars = 1, 12; and sub of Venus = 11, 6). 


Ascendant's indications: 


The Ascendant sub lord is J upiter placed in 4th and owns 1st and 5" houses. This connects Shrien Dewani's cur- 
rent place of habitat (the UK) represented by the 4th. It is in the own star of J upiter and reinforces its significa- 
tions. It is in the sub of Moon that is in 3rd and rules 8" and 9" houses. Clearly, the Ascendant sub lord has 
linked the issue of extradition (3rd being 12th from the 4th), linking with the 9th (implying having to travel away 
from normal habitat) and for reasons of crime and punishment (signified by the 8th). 


With these clear indications by the Moon and Ascendant, there is no doubt left as to the accuracy of the chart 
that reflects all aspects of the 3 related questions raised. It was considered safe to proceed with further analysis. 


Whether allegations against Shrien Dewani are true or false? 


This question relates directly to the 3rd cusp. The rules in this regard require us to check the 3rd CSL and deter- 
mine its own nature. Then check its star lord and determine the nature of that planet. Finally check the sign lord 
of the 3rd CSL's star lord and judge the nature of that planet. These have to be synthesized to obtain an indica- 
tion of truth or falsehood of the allegations. 


In this chart, the 3rd CSL is Rahu. Rahu, which indicates confusing information that involves conspiracy. Clearly, 
speculation around the Dewani case has caused a lot of confusion in the public and, indeed, speaks of conspir- 
acy on the part of Shrien Dewani to murder his wife. According to press reports, while on his honeymoon, Shrien 
paid some hit men in South Africa to abduct and kill his wife. 


Rahu is in the star of Ketu (who represents Mercury by being in Gemini, and also Mercury and Mars by aspect).

nication on the issue and it is very articulate and clear. Mars adds its element of mischief and confusion. The 3rd

CSL Rahu is in Sagitarius (whose lord is Jupiter). This is a strong pointer to truth in the allegations. Ketu is in 
Gemini and this, once again, points to truth in the allegations. The lord of Ketu's sign of occupation i.e. Mercury 
is placed in Sagittarius. This, in my view, leaves no doubt as to the truth of the allegations and points to the guilt 
of Shrien Dewani. 


Conclusion: Shrien Dewani Is guilty of his wife's murder that was committed by engaging hit men to abduct 
and kill her. 


Arrest and Extradition to South Africa from the UK? 


This question actually has two parts to it. The first relates to the arrest of Shrien Dewani by the police on the 
basis of judicial orders. The second relates to the police involvement in Shrien Dewani's overseas visit to stand 
trial in South Africa on the basis of judicial orders. 


The first question is one of arrest. The general rules for this purpose are as follows: 


The CSL of the main house i.e. 12th should be Rahu (however, Kanakji and others have found that it could 
be some other planet as well); 

This Sub lord should not be in the star of a retrograde planet (this too is open to debate); and 

The 12th CSL should signify 2 or 3 or 8 or 12. 


It is the last rule that ts critical. 


In general, in this chart, the 12th CSL is Saturn (Note that although the CSL is not Rahu, Saturn is in the sub- 
sub of Rahu. This could be considered a link of Rahu for the purpose of this rule). Saturn is in 10th and rules 
2,3,4 house; It is in the star of Moon that Is in 3 and rules 8,9. It is in the sub of Venus in 11 and rules 6. 


Clearly, 12th CSL ts linked with 2, 3, 8 houses. It Is also linked with 9 (judiciary), and 10 (judicial proceedings 
and court orders). By application of the general rules, Shrien Dewani's arrest by police upon Court proceedings 
and orders Is a certainty. It may also be noted that 12th CSL's link with the 8th indicates the reason for such 
arrest which, in this case, is the crime of murder. 


Mr. Kanak Bosmia has provided an excellent set of rules for judging arrest and detention. These 
may be reproduced below: 


|) Police is represented by the 6th, imprisonment by 12th; Courts of law by the 9th; Court's arrest orders are 
represented by the 11th; and the alleged guilty individual by the 7th.

Job Changeover - A KP appraisal 


senior Manager, C-DOT 
Electronic City, Phase-1 | 
Hosur Road, Bangalore - 560 100 (Off), 2658'7463 (Res), 0-9845039153 | f, 
| Email: v_kumar@odotb.ermet.in hr al 
a. Sm : a 
This case is a recent case of my friend who wanted to change the job and had a job offer in hand, which was in 
negotiation. He wanted to know if the job in view was good for his growth and whether he would get it. 





| took horary number 17 from him and scrutinized this case at 13-43-53 Hrs on 28-09-2010 at Bangalore, 
12N51, 77E40. The horary chart is as attached: 


Co-ordinates of judgment: 


In a query relating to the job changeover, the 5'" house gets most prominent, as this house is provides the chain 
of leaving a job and getting placed in another. The 10" house has its own importance, as it decides the flow of 
karmas. 

In the process of negotiations for the job offer with the employer, the 3™ and 9" houses get most pertinent. The 
3" house indicates the demands from the native and 9"" house indicate what is agreed from the side of the em- 
ployer. If these houses signify the 11°" house, the native get successful in the negotiation process. 

Finally, the dasha sequence plays finally decisive role and for the positive results, the dasha planets should be 
well disposed towards fructification with favorable transits. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the Moon indicates the 
Status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about.

Question 2 (Series) 


A. Rotation of the chart when the question is asked by a person in regard to his/her rela- 
tions. 


1. This ts not so straightforward to me. If the person asking the question poses it in regard to, 
for example, his third daughter, | would imagine that we rotate the chart to the 9th bhava. Is 
this correct? 


Answer: 

If the astrologer cannot get a horary number from the son/daughter concerned, then it is to adopt the rota- 
tion method, as used by Guru ji KSK in his solved examples. As the querent asks the question about the 
matter related to somebody else, the chart is to be rotated acoording to the relation between the querent 
and the person in question, in this case generally 5 house for 1% child, 7 for 2"° , 9" for 3 and so on. 
However, for a male querent it is to take 11" house for 1% child, 1 house for 2™ child and 3™ house for 3” 
child and so on, and the rationale is that the 5" from 7™ (spouse) is 11" house for 1° child. (KP Reader IV, 
page 224)

Question 3 (Series) 


A) In Astrosecrets & KP, Part-1, 5th Edition, page 95, author says that the Lagna Lord Is very 
strong when it occupies ONE of the houses 2,3,9,10,11,4 and Is tenanting the stars of lords 
of houses 2,10,11. Author has not told about “when Lagna lord tenanting the stars of

QUESTIONS & ANSWERS 


By: Tin Win (USA) 





‘ 
a 
Answer: 


(a) The lordship of planets for which the Nodes are acting as agents, i.e. planets in conjunction, aspect with 
Nodes and their sign lords, is to be considered. (Rahu/Ketu Rules in KP in the KPE-zine May 200) 


(b) As per Placidus house system the lord of rasi sign where a house cusp falls is the lord of that house. For 
example, in chart no. 2 of Cine Actor Ganesan (Astrosecrets & KP, Part-1, page 98), Lagna lord Saturn is in 
the star of Mercury, which is lord of 5 and 8" houses. (KP for Beginners- Part 4: Understanding of a KP 
Chart, KPE-zine J uly 2008/ KP Navrtnamala Part-2, Revised) 


B) Regarding Lagna lord’s occupation, should we consider sign of the house, it occupies or to 
take Cusp occupied by it. 


Answer: 

The Lagna lord's occupation should be considered house-wise according to the Placidus house (from cusp to 
next cusp) but not sign-wise. For example, in chart no. 2 of Cine Actor Ganesan (Astrosecrets & KP, Part-1, 
page 98), the Lagna lord Saturn is occupant of 9" (as it is, without using the orb theory) house-wise, al- 


though occupant of 10" sign-wise. The Lagna lord Saturn is in the star of Mercury, sign-wise though in 9", 
house-wise confined to 8" only.

Dears Kanak ji and Tin Win ji, 


Many thanks for sending me a copy of the J anuary 2011 issue of KP-Ezine. Indeed, it was eagerly awaited. You 
may well imagine that | have already read through it from start to finish with great interest. As always, the arti- 
cles you have included in this issue are very interesting and informative. | wish to thank you for including my 
analysis on the Dewani case. Time will, no doubt, indicate whether the analysis was correct or not. 


| was particularly happy to see the response to my questions by Tin Win ji. | am grateful to him for taking time 
to address my concerns. He has, in his usual way, provided crisp and to-the-point answers to the many ques- 
tions raised. While being very clear in most respects, | have additional clarification to seek: 


My question # 2 was that “if the question is posed by the same person for the same relative but saying that he/ 
she wishes to know about his daughter (without specifying that it is his third daughter or child), would we rotate 
the chart to the 5th bhava only (especially if the person posing the question is not readily available to clarify 
which child he or she is speaking about)?” 


Tin Win ji has clarified that “The serial number of the child, including the miscarriage(s), should be specific in 
order to rotate the chart properly as mentioned above.” 


| fully appreciate the response. However, my question was more to do with a situation when the serial number 
is unknown or not specified by the querent, and one Is unable to determine which serial number of the child is 
being referred to. In this case, there will be no way of rotating the chart to the relevant “serial number” of the 
child concerned as it will not be available to the astrologer. Thus, should we then just consider the 5th house as 


February 2011 KPEzine 4 





DE oe 


the lagna of ‘the child’ and proceed to analyse? OR does it imply that if this “serial number” is not available we 
should not proceed with any analysis? 


| will be most grateful for this additional clarification. 


Please also allow me to make some observations in relation to Question 1 (series). | found the effort made by 
the astrologer concerned to be remarkable in trying to find an appropriate spouse for some one. According to 
the querent, he has examined 1150 horoscopes in his effort to find the perfect one which did not have subse- 
quent DBAs linked with 6, 10 or 12. | really admire the attempt made. 


However, in my view, time has been devoted by the learned astrologer in chasing after perfection in match mak- 
Ing. | do believe that God has not destined any individual’s life to be without its ups and downs in every aspect 
of one’s life, and this includes his wedded life. Thus, to look for the perfect situation where none of the negative 
houses influence the life of the individual after marriage would be looking not just for a needle in a hay stack but 
would be, in my view, impossible altogether. 


| believe that when a horary chart is plotted for a specific query or purpose, the horoscope that emerges is a 
Snap shot of the querent’s (or that activity’s) current situation and its path in the future. While the horoscope 
focuses on the particular question or activity, it cannot be devoid of other indications that are also relevant to 
the current situation of the individual concerned or of the activity being examined. The very word ‘focus’ implies 
that there are other issues in the background, or on the periphery, which make up the total picture. 


Each horary chart, therefore, contains within itself indications regarding other issues of relevance to the individ- 
ual or activity that, simultaneously, contribute to the fulfillment, denial, or alteration of that particular aspect of 
the person’s life. 


As an example, in relation to the question on marriage, the 7th house Is the primary house and must be sup- 
ported by 2nd and 11th (and/or 5th) to bring about marriage successfully. At the same time, as the individual 
looks forward to his or her marriage, he or she is also concerned about their job, income, stability in life, name 
and reputation, travels, health, parents, siblings, etc. Therefore, if the prasna chart did not contain some indica- 
tions in relation to the 6th or 10th bhavas (as part of the ‘total picture’ of the situation), the person may get 
married but may have to start a family without any income! 


Take another aspect of the same example. The person who is desirous of marriage may, at the same time, con- 
sider obtaining a loan to buy a small house in which, after his marriage, he would reside with his spouse and 
raise a family. Now, the horary chart will have to indicate both 2,7,11 and 6 (along with other houses that are 
necessary to fulfill his desires for marriage and for purchasing a house after obtaining a loan). 


Thus, in such a case, the linkage of 2 and 6 is as important as the link between 2 and 7 at the time of the per- 
son’s marriage. Now, as a principle, and rightly so, we look only for positive links that promote the manifestation 
of the event in question. Therefore, we consider the 7th signification of the 2nd bhava as promoting the event of 
marriage. We ignore the simultaneous link of the 2nd bhava with the 6th, although we realize that this link can 
(and will) cause ups-and-downs in married life. At the same time, we are also assured that the individual will 
continue to earn his living and be able to support his or her family. 


Destiny cannot be overwritten by man. This is the plank on which Guruji KSK built his precise rules of Krishna- 
murti Padhdhati. When we as astrologers try to find the ‘best’ match for a person, it is providence that guides us 
in selecting that one particular individual who is ‘destined’ for the querent as partner for life. This is also the rea- 
son why we take a match as being acceptable when a certain number of matching factors are present beyond a 
minimum threshold. We, as astrologers, do not select the individual spouse randomly or because we are in a 
position to pick any one we think is right. We are mere instruments of providence that uses us aS a medium to 
provide an astrological stamp of approval to the matrimonial match that is destined for that particular querent.

With these thoughts, | would encourage the querent of “Question 1 (series)” to make the effort to find the ‘best 
match’ by accepting the least problematic one rather than try to find the ideal and utopic match. 


Do excuse my comments above. | only wish to highlight the futility of trying to find everything in life to be 
100%.

the source of data in general. 


2. There is one and only one rule for wining the competitive award for any one from any field of 
profession based on the main house of 10th which governs the award. 


3. The rules may be different only in the study of success in different fields of profession depending 
which main house rules each particular field. 


4. The analysis is provided in details by category, chart by chart in each category and also up to the 
micro level of each winning Oscar award for a chart. 


5. It isn’t a common practice to rectify the massive charts in an empirical research study in order 
not to add uncertainty by using a non existing fool-proof birth time rectification method without 
having sufficient information on life events. 


6. The A rated birth data are as good as the charts in many astrological books. To reduce errors and 
omissions or variance in the study and for diversification, the size of sample charts are raised by 
including some more charts other than the back bone AA rated charts.

8. To make or break a rule, a study of 100 real live charts is generally required.

After seeing the News papers and T.V.news daily, as | am interested in Astrology, | wish to know 
the result of SKC Report astrologically by implementing the K.P. rules. So the horary No. is gener- 
ated through KP Astro.3.5 and analyzed as follows. 


Query: Whether the Sri Krishna Committee Report will be favorable for Telangana or not. 
Horary No. 107/249. 

D.O.J = 2-1-2011, Sunday. 

T.O.) = 3-22-41.PM. 

P.O.) = Kurnool, AP. 


Moon indicates the mind of the questioner and the nature of query. In this horary chart, Moon (3- 
11) is in the star of Mercury (3-1&10) and in the sub of Rahu (10-4). 


3" house indicates Report. 

11‘ house represents fulfillment of desire (achievement of Telangana). 
1 house shows Self (Telangana). 

10°" house denotes respect, honour, awards, rewards, Kingdom etc. 
4" house represents the native land (Telangana Area) 


So as said above, the Moon indicates the nature of the query of the querent positively. Therefore, 
we can proceed further to analyze the chart clearly. 


First of all we have to consider the 3™ house mainly since the query is whether the SKC Report will 
be favourable for Telangana or not. 


“One is to judge the 3™ house for any information or correspondence or communication 
or report” - is mentioned clearly in page no. 171 of Horary Astrology- KP Reader VI. In addition 
to the 3™ house, we have to consider 1, 6 and 11 houses also. 


3? = Report. 

1 = Self (Telangana) 

6" = Gain to Telangana and loss to its opponents, favourable for Telangana. 
11" = fulfillment of desire (achievement of Telangana). 


So, we can frame a rule as follows: - 
RULE: - If the 3™ cusp sub lord signifies 1,3,6 or 11, then only the report will be favour- 
able for Telangana , otherwise not.

Will the coalition between Zanu-PF and MDC dissolve? 
Will Robert Mugabe emerge the victor? 


A KP Analysis 


There has recently been a strong move by the South African government to drive a large number 
of Zimbabweans back home to Zimbabwe (most of who are illegally in South Africa and mainly for 
work related reasons). This comes at a time when there is a looming election in Zimbabwe in 
2011. Obviously, the return of a large Diaspora of Zimbabweans, who will hopefully participate in 
the upcoming elections, could have a huge influence on its outcome. 


The headlines have been strong: 


“Zimbabwe PM Tsvangirai Back pedals on 2011 General Elections, Citing Violence: Mr. 
Tsvangirai as well as President Robert Mugabe have expressed the desire for new elec- 
tions in 2011 to resolve the deadlock in the power-sharing government set up in 2009.” 


Another headline reads: 


“Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe's party has backed him to run in polls which it 
said must take place next year, paving the way for a fierce contest with his arch-foe 
Morgan Tsvangirai.” 


The opposition (MDC) seems to indicate that elections may not be held in 2011. However, the 
Zanu-PF is gunning for a fight and insists that elections must take place in 2011. Whether these 
will lead to a resolution of the political impasse in the country, and whether there will be a truly 
democratic government is debatable. 


The main questions of consuming interest to political pundits are: 


1. Whether the fragile coalition that exists between the Zanu-PF (with Robert 
Mugabe at the helm) and the MDC (with Morgan Tswangirai at the helm) 
hold, or would it crash? 

Would there be elections in Zimbabwe in 2011? 

What would their outcome be? 

Will the coalition be re-installed? 

Would Robert Mugabe again assume sole power and control of the country?

A number of issues are interconnected in the questions posed. These relate to: 


1. The coalition. A coalition is a form of partnership. In this case, it is a partnership 
of two opposing political parties that had agreed to run the country. The issue is 
whether this "partnership" would continue? Obviously, this question needs to be 
viewed from the angle of partnership and breakage of partnership; 

2. The second issue is that of the election itself. Will elections be held as declared? 

3. If elections are held, what would be the outcome? 

4. Would it involve a change in the nature of the government (democratic, dictator- 
ship, or other)? 

5. Who will emerge victorious in the elections? What is the fate of the two political

Analysis of Moon: 


Let us look at the Moon. It is in the 8th and rules 7th. It is in the Star of Venus that Is in the 10th 
and rules 5 and 10. It is in the Sub of Rahu who is in the 11th. Rahu represents Mars (11, 4-11), 
Sun (11, 8) and Jupiter (2, 3-12). It may also be remembered that for the lagna of this chart 
(Makara/Capricorn), the 11th bhava is a badhaka sthana. 


The varied links of the Moon reflect the issues that are in question. The 8th shows longevity of the 
coalition and the differences (even quarrels) between the two partners (members of the coalition). 
The 10th shows the state of political affairs in the country. The 3rd relates to the will of the people 
(see Kanak ji's categorization of the 3™ in his various rules on the subject of elections). The 4th is 
the end of everything (while it also reflects the situation at home i.e. within the country). The 3rd 
Shows risk of the "home situation" deteriorating (as the 3rd negates the 4th). 


Indications of the Ascendant: 


The Ascendant Sub Lord is Rahu who is placed in 11th. It represents Mars (11, 4-11), Sun (11, 8), 
and Jupiter (2, 3-12). It is in the Star of Ketu who is placed in the 5th. Ketu represents Saturn (9, 
1-2). Rahu is in the Sub of Jupiter (2, 3-12). 


Please note that the Ascendant Sub lord also indicates the same links (and others) as presented 
by the Moon. This leaves no doubt as to the veracity of this prasna chart and one may now pro- 
ceed with a more detailed analysis. 


Coalition, its longevity and fate 


The first thing to consider would be the life of the coalition. Does the chart indicate a long, me- 
dium or short life for the Zanu(PF)-MDC coalition and its continued existence? 


1) | A consideration of longevity is primarily done through the links between bhavas 1,5, and 9. 
The Lagna Sub Lord is Rahu. Its various links have been discussed earlier under indications of the 
Ascendant. Notably, it links 1,5,9 as well as 2,8,12 and Badhaka 11th. With both significations si- 
multaneously present, it would be safe to assume that there is only medium term longevity de- 
clared by these links. Thus, notwithstanding the outcome of the elections, the coalition would exist 
for some time at least (unless, as we shall see further below, the elections themselves oc- 
cur in DBAs that indicate break down of the coalition and the outcome of the elections 


simultaneously). 


2) Fate of the coalition is akin to the fate of a partnership (or even divorce among life partners). 
The bhavas that play a role in this matter are the 2nd, 7th and 11" (and their negating bhavas). 


The 2nd CSL is Mars (11, 4-11). It is in the Star of Venus (10, 5-10) and it is in the Sub of J upi- 
ter (2, 3-12). The rule that we have to apply is that when the significators of 2, 7, and 11 signify 
1,6,10 they lead to divorce or separation or break up. When a quarrel is the basis of the breakage, 
they also involve the 8th. 

Note that the 2nd CSL links with 10". When examined from the 7th, it links with the 12th (which 
is the 6th for the 7th bhava). Thus, 2nd CSL indicates a split up.

Will there be elections at all? 


Here | would like to thank Kanak ji for his rules in relation to these issues. They have been very

"If the 3rd (election, views of the people) signifies 3, 9 (people of opposing views), 11

Here the 3rd CSL ts Ketu that is in 5. It represents Mercury (11, 6-9), and Saturn (9, 1-2). Ketu is

General rules for competition and victory 


On the other hand, the general rules relating to winning in elections (or for that matter in any

Nature of government 

Let us also use Kanak ji's rules relating to outcomes in terms of categorizing the form of govern- 
ment that will emerge victorious i.e. Democratic, Dictatorial, or Religious. Kanak ji’s rules in this 
regard may be summarised as follows: 


‘lf the Ascendant and 10th CSLs signify 11th and either 6 (Military Dictatorship) OR 4 
(Democracy) OR 9 (Religious Leadership), the outcome will be according to the 6, or 4 
or 9 linkage.’ 


In this case the Ascendant Sub Lord is Rahu which, as analysed earlier, is linked with 4, 9, and 11. 
While the 9th may indicate religious links, the 4th clearly shows a democratically elected govern- 
ment. This is further confirmed by the 10th CSL that is Jupiter which only shows links with 4 and 
11. | would read this as being an election that installs a democratically elected government. 
(Note: whether the government so elected governs democratically or not is another matter. The 
process of election may appear democratic as every citizen has the right to vote and would, theo- 
retically, exercise that right freely by casting his or her vote without adverse influence of any kind. 
However, they may have been forced (subtly or overtly) to participate in the election and, in fact, 
been forced to vote for one particular candidate. Thus, the present KP analysis being made here is

Short History 

Activists trying to oust Hosni Mubarak, the Egyptian president, are continuing to clash with police 
in the capital, Cairo , despite a government crackdown to end the unprecedented protests. Al 
Jazeera's Dan Nolan, reporting from Cairo, said there were "running clashes throughout Cairo " 
overnight and that while the situation was a bit calmer in the early hours of Thursday, more pro- 
tests were anticipated during the day as the demonstrators are "just showing no signs of stopping 
So far". 

The protests are likely to gather momentum with the arrival of Mohamed ElBaradei, the Nobel 
Peace Prize-winning former head of the UN nuclear watchdog and a potential presidential rival to 
Mubarak. 

"| am going back to Cairo and back onto the streets, because, really, there is no choice. You go 
out there with this massive number of people and you hope things will not turn ugly, but so far, 
the regime does not seem to have gotten that message," ElBaradei, who lives in Vienna, said in 
remarks on US website The Daily Beast. 

Ali ElBaradei, Mohamed ElBaradei's brother, confirmed to Al Jazeera that the reform campaigner 
would be arriving in Cairo on Thursday night and that he intends to attend a demonstration 
planned after Friday morning prayers. 


Ongoing Clashes 


In protests that seem to have been inspired by the recent turmoil in Tunisia , Egyptians have de- 
fied a government ban only political rallies and taken to the streets in thousands across several 
cities to vent their anger against Mubarak's 30-year rule. 

Since the streets protests erupted on Tuesday, the police have confronted protesters with tear 
gas, water cannons and batons and arrested more than 860 people. At least six people have also 
been killed as heavily armed police faced off with angry protesters. But our correspondent said 
that crackdown has failed to end the protests. The protesters seem determined and continue to 
gather at various locations, before being dispersed by the police. Protesters have constantly re- 
grouped, using Facebook and Twitter to galvanise and co-ordinate their demonstrations. 

Calls for another big protest on Friday gathered 24,000 Facebook supporters within hours of being 
posted. Web activists seem to have acted largely independently of more organised opposition 
movements, including the Muslim Brotherhood, widely seen as having Egypt 's biggest grassroots 
network with its social and charity projects. There have been reports of blocked internet access 
and mobile service interruptions in an apparent government move to thwart protesters from com- 
municating among themselves. 

Twitter on Wednesday said its service had been blocked in Egypt . But Al Jazeera's Nolan reported 
that the site was up and running on Thursday. Meanwhile Jillian York, who oversees the Herdict 
web monitoring service at Harvard University , said that Egyptian Facebook users confirmed to her 
that the website was blocked. Facebook, however, said it had not recorded "major changes" in 
traffic from Egypt .

The Indian Space Research Organisation will launch its advanced communication satellite GSAT 5P 
on December 25 from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota. Isro officials said that the 
GSAT 5P launch onboard the GSLV-FO6 would take place at 4.01 pm on Christmas. The countdown 
for the launch would commence on Friday. The GSAT 5P launch, scheduled on December 20, was 
called off after Isro scientists had detected a leak in one of the valves of the Russian-made cryo- 
genic engine. 





The GSAT 5, configured as an exclusive C-band communication satellite, would carry 12 normal C- 
band transponders and six extended C-band transponders. The spacecraft with a mission life of 12 
years, would replace the Insat-2E, launched in 1999.

Introduction 


1.The main objective of this study is to find the common pattern of significators in lottery win- 
nings. In this study 22 lottery winners who had the AA rated birth data and had won at least a 
million US dollars in lottery are analyzed. The source of chart details are as per courtesy of the 
AstroDatabank 4.0, which is being maintained now by astro.com and these charts may be ac- 
cessed at the following link: 


http: //www.astro.com/astro-databank/Main_ Page

Recently, someone in my office complex telephoned me to intimate that the mother of one of my 
known acquaintance was admitted to the hospital in |CU and my opinion was needed for her re- 
covery in the time to come. 


| took horary number 71 myself to assess “will her mother survive?” and scrutinized this case at 
17-12-05 Hrs on 18-01-2011 at Bangalore. The chart was rotated to 2™ house to represent the 
mother of the native well known to me. The rotated horary chart is as attached. 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating to the disease, the lagna indicates the native, lagna lord indicates health and 
6" house indicates the disease content. 5" and 11™ house indicate the recovery zone. 11 house 
also indicates discharge from the hospital (12 house). 


Finally, the dasha sequence plays decisive role and for the positive results, the dasha planets 
should be well disposed towards fructification with favorable transits. 


The Query 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the 
Moon indicates the status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna SbL-Jupiter, which is a strong planet, as there is no planet in its star, thus its 
placement would be important to study. Note that J upiter is placed in the 7 house, which denotes 
the maraca house for the native. 


Moon gets placed in 11" house as 12" lord indicating the recovery process (11'" house) in a hos- 
pital (12' house). 


Thus, the query is well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 
Analysis 
Examine Lagna 
As said above, lagna SbL-J upiter is placed in the 7 house as 8" lord, which denotes the ma- 
raca house for the native. At the stellar level, Jupiter is placed in the star and sub of Saturn 
placed in 2" house (another maraca house) as strong 6" lord. This suggests the condition be- 
ing critical due to disease. 
Since, neither Jupiter is badhaka lord nor associated with badhaka house/lord, it was safe to 
assume that death was not imminent and it was assumed that the signification of lagna sub- 
lord to maraca houses (7-2" houses) was only indicating the criticality of the disease. 
Examine the 6" cusp 
6". cusp indicates the disease profile. 
6 cuspal sub-lord is Moon, which falls in the star of Rahu placed in 4°" house, suggesting the 
disease of excesses (Rahu) in the chest area. Sub-lord of Moon is Venus, which also gets 
placed in 4" house thereby understanding that the disease is located in chest and might have 


caused breathlessness (Rahu) due to excessively congested lungs.

Violent protests are taking place in Egypt, even as | am writing this analysis. Egyptians are fed up 
with the more than 30 years of dictatorial rule of President Hosni Mubarak. Even the United 
States, to whom Mr. Mubarak was strongly allied, has declared that they have hopes for a better

already occurred. Where will all this lead? Will Egypt see a collapse of Hosni Mubarak and his gov- 
ernment? Will a new and democratic government emerge? What is the future of Hosni Mubarak 
and, indeed, that of Egyptian politics? 


| have taken a random, computer generated number 67 (between 1 and 249) and plotted this ho- 
rary chart on 29 January 2011 at 09:11:54 am at Pretoria (South Africa) Longitude 28:15 East 
and Latitude 25:38 South. 


The Moon 


In this chart, the Moon is in 5 and owns 1. It is weak, however, and its star lord Mercury is placed 
in 6 and rules 3 and 12. The sub lord is Venus which is in 5 and owns 4 and 11. 


Moon throws its light on 5th (dismissal from office - reference Shri C.R.Bhatt - 5th being 12th 
from 6th showing absence of regular work). The 6th shows the growing opposition and unrest di- 
rected against the ruling powers. The 3rd points to the views of the people which, combined with 
the 6th indicate strong public sentiments against the ruling powers, and along with the 5th show 
their desire to remove the prevailing political masters from office. 12th indicates a total change of 
environment. It also shows trouble, agitation and losses. 


The Ascendant is a moveable sign (Cancer). Lagna sub lord is Mercury which is placed in 6th and 
rules 3 and 12. The appearance of Mercury is noteworthy. Mercury is an outspoken planet. Its na- 
ture is one of strong, intelligent and outward expression. It is also violent. It is for this reason that 
the English expression "Mercurial temper" exists. Its link with the 6th (opposition), 3rd (popular 
view), and 12 (change of political environment) takes the form of a strong, vocal, and even violent 
expression of the people against the ruling powers. 


Mercury is in the star of Sun (which by nature indicates government, authority and governance). 
Sun is placed in 7 and rules 2 (both are Maraka houses and, 7‘" also indicates the opposition). To- 
gether with Mercury's own indication of the 12th house, the star lord indication of 2 and 7 does 
not bode well for the life of the existing government in Egypt. 


Mercury's sub lord is Moon which, as analysed earlier, indicates the 5th and 1st. 


These indications of Moon and Ascendant point to the authenticity of the horary chart and further 
analysis may be conducted confidently.

ANALYSIS OF THE BHAVAS 


The approach here is that | do not first work out the house grouping and then analyse each bhava 
of the group. | take the opposite approach i.e. | first analyse the bhavas and then see which rele- 
vant groups emerge. This approach allows me, in the present analysis, to observe the total picture 
as It emerges from the analysis of the various bhavas of the chart. 


1. The CSL of the Lagna, 7th and 8th is Mercury who Is posited in 6 and rules 3-12. It is in the 
star of Sun in 7 and rules 2. It is in the sub of Moon in 5 and rules 1. Mercury is also the sub lord 
of houses 1,2,7 and 8; 


2. 3rd CSL is Ketu posited in 11. Ketu represents Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. It also represents 
Saturn that aspects it by its 10th aspect. Saturn is in 3 and rules 7-8. Ketu is in the star of Rahu 
which is in 5. Rahu further represents J upiter that is in 8 and rules 6-9. Ketu Is in the sub of Rahu. 


3. 6th and 11th CSL is Saturn which is retrograde and posited in 3 and rules 7-8. It is in the star 
of Moon that is in 5th and rules 1. It is in the sub of Sun that is in 7 and rules 2. 


4. 10 and 12th CSL is Jupiter that is in 8 and rules 6-9. It is in the star of Saturn (R) in 3 and 
rules 7-8. It is in the sub of Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. 


5. 9th CSL is Venus posited in 5 and rules 4-11. Venus is a strong planet and has no planets in 
its stars. It is in the star of Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. It is in the Sub of Saturn in 3 and rules 7- 
8. 


EMERGING HOUSE GROUPINGS AS THEY RELATE TO THE QUESTIONS POSED 
1. Is there further longevity of Mubarak's government indicated? 


Here the 1st, 3rd and 8th bhavas may be examined for their links with Badhaka, Maraka indica- 
tors. 


(a) |The Ascendant is linked with the 7th and 8th as their sub lords are the same i.e. Mercury. 
Mercury who is in 6 rules 3-12. It is in the star of Sun in 7 and rules 2. It is in the sub of Moon in 
5 and rules 1. Mercury is also the sub lord of houses 1,2,7 and 8. Thus, we find the Maraka 
houses are strongly linked. These are 2,7,8 and 12. However, the bhavas 1 and 5 are also pre- 
sent. In both groupings it Is significant that the 11th Badhaka is missing. 


(b) 3rd CSL is Ketu posited in 11. Ketu represents Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. It alSo repre- 
sents Saturn that aspects it by its LOth aspect. Saturn is in 3 and rules 7-8. Ketu Is in the Star of

and 11th. While the 5th and 9th also appear, their link with Badhaka 11th cannot promise any 
length of life.

Looking at all the factors for longevity, it becomes apparent that the present government of Egypt 
IS now at the brink of its political demise. 


2. Will Mr. Mubarak emerge victorious from the present strong challenge to his position 
and reputation in politics? 


For any challenge (indeed, for any competition) the involvement of the 6th and 11th are essential. 
In the case of political challenges, the 10th has to play a significant role. Thus, the 6th must es- 
tablish links with 6 or 10 or 11 to indicate victory, and 4,5,12 are houses of loss. This must also 
be examined from the opponent's side |.e. the 12th bhava, 6th from 7th. This is the general rule. 
Let us examine how it applies in the present case. 


(a) |The cuspal sub lord of both 6th and 11th is Saturn which is retrograde. Saturn is posited in 3 
and rules 7-8. It is in the star of Moon that is in 5th and rules 1. It is in the sub of Sun that Is in 7 
and rules 2. 


Please note that the 6th CSL does not indicate 6 or 10. On the contrary, it strongly links with the 
5th. There is a strong indication of loss to Mubarak in the current challenge to his authority. 


(b) | Examining the issue from the opposition's perspective, we will use the 7th as the lagna for 
the opposition. Counting from 7‘-opponent, 6th (12th of the horary chart) sub lord is Jupiter that 
IS in 2 and rules 12-3. No planet is in the stars of Jupiter, which is the CSL of 4,6,10 and 11. It Is 
in the star of Saturn (R) in 9 and rules 1-2. It is in the sub of Mercury in 12 and rules 9-6. Here 
the connection between the 6th and 10th, 11th emerges and points to victory for the opposition. 


3. If we were to personalise this opposition to be directed against Mr. Mubarak 
(instead of speaking about his government or authority), we will be able to examine his 
personal situation using Kanak ji's rules. Let us see what these rules are: 


i) If 10th (one's position in politics) CSL signifies 10 (one's reputation), 3(one's ability), 11 (one's 
reputation as a winner), THEN in the DBA of 3,10,11 significators success is assured; 

it) Check for opponent as well using the 7th (from the fixed ascendant for the querent or person 
for whom the question is asked). 


(a) Let us see the indications of the 10th bhava. 10 and 12th CSL Its Jupiter that is in 8 and rules 
6-9. It is in the star of Saturn (R) in 3 and rules 7-8. It is in the sub of Mercury in 6 and rules 3- 
12. 


This is an interesting outcome. The 10th bhava shows that it is not strongly linked with the houses 
of success. Only the 3rd emerges. What might this indicate. 3rd corresponds to Mr. Mubarak's 
‘ability’ as a politician. While his ability is not in doubt (he has held the Presidency of Egypt for the 
last 30 years), his success in the current contest is not assured. 


Another issue that may be of some interest here is the retrogression of Saturn. While retrogres- 
sion may or may not be considered significant in a horary analysis, the fact that it involves Saturn 
(a slow and obstructive planet) may clearly show severe blockage to Mr. Mubarak's chances of any 
kind of success. 


(b) | To examine the situation from the opposition's perspective, we will use the 7th as the lagna 
for the opposition. Counting from 7th- opponent, 10th (4th of the horary chart) CSL Is Jupiter 
that is in 2 and rules 12-3. No planet is in the stars of Jupiter, which is the CSL of 4,6,10 and 11. 
It is in the star of Saturn (R) in 9 and rules 1-2. It is in the sub of Mercury in 12 and rules 9-6. 
The 10th CSL’s signification of 3,10 and 11 show victory to the opposition (as a movement or up- 
rising against authority).

4. A subsidiary question would be whether Mubarak's popularity would suffer such a 
serious blow as to end his political career altogether? This question involves, (and | 
thank Kanak ji for pointing the way in this regard), 9,10,11, 2 and 6 as well as Saturn or 
Mercury. 


For popularity in politics, Kanak ji has given us the following rules that state that: 


1) 9th CSL should signify 9,10,11, 2 and 6. The SL should be Saturn or Mercury. 
ii) LOth CSL should signify 9,10,11,2 and 6. The SL should be Saturn or Mercury. 
iil) 11th CSL should signify 9,10,11,2 and 6. 


In the present case: 


I) 9th CSL is Venus posited in 5 and rules 4-11. Venus is a strong planet and has no planets in 
its stars and, therefore, strongly signifies 5th and Badhaka 11th. It is in the star of Mercury in 6 
and rules 3-12. It is in the sub of Saturn in 3 and rules 7-8. Significantly, the 10th is missing. The 
10th relates to one's reputation directly. 


it) 10 CSL is Jupiter that is in 8 and rules 6-9. It is in the star of Saturn (R) in 3 and rules 7-8. It 
is in the sub of Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. Again, it will be interesting to see the role that may 
be played by retrograde Saturn. The benign and diplomatic/political planet Jupiter is in the star of 
retrograde Saturn, thus spoiling the indication of the 1Oth (popularity). The link of the 12th shows 
serious loss in that respect. 


iit) 11th CSL is Saturn which is retrograde and posited in 3 and rules 7-8. It is in the star of Moon 
that is in 5th and rules 1. It is in the sub of Sun that is in 7 and rules 2. When looked at from the 
final analysis of the 11th house, there are no indications of the relevant bhavas. The reading is 
clear. Mr. Mubarak will lose all his popularity and may not be able to justify his continu- 
ance as President of Egypt any more. 


5. If Mr. Mubarak loses his position and his government falls, will he be subjected to ar- 
rest, detention, and judicial or political punishment? 


An analysis of this question involves looking at the arrest and jail rules in relation to bhavas 
2,3,8,12 and also Kanak ji's rules. 


Let us look at the general rules first: 


|) 12th CSL should be Rahu (however, this does not always hold true) 
il) It should not be in the star of retrograde planets (this too is subject to debate) 
itl) 12th CSL should signify 2,3,8,12. This is the key and critical rule that will require attention. 


In the present instance, 12th CSL Is Jupiter that is in 8 and rules 6-9. It is in the star of Saturn (R) 
in 3 and rules 7-8. It is in the sub of Mercury in 6 and rules 3-12. Please note the emergence of 
3,8,12. The general rules, therefore, show that Mubarak will be arrested. While examining arrest, 
| am inclined to view this more as confinement by the public and later, with a change of govern- 
ment, official detention by the new authorities. Also, note the signification of the 7th which clearly 
points to the reason for such arrest being related to politics. 


Let us examine Kanak Ji's rules: 
|) Police is represented by the 6th, imprisonment by 12th; Courts of law by the 9th; Court's arrest 


orders are represented by the 11th; and the alleged guilty individual by the 7th. 
Il) If the 6th CSL signifies 1 (self effort) and 11 (Success) - the police will be able to arrest the de-

6. A subsidiary question of the above would be as to what nature of charge could be 
leveled against Mubarak? Could it be one of treason? 


Let us look at the Kanak ji’s rule in relation to treason. 


I) If Ascendant (dangerous activity) CSL signifies 1st (dangerous activity), 12th (treason/ 
Punishment), 6th (distressing condition), THEN one is found guilty of treason during the DBAs of 
1,12,6. | would like to point out that treason could also be interpreted to mean as any action or 
activity that harms the interests of the State. 


In the present case, Lagna CSL is Mercury who is in 6 and rules 3-12. It is in the star of Sun in 7 
and rules 2. It is in the sub of Moon in 5 and rules 1. Mercury is also the sub lord of houses 1,2,7 
and 8. The rule is fully met. Lagna CSL clearly signifies 1,12 and 6. Therefore, Mubarak will be 
considered (for purposes of history as well) aS some one that had been harmful to the interests of 
Egypt and its people. 


Now let us look at the rules in relation to assassination. 


We have already seen that Mr. Mubarak may not be subject to official action by police or judiciary. 
However, would he be subject to assassination? Kanak ji’s rules are: 


i) 8th is infamy, accidental death, executions, misery; 

1) 12th is crimes, assassinations, anxieties, blackmail, cheating, clandestine associates, exiled 

persons, misery, moksha; 

iil) If 8th or 12th CSLs signify 8,12, one can be assassinated in the DBA of 8 and 12; 

iv) If8or12 are connected with Badhaka and Maraka, then assassination is certain; 

v) If 8 or 12 are connected with 1,5,9,11 (except 9 for fixed lagnas, 11 for movable lagnas), then 
one can escape the assassination attempt on his life.

TIMING (HOW IS THE CURRENT PERIOD FOR THE CONDITIONS IN EGYPT): 


The current Dasa running is that of Mercury from 12 July 2007 until 12 July 2024. Mercury is in 6

| do not examine the Antaras that will come within Venus Bhukti. Bear in mind that Saturn has a

Answer 5 

1. Friendship, enmity and neutral relationship of planets with each other are based on the 
Traditional concepts which are easily accessible. While for J upiter, Venus is an enemy, for Ve- 
nus, Jupiter is natural. Table of Friend/Equal/Enemies and Compatible Table are also at- 
oe as per courtesy of Mr. Kanak Bosmia. 





2. The first and second rules are not a must in match making for marriage. Harmony in mar- 
ried life can be studied by the signification of 11° and 7 cuspal sub lords, as guided by Gu- 
ruji KSK in the KP Reader IV. 


3. In Mr. Kanak Bosmia’s extensive experience of KPDP matching, the 10 and last rule 
(whether the period lords operating at the time of matching in both charts indicate desirability 
for matching for marriage) has been found most important, and it is not recommendable for 
marriage if it is below 51 scores, whatever the overall matching score may be higher than av- 
erage 50, because there Is a risk for divorce. For example, in the case of separation after 40 
years of marriage of Al and Tipper Gores, the 10" rule had a score of 33% only in the overall 
score of 63% on the day of marriage, as per KPDP score Sheet attached.

The horoscope of a person or a birth chart prepared at the time of birth or commencement of 
an event is used to predict the future .The planets in the chart show the characteristics and 
activities of the person involved, in accordance to the planets ownership, deposition and as- 
pects etc. 

Professor K.S.Krishnamurthi had studied both eastern and western astrological systems and 
observed that the native or the owner of the horoscope experienced results which are no way 
connected to the signification of the planet to the rasi or bhava of the horoscope. This caused 
the Guruji to go on research on the offering of results by a planet by his signification in the 
birth chart. 

It is found that a planet offers the results of the house occupied by the lord of the star wherein 
this planet is deposited. Again trouble arose when more than one planets are found in the 
Same constellation, though referring the same matters, yet a few planets are beneficial and a 
few unbeneficial. This caused him to further carry on research and every constellation is di- 
vided into 9 unequal subs having the areas in a constellation in the proportion in which they 
are allotted the numbers of years in Vimshottari maha dasa system. 

Accordingly a planet offer the results signified by the star lord, where he is deposited during 
his dasa or sub dasa period. These results will be good or bad to the native according to the 
Signification of the sub position occupied by that planet This is the cream of the infallible 
KRISHNAMURTHI PADDHATHI propounded by our Guruji, Sothida Manan, Jeotish Marthand 
Professor K.S. Krishnamurthi.. 

In the attached bhava chart (Male, 18 Apr 1948, 12:05 pm, Galle, Sri Lanka, 06:02 N, 80:30 
E), the lagna bhava is occupied by Saturn, Moon and Mars. All these three planets are depos- 
ited in the constellation of Mercury. This Mercury Is a significator of 9 by occupation, 3 and 12 
bhavas by lordship. 

This Saturn was in the sub of Moon signifying 1 by occupation and lordship. The Moon is in the 
sub of Rahu signifying 10 by occupation and 11,4 by it's star lord Venus. Mars was in a sub of 
Jupiter signifying 6 by occupation and 6,9 by lordship. 

In the native’s Moon dasa, as the lagna lord occupying lagna should give satisfactory results. 
But due to the conjunction with Saturn as lord of 8 and 9 he will have sudden gains, loss of 
career and foreign travels etc. Moon is also in conjunction with Mars, lord of 5 and 10 would 
help the man to obtain a better position in the employment and society, to gain children and 
enjoy with music and art. 

But the native was not fortunate to enjoy such results during Moon, Mars and Saturn dasa or 
Sub periods. 

As indicated by the star lord, in one of his Mars sub dasa periods, he was transferred away 
from his native place to a remote area. He had to face all types of difficulties, unnecessary ex- 
penses and endless travelling due to the sub lord Jupiter who Is a significator of 6,9, in combi- 
nation of 9, 3 and 12 signification by the star lord Mercury. 

In a Moon dasa period, he had to leave his home and stay away. But he could obtain a promo- 
tion and a vehicle as the sub lord is Rahu signifying 11, 10 and 4. 

In a Mars dasa period, he was working away from home with lot of difficulties and uncomforts 
as the sub lord of Mars Is signifying 1, 3, 5, 9 and 12 , in combination of the star lord Mercury. 
But he was facing the difficulties with a steady mood as Mars was a significator of lagna. 
Accordingly, it is clear that the planet itself is not offering the results signified by him accord- 
ing to occupation, ownership etc; But the star lord controls everything in the dasa period of 
the planet. The sub lord decides the benefit or loss. 


LONG LIVE KRISHNAMURTHI PADDHATHI.

Here | am presenting an old prediction of Roberto Saviano case from my personal archive. 


Background 

Saviano was born in Naples on September 22, 1979. His father was catholic while his mother was 
Jewish. As a journalist, he collaborates with L’Espresso and La reblublica, and other magazines, 
and can be found in various anthologies such as Best Off. I! meglio delle riviste letterarie italiane 
(2005), and Napoli comincia a Scampia (2005). 

In 2006, following the success of the non-fiction Gomorrah, which denounces the activities of the 
Camorra, Saviano received ominous threats. These have been confirmed by the collaborators for 
justice and reports that have revealed attempts on Saviano’s life, by the Casalesi clan. Investiga- 
tors have claimed the Camorra selected Casalesi clan boss Giuseppe Setola to kill Saviano over 
the book, although the alleged hit never occurred. 

After the Neapolitan Police investigations the Italian Minister for Interior Affairs Giuloiano Amato 
assigned a personal body guard and transferred him from Naples. In autumn 2008, the informant 
Carmine Schiavone, cousin of the imprisoned Casalesi clan boss Francesco Schiavone revealed to 
the authorities that the clan had planned to eliminate Saviano and his police escort by Christmas 
on the motorway between Rome and Naples with a bomb. In the same period, Saviano announced 
his will to leave Italy, in order to stop having to live as a convict and reclaim his life. 


On 20 October 2008, six Nobel Prize-awarded authors and intellectuals published an article in 
which they say that they side with Saviano against Camorra, and they think that Camorra Is not 
just a problem of security and public order, but also a democratic one. They also think that the 
Italian government must protect his life, and help Saviano in having a normal life. Signatures are 
collected on the site of the Italian newspaper La Repubblica.

Given below are the birth particulars of a gentleman: 


Name: Mr.xXYZ 

Date of Birth: 18th October 1953 

Time of Birth: 18-20 (IST) 

Place: Tiruchirappalli (10 N 49, 78 E 41) 


The horoscope of the native is also appended for reference. 


Some relatives of the gentleman approached me on 3rd May 2010 and asked me to find out 
when the native will land on a job and permanently stick to it, as he was unemployed at that time. 
Readers may wonder why this man Is searching for job at the age of 57. It is not as though he 
was out of employment till this age. 


| was informed that he had been in various jobs from his youth but was not keen on continuing in 
any job for quite a long time. It seemed to be his habit to join a job 
and quit the same as and when he desired without thinking seriously of the consequences. 


This ‘rolling stone’ attitude of this person appeared to be strange and not easily understandable. 


However, as astrologers we also realise that the horoscope, which is the life- map of the individual 
will definitely bear a clue to this sort of behaviour. 


It is usual for me to verify the correctness of the birth time and decide whether it needs any cor- 
rection. In the instant case, the Ascendant sub-lord is Saturn. Saturn is in the star of Mars and 
Mars happens to be the star-lord of Moon. This connection between the Ascendant sub-lord and 
the Moon star-lord indicates the given time to be fairly correct and therefore | proceeded further 
with my analysis. 


It is worth briefly recapitulating the KP rules relating to employment matters at this juncture to 
get a clear picture of the case under review. 


1.For getting a job, the houses we have to look into are house two, six and ten. (2- shows income 
earned, 6- service or work by day-to-day attendance, and 10-profession. ) 


2. Change of job takes place during the period of the significators of 1,5, and 9 (12th to 2,6,10) . 
Some prefer 3,5,9 as these are houses posited in 6,8,12 to the main 10th house. 


3. If the 10" cusp sub lord signifies both 6 and 7, then the person will take up service for some- 
time and then switch over to business. 


As we all know the course of life of an individual is signified by the Lagna and whatever is prom- 
ised in the Lagna will be experienced by him. The Lagna sub-lord is Saturn in 7, lord of 10 and 11 
houses. Saturn is in the star of Mars and sub of Moon. Star lord Mars, lord of Ascendant and 8, is 
in 5. Sub lord Moon has no planet in its star and Moon ts the cuspal sub lord of 3. This signification 
of 3 and 5 Itself is ample proof that all will not be well on the service front and it will be character- 
ised by instability (5) and change (3). 


Detailed study of his dasa periods from the employable age after completion of education, say 21, 
will present a clear picture of the situation:

Background History 


From 1972, when Gaddafi relinquished the title of prime minister, he has been accorded the 
honorific Brotherly Leader and Guide of the First of September Revolution of the Great Socialist 
People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya in government statements and the official press. With the death 
of Omar Bongo of Gabon on 8 June 2009, he became the longest serving of all current non-royal 
national leaders . In 2008 a group of more than 200 African kings and traditional rulers 
proclaimed Gaddafi King of Kings of Africa. In February 2011, major political protests (inspired by 
recent similar events in Tunisia, Egypt and other parts of the Arab world) broke out in Libya 
against Gaddafi's government, which quickly turned into a general uprising. As of February 23, 
2011, Gaddafi is reported as having lost control of the eastern region of the country.

Question 1: Fortuna Calculation tn Horary Chart 

In 1978 Nov issue of A & A, page 10, Fortuna in a horary chart with a KP number is calculated 
from the "natal or time" Lagna, not from " horary" Lagna. But KPAstro 3.5 calculates Fortuna 
in a horary chart from the “horary number" Lagna. Which one is correct? Please make it 
clear. 


Answer 1 

1. In the horary chart with a KP horary number, since the house occupied by Fortuna itself 
and the houses occupied and owned by the planets are counted from the horary Lagna, it is 
more reasonable to calculate Fortuna from the " horary number" Lagna, like in the A&A Sept 
1976 p 26, Jan 1978 pp 32 & 34, Jun 1980 p 1, Dec 1980 p 30 and May 1981 p 13, by the KP 
formula below. It doesn't make sense to calculate Fortuna from the "natal or time" Lagna at 
the time of judgment, like in the A & A Nov 1978 p 10, Jun 1979 p 3 and Apr-Jun 1987 p 36. 


Fortuna = Moon + Lagna - Sun (in longitude) (KP Reader |, p 98) 


2. In the application of Fortuna in the horary chart with a number, it is better to check 
whether Fortuna is appropriately calculated from the "horary number" Lagna by the software 
used, as Fortuna is found calculated from the "natal or time" Lagna in some current horary 
charts, for instance in the KP & Astrology Year Book 2011.

page 29 it is written:

In 2. So Venus is a strong significator of marriage. .." 


But in the chart we find that Venus is not the significator of any of 2 or 7 or1l1. 

But Venus is the significator of 6 by its placement in 6.

"(c) In short if the sub lord is the significator of 1, 6 or 10, it is detrimental to the matters of 
2, 7/and11..." 


| am totally confused with these contradictory explanations. 
It would be great help in my learning if these confusions would logically be cleared. 


Answer 2 
In the example birth horoscope no. 1, page 1 of Nakshatra Chintamani, Male, 7-7-1912, 8-42 
pm IST, 23N2, 72E35, Ayanamsa 22-32, 


1. Dasa lord Venus ts in house 6, lord of houses 5,10, in the star of Jupiter in 10, I/o 3,12 and 
in the sub of Saturn in 4, l/o 1,2. 

(Here it is to consider all three steps of planet, star and sub level according to the KP funda- 
mental rule: “The planet ts the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and 
the sub ts a deciding factor whether the matter is favourable or not.”, and here to stop 
at the 3rd step of sub level, and not to go further to the 4th step, I.e. star lord of sub. 
Signification of 2 for marriage is found only by taking into consideration of sub level, which is 
stronger than the planet and star levels. Consistent consideration of all these three levels or 
three steps like in the books of Chandrakant R Bhatt and Umang Taneja would be practically 
helpful to make the correct prediction. )

Introduction 


1. This article is to study the common astrological pattern of inheritance in 31 AA inheritance 
charts with the dasa timing from the AstroDatabank 4.0 now operated by www.astro.com. Inthe 
next month article the common astrological indication of richness from self earned wealth, lottery 
and inheritance would be compared and concluded. 


2. Inheritance is seen primarily by the 8th house. Anything that is given to us through the death 
of someone close to us is eighth house territory. The 8th house is the 2nd house (gains) from the 
7th house (relationships) and represents other people's value in the form of inheritance, insurance 
policies, grants etc. Jupiter stands for money, gold and other precious salable items like diamonds 
and precious gems. Venus stands for all luxury items like spacious villas, luxurious conveyances 
and hotels, art work etc. 


8 Cuspal Sub lord 


3. For promise of inheritance, the 8'° cuspal sub lord signification of wealth generators 2"? house 
(inflow of finances), 4t° house (assets, land, vehicles), 5th house (sudden gain), 6" house (gain), 
8" house (other people's money, inheritance), 9°" (easy gains, fate) and 11 (accumulated wealth 
gain) is studied. 


4. In the analysis of 8'° cuspal sub lord of 31 AA charts under study (attached Table 1): 
a. 5H is signified by (23/74%) charts, 

b. 8H by (22/71% ) charts, 

c. 9H and 2H by (18/58% ) charts, 

d. 6H by (17/55% ) charts, 

e. L1H by (15/48% ) charts and 

f. 4H by (14/45%) charts. 

&-

Cuspal Sub lord 


5. The main house of richness, 2"? house cuspal sub lord’s signification of wealth generating 
houses is also examined. Out of 31 AA charts, the signification of 2" house indicates (attached 
Table 2): 

a. 2H Is signified by (22/71% ) charts, 

b. 8H by (21/68% ) charts, 

c. 5H by (19/61%) charts, 

d. 11H, 9H and 6H by (17/55% ) charts and 

4H by (15/48%) charts. 


DBA Lords 


6. The signification of Dasa-Bhukti-Antara lords at the time of inheritance of wealth generating 
houses is analyzed. Out of 35 inheritance events of 31 AA charts, the signification of DBA lords is 
found that (attached Table 3): 

a. 8H Is signified by (33/94% ) events, 

b. 5H by (30/86%) events, 

c. Q9Hand11H by (29/83% ) events, 

d. 2H and 6H (28/80% ) events, and 

4H (25/71%) events.

Transit 


7. The transit of DBA lords and luminaries at the time of inheritance is found as under: 

A. Out of 98 DBAs of inheritance of 31 AA charts, DBA lords were found transiting in the star or 
sub of the same DBA lords in 65 (66%) DBAs; and 

B. Out of 63 luminary transit points of inheritance of 31 AA charts, Sun and Moon were found 
transiting in the star or sub of the DBA lords in 41 (65%) transit points. 


Other Findings 
8. Other findings of interest are as given below: 

A. Natal Jupiter is found connected in any way with the 8'" house in 27 (87%) charts out of 31 
AA charts under study, as one of the most commonly seen indications of inherited wealth 
found in “Lois M Rodden: Money: How to Find It with Astrology, 2006, p 1/70; 

B. Jupiter and Pluto connection for gain of wealth or gains from inheritance (Noel Tyl: Solar 
Arcs, 2001, p 93; Celeste Teal: Predicting Events With Astrology, 2009, pp 80, 268) Is 
found only in 8 (26%) charts only; 

C. Pluto, Jupiter, Moon, Sun in 8", Fortuna in 2"? or 8" house for inheritance are not found 
Significant in the natal charts; 

D. Transit J upiter’s Hindu aspects and conjunction with Uranus, both transit and natal, for sud- 
den windfalls of wealth (Vivian E. Robson: A Students’ Textbook of Astrology, 2010 p 113) 
is found in 20 (59%) cases, out of 34 inheritance transit points; 

E. Transit J upiter’s Hindu aspects and conjunction with Pluto, both transit and natal, for enor- 
mous wealth is found in 12 (35%) cases only, out of 34 inheritance transit points; 

F. The DBA signification of the 10° house (Maraka for parents) is found in 29 (83%) events, 
out of 35 inheritance events, in line with around 25 (71%) events of parental inheritance; 

Observation 
9. In the promise and timing of inheritance, the most common prominent wealth generators 
found to be signified are 2"? house (inflow of finances), 5th house (sudden gain), 8°" house 

(other people's money, inheritance) and 9" (easy gains, fate). 

10. In addition the natal Jupiter’s connection with the 8'" house is also found to play a significant 
role in the inheritance of wealth. 

11. At the time of inheritance the DBA lords and luminaries were generally found transiting in the 
star or sub of the same DBA lords.

This birth chart belongs to a person, who is blessed with three children, first daughter, second 
son and the last daughter. The native was born in Galle, Sri Lanka on the 6" of January 1950 
at 05.55 am. His KP birth chart is attached. 


Promise of Having Children 


His first daughter was born on 10 September 1985 in Kandy, Sri Lanka . We need to check 
first, whether the native is blessed to have children according to his birth chart. For the male 
(father) first eleventh cusp and then only the fifth cusp show about promise of having chil- 
dren. (KP Reader IV page 224) 


Eleventh cusp falls in Libra, in the star and sub of Jupiter. Fifth cusp falls in Aries, in the star of 
Venus and sub of Jupiter. This sub lord Jupiter of both eleventh and fifth cusps is the deciding 
factor for promise of having children. The planet Jupiter owns the first and fourth bhavas and 
IS deposited in the ascendant but exactly on the second cusp, giving the results of second 
bhava. Jupiter is in the star of Moon and sub of own Jupiter. No planet is in the stars of J upiter 
and Jupiter is a strong significator of second, fifth and eleventh bhavas by being the cuspal sub 
lord of these bhavas required for promise of having children. So the native ts fortunate to 
have children. 


Dasa Analysis 


At the time of birth of this girl, the father was under the influence of Venus Dasa, Mars Bhukti 
and Rahu Antra. This Dasa lord Venus is the owner of sixth and eleventh bhavas and occupy- 
ing the second bhava. This Venus is deposited in the star of Mars and sub of Rahu. Star lord 
Mars is the owner of fifth and twelfth bhavas and occupying the ninth bhava. Sub lord Rahu ts 
deposited in the third bhava and it's sign lord Jupiter is the significator of second, fifth and 
eleventh bhavas, as discussed above. Thus Dasa lord is signifying or connected with second, 
fifth and eleventh bhavas required to have a child. 


The Bhukti lord Mars is the owner of sixth and eleventh bhavas and deposited in the ninth 
bhava. This Mars is deposited in the star and sub of Moon, who owns eighth bhava and occu- 
pies the seventh bhava of the native. Bhukti lord is signifying or connected with the eleventh 
bhava. 


The Antra lord Rahu is deposited in the third bhava and it's sign lord Jupiter is the significator 
of second, fifth and eleventh bhavas, as discussed above. Rahu is in the star of Mercury and 
sub of Ketu. Star lord Mercury owns seventh and tenth bhavas and occupies Ascendent but to 
second cusp. Sub lord Ketu is deposited in the ninth bhava and conjoined with Mars who is the 
owner of sixth and eleventh bhavas and deposited in the ninth bhava. Ketu is aspected 
by Jupiter which is the significator of second, fifth and eleventh bhavas, as discussed above. 
Hence Antra lord is signifying or connected with second, fifth and eleventh bhavas. 


Transit Analysis 

At the time of birth of this daughter (10° September 1985), the Dasa lord Venus was transit- 
ing in the star of Mercury, which is close to second cusp, and sub of Sun, and also in exact op- 
position to the natal position of own Venus in the second bhava. 


The Bhukti lord Mars was transiting in the star of Ketu and sub of Antra lord Rahu. 


In transit, Antra lord Rahu was in very close conjunction with fifth cusp and in the star of Ve-

2nd Marriage Rules 


As per the statistical study of 100 AA multi-marriage charts done by Sri Kanak Bosmia, the second 
marriage can be predicted after checking a chart by all the followingthree rules: 


Rule-1: More than one marriage is indicated if both the following two conditions 
are simultaneously satisfied: 
|.The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its Star lord is deposited in a dual sign 
(Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces) OR if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/ Jupiter; and 


|.The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 or 
both. 


If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


Rule-2: Second marriage Is indicated if the sub-lord of the 2nd cusp Is also a significator of either 
of the houses 7 or 11. 


Rule-3: As per Kanak Bosmia, on assumption that 2"? wife is considered as younger sister of first 


one, second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a significator of either of the 
houses 2, 9 or 11.

Co-ordinates of judgment: 
In a query relating to the premises and its suitability to the native actually revolves around the 4" 
cusp/house. In order that the house/property is suitable in general, the 4° cusp should be favora- 


bly disposed to the lagna and linked to 11" house. 


In case, if the 4'" cusp links to the adverse houses from lagna, the native would get the trouble 
related to those adverse houses. 


The seller is signified by the 7° house and the property on sale is signified by the 10" house (4° 
from 7" house). 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the 
Moon indicates the status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Look to the lagna Sub-lord Saturn, which is placed in the star of Moon placed in 4" house. 
Moon itself gets placed in 4 house indicating the mind dwelling on the property in view. Moon is 
the sub lord of 3™ and 12" cusp indicating some sense of discomfort inside to go ahead with the 
property in mind. 
Thus, the query was well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 
Analysis:

falls in the star of Venus placed in 6" house. The sub-lord of Mercury is Jupiter which is placed 
in the 10 house. Till now, things seemed OK, as there seemed some understanding between 


the native and the seller. 


Mercury is also the sub-lord of the 8" cusp that indicated to me that the property may not be 
found suitable ultimately. 


2. Examine the 10“ cusp 


Saturn is the 10" cuspal sub-lord that signifies the property for sale from the seller’s side. Sat- 
urn being the sub-lord shows that the property was not yet ready for occupation and had good 
time for its completion. 


Saturn was found to be in the star of Moon placed in 4°" house, thus the native was consider- 
ing for purchasing it. Saturn was placed in the sub of 3™ lord Sun placed in 8" house thus; it 
did not seem possible for the native to purchase it due to sme reasons. 


Note that 10" cuspal sub-lord was signifying 8°" house (2"° house from 7" house) through sub 


placement and 3™ house by the lordship of sub-lord. In this case, the signification of 8°" house 
is strong in comparison to that of 3™ house meaning that the property shall not be sold to the
