Question 1: 

Sir, to know transit (Sensitive Point) for an event in a DASHA-BUKTHI-ANTHRA period , we 
take Signs of respective DASHA Lords to start. 

For a person running RAHU or KETHU DASHA, which House sign should be taken for transit for 
these DASHA Lords. 


Answer 1: 
For the chosen DBA of fruitful significators for an event to materialize, say conjoined period of 
Sun, Venus, Mercury, then Sun sign, Venus star, Mercury sub; Venus sign, Sun star, Mercury 
sub, and Mercury sign, Sun star, Venus sub are the three sensitive and fruitful positions, which 
will be transited by Ascendant, Luminaries and the planets ruling the Dasa, Bhukti and An- 
thara. The sensitive positions when transited by the Ascendant 
degree, the exact hour and minute of the event can be told. If Moon is moved to that sensitive 
degree the day of the event can be arrived at. If the Sun, then month. If Jupiter then the year 
can be arrived at. (KP Reader V pp 161-163/ Old Edition 154-156/, Reader VI p 131, RP & KP 
p 69-72) 


The ° Sensitive Point' article in "Astrosecrets & KP, Part Il, 2003, pp 141-146 is a compilation 
of references, like KP Reader V pp 161-163 (Old Edition 154-156), 189-192 (Old Edition 180- 
182), RP & KP, 1985, pp 85-89, Astrosecrets & KP, Part II, 2003, pp 86-105 etc. Some salient 
points from this article are as follows: 


1. For selected Dasa and Bhukti for fructification of the event, Sun will either transit in rasi of 
Dasa lord and star of Bhukti lord, or rasi of Bhukti lord and star of Dasa lord. However, in KP of 
stellar theory, instead of taking sign, Sun will transit in star of Dasa lord and sub of Bhukti lord 
(there will be three such points in the zodiac one of each star). 

2. Note down the Antara period in which one has won and in which one has lost. When Moon 
will transit through star and sub of these planets, one will get similar results. 

3. If one has got the horoscope, note down the significator of 6 and 11 for gaining, and 8 and 
12 for losing. When Moon passes through star and sub of 6 and 11, one will make profit. When 
Moon passes through star and sub of 8 and 12, one will lose. 

For timing an event, the sensitive zone is a point in the Zodiac mainly ruled by the Dasa lord 
and Bhukti lord of fructiful significators of an event. J upiter’s transit of sensitive points indi- 
cates year of fructification of the event. Sun's transit over such sensitive point will tell about 
month and Moon's transit will tell about the day. 


The next article "Promotion - When" in Astrosecrets & KP, Part Il, 2003, pp 147-155, shows 
practically about the application of sensitive points.

Tables of houses from O to 60 degrees. 


The Krishnamurti Padhdhati system of sub-lords requires great accuracy with house cusps. The 
Raphael’s Tables of Houses (first published in 1821) provide only ascendant position up to the de- 
gree and minute and other cuspal positions to the nearest degree only. The current Universal 
Table of Houses or Michelsen Book of Tables gives the cuspal positions up to the degree and min- 
ute. These Krishman KP Tables of Houses have been prepared to produce cuspal positions accu- 
rate to the nearest seconds. The manual calculation by using these current Universal or Michelsen 
or Krishman Tables of Houses provides the cuspal positions very close to the SW results. The 
manual calculation of planetary positions from the American Ephemeris can give the nearest accu- 
racy of Swiss Ephemeris using SW. 


In these Krishman tables, for each degree of latitude (0 to 60 degrees) and for all sidereal times 
ranging from OO hours to 24 hours with intermediate positions at every 4 minutes of S.T. are 
given all 360 degrees for Right Ascension on the Midheaven (RAMC). The tables produce Placidus 
house cusps, which are given in 360 degree notation in Tropical (not sidereal) zodiac. Convert by 
deducting the ayanamsa of your choice (a table of Krishnamurti ayanamsas are given, from 1900 
to 2050). These days the KP New Ayanamsa of 2003 can be used.

Background 
Swiss police revealed that the father of missing Swiss six-year-old twins told their mother he had 
killed the girls in a letter sent shortly before he committed suicide in southern Italy. 


The revelation a week after his death came as dozens of French police combed one of his last 
stopovers, the Mediterranean island of Corsica, for traces of the daughters, including areas where 
Schepp had visited on holidays in recent years. 


Police, who have described the 43-year-old as a "desperate person" during his three-country dash 
last week, said that the last letter was post-marked the day he threw himself under a train. 


“The last envelope dated February 3 contained a letter in which the father said he killed the two 
girls, saying he was in Cerignola (southern Italy) where he was about to kill himself," Vaud re- 
gional police spokesman Jean-Christophe Sauterel told journalists. 


“I can confirm that in his letter he also said that they did not suffer and were resting in peace," he 
added. 


“In all likelihood they are in Corsica," said Sauterel.

The Hindu New Year Chart

The Hindu New Year chart of 2011 for Libya, is frightening because of as many as six planets, 
Sun, Moon, Mar, Mercury, Jupiter and Uranus, in the 8" house of mass deaths. In addition the 8° 
house is aspected by the 6" and 7" lord Saturn. 

But the Hindu New Year chart of 2011 does not show any sign of regime change till March 2012 as 
the 10" lord Venus is nicely placed in the 7 house. It is supported by the 10" CSL favorable sig- 
nification for the ruler of Libya, i.e. counting from 10" (ruler), 10° CSL Moon(11,3) is in the star 
of Mercury(11,5-2) and sub of Venus+(10,6-1) having no planet in its star and being the CSL of

This was the question that sprang to my mind as | saw the news media consuming a big chunk of 
air time on NDTV on 27 April 2011 to this issue. | have taken a random computer generated num- 
ber 147 (within 249) to deal with this question. The chart is plotted on 27 April 2011, time 
04:34:24 PM at Pretoria, South Africa 28* 15' 23" E and 25* 47' 14" S at 04:34:24 pm on 
Wednesday. The chart is attached herewith. 


The main issue is that a controversy has arisen in regard to Mr. Joshi's PAC report which Congress 
and others have condemned as not being fair and not representing the views of the Commission 
as a whole. The allegation is that Mr. Joshi has misused his position to condemn the government, 
and the other members of the Commission have had no chance to make their analysis or com- 
ments in the report. There is a public outcry and a call from senior political circles for Mr. Joshi to 
resign. NDTV described the allegations against Mr. Joshi as being a “unilateralist, un- 
democratic, and possessing a hidden agenda.” 


Obviously, this situation also involves another question t.e. whether there is any truth tn 
the allegations being leveled against Mr. Joshi. However, in this analysis | have not 
dealt with this issue and have concentrated only on whether Mr. J oshi will have to re- 
Sign. 


Any resignation from a public office, based on allegations of misuse of office, is also a blot on the 
reputation of the individual. The political standing of the individual concerned suffers a blow. In- 
terestingly, name and reputation, as well as the current position of political office, are all shown 
by the same house I.e. the 10th. Here the question is not so much of service or income which may 
involve the 2nd and 6th houses as well. This is a case where, pure and simple, the issue is con- 
tinuance in a public office of a political nature. 


Looking at it from this point of view, the 10th shows one's public office, name and reputation. If 
one's reputation has to suffer due to a scandal of some kind, the 8th and 12th houses also play a 
major role. It must also be noted that the 5th house Is the 8th from the 10th and will play a role 
in case of having to resign on account of a ‘controversy’ or ‘disgrace’. In any case, the 5" negates 
the 6'" which indicates the current job. 


Having set the parameters of 5h, 8th and 12th houses for analysis of downfall, after successful 
political carrier through the signification of 1,6,9,10 and 11 houses by the strong Jupiter, Mercury 
and Saturn (KP Reader III page 395), let us proceed in the usual manner. Let us first look at what 
the Moon and Ascendant indicate. 


THE MOON 


1. The Moon ts tn the 4th and rules the 10th. It is in the Star of Rahu who is in the 2nd. But Rahu 
also represents its sign lord Jupiter in 6th and ruling 3 and 6. Jupiter has no planets in its star and 
it is the sub lord of 2,3,8,9, and 10. Moon is in the sub of Saturn (R) in the 11th and rules the 4th 
and 5th. 


2. Overall, the Moon clearly indicates the mental focus on 8 (trouble, disturbance, scandal, etc.), 
4 (end of everything), and 5 (quarrel, scandal, blot on profession - being 8th to the 10th) The 
11th is the only saving grace. But the 11th is by itself and the other indications are fairly negative. 


THE ASCENDANT 


1. The Lagna Sub Lord is Mars who is in the 6th and rules 1 and 2. It is in the Star of Mercury 
who Is also strong being in its own star. Mercury is in 5 and rules 9 and 12. It is in the Sub of 
Rahu tn 2 (and as indicated under Moon, Rahu also represents its sign lord Jupiter in 6th and rul- 
ing 3 and 6. Jupiter has no planets in its star and it is the sub lord of 2,3,8,9, and 10.)

This case is a case from my file of records. One of my friends’ daughter (Doctor) telephoned me to 
know, If tt would be good for her to start a clinic of her own as a changeover from the salaried job, 
which she was doing at that point of time. Thus, the question was regarding the self-employment. 


| did not take any horary number from her and instead considered the time chart to indicate the 
prashna query. The time chart was worked out on March 09, 2010 at 11-56-45 Hrs IST at Banga- 
lore. The time chart is as attached. 

Co-ordinates of judgment: 

In a query relating to the professional success in self-employment (Business) than the Service, 
the 7 house gets prominent, as this house provides the prospects of self-employment. In case, if 
the 6" house gets connected to the 7 house, the natives do their karma with diligence. The 3rd 
house indicates the initiative that the native takes in setting up his own venture. The 10" house 
has its own importance, as it decides the flow of karmas. 


Finally, the dasha sequence plays finally decisive role and for the positive results, the dasha plan- 
ets should be well disposed towards fructification with favorable transits. 


The Query: 


Fundamentally, in any prashna, the lagna indicates the subject matter of the query, while the 
Moon indicates the status of mind and the matter on which the querist dwells about. 


Lagna sub-lord is Mars, which is also the sub-lord of 7° cusp placed in 2"° house. Thus, the pro- 
posal of self-employment seems promised with good returns (2°? house). Moon gets placed in 7° 
house itself that shows the scenario of self-employment. 


Thus, the query is well indicated in the prashna chart and it was comfortable to proceed further. 


Analysis 

1. Examine the 7“ cusp. 

Examine the 7™ cusp to see the potential of self-employment. 

7 cuspal sub-lord is Mars, which is a strong planet as there is no planet in its stars, thus its 
placement is important to study. Note that Mars is placed in the 2 house and aspecting the 10th 
cusp, denoting the self-employment with the strong possibility of good earnings (2"° house). Mars 


is the self strong planet with no planet in it's stars. 


At the stellar level, Mars falls in the star of Saturn and in the sub of Mercury placed in 10 house. 
Thus, 7°" cuspal sub-lord Mars is expected to promote the native to venture the self employment. 


2. Examine the 10“ house 

10°" cuspal sub-lord is strong lagna lord and 6" lord Venus that falls in the star of Saturn in 4 
house and in the sub of own Venus placed in 10°" house. This indicates a good sign for the native 
to be successful in the proposed venture of self-employment. 


3. Look to Fortuna 


Fortuna gets placed in the 10 house. Fortuna falls in the star of Saturn and in the sub of 3" lord 
Moon placed in the 7" house. This also promotes the desire of the native.

4. Examine the 11™ cusp. 
By the examination of the various cusps so far, the results were expected very positive. 


11 cuspal sub-lord is Ketu, which falls in the star of J upiter placed in 10" house very close to the 
10° cusp. This was a good indication. Ketu is placed in the sub of Mercury (strong lord of 5™ 
house) placed in 10" house. 


It may be noted that the 11" cuspal sub-lord links itself to the 10 house by way of both the star 
lord and sub-lord. This is taken very positive and it was inferred that the venture of the native to- 
wards self employment is well promised. 


5. Examine Dasha sequence 

At the time of query, the dasha of Ketu-Mercury-Rahu was operating till March 19, 2011. 

Ketu and Mercury have been found good in the forgoing analysis. Briefly examining, the next 
Antara was that of Jupiter from March 19, 2011 to May O07, 2011 and that of Saturn till July 02, 
2010. 

Jupiter is the strong 11" lord and was placed close to 10" cusp in 10 house. On a quick over- 
view, it was found that Jupiter falls in the sub of Sun placed in the 10" house, the Jupiter was 


considered a favorable period to start off the venture of self employment. 


Saturn is the lord of 9° and 10" house, falls in the sub of Venus placed in 10" house. Thus, the 
Saturn pratyantara was also favorable to the native. 


6. Conclusion 

Looking to all logistics of analysis as above, the native was given a positive response towards the 
Success and was asked to go ahead with the venture of setting up the clinic. It was also indicated 
that the period during March 19, 2011 to July 02, 2010 in the dasha sequence of Ketu-Mercury- 
J upiter/Saturn was favorable. 

Fact of the case: 


Native started the own clinic in the last week of June 2010 and Is earning well.

A client from Chandigarh who was trying hard to sale his house but was not successful due to one 
reason or other and he was disappointed and as he want to clear off his debits he approached me 
to know astrologically if sale deed will mature or not. | asked him to tell me any number between 
1 to 249 and he told number 3 and | made calculation on dated 26-10-2008 at 12:07pm at 
Chandigarh and the Horary chart is attached. 


Gulberga Theory 


As per Gulberga theory of if Asc sub lord of the no’s put up for query is the same as moon star 
lord. Then the answer is positive. In this case Asc sub lord of query is sun & moon star lord is also 
Sun. So | told him confidently that he will be able to sell his home and he should not have any 
worry and to further check if desire to be fulfilled at the earliest or not. 


Analysis of Fulfillment of Desire 


1lith cusp sub lord Mercury(6,3,4) Is in star lord Moon(6,5) and sub lord Ve(8,2,7). Here 11th 
cusp sub lord also signifies the relevant houses 6,5 & 3. Moreover Mercury and Moon are fast 
moving planets, so the querent’s desire will be fulfilled at the earliest. 


KP Rule for Sale of House 


As per horary astrology (advanced stellar system) of KP Sixth Reader written by Guruji K.S. Krish- 
namurti, page 177-178 and mysteries of KP astrology part-Il written by late Sh Suresh Sa- 
hashne, page 102: 


1Oth cusp sub lord should not be retrograde and it should also not be in constellation of retrograde 
planet and it should be the significator 10, 5 or 6. 

As 10th sub lord Saturn is not retrograde and its star lord Venus is also not retrograde and 10th 
cusp sub lord Saturn(6,11) is in start lord Venus (8,2,7) and sub lord Mercury(6,3,4), the 10th 
cusp sub lord signifies the relevant houses for sale of house. 


7th is purchaser 

10th is 4 to 7 

6th is 12 to 7, expenditure of purchaser 
5th is 11 to 7, gain to purchaser 


Dasa Analysis 


On 26-10-2008 Moon’s star lord was (purav falguni) Sun and sub lord was Venus. 
So it was passing in Sun Dasha, Venus Bhukti (26.08.2008 to 26.08.2009). 


Sun Dasha - Sun(7,6), star lord Rahu(11), sub lord Jupiter (10,9,10). 

Venus Bhukti - Venus (8,2,7), star lord Saturn(6,11,12), sub lord J upiter(10, 9,10) 

Hence Dasha and Bhukti are supportive for the sale of the house as they are the significators of 6 
& 10 and also 2,6,11. So! told the querent that he would get good profit from the sale of house. 


Fixing the Date of Sale 
As 11th cusp sub lord and star lord are Mercury and Moon, both are the fast moving planets , and 


as the event was likely to be happen within week’s time so | decided to move the position of Moon 
Star lord (Nakshatra).

Answer- 3: 


The Ascendant position of a KP horary chart with number (1-249) is fixed according to the 249 
Subs table in the KP Reader VI pages 89-97, e.g. for the horary number 49, the horary chart 
fixed Asc. is Ge 10.26.40 (sgl Mercury, stl Rahu, sbl Saturn) remains the same irrespective of 
the date or time or place of casting the chart. Based on the 1st cusp or Ascendant position of 
a horary number, the cuspal positions of other houses are calculated for the latitude of the 
place of judgment by the astrologer. Other cuspal sub lords will change according to the place 
of judgment. The planetary positions are worked out by the natal or time chart for the date, 
time and place of judgment when the astrologer commences analyzing the chart. The natal 
chart Asc. is different from the horary chart Asc., e.g. for 25.01.2011, 15.22.41 pm IST, Ban- 
galore, 12n51, 77e40, KPNA 23.55.16, the natal chart Asc. is Ge 2’16.55 (sgl Mercury, stl 
Mars, sbl Ketu) .

the house cusps, including the Lagna, change whereas Moon is in the same degree and minute 
and in the same Bhava, same Navamsa, same Ashtagavarga, having same Shadbala and eve- 
rything remaining the same. It is also found that it is the cusp of 12 houses which vary in 
twin births and therefore it is the cusp which should indicate whether that house 
matter will prosper or that house matter will suffer.” 

-KP Reader III, pp 432-433 (Original Edition, Practical Part, p 259)

Question - 6: 


Why is one hour difference in the starting time of Moon’s entry into the star of Mars on 
06.10.1945 I.e. “18:24” pm by a SW and “19:23” pm by another SW? 


Answer- 6: 

It is due to application of IST by the first SW and WT (war time) by the second SW. 
During the war period form 1.9.1942 to 14.10.1945, the IST was advanced by one hour as War 
Time (WT) prescribed by British. 

Therefore any recorded time during this war period must be reduced by one hour to get the 
corrected IST and to apply the IST using ephemeris’ all the time including the war period. The 
Indian Ephemeris’ give the position of planets either mostly for 5:30 am IST (referring 00:00 
midnight GMT/UT, KP by Maharbala or Krishman, Lahiri) or long ago 5:30 pm IST (referring 
12:00 noon GMT/UT, Krishnamurti, Raman, some old Lahiri). 

The IST using ephemeris’ for the war period were used in the following rectification examples: 

a) KP Reader | pp 137-138; 

b) Rectification of Birth Time by K. Hariharan, 1994, pp 26-28, 60-62 

c) Secrets of R.P. & the Birth Time by K. Baskaran, 1999, pp 18-20, 36-42, 51-54 

d) Astrosecrets & KP, Part IV, Rectification of Birth Time, 2009-2010, pp 69-77. 


It is therefore to check whether the SW used by one Is applying the automatic DST 
Lhr (WT TZ 6:30) or not. As the DST lLhr is automatically applied in a few SWs, the regular 
IST TZ (5:30) can be applied during the war period by switching the DST Lhr (6:30 WT TZ) to 
the DST Ohr (5:30 IST TZ) as cautioned by the Astrodienst SW below: 

Time zone: 6 h 30 min east, Daylight Saving T. 

ATTENTION: British prescribed war time, observed by Europeans only. 

Use 5e30 manual time zone.

Research on Earthquakes Applying KP Astrology 


Via Nicolo’33 Isola del Gransasso (Te), ITALY| | 
E-mail: Vediko@libero.1 





I have made an attempt of research to find the rules for mundane prediction of 
earthquake. I have tested 100 accurate cases of earthquakes from the following source 
using the KP rules given under. 


http://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/world/historical.php 


For any earthquake: 


1S* house presents condition of country, 4 house - earthquakes and 8" house - natural 
disasters, calamity. 


Rule-1: If the sub lord of the 1* cusp signifies 4 (earthquake), 8(disasters, calamity), 12 
(unseen danger) together with mrk & bdk, there could be an earthquake in the country. 


Rule-2: (Kanak Bosmia) If the sub lord of the 4" (earthquake) cusp be the significator of 
8 (natural disaster), 12 (loss) & 3 (loss of property), there could be the earthquake 
disaster during the joint period of the significators of 3,8,12. 


Rule-3: ( Kanak Bosmia) If the sub lord of the 8™ ( natural disaster) cusp be the 
significator of 8 (natural disaster), 12 ( loss) & 3 ( loss of property ), there could be the 
earthquake disaster during the joint period of the significators of 3,8,12. 


So to predict any earthquake, first condition is to look at the 1° cusp sub lord (condition 
of country). If it signifies 4,8 or 12 together with mrk,bdk, there is a great possibility 
for any natural disaster in the country: if it signifies only mrk,bdk, there is a little 
possibility and only 4,8,12 the danger could be much less. Second condition is all the 3 
rules must be satisfied for any earthquake and the last condition is D.B.A. must agree 
with the event. 


For any death in the earthquake: 
1°" cusp sub lord must signify both mrk & bdk houses. 


Rule-2 ( Kanak Bosmia ) If the sub lord of the 4" or 8™ cup signifies 5 (2" (maraca) from 
4), 10 (7 (maraca) from 4 ), 3 (12™ (mosksha) from 4) and bdk, the people of 
country will die in earthquake disaster during the joint period of the signficators of 3,5,10 
and bdk. 


With this in mind I will illustrate the recent Japan earthquake on March 11, 2011 & make 
a prediction for any earthquake in May in Rome. Rumors are here in Italy for a prediction 
made by a man called “Brendanti” that some say it is not true. Anyway, in the past he had 
correctly predicted earthquakes in Italy. 


http://www.esplorandoroma.it/en/EsPlOrAnDo-Roma-News/Other-News/Terremoto-a-Roma-l- 
11-maggio-tutto-falso.html

Elections in Portuga 
Who will win these elections ? 





Sunday the 5" of June 2011 is important for Peru and Portugal. Both countries are going to 
the polls and, in both countries, the elections are hotly contested. It will be interesting to 
analyse the outcome of these elections. The analysis that follows has been undertaken using 
Kanak ji’s rules relating to victory in elections. 


Elections in Portugal 





Jose Socrates has vowed to protect welfare programmes. 
Social Democrat leader Pedro Passos Coelho said he would cut wasteful state spending. 


“Voters in Portugal are due to go to the polls to choose a new government which will implement a 
demanding 78bn euro ($/116bn; £70bn) bail-out. Opinion polls suggest the opposition centre-right 
Social Democrats (PSD) lead the governing Socialists but not by enough to form a majority. 


Analysts say the PSD may try to form a coalition with the third-ranked CDS. All the main parties 
endorsed the bail-out, which requires tough austerity measures amid a faltering economy. 


Socialist leader Jose Socrates resigned as prime minister in March, triggering early elections after the 
opposition in parliament rejected his minority government's fourth austerity package in less than a 
year. Since then, he has acted as caretaker prime minister. 


‘Politically difficult’ : Portugal is faced with unemployment of more than |2% and an economy that is 
expected to contract by 2% this year and next. 


Polls suggest the centre-right Social Democrats will win nearly 37% of the vote, compared to about 
31% for the Socialists. Party leader Pedro Passos Coelho suggested this week that he was the 
preferred candidate of donors to the bail-out fund. 


Whoever wins on Sunday will have to enact urgent and far-reaching social and fiscal reforms, 
including more austerity measures, to restore national fiscal health and encourage growth. The 
terms of the bail-out call for tax hikes, a freeze on state pensions and salaries and cuts in 
unemployment benefits. 


"The road with this package is long and filled with reforms which may be politically difficult to pass, " 
Diego Iscaro, an economist at IHS Global Insight, told Reuters news agency.

The methodology of judgment: 


For assessing the sex of the child born, the 5" cusp has the key. 


The sub-sub lord of the 5” cusp if placed in an odd sign (male sign) could lead us the 
inference of a male child birth, similarly otherwise. 


The sub-sub lord of the sub-sub lord of 5" cusp may also be examined for its similar 
placement and if that planet were placed in a male sign, the male child male birth could be 


predicted.

between |-2193 ora time chart to come to conclusion.

It says that the marriages are made in the heaven. Therefore the details of the marriage can 
be seen from the birth chart of a person, as every event of life of a person or and 
organization is written in the birth chart of the moment of commencement of the event. 


Here we are trying to analyse a birth chart of a person who had his two marriages 
celebrated in his life time. The owner of this birth chart is a friend of mine and he has 
disclosed all his important events of his life and we have analysed a number of these 
important matters and found that they are easily matching with the birth chart according to 
the dasa periods he was running. 


The owner of this birth chart was born in a place called Ahangama in the southern province 
of Sri Lanka. The birth chart prepared according to Krishnamurthi Paddhathi is attached. 


For marriage we consider the seventh bhava as the primary indicator. Sub lord of the 
seventh cusp is the decider. In this birth chart, the seventh cusp falls in the sign of Gemini 
17.50.16. It is in the star of Rahu and sub of Sun. The sub lord Sun is deposited in the sign of 
Sagittarius, a dual sign and also in conjunction with Mercury, which is the dual planet. The 
position of the seventh sub lord shows plurality in all matters connected with him. This sub 
lord Sun was a significator for sixth, eleventh, ninth and twelveth bhavas. Therefore it is 
clear that the native is destined to get married. 


The marriage of a person will be celebrated during the conjoined period of the significators 
for second, seventh and eleventh bhavas, when the significators of these planets are in 
agreement with the dasa and sub dasa periods and also in agreement with the transit of dasa 
lords and the luminaries, namely Sun and Moon.

Second bhava — was owned by Saturn and no planet was deposited in this bhava. Moon 
and Jupiter were deposited in the stars of Saturn. So Moon, Jupiter and Saturn are the 
significators of second bhava.

Mars, Saturn and Kethu were deposited in the stars of Mercury. Thus Mars, Saturn, Kethu 
and Mercury are the significators of seventh bhava. 


Eleventh Bhava — Venus was the owner of this bhava. Saturn and Venus were deposited in 
the bhava. Sun was deposited in the star of Venus. Moon and Jupiter were deposited in the 
stars of Saturn. So Sun, Moon, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn are the significators of eleventh 
bhava.

Question- 3: 
| have some observations and queries on conjunctions and aspects between planets. | would 
like some clarification on these comments/questions: 


|. In KP Astrology, Rahu and Ketu absorb the energies and significations of the planets in 
the following order: 


(i) Planets that are in conjunction with them; 
(ii) If no planets are in conjunction then the planets that aspect them; 
(iii) | If no planets are either in conjunction or aspecting them, then the planet that is 


the Star Lord of these shadowy planets; and 
(iv) — Lastly of their Sign Lords. 


2. A conjunction is an aspect as well. It is an aspect formed by the proximity of the planet 
and the Shadowy planets, and allows Rahu/Ketu to absorb the significations of the planet in 
conjunction with them. 


3. Would the same apply to other planets as well? In other words, and for example, if the 
significations of Venus were being analysed, and Venus was in conjunction with Mars and 
Jupiter, would Venus be able to provide the significations of Mars and Jupiter? 


4. Similarly, in the above example if Venus was aspecting Mars and Jupiter, would Mars and 
Jupiter’s significations be considered to be provided by Venus due to its aspect on these 
planets? 


5. This question becomes particularly important when there are two or more planets in 
conjunction such as in the months of April-May 2011, Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury 
were conjunct in Pisces. Here, would each planet be considered to have multiple 
significations as provided by the other planets conjoined with them? 


6. Let us say that in the above conjunction of planets, Mercury signifies |, 3, and 4 and 
does not signify any of the relevant houses for analysing job prospects. However, Jupiter 
does signify 2 and ||. Would Mercury here be considered to provide the significations of 
Jupiter and, therefore, be fruitful for job prospects? 


7. Of course, the ultimate decision regarding the job would be taken by the Sub Lord of 
the signifying planet. However, in the above example, Mercury may not signify the job 
related houses either at its own, or its Star levels and not even at its Sub level. Jupiter, on 
the other hand, may signify the relevant houses at its own and Stellar levels, and this may be 
supported by the Sub level. Would, Mercury, then, be considered to positively indicate a job 
(due to Jupiter being conjunct) and would it be said to be decisively favourable (due to the 
Sub lord signification of Jupiter). 


8. Another important question would arise as a natural corollary to the issue of aspects. 
The planets are considered to be significators as well. What about the reverse? If a signifying 
planet is aspected by other planets, would those other planets become significators of the 
same issue as signified by the planet that is aspected? For example, Venus in the 2nd and

Saturn be considered to be a significator along with Venus for the matters of the 2nd? 


Answer- 3: 
|. The Rahu/Ketu signification rules are not applicable to other planets. 


2. Conj/Aspt is given top priority for Ra/Ke but it is the weak grade E significator for other

of an matter or significators of the bhava in question or considering the effects of dasa 
period lords. 


3. Mere Hindu Conj/Aspt is sufficient in case of Ra/Ke but for other planets, only those 
planets Conj/Aspt by the grade A to D significators are to be considered on event by event

One of my neighbors started to dig a well in last April 2011 in his owned land. As it is in the 
very close vicinity to my residence, | could notice that the land lord had not yet finished his 
job of making a new well. A few days back when I was in a friendly chat with him, he spewed 
out some agonized utterances on the delay of completing the works of well enabling him to 
consume pure well water. Furthermore he uttered that the existing well used by him 
currently is badly corrupted with mud due to collapsing of the banks beyond repair. So the 
new one, under construction is the second well of that family. 


At the end of our meeting on the 10th June 2011, for my study of the muhurat chart below | 
could obtain the date and time, when he started the digging and according to him the 
physical reasons for the delay of completing the job are as follows: 


|. After digging 8 meters they had found a hard stone (rock) and the laborers had asked him 
to blast the stone and call them back. 


2. My neighbor had to face some troubles in finding out a blaster as it should be done with a 
perfect authority of the local Government authority and the Police Department to use 
Gelignite for blasting. 


3. On the [2th April the stone was blasted and as a result some fountains were cleared and 
water started flowing. 


4. At night of the same day there was a heavy rain till the following morning and the well 
was full of water. 


5. The rain was continuing for about a week and the laborers were unable to remove the 
blasted stones from the well till 23rd April. 


6. On the 23rd April they were able to remove the stones and started to dig for some 
length till they find some fountains with rich water. 


7. Suddenly the banks of the well began to collapse and taking the mud out of the well was 
an endless work and again the laborers had asked the owner to put some concrete pipes to 
guard the banks. 


8. Then he had to find out a suitable contractor for the job and on the 23rd May a person 
had laid concrete pipes and guarded the banks. 


9. The heavy rain since April had not yet stopped and it was pouring. The owner wanted to 
dig the well up to 10 meters. But the laborers were unable to do so in heavy rain and 


postponed the job. 


10. On the 5th June he could finish the digging works, and asked the masons to complete 
the works with suitable guard walls around the well. 


| 1. On the lO0th June the masons started the same and finished on |2th June. 


|2. Next job was to clean the well by removing all the water and it was still pending as he 
must find out a suitable contractor with pumping facilities.

Analysis of the well digging muhurat chart 
(Date of analysis is 10.06.2011) 


Date - 04.04.201 | 
Time - 06.10 AM 
Place - Marapola, (WP) Sri Lanka ( 80.01/07.09) 


Ascendant at the starting time of well digging is Pisces (Meena). 
Star is Rewathi Pada 3, Lord Mercury. 
VMD -Me 06 Y, 10 M, 22 D. 


Lagna is a common (Ubhaya Rasi) and watery sign. Even in the traditional system it is advised 
to select a watery sign for digging a well and as per KP Muhurat of Sri Kanak Bosmia ji, 
selecting aq common sign is a modus operandi to avoid the [Ith house as 
Badhaksthana for the event. 


Lagna cuspal sub lord is self-strong Venus in positional status with no planet in its stars and 
in own sub. Ve is posited at the very end of the I Ith cusp and hence Ve has becomes a 
significator for |2th (impediment). Ve is in the Kumbha Rasi, the owner Sa is retrograde in 
the 7th, Maraksthana. But the star lord of Ve is Ra in 9th under the control of Ju as sign 
lord, which is a benefic for this type of work as it shows expansion. 


Mo, Ju & Su are tenanted in the Ascendant and when taking Rasi wise Ma is also located in 
the Pisces. 

Moon is chief karaka for water and denotes water tanks and pipes, water ways, wells, and 
water works (Ref: Matters controlled by Grahas — by Sri Kanak Bosmia ji in the KPE-zine 
March 2008 issue) 


Saturn is the planet for materials under the ground. So Sa is an important planet in 
construction of water well. At the time of the muhurat Sa is tenanted in the 7th Badhaka, 
Marakasthana and in the star of Mo as well as opposite to Moon and hence a Punarphoo 
Dosha had effected the construction of well to delay. 


A KP rule for plurality of wells is clearly crystallized in this muhurat chart. 
"If Mercury is connected with the sub lord, one will have another well also sunk so 
that there will be plurality of wells". (KP Reader 3, 10th Edition, 2005, page 428) 


As mentioned above this is the second well for this family. In muhurat chart the I Ith 
sub lord Ju is in the star of Me and hence the rule is satisfied.

Findings for the delay 


|. Mo and Sa connection forms Punarphoo Dosha. 

2. At the time of the muhurat chart Mo is the star lord of undesirable 7 (Mrk & Bdk) in 
muhurat and sub lord of the 10th indicating negation (12th to I Ith) to some extent. 

3. Sa the Karaka for under ground materials as well as the lord of I 1( fulfillment of desire) is 
in 7 (Mrk & Bdk). 

4. Lagna star lord Me is the lord of 7 Maraka and Badhaka. 

5. Lagna sub lord Ve is a significator of 8 (disappointment) and 12 (misery, misfortune). 


Transit 

On the [5th June 2011, the day that my neighbor took his first bucket of water from the 
new well, Mo was transiting in the sign and sub of Ma (Bhoomi Putra) and sub of Me the 4th 
(small wells, water) lord of the muhurat chart. 


The I Ith cusp sub lord Ju was transiting in Ma's sign, Ke star and own sub Ju. Ke is the 
agent of Ma, Me and Sa (property from the earth) in the muhurat chart. 


KP rules (horary) to tap water from a well 

(KP Reader 3, |0th Edition, 2005, page 427) 

a. If the sub lord of the | Ith cusp or lord of the constellation in which the sub lord of the 
| Ith cusp was situated, were to be in a watery sign, one will tap water. If it is a barren sign, 


one cannot tap water. He will leave it. 


b. If the sub lord is deposited in the constellation of Mo or Ve or Me, one will get water 
quickly. 


c. If Mo is connected with Ju in any manner, there will be copious supply of water. 
d. If Mo is connected with Ve, the water will be sweet and palatable. 
Application of the above rules to the muhurat chart under study 


a. The Ith cuspal sub lord Ju is deposited in Pisces a watery sign. (Rule is agreed to tap 
water.) 


b. Sub Lord Ju is deposited in the constellation of Me. (Rule is not agreed to get water 
quickly.) 


c. Mo is in the sign of Ju. (Rule is agreed for the new well to be currently full of water with 
rich springs.) 


d. Mo is not connected with Ve. (Rule is not agreed.) 


e. Mo is connected with Sa. (Rule is not agreed as there are numerous rich springs at the 
moment.)

Getting a Job - Difficult Circumstances 


Ezine 


Email: guptaa@unhcr.org yy 





My colleague and her husband (Mr. X) were going through a tough time since the last 6 
months or so. Her husband, a very well qualified person with good working experience, had 
been without a job for some time as he had to accompany his wife to her new posting in 
South Africa. Mr. X did not have a work permit in South Africa. It was, therefore, nearly 
impossible to obtain a job. He was trying very hard to get one in an international 
organization and that, too, was proving difficult. Mr. X did not want a job outside South 
Africa as that would entail his living apart from his wife. 


Mr. X, therefore, asked the following two questions: 


|. Will | get a job in South Africa; if yes? 
2. When? 


These questions involve 3 important issues. The first is whether he will get a job? The 
second is if it will be in South Africa? Here South Africa may be taken as the place of 
residence and the question then becomes whether he will have to leave his place of 
residence to get the job? The third is the timing. The second question is secondary to the 
main question of getting a job. 


MENTAL FOCUS 


|. The Moon is what determines the mental focus of the querent. 

2. By its position and links it will indicate whether the question has focus on and relation to 
the issues outlined above. 

3. Moon is in the 8th and rules the 9th. It is in the star of Saturn who is in the |Oth and 
rules 3 and 4. 

4. The 8th shows a level of frustration. It shows that currently the situation has come to a 
point when getting a job seems so difficult. The 9th shows absence of job as it negates 
the |O0th which is the house of profession. 

5. The appearance of the 3™ and 4th is significant. The 4th denotes home and place of 
residence. The 3rd is the negation of the 4th and shows movement out. Thus, the fear 
that one may have to leave South Africa to get a job. 


THE ASCENDANT 

|. The Lagna sub lord is Rahu who is in [2. It represents Jupiter who is in 4 and rules |-2-5. 
It is in the star of Ketu who is in 6. It represents Saturn who is in 10 and rules 3 and 4. It 
also represents Mars in 4 and rules 1[2. It is in the sub of Venus who is in 4 and rules 6. 

2. Once again the relevant houses have clearly stood out. Rahu, through its representation 
of Jupiter and Mars connects residence (4th) and earning (2nd). The combination of 2 
and 4 shows there is no separation from family. 

3. The appearance of 6 shows service (job) and 10 (profession). 

THUS, the query is well reflected in this horary chart. Further analysis is therefore possible. 


THE LINKS 


|. In regard to getting a job, the main house to be considered is the |Oth.

Mr. X continued to apply for jobs throughout after the query was analysed. He called me on 
3™ June 2011 stating that an international organization had seen his application but was

Later, on 10 June 2011 (around 11:30 am), Mr. X called me and informed me that just a 
while ago he had received a call from the said international organization informing him that 
he had been selected for a job. It is in the humanitarian field. 


There are still hurdles in the way of starting the job. Mr. X still does not have a work permit 
in South Africa. However, the international organization in question is now willing to write 
to the government on behalf of Mr. X to assist him in obtaining the work permit. The 
organization wants Mr. X to join work on Monday (13 June 2011) without waiting for the 
work permit.

Very often, questions asked by people involve a number of different issues. The normal 
approach in KP is to use a single horary number for a single question. This allows the 
astrologer to focus on the specific issue and arrive at specific analysis for the same. 


However, as long as the various issues involved in a given question are strongly related to 
the main issue (as in this case staying in South Africa was secondary to the main question of 
getting a job it was, therefore, strongly related to the main question), the horary chart will 
always reveal the main and secondary connections clearly.

|. A brain tumor is any growth of abnormal cells or uncontrolled proliferation of cells in the 
brain. Brain tumors can be growth of abnormal cells in the tissues of the brain. Brain tumors 
can be benign (non-cancerous) or malignant (cancerous). Usually, benign tumors can be 
removed, and they seldom grow back. Malignant brain tumors are generally more serious 
and often are life threatening. 





2. Brain tumors are classified depending on the exact site of the tumor, the type of tissue 
involved, benign or malignant tendencies of the tumor, and other factors. Primary brain 
tumors can arise from the brain cells, the meninges (membranes around the brain), nerves, 
or glands. 


3. The cause of primary brain tumors is unknown. This is because they are rare, there are 
many types, and there are many possible risk factors that could play a role. Exposure to 
some types of radiation, head injuries, and hormone replacement therapy may be risk 
factors, as well as many others. 


4. The risk of using cell phones is hotly debated. Though a World Health Organization study 
recently concluded cell phones may cause cancer, some are wondering why, if there truly is 
a link, there has not been a significant worldwide increase in brain cancers.

Timing of Event in Horoscope Analysis 
Using Vimshottari Dasa 


Ezine 


Sreepalee Astrological Services, 
Ketawala-Leula, Sri Lanka. 





In fixing the timing of event in natal or horary analysis, the Vimshottari dasa system is the 
most popular one commonly used out of around one hundred Prashari and Jaimini systems 
available in the Eastern system of astrology. The reason for the popularity of this 
Vimshottari dasa system may be the accuracy in prediction and the simplicity in calculating 
the maha dasa and sub dasa periods. 


The dasa balance at the time of a birth or time of judgment in a horary analysis could be 
easily calculated according to the position of Moon in the chart, then the periods of that 
dasa from the birth or from the commencement of any event. Based on this dasa balance, 
the periods in the future could easily be calculated by using the simple tables which are 
readily available in most of the astrological almanacs or any computer soft ware program. 


The total period of Vimshottari dasa system is 120 years. Most probably this number of 
years is very close to the maximum human life span and that could be one reason, which 
make this dasa system popular. These 120 years of Vmshottari dasa period is divided among 
the nine planets in unequal periods and in a specific order. 


These allocations of periods in the 


Vimshottari Dasa System are as follows: 


Kethu 
Moon | «Years 
Jupiter 


There are 27 constellations in the zodiac or the asterism belt. 


The ownership of these 27 constellations are allocated among the nine planets as follows: 


Rohini, Hasta, Sravana = SSS* Moon SS 


According to the position of Moon, the dasa balance at the time of birth is determined. This 
balance period is passed by the native and then moved into the next dasa and so on during 
his life time or beyond. In this manner the native is under the influence of some dasa periods 
at any time.

These maha dasa periods are then divided into small periods in the same order and the 
Same proportion for each planet as that is given in the maha dasa periods. These small 
periods are called Bhukti. These bhukti periods are further divided into smaller periods in 
the same order and proportions of the periods allocated for each planet. These smaller 
periods are called Antra.The antra periods could further be divided in very smaller periods 
and are named as Sookshma. But normally the Dasa, Bhukti and Antra periods are adequate 
for the timing of events or for the delineation of birth charts. Therefore we could say that 
any native is under the influence of Dasa, Bhukti and Antara at any time. 


These dasa and sub dasa lords offer the results according to their positions and significations 
in the birth chart. In determining the signification of a planet in the birth chart, his 
ownership, occupation and the aspects it receives would be considered. 


So during a Dasa period of a particular planet, the native will enjoy the results signified by 
the Dasa lord in the birth chart and according to the transit. Next the Bhukti lord will offer 
the results according to his signification and his transit. Antra lord will also offer the results 
in the same manner. Here the main control is up to the Dasa lord. The Bhkti lord will offer 
the results, which are signified by the Dasa lord. Antra lord needs the signification and 
control from both Dasa and Bhukti lords. So Dasa lord has a very significant and powerful 
role over the matters indicated by the dasa period lords. 


"No Bhukti can offer a result, if Dasa lord does not permit. If the Dasa lord is not a significator of 
the result which Bhukti lord is to give , Dasa lord the final authority will not give the ultimate 
result. Planets from a cabinet. The Prime Minister is the Dasanadha. The Bhuktinadhas are Cabinet 
Ministers. The Antharanadhas are Deputy Ministers." 

--KP Reader IV page 195 


According to Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi, profounded by the late professor, Sothida Mannan, Jeotish 
Marthand K.S. Krishnamurthi, the planets gives the results signified by the star lord of that plant. So 
the native will enjoy the result in any dasa period according to the star lord of that dasa lord.

disaster), 12 (loss) & 3 (loss of property), there is a possibility of earthquake disaster during 
the joint period of the significators of 3,8, 12. 


Rule-3: ( Kanak Bosmia) If the sub lord of the 8" ( natural disaster) be the significator of 8 ( 
natural disaster ), 12 ( loss) & 3 ( loss of property ), there is a possibility of earthquake 
disaster during the joint period of the significators of 3,8, 12. 


So to predict any earthquake first condition is to look at I* cusp sub lord (condition of 
country) whether it signifies 4,8,or,12 together with mrk, bdk. There could be a great 
possibility of any natural disaster in the country, if it signifies only mrk, bdk; there could be a 
little possibility and very less danger if only 4,8,12 are signified. Second condition is all 3 
rules must agree for any earthquake and the last condition is the D.B.A must agree with the 
event.

A boy’s father from Chandigarh brought the birth horoscope of his son on 19-07-2010 and 
wanted to know when his son would get married. The birth details of boy are as under. 


Date of birth-20-07-1983, 
Time of birth — 6 pm, 
Place of birth- Chandigarh. 


As per KP if the 7 cusp sub lord signifies house 2,7 &I1, then marriage is promised 


Here 7" cusp sub lord is Mercury in 7", lord of 7, its star lord Saturn lord of 2. 

As 7" CSL signifies house 7 & 2, marriage is promised. 

2" CSL is Mercury in 7", lord of 7, its star lord Saturn lord of 2. 

[1 CSL Venus is 11" lord, no planet is in the stars of Venus and Venus is the CSL of I. 
Venus’s star ketu is conjoined with Moon and Jupiter, both in || and its sub lord Mercury is 


in 7. Hence the sub lords of 7,2 & || cusps signify 2,7 & || houses and marriage is clearly 
promised for the boy. 


In fixing the timing of marriage on 19-07-2010, it was found that the boy was running Maha 
Dasa of Ketu) & Bhukti of Mercury from 19-02-2010 to 17-02-2011. To judge whether 
Dasa and Bhukti are capable of marriage, firstly Dasa lord Ketu was checked as follows: 





Ketu in conjunction with Mercury is in 7 Saturn is lord of 2 
Moon and Jupiter, both 
are in || 


Secondly Bhukti lord Mercury was checked as under:- 


Star lord Saturn is lord of 2 Sub lord Jupiter is in || 


So Dasa lord Ketu and Bhukti lord Mercury are both conducive to marriage by signifying 
houses of 2,7 & II. So | told him that his son will get married before |7-02-2011 i.e before 
the end of Mercury Bhukti. 


As per KP, if maha Dasa and Bhukti are conducive to any matter (marriage in this 
case), then the event will happen when sun transits in rashi or star of that maha Dasa 
and Bhukti. Here in this casethe boy wass running Ketu Maha Dasa and Mercury Bhukti 
from 19-02-2010 to 17-02-2011. 


As Ketu is in Scorpio sign of Mars, so take Mars instead of Ketu and Bhukti is of Mercury. 
Every year Sun transits in Virgo sign of Mercury and Chitra star of Mars between 8th 


October to |6th October. So | told him that his son would get married between 8-10-2010 
to 16-10-2010. 


Actually his son got married on [7-10-2010 (Sunday) as confirmed by the querent. 


My pranam to guruji Shri K.S. Krishnamurti for his wonderful padhdhati.

Will Julius Malema be re-elected as the President? 


Background: 


Since the yoke of the Apartheid regime was shed in South Africa in 1994, the ANC has been 
in power at the Centre and the majority of the Provinces (9 Provinces in South Africa) in 
the country. The Youth League of the ANC is an important component of the ANC itself, 
and is seen, more or less, as the nurturing body from which future ANC leaders will 
emerge. The Presidency of the Youth League is, therefore, seen in the country as an 
important position that, virtually, will catapult the leader to the mainstream political power 
enjoyed by the ANC. 


In recent years, the President of the Youth League has come under criticism for his brash 
and outspoken style. Julius Malema is criticised for being impolite and lacking political skills 
that may cause the ANC some public embarrassment. However, the support enjoyed by 
Malema from the youth is huge and that has kept him in the saddle. 


Soon, though, new ANC elections will take place in June 2011. These elections will put 
popular and powerful ANC members in the seats of power. As with the ANC, the Youth 
League, too, will decide its leadership. Hence the importance of the upcoming party 
elections cannot be understated. 


It will be interesting to see whether Malema will retain the leadership of the Youth League. 
A strong contender has emerged for his position in the form of Mr. Saki Mofokeng. 
Speculation is rife as to whether the latter will be able to unseat the popular Malema. 





re 
ANC Youth League president Julius Malema and Sports Minister Fikile Mbalula. 


“THE African National Congress Youth League (ANCYL) this week opened the process of 
nominating potential leaders as it prepares for an elective conference where its president, Julius 
Malema, is expected to be challenged. 


The league's election in June will have a bearing on the ANC’s own succession, to be decided at the 
party's national conference in Mangaung next year. 


The four-day conference to elect leaders and discuss policy would start on June 1/6 in 
Johannesburg.”

singer Maria Callas, Christina Onassis* & her daughter Athina Roussel who inherited 
$2.7 billions on her 18th birthday and a further $2 billions on her 21st birthday. 

3) Thirdly, here is what Dr. B.V. Raman has to say about KSY: "KSY has its bright 
shades. It makes one industrious, hardworking, aware of one's own ability- despite 
mental restlessness. It raises the natives to top positions in their respective fields 
provided of course other Raja Yogas are present. Rahu-Ketu axis favors rise in 
mundane life while Ketu-Rahu axis indicates elevation in spiritual matters. It is also 
found that KSY natives get betrayed by trusted friends and even relatives. Suffering 
due to developments in life strengthens the mind and mellows one's outlook. This is 
a blessing of KSY.... It occurs to me that undue importance need not be given to 
KSY. The view held by some astrologers that KSY affects longevity and adversely 
affects the operation of other yogas favoring a rise in life, achievement, and 
accomplishment is not tenable. The overall assessment of the horoscope is 
important. No single yoga, including KSY, is capable or marring or making a 
horoscope. In our view, KSY plays an important role in mundane astrology and is not 
of much importance in individual charts." 

4) Finally Shri K.N. Rao has written a book and many articles against this fraud called 
KSY.

KP \ Will there be a change in job? 


Ezine 


Addl. S.E. (Retd) Bhakra Beas Management Board, ;

A boy from Mohali (Chandigarh) was trying to change the job due to some frustration with his boss. He 
wanted to know if there is any chance for change in his job in the near future. 


| asked him to tell me a number between | to 249. He told me the number 129. Calculations of a KP ho- 
rary chart were made at Chandigarh on | 3-08-2010 at 5:23 pm IST. 


Moon’s Indication 


Moon is lord of house 10 and in 12; sub lord Jupiter is in 5, lord of 3 and 6. So the querent’s question is 
clear about the change of his job. 


Position of Fortuna 


Fortuna is in the star of Mercury in the sign of Mars, which is in |2, and sub of Jupiter in 5, lord of 3 and 
6, indicating change in his job. 


Gulbarga Theory 


As per Gulbarga theory, if Asc. sub lord of horary chart is the same as Moon star lord of the ruling plan- 
ets, then the answer is positive. Here in this case, both Asc. sub lord and Moon star lord are both Moon. 
So | told him that the answer to his question was positive to change the job as desired. 


In KP Sixth Reader (Horary Astrology) pages 296-297, the planets which are 6, 8 & |2 to any house do 
not contribute to the matter, influenced by that house. Accordingly houses 3, 5 and 9 happen to be in 6, 8 
and |2 to the houses 2,6 and I0 of profession or occupation. Consequently the planets signifying these 
houses 3,5 and 9 would be conducive to a change in present job during the joint period of significators of 
houses 3,5 and 9. 


Now let us check the 10" cusp for any change in job. 


Here 10" cusp sub lord Ketu, having positional status with no planet in its stars, is in 9 and its star lord 
Rahu in 3. Rahu also represents its sign lord Jupiter, having no planet in its stars, which is in 5, lord of 3 
and 6. Hence 10” cusp sub lord strongly signifies 3, 5 and 9. So there will be a change in job/profession. 


Will New Job be better? 


In KP Sixth Reader (Horary Astrology) page 305, it is said that movement will be given by the significator 
of 3" house. 


Here 3™ cusp sub lord Mars is lord of 2, in the star of Moon, lord of 10 and sub of Jupiter, lord of 6; so | 
told him that he would get better financial prospect in the new job. 


Ruling Planets

Short Background 


http://www.independent.co.uk/opinion/commentators/fisk/how-the-demise-of-a-trusted- 
adviser-could-bring-down-mahmoud-ahmadinejad-2303671.html 


lran's President has survived mass uprisings, but a corruption row engulfing his inner circle may soon be 
his undoing. Robert Fisk reports from Tehran. 


Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, Iran's irascible, unpredictable but devout president may be forced to resign in the 
coming weeks as a political crisis far greater than the massive street violence which followed his re- 
election in 2009 threatens to overwhelm him and his court favourites in the government. 


The overweening influence of his close friend and confidant Esfandiar Rahim-Mashaee, the president's 
chief of staff — who is blamed for the firing of two intelligence ministers and for infuriating even the Su- 
preme Leader, Ayatollah Sayed Ali Khamenei — is expected to bring down Ahmadinejad in one of the 
most spectacular putsches in the history of the Islamic Republic. 


lranian politicians are already speculating on who will succeed the president — Ali Akbar Salehi, the foreign 
minister and for four years the head of Iran's atomic agency, is a favourite — as three of Rahim-Mashaee's 
close allies have been purged in just three days over the past week, arrested by security agencies while 
Ahmadinejad has remained uncharacteristically silent. Mohamed Sharif Malekzadeh, who served briefly as 
Ahmadinejad's foreign minister; Ali Asghar Parhizkar, director of the Arvand free trade zone in the south 
of Iran; and his opposite number in the Aras trade zone in the north, Ali-Reza Mogimi, have all been 
charged with corruption, a dangerous accusation in the Islamic Republic where a fine line separates 
“corruption on earth" from "an enemy of God".

President S. R. Nathan announced his retirement as his second term drew to a close. Initially, 
‘he had not ruled out a third term but later decided against it. Breaking tradition from the past 
two Presidential Elections, which ended in walkovers, this turned out to be a multi-corner 
contest. All three candidates who received the Certificate of Eligibility were one-time mem- 
_ bers of the ruling PAP, serving at the different levels of ministerial, backbench and grassroots 
1 respectively. Coincidentally, they also had the surname "Tan", leading this to be dubbed "Battle 


w= of the Tans”. 


& 1 Former Deputy Prime Minister Dr Tony Tan, who resigned as chairman of Singapore Press 
Holdings and executive director of Government Investment Corporation to contest this elec- 
tion in an independent capacity, announced his candidacy much later after weeks of specula- 


tion. He was seen to be backed by the PAP government despite stating otherwise. 


His main opponent was former Member of Parliament and PAP stalwart Dr Tan Cheng Bock, 
i most remembered for his resounding victories in the now-defunct Ayer Rajah and not being 
B afraid to speak up as an internal critic. He was first to declare his intention and did not back 


down despite Dr Tony Tan's entry later. 





The third candidate, Tan Kin Lian, was former chief executive officer of NTUC Income, the 
PAP-backed union umbrella's insurance arm, as well as PAP Marine Parade branch secretary under Emeri- 
tus Senior Minister Goh Chok Tong. After stepping down as CEO, he quit PAP and became a maverick 
who stood up for mini-bonds holders and occasionally aligned himself to the opposition's activities and 


causes, particularly NSP and SDP. 


http://www.temasekreview.com/20 | |/06/08/if-the-presidential-election-were-to-be-called/ 


It is not uncommon in the lead up to elections to poll voters on the candidate that they would vote for if 
an election were called tomorrow, in order to gauge popularity of the candidates and make judgements 


based on these results as to who might win the coming election. 


In these polls, voters are also asked to identify the key issues that inform their decision about which party 
to vote for. This is a methodical process attempting to capture a representative cross-section of society 
where the election is being held. In this spirit, although without the precision of a professional poll, this 
impromptu poll attempts to gauge which candidates are receiving support from the online community and 


in a hypothetical situation may receive their votes. 


In line with the hypothetical scenario, the ‘main players’ are listed for election, ignoring the realities of 
walkover and last minute withdrawal. 


Who would you prefer to be the next President of Singapore? 
Mr Tan Kin Lian (43%, 1,127,820 Votes) 

Dr Tan Cheng Bock (35%, 915,830 Votes) 

Dr Tony Tan (21%, 545,782 Votes)

4. Query: Will my partnership be continued or not?

owner) of 6 or || the native gets a partner. Cuspal sub lord and its star lord should not travel in ret- 
rograde motion. If the sub lord of the 8th cusp (partner’s money) be the significator (in the star of 
the occupant or owner) of 5 or 12, the native will get a partner.

of 5 or ||, the partnership continues for a long time. Cuspal sub lord and its star lord should not travel in 
retrograde.

pant or owner) of 8 or 12, the partnership will be broken. If 7th cusp sub lord be the significtor of 
6th , partner will broke partnership. If 7th cusp sub lord be the significtore of |2th, querent himself will 
broke partnership during the joint period of the significators of 6 and 12. (to move to right side) 


3) If owner of 7th and occupant of 7th be a significtor of | Ith querent gets benefit from partnership. But 
if be a significator of 7, 12 loss in partnership. Source: Prashna Jyotish by C.K. Bhatt, translated by Kanak

However, we wanted to know the date. So we tried to find it out according to the infallible Krishnamurthi

This query was analysed using horary number 26 (I to 249) at [2.19 p.m. on O9th February 2011 at 
Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka. The calculated horary chart is attached. 


In this horary chart, Moon is deposited in Aries, in the twelveth bhava, in the star of Kethu and in its own 
sub. Moon is the owner of fourth and its star lord Kethu is deposited in the second bhava, Gemini sign 
owned by Mercury, lord of second and third. This is a very good indication of the mind of the querent that 
he is expecting some gains and increase in his income. 


Now we will see the fulfillment of our expectation. It is indicated by the sub lord of the eleventh bhava. 
Sub lord of the eleventh bhava is Sun. Sun is deposited in the nineth bhava but very close to the tenth cusp. 
This Sun is deposited in the star of Mars and also conjoined with Mars, which is deposited in the nineth 
bhava but very close to the tenth cusp. Sun is in the sub of Jupiter deposited in ||. Thus the eleventh 
cusp sub lord indicates some gains for the services rendered. 


The significators for the relevant second, sixth, tenth and eleventh bhavas are as follows: 


Mercury is the owner of the second bhava, No planet is deposited in the stars of Mercury. Kethu is 
deposited in this bhava. Venus, Rahu and Moon are deposited in the stars of Kethu. 


The sixth bhava is owned by Venus. No planet is deposited in the stars of Venus and no planet is deposited 
in this bhava. 


The tenth cusp is owned by Saturn. Jupiter is deposited in the star of Saturn and no planet is deposited in 
this bhava. 


The eleventh bhava is also owned by Saturn. And Jupiter is deposited in the star of Saturn and he is 
occupying the eleventh bhava and no planet is deposited in the stars of Jupiter. So the significators for the 
above relevant bhavas are: 


Mercury, Kethu, Venus, Rahu, Moon, Saturn and Jupiter.

by checking from the star and sub lords of these planets, according to their signification or negation. But it 
is better to use the Golden Theory of Krishnamurthi Paddhthi, the RULING PLANETS. The significators 


who appeared as ruling planets at the time of judgment will be the powerful significators.

A daughter of one of my colleagues wanted to know whether she would conceive second time as she was 
longing for a male child and she had been blessed with a female child before. She was not sure of her birth 
time. | told her not to worry about her birth time and requested her to give a number below 249. She prayed 
Lord Ucchista Ganapathy and gave a number. 


Question: Will | get second child? If so, when? 
Horary No: |57 (1-249) 

Date of Judgment: 06/01/201 | 

Time of Judgment: [8:50 PM IST. 

Place of Judgment: Chennai, | 3N04, 80E1I7 


The Ascendant sub lord is Jupiter and it signifies 2,5 and || houses. Hence the question is related to child 
birth. 


As per KP for second child the 7th cuspal sub lord should signify 2, 5 or | Ith house. In the given horoscope 
the 7th cuspal sub lord is Jupiter which is lord of 2 and 5 and in the constellation of Saturn in | Ith house. It 
therefore clearly reveals that the matter of conception will be successful. Since Jupiter’s star lord Saturn is 
lord of 4, strongly signifying 4th house, there will be delay in conception. 


However, | told her that she could get confirmation from her doctor regarding conception between | 4th May 
2011 to 30th July 2011 when she would be running Moon dasa, Saturn bhukti, Jupiter antara. Because the main 
ruling planets are Moon, Saturn and Jupiter. All of them are signifying 2, 5 and | Ith houses by occupation and 
lordship at the planet, star and sub levels.

US-Pak crisis: Khar recalled, Kayani meets generals 


US-Pak crisis: Khar recalled, Kayani meets generals! Comments Share | Larger | SmallerAgencies 
Tags : US Pak crisis, YousufRazaGilani, HinaRabbaniKhar, AshfaqParvezKayani, Haqqani network 


Posted: Mon Sep 26 2011, 01:40 hrs , Islamabad: 


The tense standoff between Pakistan and the US over the ISI’s links with the terrorist Haqqani 
network escalated sharply today after Prime Minister YousufRazaGilani recalled Foreign Minister 
HinaRabbaniKhar from New York, and announced a meeting of all political parties to “apprise them 
on the security situation in the wake of threats emanating from outside the country’. 


Army chief General AshfaqParvezKayani chaired a six-hour meeting with his top commanders to 
review the “security situation’, and Pakistan’s second highest ranking general complained to a top US 
commander about “negative statements emerging from the US”. 


Over the past few days, top US officials have repeatedly accused the ISI of encouraging the Haqqani 
network, describing the Afghan terrorist organisation as a “veritable arm” of the Pakistani intelligence 
service. 


On Sunday, Sen. Lindsey Graham, a Republican member of the Armed Services Committee, said that 
if Islamabad “continued to embrace terrorism as part of their national strategy’, the US would have 
to “put all options on the table”. 


A statement issued by Prime Minister Gilani’s office said Foreign Minister Khar had been “summoned 
to reach Pakistan soon to be present in the briefing, which will be given by all the concerned 
authorities’. 


The proposed meeting with all political parties “will send a strong message that the nation stands 
united when the defence and security of the country is at stake’, the statement added. “Political 
differences in domestic politics do not come in the way of national and foreign policy issues, which 
are above party politics.” 


Khar was expected to fly back to Islamabad tonight, TV channels quoted official sources as saying. 
Gilani had sent Khar to the UN after pulling out of the trip himself, reportedly after President Barack 
Obama refused to meet him on the sidelines of the UN meet. 


The foreign minister would meet both Gilani and President Asif Ali Zardari on her return, reports 
said. She has been called back because her presence is vital at the meeting of the country’s political 
leadership, official sources were quoted as saying. Khar was the only member of the civilian 
leadership to have had direct contact with US officials regarding the allegations about the ISI. In a 
strongly worded statement, the minister had rejected the US charges and warned Washington not to 
alienate an ally. Earlier in the day, a six-hour meeting of the Pakistan Army corps commanders 
reviewed the security situation in the country in the backdrop of growing tensions and sharp 
escalation of rhetoric with the US. The meeting rejected the US accusations and decided to give a 
“fitting response” to any cross-border attacks by militants based in Afghanistan, Geo News reported.

leadership into confidence, the channel reported.

the negative statements emanating from the US”. Wynne called for “addressing the irritants” in the 
relationship which are “a result of an extremely complex situation’, a military statement said.

This is an effort of appraising the KP rules in application to the astrological portrait of a famous chart. 
We know some individuals become famous with their activities which touched the general public and 
media. Some are famous with their noble characters and the service rendered for the world like Sri 
Mahathma Gandhi ji, Martin Luther King and many more. Some are notorious with their deeds and 
famous among the limited classes of the society. However every one of these famous people has own 
identity with any type of skill which most people are fond of. 


The common people can say the reasons for their reputation or glory with their experiences in 
seeing, looking or hearing about the person. It may be a common reason with the word "ability" in 
the particular field where the person is or was famous. 


But an astrologer can say other reasons for their success or glory by their third eye, which cannot be 
seen by a common person. This is such an attempt to recover the astrological reasons for the 
success, name and fame of an artist in the cine field and humanitarian works. 


She is Angelina Jolie, an American actress, who has won various 
awards in the cine field. In the humanitarian works she was named a 
UNHCR Goodwill Ambassador at UNHCR (United Nations High 
Commissioner for Refugees). She had early sexual relationship and 
she is sexy and many more.... 


Let us see her through the astrological spectacles.

The first house of the natal chart controls over the physical appearance and self image awareness and 
interest of a person. Venus in very close conjunction with the Ascendant gives her an extraordinary 
charisma. Uranus squaring Ascendant gives both the appearance and behavior as accents rather 
shocking and also a beauty, but perhaps not one that will appeal to everyone. 


Name, Fame, Honor and Awards 


As per KP rules the |l0th house tells about one's name, fame, honor, recognition, reputation, 
popularity and success. The 9th house indicates fortune as result of the meritorious deeds in 
previous lives. 


The [Oth cusp of the AJ’s chart is under the rulers of Ju as sign lord, Me as star lord and Ra as sub 
lord. The sub lord Rahu is posited in the 5th house, no planet is in the stars of Ra and Ra is the CSL 
of 4,10,1 1 houses. Ra has no conjunction with any planet and aspected by Ju(9,6,10), i.e. in 9th, lord 
of 6 and IO. Ra is in the star of Sa(I2,7,8,9) and sub of Me(11,4,12). Thus the [Oth CSL signifies 5 
(intelligence), 9 (fortune), 10 (name, fame) and || (success, fulfillment of desire) for her name, fame 
and awards. 


In addition the above ingredients explaining her success, she also has the Su in the I Ith house, 
indicating fame, and a bunch of planets, Mo (1,2), Ma (I1), Ju (6,10) in the 9th house (fortune), 
showing her ability to conquer the world.

KP Multi Marriage Rules 


Rule-I: MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if BOTH the following two conditions are 
simultaneously satisfied: 

(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp OR its star lord is deposited in a 

dual sign (Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces) OR if the sub-lord of the 7th 

cusp is Mercury/Jupiter (for this matter only) and 

(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of 

the houses 2 or || or both. 
If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second 
marriage is denied. 


Rule-2: Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 2nd cusp is also a significator of either of 
the houses 7 or II. 


Rule-3: As per Shri Kanak Bosmia’s research study : On assumption that 2nd wife is considered as 
younger sister of first one. 

Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a significator of either of the houses 2 
or Yor II. 


In the AJ’s chart, the 7th cusp sub lord is Me (9,11). 

The 2nd cusp sub lord is Ju (11,9). 

The 9th cusp sub lord is Sa (9). 

Hence all the KP multi marriage rules are satisfied in her chart.

Question- I: Placidus house system 


Here | am attaching a file about Placidus house system. | didn't understand completely of this article. | 
am scholar from Sanskrit.(M.A) But all | got is this author is saying that Placidus house system is 
incorrect or incomplete. | thought you may help me on this matter. Please read the article 
completely. If you have any answers for this kindly write an article & reply me. 


www.math.nus.edu.sg/aslaksen/projects/kh-urops.pdf 


Answer-:- | 


|. Although the Placidus house system is the one in common use, it is not spoken of highly by the 
mathematically-minded astrologers or taken as worthy of acceptance. (Universal Tables of Houses, 
by S. Balasundaram & A.R. Raichur, p Il) 


2. Theory is important, but experiment gets the last word. Numerous Vedic astrologers now use the 
Placidus system—because it works. 


http://www.astrowisdom.net/articles/in-search-of-best-house-system.htm 


3. According to “Recent Advances in Natal Astrology’, compiled by Geoffrey Dean, p 168, in the 
USA about 80% of individuals who seek help from astrologers show a preference for the system of 
Placidus. . .In addition, 90% of individuals who refer to online horoscopes prefer the system of 
Placidus. 


4. Regarding the polar region charts, there are two views. As the house system be applicable 
anywhere on Earth, Placidus house system is unsatisfactory, for example, at 70 N it is possible to 
have some houses spread across 3 or 4 signs while others are only 2-3 degree wide. The other view 
accepts these shortcomings, as England’s foremost Astrologer Ronald Davison has said, one can play 
many good tunes on a piano whose top is defective; hence Placidus system is satisfactory. 


5. If one has a client out of about one million people living in the Polar Regions, the Topocentric 
house system seems to provide a solution. 


6. The practical application of different house systems of Campanus, Regiomontanus, Topocentric 
which provide the reverse order of houses and Alcabitus, Equal, Koch, Placidus, Prophyry which give 
the usual order of houses to the Polar region born Marie Peary can be found in the article below: 

"A case Study of Polar Region Chart" in KPE-zine Oct 2010 issue. 


7. Like Vimshottari dasa without knowing the rationale of allotment of years to the planets and 
sequence of planets, Placidus is still the most commonly used house system because it works for 
correct prediction along with the Vimshottari dasa.

Dear Well-wishers, 


It gives us immense pleasure in joining you in celebrating 103” Birth Anniversary of our revered Guruji Sri K S 
Krishnamurti, Propounder of Krishnamurti Padhdhati on this |“ Nov. Though many methods of astrology are 
practiced all over the world, by virtue of his sparked intelligence, his innovative scientific method of analysis gave a 
new dimension to prediction hitherto not known to the world. All his analysis, predictions reflects the grace of Sri 
Ucchista Ganapati, his upasana deity. Many hundreds of astrologers, all over the world, have started following his 
Padhdhati and also started following his guidelines in innovating and creating new theories as an extension of KP. 
May be our Guruji not only prayed for his intelligence but also prayed for his disciples and its outcome, KP is 
expanding globally, setting new standards based on His Dictum. 


As KP-Ezine team, we thank you for your unstinted support, which is reflected in its rapidly growing database of 
subscribers; yes, subscribers count crossed 2700+ and read in 63 countries all over the world. From the first issue in 
February 2007, it is approaching the sixth successful year; crossing this milestone is possible only because of your 
kind encouragement. 


We would like to make it clear that during these five years, in good faith of distributing the true KP knowledge in 
clear and effective manner, the articles have been edited to make them more impressive, and some articles 
including three of the KP-Ezine editor were unfortunately rejected according to the KP and noncontroversial 
principles. This article reviewing process has been done on principles without any personal issue, although said 
some differently. We are sorry, if this unavoidable process hurts the authors whose articles were rejected. 


Your continued support has been a catalyst and has given us pep to our selfless, voluntary service. Our unanimous 
decision to publish KP-Ezine to the Web, FREE makes our stand clear that we are not money minded since we 
follow the foot path of our Great Guruji Sri KSKji. As you are aware life is a mix of good and bad; though we are 
criticized in some circles for some reasons, we accept it with a smiling face since they give us an opportunity to 
reanalyze their views, if it is worth to follow and are not bogged down in following the path established by our guruji 
Sri KSKji since he only guides us. Though he is not with us in physique, SOUL IS IMMORTAL. We dedicate our 
service at HIS LOTUS FEET. 


We really appreciate your suggestions and comments. 
With best wishes and warm regards,
