a 
Friday, October 7th 2011 - 18:13 UTC 
Argentine October presidential election, just another calendar day for CFK 
Buenos Aires pollster Poliarquia which in recent years has better anticipated 
electoral results in Argentina, forecasts a comfortable victory for President 
Cristina 
Fernandez (CFK) re-election bid next Sunday 23, confirming a_ third 
consecutive mandate for the Kirchner couple. 
Fabian Perechodnik, director of Poliarquia supported the statement with 
Opinion poll results from the province of Buenos Aires, Argentina’s main 
electoral and decisive district with 35% of the national ballot. 
“In the province of Buenos Aires we have a confirmation of the tendencies 
from the 14 August primary, with probably even a few extra positive notches”, said Perechodnik. 
“Governor Daniel Scioli (from the ruling coalition and running for re-election) would garner 52% of the ballot followed 
by Francisco De Narvaez with 16% and all other hopefuls below 8%, which means Scioli is above the primary 
percentage while the rest of candidates remain almost at the same level of support they had last August”. 
What Is most important is that Governor Scioli has a similar vote intention in metropolitan Buenos Aires as well as in 
rural areas of the province, which for over two years clashed with the administration of President Cristina Fernandez 
over grains and oilseeds export taxes. 
“Looking back to the mid-term election of 2009 when the large farming areas of the province of Buenos Aires were 
reluctant to support Cristina, managing a 52% support both in the traditional metropolitan belt and in the farming 
districts, is showing that Scioli has been very effective in promoting decentralization in the province, with a positive 
feedback that is evident in the vote intention”, said Poliarquia director. 
Likewise the “positive assessment of President Cristina Fernandez performance in the Buenos Aires province reaches 
66% and that of Governor Scioli, 65%. They are almost even and at very high levels”. 
“Our projections indicate President Cristina Fernandez will garner between 54 and 55% of the ballot in the province of 
Buenos Aires, followed by former president Eduardo Duhalde with 13 to 15 points; Hermes Binner, 10 to 12 points; 
Ricardo Alfonsin, 8 to 10 points and Rodriguez Saa, 9 points”, concluded Perechodnik who revealed that Poliarquia 
was working with a poll covering the whole of Argentina.

Cancer in Physiology and Astrology 


Cancer or Carcinoma is a dreaded disease which supports to Increase the death toll daily all over the world. While 
deaths are increasing, it decreases the monitory funds of a state. At the same time it makes good bank balance of 
manufactures and sellers of medicines as well as doctors. 


The primary stage of a cancer is an abnormal mass of TISSUES of the body, known as TUMOR. Some of the tumors 
are harmless while some are malignant. Malignant type tumors are growing fast and spreading to adjacent parts of 
body by the way of lymphatic cannels. The lymphatic cannel (Vasa Vaahini Paddhaty) is under the rule of star Sravana 
or Suwana nakshatra. 


Growing of tumors or abnormal enlargement is under the rule of Jupiter (Guru) and Venus (Sukra) The tumors 
depend upon various reasons of the physical activities and astrologically all those are resulting from ill-dignified, weak 
and afflicted | upiter or Venus at the birth. 


Tumors are of various kinds and types and may occur in any weakness, deposits, accumulations, and increase of 
leucocytes (white cells). Jupiter and Venus afflictions pile up the excesses and accumulations and then Saturn ( 
lingering and chronicle illness) takes them up and does his works by impeding elimination, stopping of functioning and 
secretions and excess of the mineral deposits in the weak and afflicted part in the body, as shown by the birth chart. 


Cancer is a disease of Moon and Cancer (Karkataka/Kataka) sign. In addition to the above, other helping planets for 
the disease are Mars (Kuja) for blood, and Rahu who is responsible for all types of malignant disease like cancer.

Before that, it is my duty to mention some words on the term “CONNECTION", which is repeatedly used in my study, 
for the benefit of the readers as well as the KP students. 


(a) Connection of Planets 
1. If planet A occupies in a sign owned by Planet B or 
2. If Planet Ais in the Star or Sub of Planet B or 
3. If Planet A is in conjunction or aspected by Planet B 
It may be said that Planet A and B are connected with each other. 


(b) Connection of Planet with Cusp 

. If the Planet Ais the Owner or Star or Sub of the Cusp X or 

. If Planet A Occupies in the Cusp X or 

. If the Planet A aspects the Cusp X or 

. If the Planet Ais in the Star or Sub of the Occupant of the Cusp X or 

. If the Planet Ais in the Star or Sub of the Owner of the Cusp X or 

. If the Planet A is in conjunction with or Aspected (Hindu) by the Owner of the Cusp X 
It may be said that the Planet A is connected with the Cusp X 


HUI BRB WN FP 


(c) Connection of a House or its Owner with another House 

1. If the Owner of the House X, Occupies or Aspects house Y 
It may be said that the Owner of House X is connected with House Y 

2. |f the Owner of the House X, occupies the house Y or 

3. |f the Owner of the House X is in the Star of the Owner of the House Y or 

4. |f the Owner of the House X Is in conjunction with or Aspected by the Owner of the House Y 
It may be said that the Owner of the House X Is connected with House Y. 


(Condensed from ‘Horoscopes and Diseases’ by Sri C.R. Bhatt)

Answers to the Question of Readers | 


eR AORYACCRQO a 





Question- 1: Casting a Tajika Chart 


In the part 5 of the “KP approach to different mundane charts for Polish parliamentary election” (KPE-zine October 
2011 issue), the annual or solar return chart |.e. tajaka annual chart is mentioned. 


Can we create the annual solar return chart in KP for a natal chart of native and make a tajaka analysis ? | have 
checked J Hora software and it has the feature to cast the tajaka chart. 


Does the KPAstro 4.0 software has the feature of annual, monthly, daily tajaka chart. Pls advice. 
Answer- 1: 


The erection of the Tajaka Chart or Varshphal or Varshaphala or Annual Horoscope or Solar Return Chart is the same 
for the moment when Sun during its course comes back to the original degree, minute and second of the Zodiac 
where it was at the time of the birth of native. 


The KPAstro 4.0 has the feature of casting the Solar Return Chart of a birth chart, which is similar to the Annual 
Horoscope or annual Tajaka Chart, to make a Tajaka analysis. 


However, since the KP New Ayanamsa (2003) and Placidus house systems are used in the KP Annual Horoscope, the 
appropriate ayanamsa and house system should be applied from the various options of KPAstro 4.0 for the Tajaka 
analysis. 


Another difference is that the KP Annual Horoscope Is to erect only to the locality where the native at that moment Is 
and not to the original birth place. (‘Annual Horoscope’ in KP Reader III pages 481-487, and ‘Annual Horoscope- An 
Example’ by K.S.K. in the Astrology & Athrishta ] uly 1976 issue pages 3-8) 


In the part on Solar Return or Tajaka Chart, the KPAstro covers the casting of Tajaka annual, but not monthly and 
sixty-hour etc. charts like ]Hora. Such kinds of charts casted by the JHora can be converted to the KP charts by 
KPAstro 4.0. 


Question- 2: Promise of Marriage 


Please enlighten - if the 7th cuspal sub lord does not signify 2, 7, 11 at all but does signify 5 and 8, will the person 
get married as we know some KP based methods equally recognize 5, 8 houses for marriage? 


Answer- 2: 

In KP marriage is promised, only if 7" CSL signifies 2,7 or 11" house according to the rationale of house 2 (addition 
to family members), 7 (legal bondage with spouse who legally shares the possessions) and 11(long standing love, 
permanent tie of friendship and partnership in life). (KP Reader IV pp 110, 117) 

The signification of only house 5 (pleasure) and 8 (sex) jointly, without 2,7,11, may indicate one’s inclination towards 


sexual pleasure with companion without interested in getting married. (Progeny and Romance, K. Subramaniam, 
pages 144-146)

| mportance of Longevity 


As said by Guru ji KSK, every one, however old he may be, would like to live for some more years. Death Is the last 
event in the life of a native, hence the astrologers attached great importance either to toil over the assignment of 
more or less approximate date of departure from this world or determine the circumstances and the type of death. 


Longevity and Death 


2. The double role of 8" house is like that while it represents longevity or life span of the native, it denotes death as 
well, and it is so confusing or confused that it is to show the adverse effect of the 8" house signification in the 
analysis of both longevity and running DBAS. 


3. Regarding the role of longevity, houses 1,8 and 3 are the houses of longevity. It means that houses 1,8 and 3 are 
to be judged for longevity whether one will live long or is blessed with short life. The 12™ to houses 1,8 and 3 are 
death-inflicting houses 12, 7 and 2; houses 2 and 7 are called Maraka and 12 Moksha (death). The Bhadhaka houses 
are the worst malefics for death. Regarding longevity, lords of 1,5,9 and 10 are benefics and lords of 6,8 and 12 are 
malefics. (KP Reader III, pp 161-162/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, pp 8-9) 


Judging the 1* Cuspal Sub Lord for Longevity 


4. For longevity, it is therefore to judge the cuspal sub lords of 1, 8 and 3, but most importantly and by experience to 
examine the lst (native self) CSL, whether it signifies 1,5,9,10 for long life or Badhaka, Maraka, 6,8,12 for short 
life. But the 1st CSL’s signification of 1,8,3 does not mean long life because of 8" signification. If the sub of the 
Lagna is a malefic t.e. lords of 6 (disease), 8 (incident) and 12 (danger, death), life is short. Therefore if the 
Ascendant and the lord of the Ascendant and the sub are in the constellation of planets who are significators of 
houses other than 6 or 8 or 12, the native will live long; good health will be maintained. (KP Reader III, p 175/ 1971 
Practical p 22) 


5. The importance given to the 1 CSL can be seen in the following examples: 
e Ex chart 1 (KP Reader III, pp 159-161/ 1971, Practical pp 7-8) 

Ex chart 2 (ibid pp 164-166/ 1971 pp 12-14) 

Air Accident(ibid pp 17--172/ 1971 pp 17-18) 

Escape from an Accident (ibid pp 173-174/ 1971 pp 20-21) 

KP Reader VI, pp 155-156 


Danger to Life 


6. If the 1% CSL signifies the 8" house (danger to life), then the 8" CSL is to be further examined. If the sub lord of 
the Ascendant is deposited in the constellation of the significator of the 8th house, one will meet accident. (KP Reader 
VI, p 155) If the sub lord of the 8" house is deposited in the constellation of the planet which is a significator of the 
8th house, then the accident is indicated. (KP Reader VI, p 159) If a planet signifies Lagna bhava and it is in the sub 
of the significator of 8°" house, one meets with danger. (KP Reader V, p 144/ 1971 p 138) If the sub lord of the 8" 
cusp is deposited in the constellation of a planet who ts the significator of Badhakasthana or Marakasthana and also 
8" house, one would commit suicide. (KP Reader VI, p 258) 


Adverse Effects of the 4 House Signification 


7. If 8th (serious sickness/ disease, incident, suicide, surgery, danger to life, no luck etc.) signification appears in the 
judgment of lst (native self) CSL and 8th CSL and in the significators of running DBAS, "the life of a native is in 
danger or may be cut short without mercy", especially in combination of Badhaka, Maraka, and 4th & 12" forming 
4,8,12 (trigonal houses for serious incidents by Kundanthai Nathan in Astrosecrets & KP Part Il, p 94 and K.M. 
Subramaniam in Sub Lord Speaks-2, pp 62, 108 as well as so-called terminal houses in the Western astrology). 


8. The adverse effects of 8" house signification on longevity are as given under: 


1) 8th house is called the house of "longevity". Therefore planets in the constellation of evil planets in the 8th house, 
except Saturn, occupants of the 8th house, planets in the constellation or in the sub of lord of 8, lord of the 8th cusp 
and planets in any manner connected with them indicate (a) danger to one's life, (b) the cause of death and (c) the 
place of death. (KP Reader III, pp 160-161/ 1971 p 8) 8" denotes longevity or span of life, house of death, suicide,

Longevity is the matter which according to me cannot be calculated easily. What | can analyse from a chart Is 
whether there is any threat or danger to life. For calculating the longevity of any person, | use and apply only the KP 
Astrology principles. Astrologers are not God. Astrologers answer the queries on the basis of their knowledge and the 
applicability of the rules they know. Here Is a query regarding his mother’s deteriorating health from a New York (US) 
based native. As his mother’s birth details were not available | asked her horary number. To calculate the longevity of 
mother we need to rotate the Ascendant to the 4th cusp. 


Query: Mother’s Longevity 
Horary (1 -249 ) : 127, Date: 15 - 06- 2010, Time: 20:38 pm 
Place : Bhopal, Latitude: 23N07 ( G), Longitude : 77E27, Ayanamsha: KP 23:54:46 


HINTS: 

If the Sub Lord of the Ascendant be the significator of 

A) 6 , 8 and 12 house, a Short Life up to 33 years 

B) 1,5,9 or 10, a Long Life beyond 66 years 

C) both A and B, then the Middle Life up to 66 years is indicated. 


Consider the houses 8 and 12 for accidents. Mars, Saturn , Rahu and Ketu cause accidents. 
Besides, if the cusp sub lord be the significator of Maraka ( 2,7 ) and Badhaka ( 11th for Movable , 9th for Fixed and 
7th for Common signs), then it is also bad for longevity. 


The houses Ist, 3rd and 8th are to judge for longevity. The 12th to any particular house denotes non existence of the 
matter signified by that particular house. So 12th house, 12" to 1° (self) house, is also harmful for longevity. Saturn 
is the chief governor of longevity. Here we will have to analyse all the 1st, 3rd and 8th to judge the query and also 
the Mahadasha , Bhukti , Antara and Sookshma as well as the transit of Sun and Moon. Lagna is moved to the 4th 
cusp for mother. 


MOON AND ASCENDANT SUBLORD 

Before solving any query one must look at the position of Moon and the Ascendant sub lord. Let us analyse the chart 
whether the query is indicated by either Moon or the Ascendant sub lord. Moon is placed in the 7th house which is a 
Maraka Sthan and it Is in the star of Saturn which is placed in 8th house i.e. house of longevity, serious illness, death, 
so the Moon clearly shows the state of mind of the querist. Now look at the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant which Is 
Saturn which Is lord of 1st and 2nd house and placed in the 8th house. So we proceed to analyse the cusps to 
validate the query. 


CUSPAL ANALYSIS 

1st Cusp ( Capricorn 03:07:30 - Sa Su Sa ) & 3rd Cusp ( Pisces 05:11:58 -- Ju Sa Sa ) 

The lord of the Ascendant, 3 and also sub lord is Saturn. It is placed in 8th house, lord of 1st and 2nd houses, in the 
star of Sun which is also placed in 5th house, lord of 8" house, and in own sub of Saturn. So Saturn is strongly 
signifying 5th and 8th houses, along with lst and 2nd houses, hence it is mediocre for the longevity . 


Sth Cusp ( Leo 04:45:05 - Su Ke Mo ) 

Moon Is the cuspal sub lord of the 8th house, the house of longevity; it is placed in the 7th house as house owner. 
Moon is in the star of Saturn which ts placed in the 8th house, lord of 1st and 2nd houses, and in the sub of Mars in 
the 8" house, lord of 4° house and 11" house (Badhaka). Hence Moon becomes the strong significator of 8", 7" and 
2™¢ houses, so it is not favorable for the longevity. 


RULING PLANETS 

Lagna Sign Lord : Jupiter 
Lagna Star Lord : Venus 
Moon Sign Lord : Moon 
Moon StarLord =: Saturn 
Daylord : Mars 


As discussed above, most of the Ruling Planets signify the negative houses for longevity. J upiter is the lord of the 
12th house and 3rd house and placed in the 3rd house. Jupiter is in the star of Saturn which Is placed in the 8th 
house. Mars is the lord of the 4th house and 11th house. It is placed in 8th house. So all the RPs are generally 
indicating the longevity negatively.

Now | am going to analyze the nature of the death of the wife from the birth chart of her husband. (Birth details of 
Husband: - DOB=06-12-1959; TOB=03-25PM; POB=Koilkuntla; 15-14N; 78-15E ;) For the sake of reader’s 
convenience and for easier understanding (1) the rotated chart to 7th as Asc. (2) the birth chart of husband and (3) 
transit chart (for the day on which the event took place) are attached with this article. 


The 8th house is called as the “House of Death”. Mostly Hindus consider this house as the end of man’s life in this 
world. This house also conveys whether it is a natural death or unnatural one such as drowning, fire, accident or 
Suicide or due to chronic diseases and whether it is a slow or sudden and violent death. 


(1) “To commit suicide, the sub lord of the 8th cusp should be in the constellation of a planet who is the significator 
of Maraka or Badhakasthana and also 1 and 8 houses”. 


(2) “The sub lord of the 8th cusp should have some kind of connection with Mars and Ketu”. 


(3) “Moon should also be afflicted with airy sign connection with Saturn and Mars aspect or conjunction as this 
combination produce negative thoughts to a native.” 


(4) “If there is any kind of relationship or connection between/among the co-rulers of the Ascendant and the 8th 
cusp, then the native only will be the cause of his/her own end.” 


(5) “The assassin is represented by the 7th house of the native. It is a well-known fact to all of us that the 7th 
house represents all the persons who have dealing with the native. When the sub lord of the 7th cusp is deposited in 
the constellation of a planet signifying Maraka or Badhakasthanas and also the 8th house of the native, then the 
native will be assassinated in the hands of assassin”. 


(6) “An event generally happens during the joint period of the relevant significators when the transit agrees.” 


(7) “At the time of event the luminaries (Sun & Moon) or /and joint period rulers are generally found to be transiting 
in the star or sub of the same joint period ruler or rulers (i.e. in the star or sub of the Dasanatha, Bhukthinatha, 
Anthranatha and Sookshmanatha period ruler.)” 


(8) Place of death of the individual can be known by the placement of either the 8th cusp sub lord or It’s star lord in 
which sign it is posited. 


Let us apply the above mentioned rules one by one to the rotated chart to 7th as Asc. for wife in an elaborated 
manner: - 


(1) The 8th cusp sub lord Jupiter (2-3, 6) is in the star of Mercury (1-9, 12) and in the sub of Venus (12-1, 8). No 
planet in the star of Venus, and Venus is the CSL of 6, 7, 12. Jupiter is the 8th cusp sub lord and the occupant of 2. 
He is in the star of Mercury who owns 12. He Is in the sub of Venus who owns 1 & 8 and also the occupant of 12. 
Jupiter is in the star of Mercury and Mercury is in the star of Jupiter. This is known as “NakshatraParivarthana” 
(mutual exchange of starlords).This sort of parivarthana indicates the Positional Status of the Planets concerned. If 
you see the table of Significators-Planet View, it is crystal clear that Mercury signifies 2 & 1 as ‘A’ & ‘B’ grade; J upiter 
signifies 1 & 2 as A & B grade. Hence J upiter signifies 2 & 12, both are Marakasthanas and also 1 & 8. 


(2) The 8th cusp sub lord J upiter and Its star lord Mercury are conjoined with Mars. 


(3) | Moon Is in the airy sign (Aquarius). This Moon is aspected by Mars and Saturn. So this combination produces 
negative thoughts to the native. 


(4) The co-rulers of the Ascendant are Venus/Rahu/Ketu and the co-rulers of the 8th cusp are Venus/Moon/] upiter. 
Venus Is the sign lord of both the Asc. and the 8th cusp. The 8th cusp star lord Moon is in the star of Rahu who is the 
star lord of Lagna. Lagna Sub lord Ketu is aspected by 8th sub lord J upiter. Hence this sort of relationship between 
Asc.and 8th cusp Is only the cause of her own end. 


(5) 7th cusp sub lord Venus (12-1, 8) is in the star of Mars (1-2, 7) and in the sub of Sun (2-11). Venus’ star lord 
Mars is the significator of Marakasthanas (2 & 7) and Venus owns 1 & 8 also. There was a roumour that this native 
was asSassinated in the hands of her husband as the 7th cusp sub lord Venus also stands for KALATRAKARAKA. 


(6) Suicide on 26-05-1999 at about 3-31PM. At the time of this event Saturn/Mars/J upiter/Mars was running from 
24-05-1999 to 27-05-1999 as Dasa/Bhukthi/Anthra/Sookshm lords respectively. The D/B/A/S must be the significators

Except Saturn as Dasanatha, the remaining Mars, Jupiter, and Mars as Bhukthinatha, Anthranatha and 
Sookshmanatha appeared in the above table of significators. “When Dasa Lord Is not favourable for the fructification 
of the event, Bhukthi Lord and Anthra Lord cannot do anything over ruling Dasa Lord” Then how Saturn becomes the 
dasanatha at the time of suicide? The answer for it is very simple. In this type of critical situation, we have to 
consider “E” grade significators as a last resort. 


(a) “A planet in conjunction, or association with or aspected by a significator gives the results of the house or houses 
denoted by the significator. So the last preference should be given to the planet in conjuction or aspect with that 
Significator.” 


In this chart, Rahu, the significator for Il, Xl & XIl, and Moon, the significator of XII are aspected by Saturn. Now this 
Saturn can be included in the list of the significators. 


(b) Imp: - The eleventh cusp (Badhaka) Is co-ruled by Ketu as Star lord and Mars as sub lord. If any planet is situated 
in the Star or sub of either Ketu or Mars, that planet will indicate the Eleventh house results. This rule applies to all 
Cusps. 


Saturn only a single planet is situated in the star of Ketu. So the Saturn will indicate the eleventh (Badhaka) results. 
(c) “A planet aspecting the house may be considered as the significator of that house.” 


Saturn aspects the 12th house (Marakasthana). Saturn Is in the star of Ketu and Ketu is an agent of J upiter, J upiter is 
occupant of 2. Saturn is in the sub of Mercury owner of 12. 


Thus Saturn acted as Dasa Lord at the time of suicide. 

Important Note:- The Key Points mentioned above in (a), (b) & (c) are to be remembered. 
(7) Saturn (D)/Mars (B)/J upiter(A)/Mars(S) = 23-05-1999 to 26-05-1999. 

Committed suicide on 26-05-1999 at about 03-31 PM in Kurnool. 


Transit: - (a) Sun Is transiting in the sign of Venus along with Mercury. This Mercury is in the sub of Mars who is the 
Bhukthi lord at the time of the event occurred. Both Sun and Mercury are aspected by Mars, the bhukthinatha with 
8th aspect. (b) Moon is transiting in Kanya in the star of Mars and in the sub of Saturn. (Saturn is the Dasalord and 
Mars is the Bhukthilord). (c) Saturn, the Dasalord is transiting in Aries along with Jupiter. (J upiter is the Anthralord). 
(d) Mars, the Bhukthilord and Sookshmalordistransitting in Libra in its own star (Chitta-3 pada). (e) Jupiter the 
Anthralord Is transiting along with Dasalord Saturn in the sign of Mars who is the Bhukthilord and Sookshmalord. 


(f) Both Saturn(dasalord) and Jupiter(Anthralord) are aspected by Mars(Bhukthilord and Sookshmalord) and vice- 
versa also. 


(8) The 8th cusp sub lord Jupiter and it’s star lord Mercury are posited in Scorpio which is fixed sign. So this native 
died in her own house by burning. 


Suicide by burning is tallied astrologically as follows:- 


8th cusp sub lord Jupiter is the owner of a fiery sign (Sagittarius) is hemmed in between Sun (owner of a fiery sign- 
Leo) and Mars (owner of a fiery sign Aries). All the three planets (Mars, Sun and Jupiter) are the lords of fiery signs. 
Hence she died by burning.

Question-2: Role of Badhaka 
P| clarify whether the Badhakas are trouble makers for any event of life. 
Answer-2: 


1. The J ataka Parijata (Chapter ||, Sloka 48) originated Badhaka (11, 9, 7 houses for moveable, fixed and common 
sign respectively) are taken into consideration in KP only when judging the longevity, health and end of life, and not 
for any other event of life. 


2. Badhaka may affect only the health if its Dasa or Bhukti is operating... (KP Reader V p 263/ 1971 edition p 226) 


3. In Jathaka Chandrika the author claims that the lords of the houses 3,6,8 and 11 are malefic. By that he means, 
according to me, that these are evil only for one's heath and longevity and not for other aspects in one's life. (KP 
Reader V p 131/ 1971 p 125) 


4, The Badhaka (11,9,7) and Maraka (2,7) concepts are originally Rasi/sign based but in the Placidus house applied 
KP, it is just to follow what the Placidus cusps show, nothing else. The problem arises when two or four signs are 
intercepted (sign with any cusp falling there) and please see the practical application in the example charts (with 
intercepted signs) in the KP Readers and CR Bhatt’s books etc. 


Question- 3: Manual Calculation of Vimshottari Dasa Balance at Birth 


In the KP-Ezine June 2011 issue “When | will get Rs 10 crores through the sale of business product which | am 
developing now”, for the date of 24-9-2007, time 10.26.07, lat 23.00N, long 72.32E, KP ayanamsa 23.52.29, Moon 
position is 8.30.09 in Aquarius. By software calculation the dasha balance at birth is Rahu 15y 6m 8d but! calculate

Short Background 


As you all are aware, Mr. Sarath Fonseka, the former Commander and General of the Sri Lanka Army, is the most 
discussed person in the international media and by the lips of Sri Lankans from the time of ethnic struggles in Sri 
Lanka up to now, while he Is in a cage of prison breathing through the iron bars. From the date of his 
imprisonment no stone unrolled by the family members and his supporters and followers to save him from the jail, 
which all were ended in smoke till the date. Rest of the leaders of the General’s political party and his wife Mrs. 
Anoma Fonseka have launched an on line petition to be signed by the Gen's lovers for his early release. Meanwhile 
one of his followers and a sub leader of his political front announced that he has finished some successful discussion 
with the President for the release of General SF. 


This effort is to see its successfulness through the KP stellar astrology and its rules for "imprisonment". Before going 
for any study on his release from the jail, it is better to check his destiny for imprisonment to see the correctness of 
his life events mirrored by his natal chart. 


Natal Chart 
Gen. Sarth Fonseka was born on 18 Dec. 1950 at 02.12.45 AM in Ambalngoda, southern Province, Sri Lanka. The 
natal chart erected by KPAstro 4.0, adopting the KPNA, is attached herewith. 


KP Rule for I mprisonment 
12th cuspal sub lord should be Rahu or Saturn but not always and signify 2, 3, 8, 12th houses. 


Here in his natal chart the 12th CSL is Sa, the lord of 4 & 5 in 12, in the star of Su lord of 11 In 2 and in the sub of Ve 
lord of 8 & 1 in 3. As the 12th CSL is Sa and signifies the required houses 12,2,8 and 3, the rule for imprisonment Is 
satisfied. 


Genaral Sarath Fonseka was arrested on 08.02.2010, when he is under the DBAS of Ma - Me - Ra - MA and the 
Military Tribunal Verdict was declared on 14.08.2010 with the punishment of two years imprisonment in the DBAS of 
Ma - Ke - Ra - Su.

Anthara Lord (Ra)

Dilemma of Accurate Birth Time 





TinWin 
=e tw853@yahoo.com 


Criteria for Moments of Birth 


1. There is difference of opinion regarding what is the criterion to be followed to find out the correct time of birth out 
of the following five moments of birth: 


1) Emergence of the head (M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & KP, Part 1); 

2) First breath (A. Raichur); 
http://wiki.astro.com/astrowiki/en/Moment_of_Birth 

3) Emergence of the whole body (Satyacharya: Satya J atakam; KP Reader VI); 

4) First cry (K. Subramaniam: Astrosecrets & KP Part IV, Rectification of Birth 
Time); 

5) Cutting of the chord (Prof. P.S. Sastri: Rectification of Birth Time, Sanjay Rath). 
http://wiki.astro.com/astrowiki/en/Moment_ of Birth 
http://www.astrologyweekly.com/dictionary/birth-moment.php 


2. Charles Jayne's extensive work with rectification led him to conclude that the effective moment of birth for chart 
calculation purposes may not necessarily coincide with the common moments of birth and the chart that works might 
precede or follow the birth. 


Many Birth Time Rectification Techniques 


3. There are so many birth time rectification (BTR) techniques talked about in KP and other systems, as provided in 
the Attachment |. There have been no adequate comparative studies of the various methods for rectification 
accuracy. The inadequacy of these methods speaks for the wide range of Mrs. Indira Gandhi's birth time, as shown in 
the attachment II. The extensive discussion on this topic has been done all the time, but with no practically applicable 
conclusion. 

Note: Astro-Databank- Rodden Rating “C”: Use with caution: original source is not known, or the data have been 
“rectified”. 


http://www.astro.com/astro-databank/Astro-Databank:Handbook_ chapter 01 


4. Based on the findings of Geoffrey Dean (Recent Advances in Natal Astrology, The Astrological Association, England, 
1977, p 470), the reasons for such inconsistency seem to be as follows: 

1) Rectification requires expertise; 

2) There is no agreement on which techniques are reliable and which are not useful; 

3) There is no objective evidence for the validity of the dynamic techniques on which most rectifications are based; 
4) Some techniques such as the prenatal epoch are questionable. 


5. Under these conditions, we will probably never know the truth of this matter. The controversy about what is the 
birth time will never be settled. (K.N. Rao: Timing of Events Through Vimshottari Dasha, 1996, in Preface to the 
Second Edition) 


A Possible Way Out 


6. Instead of getting struck in that, only if the TOB is doubtful, especially by the consultant, the BTR can be done by 
the help of RPs because of the following reasons: 


1) Some methods in mathematical nature have been found biased to acceptance or rejection of birth times in 
the statistical studies done by Dr. Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy. 
(http://groups.yahoo.com/group/k_p_system/files/Rectification% 20Study/) 

2) To find birth time - - only the Ruling Planets at the moment of judgment will be useful and innumerable 
instances are given in the magazine "Astrology & Athrishta." (KP Reader VI, p 138) Our beloved Guruji had 
found and was correct to tell that the RPs alone can be well used for the rectification of birth time in charts. 
(Prof. Vikari Ramamurthy, in KPE-zine Nov 2009 issue) 

3) Note the sublord of the sixth (6th) cusp. This needs correct moment of birth. If it is not available, then if you 
want to know the sub of the sixth, you take ruling planets at the moment when you have the urge to put the 
query. Mysteriously God will help you by eliminating the previous and the next sub to the one which you have 
to select. (Astrology & Athrishta 1970 Jan issue p 27, Astrology and Disease' by Guruji KSK, also in KP 
Reader III p 281/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, p 118) 

4) Unless the client raises specific doubts in his birth-time, we need not attempt unnecessarily to correct the 
birth-time at all. However, it is better to check his birth-horoscope by taking the RPs...(K. Baskaran: Secrets of 
R.P. & The Birth Time, p 10) 

5) An unnecessary and unreliable BTR would add some more drops in the 
ocean of uncertainties.

Vimsoththari Mahadasa and Dasa Results According to KP Eziie 





G.H.W. Silva,

Interpretation of the dasa results according to Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi is totally based on the method of the 
Vimsoththari dasa system. 


As the zodiac is divided into twelve equal parts, called the signs or rasis and again to twenty seven asterisms or stars. 
Each of these stars is again divided into nine parts according to the order and the duration of the planets according to 
the Vimsoththari udu dasa system. With the division of the stars for nine parts of all stars, we get 243 (27x9) parts in 
the zodiac. Our Late Guruji, Sothida Mannan, Jeotish Marthand, Prof. K.S. Krishnamurthi made this circle into 249 
parts by adding the overlapping 6 sub divisions, and named as sub positions of the rasi chakra. This is the cream of 
the Krishnamurthi Padhdhathi, where we all make accurate preditions and delineations using the sub lord theory. 


Normally every one will face the influences of each planet during their periods according to Vimsoththari dasa system. 
The dasa balance at the time of birth is determined according to the position of Moon in the birth chart. The major 
period of the dasa is shown according to the star lord, where the Moon is posited and the lord of the sub division of 
the star shows the lord of the sub dasa or Bukthi. When these parts of the stars are further divided in the same 
manner, we could identify the lord of the sub sub dasa or Antara. 


Recently we came to know a controversy that some Western astronomers have tried to identify an additional sign in 
between Capricornus and Aquarius naming as Opechius, thus indicating that there are thirteen signs inside the 
zodiacal belt of 360 degrees. However the eastern zodiac of 12 signs Is giving accurate results as before. Therefore it 
will not be necessary to change over to thirteen sign zodiac soon. (According to Mr. David R. Roell, astrologer and 
wner of the biggest astrological ‘Astroamerica’ book store in US, in the Astroamerica News Letter, dated J anuary 18, 
2011, that past week a group of unreliable astronomers in Minneapolis suckered the local paper, the Tribune, into 
running the old lie about Ophiuchus being the “13th sign of the zodiac.” Which got picked up by KSTP, the local TV 
Station, and then by CNN, The Christian Science Monitor, The Huffington Post & everyone else. 


http://www.astroamerica.com/astroamericanewsletter. pdf 


According to the always reliable Krishnhamurthi Padhdhathi, a planet will offer the results indicated by the star lord of 
that planet during his dasa or sub dasa periods. Therefore we need to find the star lord of the dasa or sub dasa 
periods and its signification in the horoscope. Further the native will enjoy favorable or other results according to the 
position of the sub lord of the planet. 


To explain the behavior of the dasa or sub dasa lord, we will use the following birth chart. 


At the time of birth, this native had a dasa balance of about 2 years for Sun. Accordingly she was under the influence 
of Rahu dasa from J] une 1979 to June 1997. 


This dasa lord Rahu Is aspected by J upiter and J upiter is in 5, lord of 6, 9. Rahu ts in a star and sub of Sun, who Is in 
eleven bhava and lord of second bhava. Therefore during the period of Rahu, the native will enjoy the results the 
results connected to higher education, life in a foreign country, matters connected with the father and live a noble life 
and magnanimous activities. Again this star lord Sun as a significator for eleven make the native get her expectations 
fulfilled with less effort and these will give satisfaction in life. The fifth signification will make the environment for the 
native to enjoy music, have love affairs, take part in sports and involve with children. 


Accordingly, we have identified that the native will have very good results during the maha dasa or sub dasas of 
Rahu. 


This native got employed on first October 1986. On this day she was under the influence of Rahu as dasa lord and 
Saturn as bukthi lord. This Saturn is in a star of Venus and sub of own. Saturn Is in 6 and lord of 7, 8. Star lord Venus 
iS in 11, lord of 4, 11, which Is a significator for eleventh, six, tenth and fourth bhavas. 


Tenth cusp shows the nature of employment. It falls in the sign of Aries, star of a planet ruled by Venus and a sub of 
Mercury. This Mercury and Venus combination in a sign of Mars shows engineering and construction along with 
ground/earth. 


This sub lord Mercury is deposited in one of his own signs, Gemini. This is a clear indication of plurality in the 
employment and also the high knowladgebility is indicated. This sub lord is deposited in the eleventh bhava and ina 
Star of J upiter. J upiter is the lord of sixth and nineth occupying the fifth bhava.

Question & Answer 

Question: Which birth details of Smt. Sonia Gandhi are preferable? 
Answer: 

Short Background 


1. Based on the old records dated May 18" 2004, the world’s largest democracy had been stunned on May 18" 2004 
by the size of the Congress win over veteran PM Mr. Atal Behari Vajpajee, who called the elections six moths early to 
cash on in a booming economy, bumper harvests and the prospects of peace with Pakistan. (Opinion polls: 53% for 
Vajpayee, 25% for Sonia and 2 % for Advani). 


2. Any favorable astrological prediction for Mrs. Sonia Gandhi had not been found in the internet before the elections, 
except the unknown AstrologyForU.com “In Budha-Mars dasa till 22-03-2005, she may likely to land in the highest 
position.”; Narayanan “Congress will fare well.” ; and the Grassshopper, 22-09-2003 (based on ‘No. 8 Lo-Shu square’) 
“Feb, May and August 2004 she will be centre stage and her political fortunes should also climb”. 


3. It is said that much earlier in his life, Yogi Karve told Mr. Nehru in Yeravada Jail, “Don’t worry, you, your daughter 
will become PM, and she will have a son, who will also be PM, and he will have a wife, who will also become PM”. 
What Mr. Nehru once laughed off later came true. The last thing is that Mrs. Sonia Gandhi actually won the general 
elections to become PM, but she had declined. 


Unsure Birth Charts 


4. At that time some unsure birth charts of Mrs. Sonia Gandhi were in circulation - - - Cancer Ascendant mostly used, 
le. TOB 21:15 pm, 21:30 pm, 21:40 pm, DOB 09.12.1946, POB Turin (Italy), but for some Gemini, Scorpio, Capricorn 
etc. without unnecessarily mentioning the recorded astrologers’ names. 


5. A possible source is the horoscope of Mrs. Sonia Gandhi [Date of birth: 9th Dec.1946, 

Time of birth: 21:30 hrs. (Italian Zonal Standard Time), Place of birth: Turin (Italy), 45N03, 07E40, Asc 
23:57:32 using Chitrapakshiya Ayanamsa] on page 83 of the “Sonia Gandhi (A Biography)” by Mahesh Sharma, 
Diamond Pocket Books (P) Ltd., 2005, which is the same as in the link below: 


http://www.howisyourdaytoday.com/SoniaRjv.Htm 


6. In the biography of “Sonia Gandhi Through a Different Lens” by Sir Dr. Ravi Singavarapu, Fultus Publishing, 2005, 
p 3, she was born in a place called Orbassano, an Italian village, 80 km from Turin on Dec 9, 1946. 


Birth Details as per Birth Certificate

Mrs. Sonia Gandhi has been found “born on 9 December 1946 at 21:30 (= 9:30 PM ), Place Lusiana, Italy, 45n47, 
11e34, Time zone MET hle (is standard time) in the US$ 200+ paid AstroDatabank 4.0 SW, as shown in the following 
link, now free at the courtesy of the www.astro.com :

little village 30 km from Vicenza in Veneto, Italy, where families with the family name "Maino" have been living for 
many generations. She spent her adolescence in Orbassano, a town near Turin, being raised in a traditional 
Roman Catholic family and attending a Catholic school. Her father, a building mason, died in 1983. Her mother 
and two sisters still live around Orbassano.’

Is Jupiter always beneficial? 


Sumanadasa Namarathna 





“Death comes primarily during the conjoined period of significtors of Badhaka (11 or 9 or 7), Maraka 
(2,7), Moksha (12) (and in some cases, 8 = accident, 4 = end of everything including life, 10 = 
retirement from this world or life; 4,8,12 = trigonal or terminal houses of serious accidents or unnatural 
death; also 6 = injury in accident)." 


1.Sri Rabindranath Tagore 


Born on 07/ May/ 1861, 02:51:00 AM, TZ Hr 5:53 East, KOLKATA (CALCUTTA), WEST, BENGAL, India, 
22:32 N/ 88:21 E, KPNA 21° 49' 54", Asc. Pisces 042 46' 15", Bal. Dasa: Mercury 11 Y, 11 M, 11D 


The lord of the Ascendant J upiter is posited in the 5th house, Cancer sign. As per Hindu astrology J upiter is said to be 
exalted in Cancer sign and hence very strong. Varahamihira says it is yoga for an intelligent native. It is true. By being 
the Kendradhipathi (1 & 10) here J upiter is a beneficial planet for the native according to the classical astrology. 


As per J aimini astrology, J upiter is exalted in 9th from ArudhaLagna. In KP 9th is for good luck. But the bad luck came 
into effect by Jupiter for the reasoning of Its star lord Mercury, the lord of 4 (end of life) and 7 (Maraka&Badhaka). 
Dr. B.V. Raman has easily founded this fact and explained in his books (My Experiences in Astrology, 1998, pp 84-86; 
and Notable Horoscopes, 1995, p 191). 


As per KP, J upiter(6,1-10) is in the star of Mercury (1, 4-7) and in the sub of Rahu+(10) No planet in the star of Rahu 
and Rahu is CSL of 10, 11. Rahu is in Sagittarius sign hence represent Jupiter. Thus Jupiter has contributed the 
effects of 7 (Maraka&Badhaka), 6 (diseases, injuries), 4 (end of life) and 10 (retirement from this world). He died on 
7 Aug 1941, when he was under the MahaDasa and Bhukti of J upiter. 


2. Sri Mahatma Gandhii - 


Born on 02/ Oct/ 1869, 07:11:48 AM, TZ Hr 4:38 East, Porbandar, India, 21:38 N / 69:36 E, KPNA 21° 56' 
56", Asc. Libra 042 45' 08", Bal. Dasa: Mercury 2 Y, 6 M, 6 D 


Ascendant lord Venus Is in Lagnabhawa conjoining with Mars, the lord of 2 & 7 (Maraka) and associating Mercury, the 
lord of 9 & 12, which can be considered as an evil yoga. In the Moon Dasa he acquired his name and fame. Mo, the 
lord of 10 (name and fame) is in its own sign Cancer, the 10th and conjoined with Rahu. Here Rahu has offered him a 
great success in all his careers with the influence of its star lord Saturn (common people) and sub lord Mars, a planet 
of practical thoughts and courage. Venus as a planet of truth took him to the front and made him a leader of non- 
violence movement in India. Mars+(1,2-7) with its maximum tension in Lagna, conjoined with Lagna lord Venus, had 
allowed him to start his political career and taste the rice of jail as well in its main period 1915-1922, and produced a 
brave hero to the Indian nation, amalgamating a lawyer, a civil right champion and a spiritual character. 


Role of J upiter

of Ve.

Sumanadasa Namarathna 





In Monroe's chart, 8th CSL is Mercury, owner of 3, 12 (Moksha), occupant of 10 (retirement from this world), in the 
star of Moon, owner of Lagna, occupant of 7 (Maraka), and in the sub of Jupiter, lord of 6 (diseases/ injuries), 9, 
occupant of 7 (Maraka). The above rule of unnatural death Is satisfied, along with the involvement of 7, indicating the 
possibility of a foul play. 


7. John Lenon 


Born on Wednesday, 09/ Oct/ 1940, 06:30:00 PM, TZ Hr 1 East (Daylight Saving Time), Liverpool, 
England, 53:25 N/ 02:55 W, KPNA 22° 56' 24", Asc. Pis. 262 57' 47", Bal. Dasa: Moon 9 Y, 6 M, 16 D 


John was a worldwide popular British musician as one of the founding members of the most commercially successful 
musical group "The Beatles". He was shot to death on 8th December 1980, in his J upiter Dasa and Mercury Bhukti. 


Role of J upiter 


Jupiter is the lord of Lagna and 10, occupant of Lagna, in the star of Venus, lord of 2 & 3 in 6, and In the sub of its 
own Jupiter. In addition Jupiter with no planet in its star is the sub lord of Lagna, 3, 7 (Maraka&Badhaka), 9, 11 
cusps. Thus Jupiter has become an invidious malefic for the native. The Lagna lord Jupiter in the Lagnabhawa is 
found not helpful for the danger to his life although J upiter placed in one’s Lagna Is supposed to cancel a lakh doshas 
in the horoscope. 


In case of an assassination the assassin is represented by the 7th cusp. On this condition, if the 7th CSL signifies 
Maraka or Badhaka and also the 8th, the native would meet with the death by the hand of an assassin. 


In the chart of John, the 7th CSL is Jupiter, in the star of Venus the Maraka lord of 2 and conjoined with Saturn, 
Significator of 6 & 12, and Jupiter-Saturn are aspected by Mars, lord of 8. Hence Jupiter has satisfied the 
requirements to be a killer. 


Conclusion 


In KP, no planet is wholly malefic or benefic, and the same trend Is emerging in the astrology of East and West. Many 
modern astrologers think that the idea of malefic and benefic planets is now obsolete. 


This little study reveals the truth in KP as mentioned by Guruji Sri KSK in his Readers as follows: 

“Hence no planet is wholly a benefic nor in full a malefic. It is similar to the Rose with thorns. A planet 
Is said to be a malefic when thorns are many. A planet is a benefic when the thorns have fallen down 
and the Rose alone looks bright, without any bee, which may perchance sting" (KP Reader III, p 136/ 
KP Reader V, p 136) 


“Hence one is to note what each planet can contribute. Always consider the Sub Lord." (KP Reader III, 
p 362).

Great Poet 


1. Adam Mickiewicz is generally regarded as the greatest Polish romantic poet. There are statues and monuments to 
honor him all over Poland as well as over the Slavic and Baltic states. Even streets are named after him. < 2 > 


2. This article is to analyze his important life events by the KP astrological rules.The following astrological 
combinations have made him one of the greatest poet of romanticism, patriotism and spirituality. 


e The 3™ (writing) cuspal sub lord (CSL) Rahu in house 2 (speech); No planet is in the stars of Rahu and Rahu 
is the CSL of 3 (writing), 6 (gain over opponent), 8 (something unknown/ innovative), 9 (creativity, higher 
mind), 11 (gain, success), 12 (something unknown/ innovative); Rahu is in the star of Sun in 10 (career, 
name, fame) and sub of Jupiter in 1, lord of 10, indicating great success in writing poetry with hardship. 

e The 2™ and 3™ lord Venus (artistic sense) in 10 opposite 5 lord Moon (imaginative poetic ability) in own 
house 5 and the joining of Sun with Venus in 10; 

e Neptune, discovered in 1846, rules the art of the Romantic Movement. The J upiter inflames Neptune’s artistic 
talent and Neptune raises Jupiter’s creativity with exceptionally good writing skills through their mutual 
aspect and also spirituality as Jupiter is religion and Neptune is spirituality; < 3 > 

e The powerful magnetic aspect of 9" lord Mars (energy to take action) from Pisces (poetry) on Neptune 
(longings, spiritual imagination) in Libra (sense of symmetry) intensifies emotional nature and the ability to 
develop great creativity; 

e The mutual aspect between Mars and Uranus stimulates the exceptional energy for invention with mechanical 
Skill and the joining of Saturn’s aspect on both Mars and Uranus lessens the likelihood of violence; < 4 > 

e The Mercury (intellect, writing skills) opposite Saturn (deep thinking and analysis) provides the architecture 
for poetry.

10. Mickiewicz was in Rome when the news of the November 1830 uprising reached him. In April of 1831, he set out

never again set foot on Polish soil, and thus Nowogrodek and Wielkopolska became the only regions of Poland the 
poet ever knew. He never made it to Warsaw or Krakow or any other of the Polish cities.

Longevity and Death

Crimean War, and Mickiewicz traveled to Istanbul, along with Prince Czartoryski's son, to launch a Polish legion, and 
there in Istanbul, Constantinople (now Istanbul, Turkey) he contracted cholera and died suddenly on November 26, 
1855.

1855 (Ve-Ma-Mo-Su) @ age of 56. 


17. Dasa lord Venus signifies 10 (retirement from this world), 2 (Maraka), 8 (danger to life, serious disease) and 12 
(Moksha), Bhukti lord Mars 8,12 and 10, Antra lord Moon 6 (sickness), 10 and 2, and Sookshma lord Sun 10,8,7 
(Bhadaka, Maraka).

in 1822 and again suicide attempt in December 1838 (Me-] u-Ra-Ve) because of marital discord, and his wife Celina's

New Delhi, December 17; Uttar Pradesh’s ruling Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) Is likely to be replaced by Mulayam 
Singh's Samajwadi Party (SP) as the single largest party in the 403-member assembly after elections next year, an 
opinion poll said Saturday. 

STAR News-Nielsen survey, conducted in 202 constituencies of the state in November, also said that the “Rahu 
Gandhi factor” can make at least 24 percent non-Congress voters shift to the Congress. 

According to the survey, the SP would emerge as the single largest party ahead of the BSP, followed by the Congress 
and the Bharatiya Janata Party (B/P). 

The survey predicted BSP's victory in 117 constituencies, a massive drop trom its 2007 tally of 206. The SP Is likely to 
win in 132 constituencies, a gain from its 2007 tally of 97. 

The Congress may win in 68 constituencies, a huge gain from the 22 it won in 2007, while the B/P Is likely to finish 
with a tally of 65. 

A statement on the survey's findings said the Congress’ alliance 
with Ajit Singh’s Rashtriya Lok Dal would result in the alliance 
winning in 8&5 constituencies. 

“The alliance between Ajit Singh’s RLD and the Congress was 
announced midway through the survey. The Congress’ move to 
tie up with Ajit Singh seems to be paying off as the survey 
estimates that the alliance will get 85 seats,” said the statement. 
Within the alliance, the Congress may win in 70 constituencies 
while the RLD may win In 15 constituencies. 

The survey also said that Rahul Gandhi's aggressive campaign in 
the state “seems to be striking the right note with the voters”. 
The survey showed that 47 percent people felt that the Congress 
general secretary should immediately take over as _ party 
president

Question: KP Ayanamsas 





| hope you will not mind if | ask for your help and guidance. 

| am confused about the KP straight line ayanamsa? Also, what is the formulae for calculating the New KP Ayanamsa? 
| am assuming that the old KP Ayanamsa is taken from the Original Table of Ayanamsa as given in the Readers. 

| will be obliged if you would kindly explain or guide me to a book or article on this subject. 

Answer: KP Ayanamsas 


1.The KP straight line ayanamsa was proposed by the "math wizard" M.G.G. Nayar's article "Ayanamsa and its 
Importance in Stellar Astrology" in the Astrology & Athrishta 1976 J uly issue pp 12-13, and practically introduced by 
MC Khare's article "Ayanamsa-Problem?” in the A&A Oct 1978 issue pp 6-8, also providing two tables to calculate 
the value of this ayanamsa up to the required month and date, which Is called the 'KP straight line (adjusted) 
ayanamsa' in the KPAstro 4.0, since its first version. Dr. Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy, developer of KPAstro, had 
explained how to calculate it in detail. 


2. In the above articles, it's value is justified by very closeness (around 30-40 sec) to the (Lahiri) ayanamsa used in 
the UTOH and the ayanamsa recommended under Drick system, also mentioning that it is higher around 6 min than 
the values of ayanamsa in KP Reader | and R.E. Manu's Ready Reckoner. Because the ayanamsa used in the UTOH is 
Lahiri ayanamsa as said by Late Shri Raichur, co-author of the UTOH, while the controversy of the Correct Ayanamsa 
was going on, in the UTOH, the aynamsa adopted was really Laheri's, though not so stated. Hence that Lahiri’s is 
around 6ms different from the KP ayanamsa. 


3, It can be confused whether an astrloger is using the Old KP, Lahiri or straight line ayanamsa. But it is not to worry 
for the KP beginners about the difference between KP Old/New and Straight Line for KP analysis by using up to sub 
only, except in the border line cases. 


4. The KP yanamsas is explained with compared to Lahiri’s as under:

KPSTLA = T*P/ 3600 

where 

T = Year of Birth minus 291 A.D. 

P = 50.238847/5sec per year 

Note: T = fractional/decimal year taking days between given date and 15th April 

The KP Stright Line Ayanamsa such calculated up to the required date is called KP Stright Line (Adjusted) Ayanamsa 
in the KPAstro 3.5. 

(as per MC Khare in the A&A Oct 1978 issue pp 6-8, and as explained by Rangarajan Krishnamoorthy, developer of 
KPAstro 3.5)

Determination of Lagna First is not a KP Practice 





TinWin 
By i tw853@yahoo.com 


Taking Lagna Alone 


The evolving research findings of Guru ji KSK were written and compiled in the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati, two 
volumes of 1966 by Sagar Publications and later extended, updated and regrouped in the six KP Readers of 1970-71. 
For instance, in the earlier writings of Guru ji KSK, it had been ascertained whether Lagna or the Moon sign is 
stronger, but the further research revealed that the correct approach is to take always Lagna alone, and the 
correction was made by Guruji KSK in the KP Reader III, pages 432-3 (1971 Edition, Practical Part, p 259). 


http://www.scribd.com/doc/24500319/krishnamurti-Padhdhati 


What is Determination of Lagna First? 


2. Determination of Lagna first is meant for consideration of Lagna first for any matter related not only to first bhava 
ut also other bhavas, and then also simultaneously determination of the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of the relevant bhava. 
Such practice is done in the cuspal interlinks methods by classification of Lagna based or non Lagna based matters or 
in general. For example, for promise of marriage the signification of houses 5,7 or 11 by the Lagna CSL or CSSL is 
determined first and then also the similar signification by the 7‘ CSL or CSSL is simultaneously considered. 


3. In KP, the Lagna CSL is determined for 1* bhava matters only. For other bhavas’ matters, only the relevant CSL is 
determined straight, without simultaneously considering the Lagna CSL first. For example, for promise of marriage, 
only the 7 CSL signification of house 2,7 or 11 is considered straight and the Lagna CSL has nothing to do with 
promise of marriage in the whole KP Reader IV of ‘Marriage, Married Life & Children’. In other words, KP does not 
determine Lagna first and simultaneously the relevant CSL for promise of other bhavas’ matters but the cuspal 
interlinks methods are practicing such kind of the simultaneous consideration of the Lagna first and also the CSL of 
the relevant bhava. (K Baskaran’s Principles of Cuspal Interlinks by, pages 38-45, 197, 202; S P Khullar’s Horary 
Astrology, pages 451-458, How to use the Appendix A: House Grouping) 


4. The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is promised or not. The significators point 
the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara (transit) must agree. (KP Reader V, page 224/ 1971 Edition page 
211; KP Reader III pages 226, 362/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, pages 68, 194) 


Three Ways of Mentioning of Lagna in the Astrological Analysis 


5. First way: J ust introductory saying of what is the Lagna, e.g. Aries Lagna or Ascendant in Hindu or Aries rising in 
Western 
e Just introductory talking about Lagna but not determination of Lagna first for promise of other bhavas 
matters other than first bhava matter (KP Reader III, page 147 (1971 Edition, Theory Part, page 140) 


http://www.4shared.com/office/qgenZw20C/kpreader_3-predictive_stellar_.html 
http://www.4shared.com/office/DQQWMT9q/kpreader_3-predictive_stellar_.html 


e Another introductory saying of “The ascendant was LIBRA” is not determination of Lagna first for promise of 
other bhavas matters other than first bhava matter. (KP Reader II] p 199/ 1971 Edition, Practical Part, page 
43) 


e Also introductory mentioning of “The native is born in Libra Ascendant” is not determination of Lagna first for 
promise of other bhavas’ matters other than first bhava matter. (KP Reader III pages 218-219/ 1971 Edition, 
Practical Part, page 61) 


6. Second way: Lagna cuspal sub lord (CSL) is studied for Lagna (First Bhava) matters such as physical features, 
general characteristics, health, longevity, status etc. 


e At the beginning of the Guru Ji KSK’s old article: “The Greatest Sage in Our Age” (Astrology & Athrishta March 
1965 issue/ Notable Persons & K.P.”, edt. K. Hariharan, pages 1-7), Lagna is determined for physical features 
and general characteristics of the Lagna bhava matters. After that for speech, food 2nd house, mother 4" 
house, father 9° house etc are determined, i.e. Lagna is determined for Lagan bhava matters only and non 
Lagna bhava matters are determined by other relevant bhavas. So it is not determination of Lagna first for 
other bhavas’ matters. 


e Considering Lagna bhava matter of marks, scars or mole on the body from Lagna but it is not determination 
of Lagna first for other bhavas’ matters. (KP Reader III page 159 (1971 Edition, Practical Part, page 7)

Is Saturn always malefic? 





& ~—s Sumanadasa Namarathna 
(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
Ex-Accountant, KP Astrologer 
Marapola, Veyangoda, Sri Lanka 


Ssunaparantha@yahoo.com 
Nilanjana samabhasam raviputram yamagrajam, 
Chayamartamda sambhutam tarn namami Sanaischaram. 


Oh Lord Shani! Let me allow to recite this stotram as written in "Brahmanda Purana" and write an essay on you for 
the benefits of the living human who tremble when hearing of you. 


In Sanskrit Saturn is called Shani or Shanaischara by the meaning of slow mover. Being the sixth planet from the Sun 
and the second largest planet in the solar system, it takes 30 years to complete one circle of the Zodiac and two and 
half years for a Zodiac sign. In the Zodiac, Saturn rules two adjoining signs, Capricorn (Makara) and Aquarius 
(Kumbha), and is the owner of stars (nakshastra) Pushya, Anuradha and Uttara Bhadra. Saturn is exalted (Uchcha) in 
Libra, debilitated in Aries (Mesha) and Leo (Simha) being the worst (Moodha) amongst its enemy houses. In KP, when 
Saturn is connected with the Moon, Saturn denotes four "D's, ie; Delay, Deny, Dejection and Disappointment in any 
life matter. Generally Saturn is known as the most dreadful and most malefic planet in the zodiac, which has the keys 
to heaven and hell in his hand. 


Most of Astrologers used to warn and advise remedies to their clients on the movements of Saturn using many 
adjectives like Shani Eraastaka, Sade Sati, Shani Sapthama and many more. When Saturn moves to 8th from the 
Moon in the natal chart it is called Astama Shani and a bad period is at hand. When it moves 12th, Lagna and 2nd 
houses from Moon, the native would have to suffer for a period of seven and a half years, Known as "Sade Sati" 


When Saturn travels in the 12 house, the first part of Sade Sati, the native would have loss of prestige and honor, 
aimless travels, lack of comfort in living, arguments, and poverty, rise in expenses and losses etc. When it Is in the 
first house, threat of assassination, status and prestige could get affected, mental afflictions, and sorrows, health 
could suffer. If it is in the 2nd house the native’s mind becomes unsound, innumerable worry accumulates, there is a 
general failure to achieve good results, the native experiences ill health, and misunderstandings arise. There is also a 
considerable amount of financial stress. 


If it is true, 25% of the population of the world is always under these bad effects of Saturn, and after that next 25% 
is to be a victim of Saturn and there is no end at all in this process. If Saturn is doing such a horrible duty, there 
won't be a single living being in peace and prosperity in this universe! 


In the planetary cabinet Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus and J upiter are generally branded as most benefic by nature and 
Mars, Saturn, Rahu & Kethu are branded as malefics, Saturn the worst by ancient sayings. Now it is the time to see 
how far these doctrines are justifiable. From the history we can see that there were many rulers like Kings, 
Presidents, Prime Ministers and many successful people in various ranks of the society who had come to their glorious 
periods of life under the shelter of so called the most malefic Saturn. Something may be wrong with branding the 
planet Saturn because Smt. Indira Gandhi, Amitah Bachchan, Bill Clinton, Napoleon Bonaparte, Helmut Kohl, Francois 
Mitterrand and many more reached their peak in the Saturn Dasa and Bhukti or in the Sade Sati in progress. 


Saturn in the 10" house is also said for speedy rise to a high level and prestige and then sudden fall from power, with 
Napoleon and Hitler often being cited as examples. Oscar Wilde is supposed to fall from height with Saturn in his 10°" 
house. However this Rise and Fall Rule of Saturn in the 10 house is found not valid for Bill Clinton and Francois 
Mitterrand with Saturn in 10° house of Cancer, Helmut Kohl with Saturn in 10 house of Sagittarius and many others. 
To grasp the meaning of the brand or the rank of a planet, let us study some charts with these three aspects of 
Saturn, namely Saturn dasa aspect, Sade Sati aspect and Saturn in 10" aspect.

By being one of the giants of post-war French politics, Francois Mitterrand was the 21st President of French Republic 
for 14 years for a record as the longest serving President of France. As President, Mitterrand introduced a series of 
radical economic and political reforms. This included nationalizing financial institutions and several large corporations, 
raising the minimum wage, improved welfare benefits and abolishing the death penalty. 


| would like to end his autobiography with the following quotation witnessing to his great political success under the 
influence of Saturn in 10™ house. 


"People seem to take pleasure in recalling that day, and to share their memories," said Pascale Kremer, a journalist at 
Le Monde magazine, the weekly supplement of the French daily, Le Monde, which invited readers to share their 
memorable May 10, 1981 moment. 


Above is only a bit in the list of great persons who have Saturn in 10th house of their natal charts, and there are so 
many un-fallen characters in various types of careers with Saturn in 10th house, for example, Muhammad All - boxing, 
Carl XV - King of Sweden, Hugo Chavez - Venezuelan President, Cheiro - seer, Nicolaus Copernicus - Polish 
astronomer, Leonardo DiCaprio - American film actor, Leonardo da Vinci - Italian artist, Albert Einstein - scientist, TS 
Elliot - poet, Greta Garbo - Swedish film actress, Joao II - King of Portugal, John Maynard Keynes - economist, Pope 
John Paul Il, Pablo Picasso - artist, Georges Pompidou - French Premier, Noel Ty! - American professional astrologer, 
Oprah Winfrey - American actress, whose chart details are available in the AstroDatabank, now at www.astro.com . 
According to KP, the positive or negative effect of Saturn is to be considered by the signification of its sub lord. 


Conclusion 


It is found that planet Saturn is not responsible for all the downfalls of a native, as written in various astrological 
treaties. In Vedic, Saturn is called as miserable planet. But this miserable Saturn had shown its qualification to fulfill 
the nature and application of Mid Heaven, such as Jeevana - livelihood, Rajaspadada - kingdom, Sat - good, Mana - 
honor, Kriyam - sacrifice, Vyapara - commerce, business or trade, Aspada - position or rank, Artha - wealth, Pravrithi 
- Inclination, Karma - occupation, Guna - quality, Jaya - success etc as In Vedic system. 


Brinat Parashara Hora Sashtra by Rishi Parashara, Phaladeepika by Mantreswara, Bhrigu Sutras by Rishi Bhrigu and 
Saravali by Kalyana Varma do not definitely say that Saturn in 10th house is bad. Further it is not limited only to 10th, 
but any where in the chart even with its Sade Sati it proves the universal truth that Saturn Is not always malefic, 
depending its position and signification as per KP astrology. According to Meenakshi Raut’s study on Benefic Ad 
Malefic Effects of Saturn’s Sade-Sati, a gloomy view of Sade-Sati shoud not be taken unless the entire horoscope Is 
analyzed properly. (Empirical Insights in Vedic Astrology, Sane Publications, 1999, pp 201-217) As per Robert Hand, 
Saturn is not malefic in traditional sense of ‘unlucky’ and growth and knowledge come about through Saturn although 
it may not feel good by Saturn transit. (Handling the Malefics, Essays in Astrology, Whitford Press, 1982, pp 39-48). 
So there is nothing to worry about Saturn in its Dasa Bhukti periods or in the periods of Sade-Sati or Saturn in the 
10™ house of natal chart.

A young person of Ludhiana, who was eager to go to an Arabian country for job at a foreign company for quite a long 
time but was not successful so far, approached me to intimate when he will be able to go abroad. | asked him to tell 
me a number between 1 to 249; accordingly he told me a number of 113. Calculations were made for this horary 
number on 12-02-2007 at 1.10 pm at Chandigarh. 


Moon’s I ndication 

As per Moon as indicator of mind condition, Moon is lord of house 11 in 3. Moon’s star lord Mercury is in 6"" (job), lord 
of 1 & 10 and its sub lord is Venus, which Is placed in 6, lord of 2 & 9 (long journey). So it clearly shows position of 
mind willing to go abroad for job. 


Fulfillment of Desire 
The 11" cusp sub lord Rahu is in 6 and sign of Saturn (retrograde). Rahu’s star lord Jupiter is in 3 and lord of 4, 7 
and its sub lord is Saturn (retrograde). So there is no chance of fulfillment of desire. 


Cuspal Sublord 

As per Horary Astrology of Sixth Reader written by Guru ji K.S. Krishnamurthy on page 300 for going to a foreign 
country, it is to judge 12 cusp and find out whether the sub lord of 12™ cusp is either retrograde or deposited in a 
constellation whose lord Is retrograde. If either one is retrograde, one cannot go abroad. If the sub lord and lord of 
the constellation in which sub lord is situated are in direct motion and if the sub lord of the 12" cusp is also the 
significator of either house 3 or 9" or 12, one can go abroad. 


As per guidance on page 303 last paragraph of Sixth Reader, if the sub lord of WA cusp IS deposited in a common 
sign, he will go and come back; if it is movable sign he will once for all leave the present place and never return. If It 
is in the fixed sign, it indicates that he will not move out. 


Here the 12™ cusp sub lord Venus is in 6" and lord of 2 and 9 but at the same time it is in Aquarius sign which is a 
fixed sign. Also Venus Is in the star of J upiter which is located in a fixed sign of Scorpio, although it Is in 3, lord of 4,7. 
Because of the location of the 12" cusp sub lord and its star lord in the fixed signs the native cannot go overseas, 
although 12" cusp sub lord signifies houses 9 and 3. 


Coincidently the 9°" cusp & 3™ cusp sub lord is also Venus and as we have discussed above, Venus indicates obstacles 
in moving to a foreign country. 


Further | also checked the Dasa and Bhukti period whether it is conducive or not to foreign going. 
As per dasa period on 12-02-07, he was running Mercury Dasa and Venus Bhukti from 09-12-2004 to 09-10-07. 


MahaDasa of Mercury: 
Mercury Is in 6, lord of 1 & 10 and in the star of Rahu in 6 and sub of Venus In 6, lord of 2,9. However, all of them, 
Mercury, Rahu and Venus are placed in Aquarius of fixed sign. 


Bhukti of Venus: 

Venus has been discussed above and it indicates obstacles in foreign going. Hence Dasa lord and Bhuktilord are not 
conducive to overseas travel, so aS per analysis done by KP astrology he cannot go to a foreign country for job 
purpose. 


It was later confirmed by the young man that all his required papers were completed by the foreign employment 
company and he went to Delhi airport on 02-2007, along with many other recruited employees but he was deported 
from the airport. While other members of the team were allowed to proceed to the foreign country, he had to return 
home and was very much disappointed. Until date i.e. February 2012 he is not able to go to a foreign country. 


My pranam to Guruji Shri K.S krinnamurthy for his marvelous KP astrology.

9. Her complicated love life owes much to the triple conjunction - tumultuous rebel Uranus, mental Mercury, lord of 
5" house (love affairs), and ruthless Pluto in Leo - flanking the cusp of 7" house of relationships, which made her 
attracted to wayward, unpredictable boys, as was the case with her spouse. Additionally the residence of Mars (the 
King of war), lord of 10 (12 to 11) also in 7" house made her married life a battle ground of violent fights with the 
spouse. It is also shown by the 4,6,8 and 10 signification of the 7" and 11" CSLs, as given below. 


10. The 7 CSL Venus is in 6 (enmity, detrimental 12" to 7), lord of 3, 4 (detrimental 12 to 5), 8 (quarrel, 
disappointment), in the star and sub of Mercury in 7, lord of 5. The houses 2, 5, 6 and 7 are assumed connected in 
KP through the sub lordship of same Venus. 


11. The 11" CSL Sun+ is in 6 (enmity, detrimental 12" to 7), lord of 7, with no planet in its star, in the star of 
Mercury in 7, lord of 5 and sub of Mars in 7, lord of 2,9,10 (detrimental 12™ to 11). 


Longevity 


12. 1° CSL Ketu+ is in 11, aspected by Mars in 7, lord of 2,9,10, sign lord J upiter in 1, lord of 11, in the of star Venus 
in 6, lord of 3,4,8 and sub of Mercury in 7, lord of 5, indicating less than medium life because of signification of 9 
Badhaka, 2,7 Maraka, unbeneficial 6, 8 danger to life, 4 end of life against the favorable 1,5,11 signification for 
longevity. 


13. The 2" house (food) is aspected by its lord Mars, significator of Badhaka and Maraka, denotes bad food (drugs). 
Jupiter is in its own sign of Pisces, an addictive sign conjunct the Moon. Jupiter also aspects Venus in the 6 house 
(drugs), which shows her tendency toward indulgence. Saturn (drug) particularly aspects J upiter very closely from the 
12™ house (drug rehabilitation clinics). Unfortunately her Sun in Cancer also opposed Saturn which rules addiction and 
entrapment and also the 12th house of self undoing. The Saturn-opposition-Sun-Venus would not make her feel 
Satisfied despite her soaring talent. According to Frances Sakoian & Louis S. Ackera, Moon opposite Mars could 
indicate a tendency to act out and get drunk and spend money foolishly. The square between the Sun (life force) - 
Venus (attraction) conjunction and Neptune (drugs) reveals her weakness for drugs, which ruined her career and life. 
As per Liz Greene, Neptune in the 8" house can be connected with certain kinds of depression or soul sickness and 
also with the case in deaths caused by drug overdose, form example, the pop singer Janis Joplin and the cult leader 
Jim Jones. Neptune and Pisces expressed themselves through art and creativity, as said at the beginning, but could 
also indicate the strong urge to transcend the realities of her live without seeing it clearly, which is why drugs and 
drink are so addictive, and that was a hallmark of her short life.

(drug, sickness), 8 (danger to life), 4 (end of every things) and 10 (retirement from this world).

Mr TinWin answers to the questions of readers 





Dasa and Sookshma lord J u(8,2-4) is in own star J u(8,2-4) and sub Mo+(10,11). No planet Is in star of Mo which is 
sub lord of the 2° cusp. Bhukti lord Me(6,8-10) is in star Su(5, 9) and in own sub Me(6, 8-10). Antra lord Sa+(11,3) 
is in star Ju(8,2-4) and sub Me(6,8-10). No planet Is in star of Sa which Is sub lord of the cusps 6, 12. 


Here the point is that marriage happened with the signification of 2 or 7 or 11 by the Dasa, Antra and Sookshma lords 
only but without the signification of 2 or 7 or 11 by the Bhukti lord. It shows that marriage can happen in KP without 
signification of 2 or 7 or 11 by each DBAS lord as long as the Dasa lord is capable of giving marriage. It is the 
difference from a KP based system which is said to complete the chain of 2,7,11 by each DBA lord signification. Such 
cases of marriage without the complete chain of 2,7,11 Is the reason for failure in selecting the fruitful significators in 
fixing timing of event in prediction. 


Only the DBAS lords of significators of 2 or 7 or 11 which are common with the Ruling Planets are to be chosen as the 
fruitful signifcators for marriage, and so in such cases the Ruling Planets method as selection tool cannot be helpful. 


The second point is that the J upiter Dasa/ Mercury Bhukti dasa sequence gave the marriage because of Dasa lord 
Jupiter’s capability of giving marriage although Bhukti lord Mercury’s inability of giving marriage but the Mercury 
Dasa/ J upiter Bhukti reverse dasa sequence cannot give marriage as Dasa lord Mercury Is not conducive to marriage 
although Bhukti lord is capable of marriage.

Book Review aa 





By 
~~ wii 
tw853@yahoo.com 





The Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology 
by H.L. Cornell, 958 pages 


The author Howard Leslie Cornell, M.D., (1872-1938) was a natu- 

ropathic physician with a practice in the US and India. In 1918 he 

set about to compile the medical references in his many astrology 

tia books. The result of 15 years work was published in 1933. It has 
The | been in print, off and on, ever since. It remains the one indispen- 

| Eneyclopaedia | sable medical astrology book. 

| af 
Medical 
Astrology 


HS. Cornell, 


Of this book, the author writes, "In my years of practice as a phy- 
sician, | have, by the use of Astrology, been able to very quickly 
locate the seat of the disease, the cause of the trouble, the time 
when the patient began to feel uncomfortable, as based on the 
birth data of the patient, and this without even touching or exam- 
ining the patient, and my intense desire to get this knowledge 
and wisdom before students and Healers in a classified form, Is 
the reason for this Encyclopaedia.... When once you have discov- 
ered the cause of the disease, and understand its philosophy and 
the relation of the patient to the great Scheme of Nature, the 
matter of treatment | leave to you, and according to the System 
and Methods you may be using." (from page 502) 


This is by far the best book ever written about medical astrology. 
Though it dates from 1933, it is the best medieval astrological 
medical reference ever put in print. The fundamental purpose of this encyclopedia is to give the planetary influences 
which cause the various diseases, afflictions, events, accidents, and injuries of life, and to gather such knowledge 
under subjects, and arrange them alphabetically with the cross-index.

Different Views 


Rahu and Kethu have no size or shape or substances and they are only two celestial points in the sphere of Zodiac. 
So they are called shadowy planets or Chaaya Graha. In most books of Hindu Astrology these "Nodes" are inherently 
viewed as evil cosmic influences, and the influence of Rahu is comparable to Saturn and Kethu for Mars saying "Shani 
Vat Raahu - Kuja Vat Kethu". 


As the dragon’s head (North Node) and the dragon tails (South Node) of western astrological thought the two nodes 
represent powerful psychic forces beyond our personal control and understanding as having something to do with 
one’s karma. In the Uranian astrological system of Germany, the nodes are interpreted as having a lot to do with 
interpersonal relationships. 


According to the Kalidasa’s Rahu/Kethu rules mentioned in the “KP Reader II, page 315”, Rahu or Ketu will act as a 
strong agent to the planets to which they are conjoined. If they are not conjoined with any planet, then they give the 
results of the planet which aspects them. Only when they are neither conjoined with, nor aspected by any planet, 
they represent the lord of the house. (Uthrakalamrita -- Khanda VI Sloka 14 onwards) In addition to these rules the 
star lord of Rahu/Kethu is also considered in KP. 


Generally Rahu or Ketu is stronger than any planet. So, if Rahu or Ketu represent any significator planet, then 
Rahu/Ketu should be given first preference as a significator in place of that significator planet. 


Analysis of Example Charts 


Not only adverse results but also beneficial outcomes have been found given by Rahu for many of the well known 
characters in getting to their peak, as mentioned in the “Skanda Purana” that Rahu Is instrumental in strengthening 
one’s power and converting even an enemy into a friend. This is an effort to verify some of those highly appraisable 
results given by Rahu, based on notable charts as follows. 


1. Sri Mahatma Gandhi 


Born on Saturday, O2 Oct. 1869, 07.11.48 AM LMT, TZ 5.21 East, Long. 69:36 E/ Lat. 21:38 N, Porbunder, 
Gujarat, India, KPNA 212 56' 56", Asc. Libra 042 39'38", Bal. Dasa: Mercury 02 Y 06 M 07 D. 


Rahu is tenanted in the 10th house, sign Cancer in conjunction with Moon, the cusp and sign lord. Rahu Is in the star 
of Saturn in 2 (Maraka/ house of wealth / getting family) and in the sub of Mars in Lagna Bhawa. According to the KP 
principles, Rahu is stronger than Moon, here for the 10th house (name, fame). 


Just after two days of the commencement of Moon Dasa- Rahu Bhukti period from 09 Sept. 1906, on 10 Sept. 1906 
Gandhi addressed a mass meeting of Indians at Johannesburg, which took oath of passive resistance against newly 
promulgated Transvaal Asiatic Law Amendment Ordinance. In early 1907 he wrote a series of articles on "Ethical 
Religion" published in weekly Indian Opinion and later as a book in Marathi. In Rahu Bhukti he had achieved a 
considerable public reputation not only among the Indians but also all over the World as a leader for freedom. 


In 1915 during Mars Dasa, he came back to India from South Africa and joined the Congress movement as a leader 
and could gather more supporters to Indian National Congress Party as his starting point of political carrier. 


During Rahu Dasa (10.04.1922 to 10.04.1940), in 1924 September he started Satyagraha for the unity of Hindu and 
Islam in India. In 1925 he founded All-India Spinner's Association. |n 1930 he marched to Dandi Sea Beach breaking 
the Salt Law, where he was arrested with his supporters but unconditionally released. In 1931 he participated in the 
second round table conference in England as the sole representative of National Congress of India for freedom. In 
1932 he won his demand regarding Harijans in India. Thus Mahatma Gandhi had gained success with name and fame 
mainly during the Bhukti of Rahu which occupies 10" house in conjunction with 10 lord Moon and with their 
respective star lord Saturn for common people and sub lord Mars for bravery and courage.
