It is also noted that Gandhi had under gone so many difficulties too in the above periods, especially imprisonment 
for 13 times from 1908 to 1942 by the British ruler. But most of those judgments were limited only to "punishment", 
as he was released in each period within a short duration. During the 18 years period of Rahu Das, Mahatma Gandhi 
was sentenced with imprisonment for three times |.e. on 05 may 1930, 04 Jan 1932 and 01 Aug 1933. 


Here in the chart of Mahatma Gandhi, he had experienced more benefits than some unpleasant incidents during the 
so called Paapa Grahas. If Rahu were a planet of wholly malefic in the 10th for political success with name and fame, 
how did he play a crucial role in India for its freedom? How did he bear the iron core of determination to reach his 
goal? Had he ever been In any distress of frustration? No, he became as an exemplary master politician beloved by 
the millions of people all over the world. According to my limited experience and the KP research finding, no planet 
Is totally malefic or benefic.

Origin of Theory 
1. Western Origin 


Claudius Ptolemy gave the so-called ‘five degree rule’ in his 7etrab/bios, a planet falling in the last 5 degrees of a 
house is judged to be in the next house, and applied it only to certain houses for a specific purpose. His disciples 
included all 12 houses in the rule. In William Lilly’s Christian Astrology, when a planet is within 5 degrees of the 
following house, it is to count the next house. It is perhaps like aspects between planets, the planets have a few 
degrees of orb and this puts it in conjunction with the following cusp. 


2. Vedic Origin 


In the Vedic and Nadi astrology, the following time frames and consequent approximate degrees, approximately 
around 5° except for Moon, are attributed to different planets in transit which they tend to give the influence of next 
sign in advance before the planet actually enters into the next sign: 


Sn Planet 


Moon 1.12 hr 
Mars 8 days 
Mercury 7 days 

| 2 months 


Rahu/Ketu | 2 months 



























3.KP Ongin 


In the example chart, Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, page 281, Moon at 21° 30’ Gemini, 
which is very near the 12" cusp, indicates life in a foreign place, and Moon is considered as if placed in the 12” 
house, although it is physically located in the 11th house. 


4. In the example chart, KP Reader /V, 1970, pages 107-108, the 7" cusp sub lord Rahu at 13° 09’ Libra is physically 
located in the 10 house but very near the 11° cusp at 15° 38’ 42” Libra within 2° 30’ orb gives marriage, which is 
the result of next 11‘ house. 


Different Opinions 


In the example chart, K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2000 pages 81-83 and also 2003 page 46 (by T. Rajendra Kumar), 
Jupiter at 10° 16’ Capricorn Is actually in the 5" house but very close to the 6 cusp at 11° 13’ Capricorn, giving the 
result of 6" house of service; similarly Saturn at 9° 08’ Gemini which is actually in the 10" house, giving the 11°” 
house results by being very near the 11” cusp at 11° 35’ Gemini. Also in the example charts of Times of Astrology 
magazine it is noted that if a planet is within 1° or 2° behind the cusp of a house and no other planet Is in the 
following house, it gains the significance of the following house, e.g. Jupiter gains significance of the 6th house and 
loses signification of the 5th house where J upiter is actually located since there is no planet in the 6th house. 


In the example chart, K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2005, pages 58-61 (by C.V. Tyagaraja | yer), the 2"° cusp sub lord 
Moon close to the 2nd cusp within 5° orb offered 2nd marriage to the native. 


In experience of Anant Raichur as well as of Sunil Gondhalekar, when planets are close to a cusp, they give not only 
results of the house they are in, but also predominantly of the house to which they are near, fixing the orb 3° 20’as 
1/4 of a pada of the nakshatra, as an approximation. But it can be extended to 4°-5°, if needed especially for the fast 
moving planets. 


Chandrakant R. Bhatt - Nakshatra Chintamanr \f a planet is within 5° of the cuspal degree of a house, it exerts its 
influence on both the houses. However, the ‘practical’ application cannot be found in solved examples in his books.

house commencing at Sagittarius 14°50'02. (Robert Hand) However, depending on orb, the Sun, which is 4° back 
from the 6th house cusp is in the border area and is a mixture of 5th and 6" houses. (Robert Hand: Horoscope 
Symbo!s) 


Carl Woebcke: You and the Universe - \f the Sun is in the 3 house and also within 3°- 4° orb (depending on planet) 
of the 4" house cusp, then its expression through the 4" fourth house is at least as strong as through the third; if its 
orb is less than 1.5°, it should be read as though it were in the 4" house and not in the 3rd house at all. 


Michael McClain: If the planet is close enough to be considered in conjunction with the next house cusp, say within 
around 2°, the action of the planet will most likely be directed into the oncoming house. 


Stephen Arroyo: Astro/ogy, Karma, and Transformation - Any planet located within 4° of a house cusp can be 
interpreted as belonging to, and concerning itself with the issues of both houses. 


In the horoscope analysis of http://www.astrotheme.com , regarding ‘precision’, according to the tradition, a planet 
near the beginning (called cuspide) of the next house (less than 4 degrees for the Ascendant and the Midheaven, and 
less than 3 degrees for all other houses) belongs to this house in our texts. 


Martin Bulgerin: AS you move counter-clockwise from one house to the next, the new house's influence starts to 
check in about 5° before the actual cusp position. J eff J owa also likes to use orb of about 5° with house cusps. 


Barbara Lee: Much depends on how far in degree the planet is from the next house cusp. If, for instance, Mars at 24° 
Aries close to the 10th house cusp at 26° Aries, the planet, while technically in the 9" house will operate more like a 
10" house comparative placement. 


John Frawley: Sports Astrology - A planet conjunct the house cusp but technically in the preceding house, could be 
seen as having power over the affairs of that house. So if J upiter is 2° from the 7" house cusp, then it might be seen 
as having power over the 7". 


Kevin B. Burk: Depending on which house system you use, a planet may fall in different houses. For natal 
interpretations, a planet close to a house cusp, particularly when it is about to enter the next house, can often be 
interpreted in terms of both houses; blending the interpretations of the houses are often both useful and appropriate 
in these cases. In horary and predictive astrology, a planet within 3-4 degrees of a house cusp is usually interpreted 
as being in the next house.

tw853@yahoo.com 





Zane B Stein: Traditionally, if a planet is in one house, but within five degrees of the cusp of the next house, it is read 
in the following house. Thus, Neptune in the 3™ within 5 degrees of the 4th cusp would be read as a 4th house 
influence. However, it has been my experience that this is an oversimplification, and that the planet is felt in both 
houses, but has its strongest impact on the next house. Thus, you would feel Neptune in both houses, but the impact 
would be strongest in the 4th. 


Robert Wilkinson: Depending on which system(s) we use, we'll get a variety of points that mark the cusps of the 
houses. But if it occupies a degree that puts It In one house in one system and an adjacent house in another system, 
then that planetary function involves how those adjacent houses affect each other. Rather than being in one or the 
other, it's actually in both simultaneously. 


Donna Cunningham, ‘How to Read your Astrology Chart: \|nstead of crisp dividing lines, there may be gray areas 
Shading gradually from one house into the other. What the interviews for any planet within five degrees of an 
intermediate cusp clarify, as often as not, is that the planet on the cusp affects and is affected by the matters of both 
houses. 


Joanna Martine Woolfolk - ‘The Only Astrology Book You'll Ever Need‘: \f you were cusp born, you are under the 
influence of both signs. However, much like being a traveler just leaving one country and crossing into another, you 
must actually be in one country - you can’t be in two countries at the same time. One sign is always a stronger 
influence, and that sign is almost invariably the sign that the Sun was actually in. 


Jean Baptiste Morin: Astriogia Gallica, Astrological Books: \t is noted that the ancients determined the strength or 
influence of a planet in a house is the same regardless of where the planet is placed in the house. This he regarded 
as contrary to reason of the five degree rule. It is also argued that the houses do not begin five degrees before the 
cusps because if that were true, the planet posited in that five-degree area would no longer have influence on the 
preceding house. 


Observation 


There is the possibility of orb effect for a planet very near the next cusp to give the results of the next house 
depending how tight is the orb. The modern tendency is to use small orbs from around 5°-6° by J Mayo, and Maurice 
Wemyss to about 3°- 4° by DA Bradley and CEO Carter. (Geoffrey Dean: Recent Advances in Natal Astrology) and 1°- 
2° by T. Rajendra Kumar, Michael McClain, K. Subramanium, Carl Woebcke etc. 1°-2° to give the result of next house 
only, and if the orb is larger than that the planet is supposed to give the results of the previous house only. 


If a planet is supposed to be a significator of both previous and next houses, the result of the next house may not be 
effective as the previous house is detrimental or Vyaya or negative to the matters of next house. (KP Reader ///, KF 
Reader IV, CR Bhatt's Nakshatra Chintamani). 


The orb theory for planets near the house cusps is not a rule consistently applied in the KP Readers although the 3° 
20’ orb theory has been found applied in KP practice to some extent. But the charts against the orb theory of planets 
near the cusps have been noted in the KP articles and discussion forum. 


It is open to further research on practical charts for or against the theory that a house begins, say 3° 20’ before the 
next cusp. Whether to apply the orb theory or not Is therefore up to the preference and experience of an astrologer.

Question: Is Saturn always malefic? 


In the article on Saturn you are writing off the distress, difficulties and agony that a person like Sri Amitab Bachan, 
Mr. Bush or Smt. Gandhi et.al. faced during Elenati Sani. 

| wish to contradict with all humility that what we see from out side as Rosy for such high up on the pedastal people 
is and may not be true !.The feel happy and being good factor is what one feels within and not what we appear to 
reckon. 


| am sure the great clenser Saturn certainly subjected them to difficulties to soend some of their Sanchit Karma. 
Forgive me if | am wrong. But | am only trying to corroborate what the great sages like Parasara told us. 


For the sake of emphasis | am placing in the concluding paragraph that | enjoyed and benefited from various other 
articles that you published earlier in this great Ezine. This however is only my opinion and | may be wrong. 


Answer: No planet is wholly benefic or malefic. 


It is true that those notables got success by hard work under the Saturn’s pressure. Similarly Napoleon had also 
fought sixty big battles and countless small ones, till nineteen horses had been killed under him, to be regarded as 
one of the greatest military commanders of all time. Hitler had fought in the German army during the WWI, winning 
the Iron Cross twice for bravery, till he was nearly blinded, to become a historic figure nearly a par with Caesar and 
Napoleon from a homeless, lost person in Vienna for four miserable years. 


The theme of articles on Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu etc. is that no planet is wholly benefic or malefic, which is not only the 
KP research finding but also the modern trend of both East and West astrology.

In the April 2012 issue of KPEzine magazine there was an article on Myanmar, where by-elections were held on 1° 
April 2012, and our able Editor Sri Kanak Kumar Bosmia predicted according to Krishnamurti Padhdhati that Aung San 
Suu Kyi will win the elections. As predicted by Kanak Ji, ASSK won a seat in parliament and according to world news, 
Madam Aung San Suu Kyi will be entering the parliament on 23™ April 2012 for the first time. 


As this great lady is a very favourite subject in the entire world today and also in appreciation of the achievement of 
Sri Kanak Bosmia on his prediction, | wish to add a little more on analysis of ASSK‘s birth chart. She was born in 
Burma, now Myanmar on 19" June 1945 and her Ascendant is Sagittarius. The birth chart published in the KPEzine, 
April 2012 issue by Kanak Ji is used here. 


The Vimshottari Dasa running at the time of birth was Mars for a period about five and half years. Now she is under 
the influence of Mercury dasa till the end of 2020. In her birth chart, Mercury is occupying the sixth bhava as lord of 
seventh and tenth, and in a star of Rahu. Rahu is in Gemini owned by favourable Mercury again. Rahu is also 
conjunct Sun in 6, lord of 9 and no planet is in the stars of Sun which is the cuspal sub lord of 10" . So Rahu is a 
good representative and a significator for having relationships with friends and also with opponents. 


Here we go through the transit in her birth chart on her winning day (01.04.2012 at Sunrise time in Myanmar). It is 
not a repetition of what Kanak Ji has written, but something like further transit analysis of the DBAS lords, Mercury- 
Moon-Venus-Rahu and luminaries. 


The Dasa lord Mercury was transiting in the 4" bhava of the natal chart, in the star of Jupiter and sub of Moon. 
Jupiter is the lord of 1st and 4" bhavas in 9" bhava in the birth chart. Moon is in the 10" of natal chart. 


The Bhukti lord and luminary Moon was transiting in the 7 bhava, in the star of Jupiter and sub of Mars. J upiter is 
the lord of 1st and 4" bhavas in 9" bhava. Mars is lord of 5 and 12 bhavas occupying the 4th bhava. 


The Antra lord Rahu was transiting in the star of Saturn and sub of own. Rahu is in 7 , very closely conjunct with 
Mercury in 6" , lord of 7, 10" bhavas. Rahu is also conjunct Sun in 6, lord of 9 and no planet is in the stars of Sun 
which is the cuspal sub lord of 10" . Star lord Saturn is in 7" , lord of 2"? and 3™ bhavas. 


The Sookshma lord and second luminary Sun was transiting in the star and sub of Mercury, which occupies 6" bhava 
as lord of 7 and 10" bhavas. 


The above significations of 1%, 6 , 9" and 10". bhavas show good relations for gaining and winning. 


In the past, we are aware that ASSK had been taken under house arrest in Myanmar for fighting for democracy in her 
country for most period of the 21 years from 20 July 1989 (Saturn-Mercury Dasa-Bhukti) until her most recent release 
on 13 November 2010 (Mercury-Sun Dasa- Bhukti), becoming one of the world's most prominent political prisoners. 
Her 12" cuspal sub lord is Ketu and its sign lord Jupiter is lord of 4° bhava and no planet is in the stars of J upiter 
which is the cuspal sub lord of 8". Ketu is in the star of Moon, lord of 8 and no planet is in the stars of Moon which

However, in her case 4,8" bhavas are found valid and 12" (new environment) is not prominent as she had been

According to her birth chart, current Bukthi Moon ends in mid 2012 and then the Bukthi Mars will commence. In her

10".

 suna arantha@yahoo.com 


Simply the deafness is loss of hearing. The hearing organ ear consists many other micro organs in it. The reason(s) 
for loss of hearing may be due to any weakness of one or more micro parts in the ear or any extrinsic or incidental 
damage of the internal micro organs. The hearing or the sense of hearing is generally ruled by planet Mercury, sign 
Gemini and house 12th. 


The dumbness is loss of power of speech. The Larynx is the main organ which produces the sound, also Known as 
sound box. The pith and volume are also manipulated by this. The larynx, which houses for Vocal Folds known as 
Vocal Cords, is connected with four Laryngeal Nerves i.e. two left and right superiors and two left and right recurrent 
nerves. Further it consists with muscles and cartilages to support for phonation and voice. 


Deaf and Dumb in Western Astrology 


According to the Encyclopaedia of Medical Astrology by H.L. Cornell, the hearing or the sense of hearing is 
generally ruled by planet Mercury, sign Gemini and house 12th. Some biological and astrological causes to the 
deafness are as given under: 


e Clogging of Auditory Nerve: The Auditory Nerve and the organs of hearing and the sense of the hearing 
are ruled by Mercury. Clogging and inhibition of the Auditory Nerve are due to mineral deposits by Saturn and 
especially when Mercury Is afflicted in the 12th house. The hearing become less and less acute by the 
clogging of the Auditory Nerve, when Mercury Is in Gemini, Libra or Aquarius and aspected by Mars. 

e Deafness due to III-Blood: in the veins of the ears or congestion in the blood vessels due to J upiter 
adverse influence and J upiter being in Aries and afflicted by Saturn. 

e Deafness due to bones in the ears: Hardening of the bones in the ear due to Saturn influence and Saturn 
being afflicted in Aries. 

e Born Deaf: This is due to parental afflictions as a rule. Natal aspects and conditions may concur such as 
Saturn afflicted in Aries or Taurus at birth; Saturn, Mars, Mercury being in Aries, in the 12th. 

e Deafness from Catarrh: so called Catarrhal Deafness is due to Saturn afflicted in Taurus, or in Taurus, in 
12th house. 

e Circulation Obstructed: The venous circulation in the ears is obstructed tending to deafness, owing to 
Jupiter in Aries and afflicted by Saturn, Venus in the 12th house and afflicted by Saturn, Mercury or Mars. 

e Deafness from Colds or Chills: due to Saturn afflicted in Aries. 


As we all know the entire nerves system of the body is under the rulership of Mercury, and all organs related to 
Speech are also mainly ruled by Mercury and sign Taurus. Also Mercury rules the air which stirs the vocal cord into 
action; the vocal organs are strongly ruled and influenced by the Scorpio sign. The transformation of thoughts into 
Speech and nerves related to speech are mainly under the ruler Mercury, and also ruled by the signs Aries, Taurus 
and Gemini. Uranus rules the motor nerves of speech. Mercury in Taurus especially rules and affects the motor nerves 
of speech. Uranus in Taurus also rules and affects the motor nerves and speech. Sign Aries rules the intellectual 
faculties, of which speech is the natural expression. The Taurus sign is closely connected with speech, as the center 
where thought is transformed into speech. The dumbness may be related with some other causes such as: 


e Amnesia : Loss of memory for words due to Mercury afflicted by Saturn and the Moon and Mercury in no 
aspect or relation to the Ascendant; Mercury being afflicted in Aries; Mercury combust and afflicted by Saturn 
and the Moon; And also setting in the west, out of dignity and in a weak sign. 

e Aphasia: Loss of power of speech due to afflicted Moon in Aries. 

e Aphonia: Loss of or whispering of voice due to Uranus or Mercury afflicted in Taurus 

e Stammering: The Sun in an Angle; Mars, Saturn and Mercury (especially Mercury) being in occidental 
(West); Saturn and Mercury configured with the Moon; The Moon increasing in a day geniture, separation 
from Mercury and applying to Saturn; The Moon and Mercury being afflicted and parallel or conjunction or 
Square or opposite to Saturn. 












































Dumbness is mainly caused by affliction in the dumb or mute signs (Reptilian signs/ sarisrp) Cancer, 
Scorpio and Pisces at birth or greatly afflicted at conception or during gestation. The mute signs tend to cause 
impediment of soeech when Mercury Is afflicted. This is a Mercury disease as Mercury rules the speech and caused by 
Square (90°) or opposition (180°) aspect of Mercury: Mercury in mute or dumb sign and afflicted by Saturn; Afflictions 
to Mercury at birth; Mercury in Taurus, the 12th House as Taurus rules the vocal organs and ears; Mercury in the 
12th house and conjunction with Neptune or square to Jupiter; if at conception Sun or Moon be in the 6th or 12th 
and Mercury with one of them in 12; A mute sign on the Asc. and Mercury being afflicted or if Mercury being afflicted 
by a malefic, posited in a dumb sign.

According to Western astrology, ears are ruled by Taurus sign and the lst house, and the sign Aries also has some 
influence over the ears and hearing as Aries rules the head. The hearing of the right ear is especially more affected by 
Saturn and that of the left ear by Mars. 


So, any of the above conditions may be a cause for deaf and dumb as written in the Western medical astrology. The 
readers should keep in mind that these are not KP or Vedic or Traditional rules for this disease. 


Deaf and Dumb in Vedic Astrology 


In the Vedic astrology hearing is ruled by the 3rd house and the ears have special affinity with Mercury (hearing and 
communications) and the Taurus sign. The 3” house indicates the right ear and the 11™ house represents the left ear. 
The ear, aS a part of the nose, throat region comes under Taurus and Venus. The 12th house and its conditions at 
birth tend to affect the hearing, as this house is closely connected with the senses and limitations upon them and in 
case of deafness Mercury and 12th house are badly afflicted. Mercury is said to be the messenger between the God 
and the Man as one should have five senses including hearing to have contact with the God. Mercury ts the 
Significator of speech as it is for hearing. 


Manifestation of sounds is under Akash Tatwa and J upiter is the ruler. The second house and sign Taurus (2nd house 
of natural Zodiac) rule the organs of speech. The communication planet is Mercury. If any affliction occurs to J upiter, 
Mercury, 2nd & 3rd of the natal chart and signs Taurus and Gemini, it causes the problem of hearing and speech. 
Lords of Trikasthana (Trine) |.e. 6, 8, 12 and depositors therein are to be considered for their connection with each 
other and DBA lords also to be connected with them. The 8" house represents incurable or chronic or lingering illness. 
(Essentials of Medical Astrology by Dr. K S Charak, pages 155-161) 


Deaf and Dumb in KP 


Any clearly pin pointed solid rule for deaf and dumb, like houses 2,7,11 for marriage, has not yet been available in KP. 
According to the Medical Astrology for All by K. Subramaniam, page 95: 


e the sub lord of the 3rd cusp is to be judged for the deafness and the following sub divisions of sign Gemini 
tells about the ear troubles and deafness.

152 13' 20" to 172 26' 40" - Mercury - Rahu - Venus

e the sub lord of the 2nd cusp is to be judged for dumbness and the sub division in Taurus sign 192 40' 00" to 
202 26' 40", Venus - Moon - Kethu, tells about the defective voice or mute. 
Any affliction to Mercury (expression and communications) at birth either by conjunction, square or opposition 
with Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, creates deformity in speech. 


It is also said in Vedic astrology that any planet posited within 142 to 182 degrees of Gemini sign is taken as afflicted 
planet and the said zones are called as Murtu Bhaga. In my study, the planets that are responsible for deaf and dumb 
have been found located mostly in the signs of Gemini and Sagittarius. 


C. R. Bhatt’s Rule for Deaf and Dumb 


An Indian savant in Sayana and Nirayana systems of Astrology, Sri Chandrakanth R. Bhatt had contributed some 
meaningful rules of Medical Astrology based on stellar system in his book Horoscopes and Diseases. The rule for 
deaf and dumb provided with solved example charts on pages 90-94 of the above book is as given under: 


1.1. In case of defective speech and sense of hearing or in case of deafness or dumbness, the cuspal 
sub lord of house 6, 8 or 12 is the significator of 6, 8, or 12, and It is connected with Mercury (speech 
and hearing), the 2"° house (speech), the 3“ house (hearing) and mute signs Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces 
(dumbness); 

Or 

1.2. The cuspal sub lords of house 2 & 3 are connected with malefics, mute signs and the house 6, 8, 
and 12, the native is deaf and dumb by birth. 


The 6th represents disease, 8th house is for chronic illness/ defect and 12" is for limitation. This rule has been found 
valid in the study of the following first two blind charts and other charts as well.

c. 12th CSL - Moon as discussed above Is connected with sign Gemini and Venus and is in the star and sub of Rahu, 
that is the sub of 8, under the rule of Saturn (3 - 3 -2, 9 - 5, 6), Mars (5 - 1 - 3, 8) & Jupiter (lord of Pisces- mute 
sign). 


As above, all the CSLs of 6, 8 & 12 are generally satisfied the rule(s) given above. 
Analysis of Dasa Lord at Birth 
Chart No 1 


The native was born under Maha Dasa of the Sun, which is located in the 12th house, and also in the sub of J upiter 
and aspected by Jupiter tenanted in Aries, the head of the Kaala Purusha. It is to be well noticed that this MD Sun is 
the star lord for Moon (12, 1, 9, 8 & mute sign Cancer), Mercury the ruler of speech and hearing (12, 1, 9, 7, 10) and 
Jupiter (12, 5, 9, 1, 4 & mute sign Pisces) by illuminating the operation of stellar system propounded by Sri KSK. 


Role of Saturn- 

Saturn is the lord of 2 (speech) & 3 (hearing) and aspects Jupiter in Aries from 8th house Cancer (mute sign), and 
lord of Cancer (mute) Moon is in the 1st house and Venus Is in the 2nd house, the lord of 6th (disease) & 11 ( left 
ear). 


Role of Moon 
The Moon, the lord of 8 Cancer (mute) is the cuspal point star lord of 2 (Speech) and 6 (disease) located in Lagna. 
This Moon is in the star of Sun, the Maha Dasa at birth. 


Role of Mercury 

Mercury, the chief operator of speech and hearing, is in Lagna (head), also acquiring the lordship of 7 (Maraka) and 
10 (Karmasthana/treatment not effective), the cuspal point sub lord of Lagna, 7, 10 & 12 house, and also the cuspal 
point star lord of 4 & 12. Further Mercury is the cuspal point star lord of Mars in 12 Scorpio, a mute sign and of 
Saturn in 8 Cancer, a mute sign. 


Chart No 2 


Janma Dasa owner of this native is Venus. It is the lord of 4 & 11 (left ear) and located in the 6th (disease). It is in 
the sub of Saturn that is in Lagna, Cancer (mute). In stellar-wise Venus Is in the star for Moon, which is the cuspal 
point star and sub lord of 3 (hearing) falling in Virgo, a house of Mercury. 


Role of Saturn 
In this chart Saturn by being in its own star, holds the sub lordships for Mercury (3, 12), Jupiter (6) & Venus (4, 11), 
in addition to its placement in Cancer, Lagna. Saturn Is the lord of 7 (Maraka) & 8 (chronic illness). 


Role of Rahu 

Here Rahu is the cuspal point sub lord of 7 (Maraka) & 11 (Badhaka), located in 9th Pisces (mute) and have becomes 
unbeneficial for the native. Rahu has neither conjunction nor aspects and hence it gives the result of sign lord J upiter, 
which Is connected with 6. 


Chart No 3 


Native was born in Rahu Maha Dasa. Rahu is in the sign of Saturn (3,5,6) and in the star of Mars the lord of 3 
(Scorpio- mute) and in the sub of J upiter lord of 4 & 7 (Pisces- mute) as well as the cuspal point sub lord of 8th. Sub 
lord of the 2nd (Vaksthana) house is Moon, a Karaka planet for this disease, also under the rule of Rahu as star and 
sub and another two mute lords Mars and J upiter too are in the star of Rahu. So the Maha Dasa Rahu has acquired all 
the responsibilities of this disease by denoting chronic disease (8) and long lasting lingering (Saturn) disease 
connected with mute sign vis a vis deaf and dumb. 


Other Charts 
The rule of 6,8,12 sub lords and birth Dasa lord connection for deaf and dumb also can be found in a case study 


appeared in the Astrology & Athrishta July, 1977 issue on page 15. Birth details are 08.04.1972 at 10.55 pm IST in 
Villupuram, India.

When will I get my Visa papers? 





Er. V.K. Sharma, B.E (Elect.), Supdt. Engineer (Retd.), 
Punjab State Electricity Board. 

#104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, 

Mohali (Chandigarh).

On dated 16-6-2009 a couple came to me as they were eagerly waiting for their visa for further proceeding to their 
Onward journey to Australia for Permanent Resident ship. | asked the lady to tell me any horary number between 1 
and 249, accordingly she intimated number as 16. | made calculation of the horary chart on dated 16-06-2009 at 
11:14 AM at Chandigarh. 


Moon’s I ndication: 

Moon lord of 4 is in house 11, its star lord Saturn is in 5, lord of 10 & 11. Moon Is in the sign of J upiter in 10, lord of 
9 & 12, and Jupiter aspects 3 house. So the query was related to overseas journey, and | decided to proceed 
further. 


Gulbarga theory: 

As per Gulbarga theory if Ascendant sub lord of horary number and moon star lord of ruling planet is the same, then 
answer Is affirmative. In this case Ascendant sub lord of horary number is Saturn and Moon star lord is also Saturn. 
So | told her that the answer is positive and she will certainly get her visa papers. 


General Aspects: 
To further verify the matter regarding visa papers, all kinds of correspondents, letters, papers, writing means of 
communication, ticket, certificate, visa, work permit etc belongs to the third house. 


Rule: 

If the sub lord of 3 house signifies house 3 & 11, one gets the desired results. 

Also if the 11" cusp sub lord signifies 3 or 11, one gets positive answer. 

Further the 3™ and 11™ cusp sub lord should also have linkage with house 3, 9 or 12 for getting visa for foreign 
country. 


3™ sub lord Mercury is in 1, lord of 3, 6; its star lord Sun in 2, lord of 5 and sub lord Venus in 12, lord of 2, 7. Hence 
3" cusp sub lord signifies 3 and 12. 


Similarly 11t cusp sub lord Venus ts in 12, lord of 2,7, in the star of own and sub lord Sun in 2, lord of 5. 
So 11™ cusp sub lord signifies 12. 


| told her that she will get visa papers. Further | also told her that Moon is posited in 11‘ house, so she will get visa 
papers very soon. 


Transit of Planets: 
As Moon was posited in 11" house, so visa permit was likely to issue at the earliest within a month or so. 
Hence | decided to rotate/check the transit of Sun, which was running in Gemini sign. 


On dated 16-06-2009 sun was transiting in Gemini rashi and Mars star lord (Mrigsharanakshtra). 

After that Sun will be transiting in Gemini rashi and Rahu star lord (Ardranakshtra) from 22-06-2009 to 6-07-2009. As 
Rahu was not a ruling planet , | rejected that period. 

Further Sun transits every year in Gemini rashi and Jupiter star lord (Punravasunakshtra) from 6 July to 20 July; 
Jupiter is a ruling planet. 

So the tentative period was calculated for visa papers from 6-J uly-2009 to 20-] uly-2009. 


To narrow down the exact date as to when the visa will be received | took the period when Sun transits in 
Mithunrashi and Jupiter star lord (Punravasunakshtra) and its Saturn sub lord. | took Saturn sub period because 
Saturn is also a ruling planet. 

So | calculated that visa will be received when Sun transits Mithunrashi and Punravasunakshtra (J upiter star lord ) and 
Saturn sub lord which comes between 7 July to 9 July approx. every year. 


Actual fact of the case: 
The couple got visa on 7-7-2009 on Tuesday when Moon was in Pisces (J upiter). Question was also asked on Tuesday 
on dated 16-06-2009 when Moon was in Sagittarious sign (Jupiter).

of KP form the KP original 2 Volumes to the KP Readers | to V/, KPE-zine September 2008 issue)

The public who follows astrology worries about Mars as a result of the various commentaries written on Mars as a 
scary planet for the human life. It is a frequent scene in Sri Lanka advertising a marriage proposal in a newspaper for 
a partner with Mars in house 7, 8 or 12 in the natal chart to match the chart with Mars in such a house. If any partner 
seeker finds a chart of opposite sex with Mars in 7, 8 or 12, one has no hesitation to throw it away without going for 
further analysis. The reason Is the great brand of "Kuja or Mars Dosha" or "Kuja Bauma Dosha" or "Angaraka Dosha" 
fabricated with Mars, which has been penetrated into the heart and mind of the people. 


Not only in the marital matters, but for all phenomenon of the life also, Mars is generally considered as a great 
malefic. Is this correct? Is this true? This article is an effort to find out the pros and cons of Mars by studying the 
charts of well known characters in the different fields. 


Mars Dosha 


As presented by Sri Tin Win ji by an illustrated article on Mars Dosha appeared in the KPE-zine December 2008 issue, 
it is not to worry about Mars Dosha because of the following reasons: 


e The fear of Mars Dosha in the traditional system is mainly for the longevity. All major life events of a native 
including longevity are to be predicted according to one’s natal horoscope. Therefore longevity of a native 
cannot be changed by marrying anyone including a so-called Manglik. Anything good or bad in the life is only 
a result of the Poorva Karma of the native. One should consider the individual horoscope by the KP rules to 
study longevity, prosperity, matching, separation, divorce, multi-marriage, happy or unhappy married life etc. 
without mixing up with the traditional Mars Dosha. 

e The traditional way of Manglik-to-Manglik matching is like adding more fire to a house which is already in fire, 
and it does not agree with the KP principle to throw water and send when a house Is In fire. (KP Reader VI, 
page 319) 

e Not Mars alone, any planet can cause such undesirable effect of disagreement, dispute, divorce etc among 
the couple provided they happen to be deposited in such a position of the significator of 6 or 10 or 12. (KF 
Reader |V, page 69) On the other hand, Mars also can give the beneficial results and so Mars like any other 
planet should not be branded as a fully malefic planet. 

e Mars Dosha Is not found valid in the KP practice and empirical studies other than a lengthy explanation about 
the traditional Mars Dosha in the KP Reader /V. (Vedic research on Mars Dosha by Sri Raichur ji in a KP 
system Yahoo group and KP research on Mars Dosha by Dr. Rangarajan Krishnamurthy ji and Sri Kanak 
Bosmia ji in the KPE-zine August 2007 issue) 


Mars as a Planet of Sports 


Whenever we see the "6" in a horoscope, we need not unnecessarily entertain any fear about Mars and its untoward 
effects. Mars generally signifies courage and bravery, energy, ability to organize, aggressiveness, ambition, 
determination, competition, love for game, muscles, strength and self confidence. The 6th house represents actions, 
victory over enemies or opponents in competition, benefits from sports (2nd from 5th - sports). 


As explained by Shri Tin Win ji in a KP system Yahoo group, the rationale of 6th house in the KP House Grouping ana 
Competition is that the lords of 3,6 and 11 houses being evils in Jataka Chandrika, stanza 5, 1s supposed to be only for 
one's health and longevity and not for other aspects in one’s life. So the 6th as an upachaya house and a desirable 
house can offer favorable results like financial imorovement through service to others, paid job and promotion or 
independent business, inheritance, raising of loan, getting dowry or donation, and success in any sort of competition 
(election/ litigation/ sports match/ share market/ interview/ competitive award or prize etc) by being 12th to 7th (loss 
of opponent/gain for the native). But the negative side of 6th is valid as house of sickness, disease, injury in accident 
and the disease finder through the 6th cuspal sub lord.

Question - 1: KP and KB 


Having read the KP-Ezine, I’m very interested in KP and let me ask some questions. What Is the different between the 
KP system and KB system? Is it KB system is the interlinks method? Is it the new dimension of KP? What is KB mean? 
Mr. A. Devaraj wrote the article on 2008 October issue. Because | was learning V K Choudhry’s System Approach for 
interpreting horoscope. Now I’ve read the KP-Ezine and interested again in KP. Please advise me which books is easy 
and simple for laymen like me. 


Answer - 1 
KB is the KP-based Cuspal Interlinks method of K. Baskaran and it’s now called the Baskaran astrology. 


2. The main differences between KP and KB are mentioned in the book of K. Baskaran: Principles of Cuspal /nterlinks, 
Sagar Publication, First edition, 2000, pages 200-203, for examples: 


KP: For marriage, the 7th cusp sub lord should be the significator of 2 or 7 or 11 house. 
KB: For marriage, the Lagna sub lord should be linked with 5 or 7 or 11. 


KP: Various bhavas would be studied for a single question. 
KB: A single bhava for single question, of course with the study of its inter-links to other 
cusps. 


KP: No mention about the potential of a Horoscope. 
KB: Advocacy of determining the potential first, by using Lagna. 


KP: In Horary chart, if the 5“ cusp sub lord is a significator of 2 or 5 or 11, the pregnancy 
is assured. 

KB: in a Horary chart, if the Lagna. sub lord is linked with 2 or 5 or 11, the pregnancy is 
assured. 

(Determination of Lagna First is not a KP Practice in the KP-Ezine March 2012 issue) 


KP: 11° house counted from Lagana would bring success. 
KB: 11 house counted from the concerned house in question would be studied for 
success for the concerned matter. 


3. A. Devaraj’s articles on KB in the old KP-Ezine are as given under:

October 2008 - - - Principles of KB System - Fate & Will

Question - 2: Karma and Destiny 
| have a query and request you to enlighten me / others through KP-Ezine and my query is as follows: 


1] Human birth is taking place on a specific date and time in a specific star and this is predetermined by God, as per 
our prarabdha karma. 


2] When a person Is born in a specific star e.g. Ashwini star, we calculate remaining period of Ketu dasa that will be 
ruling from the date of birth which means that some portion of Ketu maha dasa Is already exhausted / crossed when 
the child was in the womb of the mother. i.e. period already covered when the child was in the garbham [pregnancy] 


3] When a child stays only for 280 +/- days in mother's womb, how a major portion of dasa is crossed by the child 
during pregnancy? Does it have any link to the child's previous birth? Could there be a possibility that the child in its 
previous birth had its last breath during Ketu maha dasa and continues to be under the ruling of Ketu maha dasa in 
its present birth for remaining period of Ketu maha dasa? 


4] What is the prarabdha karma that a person will undergo in his present birth based on the study of 12 bhavas? How 
to identify it? 


5] How to quantify the good or bad impact in a person's life? Having one lakh / one crore / multiple crores is wealth, 
how to judge and quantify the wealth of a person? 


Answer - 2: The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house ts favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara (transit) 
must agree. (KP Reader V page 224/ 1971 Edition p 211/, KP Reader I!/ pp 226, 362 /1971 Edition, Practical Part 
pp 68, 194) 


1. Astrology we're practicing is entirely based on the Karma and Reincarnation theory. The inequality that exists 
among mankind is the result of our own past actions and our own present doings (esp viriya ‘effort’ and panna 
‘wisdom'). Astrology explains what Karma one should have done in the previous births and what one should 
experience in this birth and when on the basis of a birth chart and dasa system along with transit. There are three 
categories of Karma- sanchita the accumulative, parabdha the operative portion being our destiny in this life and 
agamithe prospective - and the horoscope indicated the prarabdha. One may have full control over the sanchita and 
agamithe Karmas but not over prarabdha, like once an arrow has been shot, It can not be recalled as said by Shri S. 
Balasundaram. 


2. As there is difference of opinion about the mode of recording the correct time of birth whether - 


(1) the time of the head emerging from the mother’s body (-M.P. Shanmugam, Astrosecrets & KP,Part 1, page 289/ 
present medical practice) 

(2) the time of taking the first breath (A. Raichur/ present medical practice/ most Western astrologers/ when this 
happens, no one knows for sure) 

(3) the time of the first cry (K. Subramaniam: Astrosecrets & KP Part IV, pages 1-2, Yogesh Lajmi Rao) 

(4) the time the whole body emerging out of the mother’s body (KP Reader VI, page 88/ Satyacharya: Satya 
Jatakam - - as the the moment of conception and the time when the head becomes visible are hard to ascertain) 

(5) the time of cutting the umbilical chord (Prof. P.S. Sastri: Rectification of Birth Time, 1999, page 10/ Sanjay Rath/ 
past medical practice/ most Western astrologers) 


all may be in a wild goose chase only and anybody can apply any rule that works for him at all times..... as said by 
Shri K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi. 


3. Whatever it may be the time of birth, at that very time, the Dasa?bhukti/Antra/ Sookshma starts operating. 


4. Each individual's chart is simply a reflection of his destiny based on one’s past karma. The bhava wise matters of a 
native life can be analyzed by the concerned bhava cusp sub lord using the KP house grouping, for instance for 
richness 2™ cusp sub lord signification of 2,6,10,11 house, for marriage 7™ cusp sub lord signification of 2,7,11 house 
etc. and timing of event can be predicted by the DBAS of the concerned house grouping, for marriage during the joint 
period of significators of 2,7,11 huse.

5. The KP rule to be rich is as given under: 


The significators of the houses 2,6,10 and 11 deposited in the sub of the signifcators of either 2 or 6 or 10 or 11 
houses give wealth during the periods of these significators, only when the lord of the sub Is good.....One can go 
through the second volume of Krishnamurti Padhdhati (1966 Sagar Publications), page 74 (reprinted in KP Reader III 
pages 181-2/ Old Edition Practical Part page 28). Rule is simple; one universal rule only, which Is applicable to one 
and all... Recent researches have added this vital one, i.e., one should judge the lord of the sub of the 2nd and the 
11th cusps. Unless the lord of the sub is the signification of the houses 2,6,10 or 11, one cannot improve his bank 
position. 

(Simplicity of Krishnamurti Padhdhati by K.S.K., KP & Astrology Year Book 1996 page 78) 


6. The rules to judge the different levels of wealth can be found in the following book: 

M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & KP, Voll, pages 65-69 
http://www.4shared.com/office/jD3Z4qvL/Astro-secrets__KP_Part1.html 

For instance, the 2"? bhava cuspal position tells whether one will earn enormous wealth, ....if the 2nd house cuspal 
position with no connection at all to 5,8,12 and is connected to houses 2,6,10,11, the native would be given 
enormous wealth. 


7. The Vedic rule to be rich ts that the astrological relation among the houses 1,5,2,11 and 9 would make a person 
rich. 


1 = potentiality to set goals for oneself 
5 = intelligence to carry out the planning 


2 = wealth 

11 = gain profits and amass wealth 

9 = luck. 

8. In the study of the charts of ten self-made billionaires from Bill Gates, Warren Buffett, ........ , to Donald Trump, 


the 2,5,6 and 11 house significations by the 2° and 11" cuspal sub lord are found valid but not 10 house 
signification. The most surprising finding is the highest appearance of house 5, which indicates the intelligence to 
carry out the planning to be rich for these self made billionaires. (Why They are Rich? in KP-Ezine November 2005

Some Views on Mundane Charts 


Charles Harvey has said that ingresses and lunations give weak results in mundane astrology, quoting important 
mundane astrologers Charles Carter and Andre Barbault and the eclipses and the natal charts seem to give better 
results. According to Charles Carter, the chart of national leaders, together with the chart of the nation itself, where 
the times of these are accurately known, constitute by far the most reliable basis for mundane forecasting. (Mundane 
Astrology by Michael Baigent, Nicholas Campion, Charles Harvey, 1989) 


The first and foremost base in making mundane predictions is the birth or foundation chart of a nation but a lot of 
difficulties are faced because such data Is not available or too ancient to be verified. Hindu astrologers have solved 
the problem of conflicting lagna by using the Hindu New Year chart... Annual horoscope based on the foundation 
chart of a country has been a valuable tool in the hands of an astrologer like late Hardeo Sharma Trivedi. ( 7/me 
Tested Techniques of Mundane Astrology by M.s. Mehta, A. Radhika) 


According to William Ramesey, Astrology Restored, 1653, the true time from whence judgment is to be raised for the 
exact knowledge and predicting of future natural events in the elements for any year, is when the Sun enters the first 
point of Aries. 


Dr. B.V. Raman has considered that the Hindu New Year charts provide an excellent method of predicting events for 
the whole year. (Practical Mundane Astrology, Basic Principles, by J. C. Luthra) 


In R. Santhanam’s opinion, Essenta/a/s of Preditive Hindu Astrology, applying Dasa bhuktis in mundane astrology to 
horoscopes of countries is only a futile exercise.... Dasa bhuktis apply only to human beings.

Education, Higher Education and Education in Foreign Land Ro 





GUNTI NAGARA] U, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 

KP astrologer 

12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, Secunderabad- 500 017

In today’s world of growing competition, a child is given education to prepare for chiseling out a career /profession. 
The education has become highly advanced, competitive and therefore stressful. It needs a lot of preparation by both 
the parents and the child. Here, astrology plays an important role in identifying the levels of education, and indicating 
branches of education. It helps the native by giving suitable guidance in the selection of specialization of the faculties, 
level/strength of success in acquiring the education, financial aspects of the education, the end result of the education 
etc. 


The invention of Sub Lord Theory by our Guruji Sri K.S. Krishnamurthi has made the astrological science as a simple 
and lucid predictive tool. K.P. system has deep and well set rules on the aspect of education which has given 
astonishingly accurate results by the study of both natal and horary charts. 


Before proceeding further let me first furnish what K.P. rules say in this regard. 


01. For primary education we have to see the 4" house. The significator of the 4° house indicates the native’s 
regular attendance in a school or college, aptitude, general education and studious habits. 

01 A. The 9" house indicates higher education. 

01 B. The 11" house indicates success in education. 


02. From the sub lord of the Ascendant we can find out whether the native is studious and industrious. Generally 
Mercury and Jupiter as significators give him the mind to study, where as Saturn throws obstacles during the course 
of his study. 


03. If 4 cusp sub lord is connected to 4 and 11 only but not to 9th, it shows completion of general education. 
Nowadays education up to graduation level can be considered as general education. Above graduation level, it Is 
considered as higher education, even leading to doctorate and higher research works. 

Therefore, if 9°" cusp sub lord is connected with 4 or 11, it indicates success in higher education through hard work. If 
9 cusp sub lord is connected with 11 only but not connected with 4, it indicates success in higher education without 
hard work. 


If 9°" cusp sub lord is connected with 4,9,10, or 6 house, one will undergo vocational training program. If 9" cusp 
sub lord is connected to 3™ house along with 9", house one will do post graduation through correspondence. If 9" 
cusp sub lord is connected to 3rd, 9th or 10th house, one will do vocational training programmed through distance 
education or through internet. 


Alternatively if 11° cusp sub lord is connected with 9 "°¥S*, it indicates higher education and if connected with 4th 
only without having connection with 9", it indicates general education. 


04. The 3™ house (inclination to study, mental concentration, and writing examination) indicates specialization or 
special subject when connected with 4 or 9 or 11. 


05. K.P. Rule for Foreign Travel for the Purpose of Higher Studies 

A) If the 12" cusp sub lord signifies 3,9,12,6,11, one can go to foreign countries for higher studies during the D/B/A 
signifying 3,9,12,11 houses. If 11" cusp sub lord is connected with 9" house, success is assured. 

B) If the 5th cusp sub lord signifies 9 or 12 or 3, one can go to foreign countries for higher studies. (Sri Kanak 
Bosmia). 


A special note: 


01. Whenever the sub lord is referred, if the sub lord is directly not connected with the relevant houses, but the star 
lord in which the sub lord is posited is connected with the relevant houses, then also the same results can be taken. 


02. If the sub lord or star lord is not connected with the relevant houses, then Rahu or Kethu representations can be 
taken. 


With this back ground of K. P. rules for education | would like present a natal chart of a young man who left for 
foreign land in pursuit of his higher studies.

In timing events, the transit and aspects of dasa, bukthi and antara loads along with the luminaries play a major role. 
The tenth bhava in a birth chart is considered as the place of the native in the society and his destiny or how the 
people look at the native. Nowadays we need to have a good job to acquire a respectable position in the society. 


The tenth bhava position is important to identify the nature of the job and the performance of the native, when he is 
involved with the works he is entrusted to do so. In this birth chart, the tenth cusp falls in the sign of Virgo, owned by 
Mercury and in a star of Moon and a sub of Mercury. This sub load Mercury is the lord of 10. Therefore the native is 
destined to have an employment, and plurality of. 


The native would obtain employment when the significators of second, sixth, tenth and eleventh bhavas are in 
Operation, during a dasa and sub dasas of planets, who are in the stars of fruitful significators. 


The second bhava significators will make gains, thus increasing the wealth of the native. The significators for the 
second bhava of the native are Saturn, Sun, Jupiter, Venus and Moon. The sixth bhava is for gains to someone by 
serving another, loss to the employer. The significators for sixth bhava of this native are Saturn, Sun and Venus. The 
tenth bhava Is for employment or the ability to serve by having a capacity for giving some service to the employer or 
to a company. The signifiators for tenth are Rahu and Mercury. The eleventh bhava is for the fulfilment of the 
expectation or the desire of the native. The significators are Saturn, Sun and Venus. 

In this birth chart, the significators for the above four bhavas are; Saturn, Sun, Jupiter, Venus, Moon, Rahu and 
Mercury. 


All of these planets are not fruitful significators for employment. Therefore we need to select the fruitful siginificators 
out of these planets. This could be done by comparing with the ruling planets at the time of judgement or by 
selecting the planets who are not deposited in the stars or subs of planets of negative bhavas. 


As we have considered second, sixth, tenth and eleventh bhavas for employment, the twelfth to these are giving 
negative results. So loosing or leaving the employment is indicated during the periods of significators of negative 
bhavas, namely first, fifth and ninth. The eleventh is always come for fulfilment of expectations. 


Sun is in a star of Venus, significator for 2, 6 and 11" bhavas by occupation and lordship. Moon is in a star of Saturn, 
Significator for 9, 2 and 3rd bhavas. Mars, Mercury, J upiter and Kethu are in the stars of Moon, significator for 7 and 
8" bhavas. Venus is in a star of Mars, significator for 9, 5 and 12" bhavas. Saturn is in a star of Venus, significator for 
2, 6 and 11" bhavas. All these planets are contributing for obtaining the employment by signifying 2, 6, 11 and 
leaving it by signifying 5, 9, 12.

Recently, a family friend of mine brought the natal horoscope of his wife and showed it to me. 


He was particularly interested in knowing as to whether his wife can make another attempt for the examination for 
medical transcription work. 


It appears that the owner of the horoscope had failed in her first two attempts in the examination earlier. 


Having not understood the reasons for failing consecutively, as a medical doctor cannot treat and cure this type of 
problem, it appears that his conscience has led him to an astrologer, who happened on me. 


The canon of KP system clearly speaks that if the 4" cusp sub lord is linked to 4, 9, 11 and 6" house, one shall come 
out successfully from the competitive examination, which is connected to education. 


But astrologer has to bear in mind of the detrimental houses 3, 8, 5 (12" to 4,9,6) and 12 (loss/ failure) for success in 
education, which may be signified by the running DBA lords for the native. 


In the case under consideration, the 4" cusp falls in sign of Libra, in the star of Jupiter and sub of Venus, and its sign 
lord and sub lord Venus is owner of relevant houses 4, 11. 


The native had appeared for the examination cited above during the Vimshottari dasa joint period of (a) Saturn-Mars- 
Rahu and (bo) Saturn-Mars-Saturn. Unfortunately, both the periods did not favour for success in the examination and 
so the result was negative. 


Dasa and Antra lord Saturn signifies houses 1, 7, 8 by occupation and lordship of Saturn and 3, 4, 11 by its star lord 
Venus. 


Bhukti lord Mars signifies houses 5, 10 by Mars, 8 ,7, 1 by star lord Ketu. 


Antara lord Rahu signifies houses 2 by occupation, 1, 7, 8 by conjoined Saturn and 4, 2 by its star lord Sun. also 
indicating medicine. 


It was felt that the signification of detrimental houses 3, 5, 8 by the running DBA lords had caused failure and 
disappointment for the native and the Saturn-Moon connection by Saturn’s aspect indicates the requirement of more 
than one attempt for success. 


It is also a fact that Bhukti lord Mars is not strong enough to offer good result because of its link to 5 and 8" houses, 
as discussed above. 


However, upon query from the husband of the native, it was clarified to him that the DBA of Saturn-Rahu-Rahu would 
be favourable for the native’s success in the examination as a combined result of the signification of required houses 
4, 11 by Dasa lord Saturn and again house 4 by Bhukti and Antra lord Rahu’s star lord and sign lord Su, also 
indicating the medical profession. 
Wishing all the best to the native.

Kalathrakaraka, beauty and comfort. So our ancient saints had substituted Venus as Maha Laxami, the wife of Lord 
Vishnu. Westerners have also denominated Venus as the lesser of fortune with huge benefices. Further Venus 
governs Vasantha Rithu, a time the young minds are craving In opposite sex. Pleasant and handsome countenance is 
in the top of Venus’ legend.

strong sex drive, consequently the sex scandal for their downfall , and also causing the drug addiction and then

Mr. Enrique Pena Nieto 
Born Atlacomulco, Mexico State, J uly 20th 1966 Candidate for the Institutional Revolutionary Party and the Green 
Party 


The Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI), which governed Mexico for 71 
years until 2000, has long groomed Enrique Pena Nieto to lead it back to 
power in 2012. The telegenic young politician finished a six-year stint as 
governor of Mexico State, the country's largest, last year. He promises an 
"efficient state" to perk up economic growth, and more private investment in 
oil. 


The PRI earned a reputation for corruption during its long stint in power. Mr 
Pena Is young enough to avoid much of the taint, but he Is linked to party 
dinosaurs that many had hoped were extinct. The question for many 
Mexicans is whether the PRI has really changed in its 12 years out of 
government. Mr Pena currently leads opinion polls by a wide margin.

Question - 1: Three-step and Four-step Significators 





In the Astrology & Athrishta, February 1980 issue, pages 6-7, (regarding election chart, 15-09-1979, 07:28 pm IST, 
Trivandrum, Kerala) it’s mentioned as follows. 


Ascendant sub lord Sun is a strong significator of 5th house. It is tin the sub of Mars, significator of houses 
1,8,3,9,12,4. But Mars is a strong significator of the (not readable) - - the house being posited in J upiter star. 


Is it the way to consider the signification in KP? 
Answer -1 


Ascendant sub lord Sun, in 5, lord of 5, is in the star of own Sun, in 5, lord of 5, and sub of Mars+ in 3, lord of 4,8, 
having no planet in its star and being the cuspal sub lord of 6" house. Here the KP practice of signification, according 
to the KP six Readers, stops with three steps, planet, its star and sub. (Three-Step KP Signifcators, KP-Ezine, May 
2012 issue) 


Going further to the 4" step, up to the sub’s star lord is the way of signification by Sublord Speaks or 4 - step theory 
1.e. two steps up to planet and star cane be called stellar theory, three steps up to sub KP and four steps up to sub ‘s 
Star 4 - step theory. This sub’s star lord is still a decider in the Sublord Speaks but a significator in the 4 - step theory. 
In this example the fourth step is also considering the sub Mars’s star lord J upiter which is in 4, lord of 9,12. (A Study 
Article on Four-Step Theory, KP-Ezine December 2007 issue) 


Question - 2: Different Role of the Cuspal Sub Lord and Dasa Period Lords in Timing of Event 

In the Marathi magazine Nakshtrache Dena, diwali issue 2011, page 36, Note from Editor, it is mentioned that if sub 
lord of the relevant cusp signifies the matter under consideration but when the dasa lord does not signify the relevant 
bhavas, it does not need to leave that dasa to give the result of the matter. 

Is it to leave or not to leave such dasa, not signifying the relevant bhavas, in the KP timing of event? 

Answer - 2: 

The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house Is favorable (promised) or not. The 
significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara (transit) must agree. (KP Reader V page 224 
/1971 Edition p 211/, KP Reader III pp 226, 362 /1971 Edition, Practical Part pp 68, 194/) 

No Bhukti can offer a result if Dasa lord does not permit. If the Dasa lord is not a significator of the result which 
Bhukti lord is to give, Dasa lord, the final authority will not give the ultimate result. Planets from a cabinet. The Prime 
minister Is the Dasanadha. The Bhuktinadhas are Cabinet Ministers. The Antharanadhas are Deputy Ministers. (KP 
Reader IV page 195_

It says that the marriage is made in the heavens. Accordingly it is a wonderful story in most of the married persons 
that how they met, carried on and tie the knot. In our Eastern culture, most of the marriages are arranged by the 
parents by matching the horoscopes and with the other agreements, they say | do. In some cases, no matching of 
birth charts or any other needs are considered, but love at first sight makes the couple to get together and live 
happily. Or else by meeting at a party or any such place, they consent for marriage, whether the horoscopes are 
matched or not, they happily live together. 


In the Eastern system of astrology, we have a number of methods and laws for checking about the compatibility for 
marriage. Mainly the seventh bhava of the birth chart indicates the nature of marriage and all the other details such 
as the method of meeting, nature of the partner, longevity etc. regarding the marriage. 


The Lagna bhava shows the characteristics of the native and his capabilities etc. The seventh bhava, which is the 
opposite of lagna, shows about the partners in marriage or in business or opponents also. Any one dealing with the 
native is shown in the seventh bhava. 


The seventh bhava is on the exact opposite of the lagna bhava, Therefore if the lagna bhava Is rectified, we know 
that the seventh bhava also get rectified automatically. When the birth chart is analysed for marriage, we see that the 
seventh bahva for identification of the partner. Second bhava for the development or increase of the family by 
marriage and by eleventh bhava, the expectation or the fulfilment of the desire. 


In Krishnamurthi Paddhathi, profound by the late Guruji KSK, we give a very important place to the seventh bhava 
Sputa and its lords as sign, star and sub in the consideration of the marriage. The sub lord is the deciding factor. If 
the sub lord of the seventh cusp is a significator for the second or seventh or eleventh bahavas, the native is destined 
to get married. 


In this birth chart, the seventh bhava falls in the sign of Gemini, in a star of Rahu and in a sub of Kethu. This Kethu is 
in the sub of Mercury, lord of 7; No planet in the star of Kethu and Kethu is CSL of 7. So marriage is promised to the 
native. This sub lord Kethu is aspected in trine by Jupiter. So the native Is very shy and slow in marriage matters and 
he will go for genuine way due to the good aspect of J upiter. 


There has been a delay in getting married from the normal age of this native. This is due to the nature of Kethu, and 
also due to the influence of J upiter. He had got married by a proposal made by his parents with the consent of all the 
parties concerned. 

In this birth chart, the significators for the marriage are; 


Second bhava: Saturn, Sun, J upiter, Venus and Moon 
Seventh bhava: Mercury and Rahu 
Eleventh bhava: Saturn, Sun and Venus 


As all these planets are not powerful in giving the marriage, it is necessary to select the fruitful planets. This is done 
by selecting the planets, which are deposited in positive constellations and subs for marriage. 


Sun is in a star of Venus, connected with second and eleventh bhavas and in a sub of Saturn, lord of second house. 
Moon is in a star of Saturn, is lord of second house, not in signification. 

Mercury is in a star and sub of Moon, not related to 2,7,11, although Mercury is lord of seventh. 

Jupiter is in a star of Moon, in second and in a sub of its own. 

Venus is is in 2™ and lord of 11" and it is in a star of Mars, and in a sub of Rahu. 


Saturn is in a star of Venus in 2 and lord of 11 and in a sub of Kethu, also a strong significator for seventh bhava as 
having no planet in Ketu star and Ketu is CSL of 7. 


Rahu is in a star of Mercury, a significator for seventh bhava and In a sub of Kethu, again a strong significator for 
seventh bhava as having no planet in Ketu star and Ketu is CSL of 7.

This note is to review which one is the KP horary analysis out of using the horary numbers 1-108, 1-249, 1-2193 and 
time chart. 





Division of the Zodiac into 108, 249, 2193 Parts 


2. For the horary numbers 1-108, the zodiac is divided into 108 equal parts, 360°/108 = 3° 20', |e. 27 stars 
multiplied by 4 quarters, and one part is equal to one pada of a star, 3° 20’. 


3. For the horary numbers 1-249 subs, the zodiac is divided into 27 equal parts of stars, and the area of each star, 
i.e. 13° 20, is further divided by nine unequal subs in proportion of the numbers of years allotted to each planet to 
the total number of years of the Vimshottari dasa system, |e. 120 years. (27 x 9 = 243 plus overlapping 6 equal to 
249 subs) 


4. For the horary numbers 1-2193, the subs are further divided into nine unequal sub subs in the similar 
proportion of the Vimshottari dasa system above. (27 x 9 = 243 x 9 = 2187 plus overlapping 6 equal to 2193 sub 
Subs) 


Example Horary Numbers 


Horary Number 16 


5. For the horary number 16 * (out of 108), it is to take the 16" division, i.e. the 4'" quarter of the 4'" star counted 
from the first star Aswini. It is Rohini 4°" pada, i.e. 20° 00' to 23° 20' Taurus. Another way of calculation is (360°/108) 
15 = 20° 00' Taurus, and by adding one pada 3°20', Ascendant is 20° 00' to 23° 20' Taurus. The Ascendant (20° 
00' Taurus) is in the Venus sign and in the star of Moon. The sub may be Ketu or Venus or Sun. (*KP Reader III, New 
Edition, pp 219-225/ reprint from KP Reader II1, 1971 Edition, Practical Part, pp 62-67/ reprint from Krishnamurti 
Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, pp 123-129) 


Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2 by Modem Astrological Research (the exact reprint of 1966 Edition by 
Sagar Publications) 
http://www .scribd.com/doc/245 00319/ krishnamurti-Padh dhat

the star of Venus and in the sub of Saturn according to the table of KP horary sub numbers 1-249. (KP Reader VI: 
Horary Astrology, page 90) 


7. For the horary number 16 (out of 2193), the Ascendant is 02° 12' 13? Aries, in the sign lord, star lord, sub lord 
and sub sub lord: Mars, Ketu, Venus and Saturn respectively according to the table of horary sub sub numbers 1- 
2193, compiled by late Shri A. R. Raichur ji or KPAstro 4.0 SW.

Short History 


Vieri started his playing career at A.C. Prato, a small club in Serie Cl in 1989. While there, he was spotted by Torino 
and played his first Serie A game the next year for the Turin team. Vieri made six appearances in the league as well 
as in the Coppa Italia. ln November 1992, he was sold to Serie B club, Pisa Calcio, scoring two goals. Another season 
went by, he then moved to Ravenna in Serie B, scoring 12 goals. He was subsequently sold to Venezia A.C. in Serie B, 
scoring 11 goals. Another move followed for the youngster, this time to Atalanta where he scored seven goals. A 
change of luck came when he was spotted by Juventus F.C. in the 1996-97 seasons. He made 23 appearances and 

scored eight goals in Serie A, and six goals in ten matches in Europe. 


Vieri was on the move once again, this time it was to Spain and Atlético Madrid. This is 
where the Vieri name became a trademark for Italian football and he formed a 
successful partnership in the 1998 FIFA World Cup with Roberto Baggio. Amazingly, he 
scored a total of 24 goals in 24 appearances for Atlético, five goals from seven 
appearances in Europe which led him to become the Spanish top scorer. 


Vieri played for Inter Milan from 1999 to 2005, leading the scoring in Serie A in 2003 
with 24 goals. 





As of the end of 2004, he had scored 22 goals in 43 matches for Italy and played for 
his country at the 1998 World Cup, scoring five times, and the 2002 World Cup, scoring four times, though he 
endured a less successful tournament at Euro 2004. Vieri is generally considered one of Italy's greatest strikers of 
recent times despite strong competition, and is one of Italy's most prolific World Cup goal scorers. He was named by 
Pelé as one of the 125 greatest living footballers in March 2004. In private life he is considered a playboy and not yet 
married, so it Is interesting whether he will get ever married in his life? Natal chart source:

Marriage - a mystic question? Ro 





GUNTI NAGARA] U, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 

KP astrologer 

12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, Secunderabad- 500 017 
Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371

Marriage is an institution through which two individual souls in the form of man and woman come together, so as to 
pursue dharma (duty), artha (possessions), kama (physical desires) and moksha (emancipation) together. It also joins 
two families. Now a days it is observed that this institution of marriage is losing its sanctity as envisaged in the 
scriptures. 


There is an age old proverb “marriages are made in heaven”. This clearly means a marriage has divine approval and 
blessings. But still one needs to look for the right mate. Anxiety with regard to marriage is all the more as the 
selection is made once in a life time. 


In the present day scenario this aspect of marriage of individual’s life has become very often a vexed problem for 
some, a mystic question for some others and an interesting turn for many in general. Here the role of astrology 
comes into picture as a helping tool for the parents and the youth in answering many questions like - whether 
marriage Is promised, marriage is denied, love marriage, status of marital life etc. 


K.P. Rules for marriage and denial: 


Rule no. 1 
If 7" cusp sub lord be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 2, 7 or 11 marriage is promised. 


Rule no. 2 

If 7 cusp sub lord be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 1, 6 or 10, or connected with 1,6 or 
10, also Saturn, Rahu, or Kethu; barren or sterile signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Virgo or Capricorn) - this portends denial 
and even disappointment. 


Rule no. 2 (A) 

sri M.P. Shanmugam, another exponent of K.P. has elaborated this principle by saying ” when the sub lord of the 7” 
and sub lord of the 2" are connected only to houses 6 and 12 predominantly and the sub lord if it is Saturn or Mars 
or Sun , then there will be no marriage in his life time.” 


Rule no. 3 
If a planet is strong and single significator of 6 even though it is a significator of 2, 7, 11, it would not give marriage. 


Rule no. 4 
Punaraphoo dosha Is also one of the causes for the delay of marriage. 


Rule no. 5 
As per principles of cuspal interlinks of sri K. Bhaskaran, if sub lord of the ascendant and 7" cusp are inter linked with 
houses 4, 6, 10 and 12, then the person is not likely to have a marriage. 


Now | would like to discuss marriage denial of two individuals. 
CHART no. 1- Ms Virgin: DOB-04-12-1939, TOB-16.18.20 Hrs, POB-Machilipatnam 


As per rule no. 1 - 
07" cuspal sub lord is Mars. Mars is in Rahu star and Venus sub. Mars is bhava lord of 7™, star lord Rahu is in Venus 
sign and Venus is bhava lord of 2". Sub lord Venus is bhava lord of 2"°. So marriage is promised. 


But actually this native remained unmarried. Now let us see what are the factors that lead to denial of the native’s 
Marriage. 


As per rule no. 2 - 

Mars - the sub lord of the 7™ cusp is in the star of Rahu who is the occupant of 6". Rahu is in the sign of Venus, 
aspected by Saturn. So Rahu represents Venus, and Saturn. Venus is bhava lord of 1°. Saturn is bhava lord of 10" 
and in 12". Rahu, Venus and Saturn all are signifying negative houses of marriage 1, 6, 10 and 12. Saturn is placed 
in Aries with Ketu. Aries is a barren sign. These factors have contributed for denial of marriage. 


The 7" cusp sub lord Mars is the top significator of 6 as per occupation and through its star lord Rahu in 6". 2" 
cusp sub lord Saturn is the top significator of 12 as in 12™ and its star lord Ketu is in 12. These factors have denied 
the native’s marriage.

As per rule no. 2 -

As per rule no. 5 -

its star lord Kethu are also placed in Leo (a barren sign) and there by negating the marriage.

Question: Is craze for the old issues of the Astrology & Athrishta worthy? 
In the old Astrology & Athrishta, J anuary to December 1967 monthly issues, it has been read that: 


All articles say to check Lagna and Moon, which is stronger; 
No sub lord analysis at all; 

No significator table at all; 

No 1-249 sub number but 1-108 number is used. 


BRWN Ee 


Nothing seems as per KP in the KP six Readers. 
Can you tell when the sub number 1-249 and sub checking were started? 
In my opinion craze for old issues of A & A is not worthy. 


Answer 
1. Checking Lagna and Moon, which ts stronger 


1. In the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, 2 volumes set, first edition, was published in late 1966 by Sagar Publications. In 
the volume 2, out of many solved examples, in some examples like in pp 82, 118, 255, 261-262, 264, 313, 316, it was 
ascertained whether Lagna is strong or the Moon sign, and the Moon sign was taken as the first house in the two 
examples of pp 118 and 264. It is therefore to check Lagna and Moon, which is _ stronger. 


Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2 by Modern Astrological Research (the exact reprint of 1966 Edition by 
Sagar Publications) 


http://www.scribd.com/doc/24500319/krishnamurti-Padhdhat 


2. But the further research reveals the correct approach is to take always Lagna alone, and the correction was made 
by Guruji KSK in the KP Reader III, first published in October 1971, Practical Part, p 85/ New Edition pp 243-244 as 
below: 


Disposal of a House 


A building Is indicated by the 4th house counted from Lagna. Always count from the Lagna. Never consider whether 
Moon sign is strong or Lagna Is strong. !n the research after 1967 it was found that we have to take always Lagna 
alone. We should never /udge which Is stronger whether Moon sign or Lagna. The main reason Is that in a twin birth, 
only the cusps of the house including the ascendant change whereas Moon ts in the same position. What we had been 
following in KP printed in 1966, Is to be give up. 


Also in KP Reader III, 1971 Edition, Practical Part, p 259/ New Edition pp 432-433: 
Why Lagna alone Is considered? 
Dear Sir, 


/ find in your Magazine, that since a couple of years, you are not suggesting that the Moon sign should be taken in 
case the lagna Is afflicted and Moon sign is not. Why? 


Answer; Sir, | had been following the above method of taking the unafflicted ascendant or Moon sign, in case the 
lagna Is afflicted and Moon sign Is not. But in my research only in 1965 end, | understood that when twins are born, 
Moon does not move a single minute, whereas the lagna alone moves and when the research on the sub-lord, came 
out successful to read out the diametrically opposite results among the twins, | have given up the idea of taking Moon 
sign, in case lagna Is afflicted. 1t needed reconsideration. So, we must, whether lagna Is afflicted or not, take only the 
exact position of lagna. If the lagna Is afflicted, then the horoscope has certain defect, and simply because there Is 
that defect, we should not jump to Moon sign which Is auspicious. After having found out this, | have stopped writing 
in the above manner, mentioned by you. Therefore, | request all the readers to take only the lagna and never the 
Moon sign, whether the lagna Is afflicted or not. 


2. Sub Lord Analysis 


KP is the sub lord theory only, nothing else. Finding the way to use the sub lord makes Guruji KSK crowned with 
success. Without consideration of sub lord, it is not a KP analysis. Consideration of A to D grade significators only, 
which are based on the KP significators table, does not make a sub analysis. Nowadays the KP analysis up to the sub 
lord has been commonly found practiced. (Three-Steps KP Significators, KP E-zine May 2012 issue)

Guruji KSK began using only 108 (Star padas) for Horary astrology and not 249 for Subs, as per given results of 
Horary no. 16 (out of 108), by analysis of signs and stars only and not subs, under the topic “Theft and Recovery” in 
the Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, pp 123-129 (reprinted in KP Reader II1, Practical Part, 1971, pp 62-67, / KP 
Reader III, New Edition, pp 219-225). Also in the newly written KP Reader VI: Horary book, first published in 1970, 
.e. not based on materials of the Krishnamurti Padhdhati 2 Volumes, 1966, as the zodiac Is divided into 108 equal 
parts 27 stars multiplied by 4 quarters and the number mentioned is 80. (pp 237-239); For 78 (out of 108), we get 
16:40 Dhanus to 20 Dhanus is not the same fro 78 (out of 249) in p 92. A chance is given to the astrologer to find out 
from number 78 within 108 and 237 within 249 and enjoy as the same result is obtained. This mysterious agreement 
can be found only in this Divine Science practiced by intelligent astrologers making honest attempts with open mind. 
(p 231) 


But later since around 1969 Guruji changed the number between 108 to a more scientific and logical between 249 
Subs, according to the solved example horary charts on pp 242-244 for 13-08-1969, pp 269-270 for 17-02-1969 with 
explanation, pp 278-283 for 11-05-1969, pp 284-285 for 21-09-1968, p 287 for 07-1969, p 290 for 10-1969, p 292 for 
08-1969. 


The point to be noted is to use the sign and star analysis for a horary number between 108 star padas, 


the sub analysis for a number between 249 subs and the sub sub analysis for a number between 2193 
sub subs in a consistent approach. 


There have been continuously so many series of collection of refreshing A & A articles published by Guruji's second 
son K. Subramaniam and third son K. Hariharan giving no chance for the important or useful articles to be left behind. 


Craze for the old issues of the Astrology & Athrishta is not worthy.
