Astrology for Beginners: Encyclopedia of Astrology 
(KP - 6 Volume Set) 

by K. Subramanian 

Krishman & Co. 


This 6-volume set of books is a beginner's guide 
ali ele to the Krishnamurti Padhdhati astrology, 
explaining with numerous solved examples. 
‘J=-if=si: ie Volume 1 to 4 (first half) have been devoted to 
the fundamentals and basic calculations of 
STELLAR astrology, as shown by the contents. The dual 
signs, Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces are 
explained as double-bodied signs. (Vol. 2, page 
233) Regarding the orb for a planet near the 
cusp, a planet within 5° or 6° of the next cusp 
may signify the previous cusp, and only if the 
planet within 1° or 2°, having the same sub-lord 
of the next cusp, may signify the next cusp. 
(Vol. 3, pages 355-358) To show the sub lord 
alone can give decision in the matter of twins, 
several twin horoscopes are shown in traditional 
and KP calculations in the second half of Vol. 4, 
pages 513-568. 


The strength of Rahu/Ketu’s signification is 
emphasized in Vol. 5, page 669 by saying that 
only if there are no planets in Rahu/Ketu star, 
Rahu/Ket will signify the house occupied. (If a 
planet is in Rahu/Ketu star, the planet will 
signify the house occupied by Rahu/Ketu.) Only 
if there are no planets in the star of the sign 
lord, Rahu/Ketu will signify the results of the 
sign lord. And then the results of the planets in 
conjunction and aspect are mentioned to be 
considered. In the most solved examples of the 
KP Readers, only some, not all of the house 
occupied by Rahu/Ketu, planet in conjunction, 
planet in aspect, star lord and sign lord are 
found considered depending on relevance to the 
matter under consideration regardless of their 
sequence of order. (Rahu/Ketu Rules in KP in 
the KP E-Zine, May 2007 Issue) 





In the case of Punarphoo due to Saturn-Moon 
connection, the adverse Western aspect (Square, Opposition etc.) between Saturn and Moon is supposed to mitigate 
the potency of Punarphoo dosha and so to give early marriage without delay; the favorable Western aspect (sextile, 
trine etc) is to give later marriage. (Vol. 5 pages 702-703) In the Dr. K. R. Kar’s Punarphoo cancellation theory is 
burning Saturn/Moon by the Sun’s rays. (K. P. & Astrology, 1966 Year Book, pages 69-72) 


In KP Reader V, page 224 (1971 Edition page 211), KP Reader III pages 226, 362 (1971 Edition, Practical Part pages 
68, 194), the cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable (promised) or not, and 
the significators point the time of event. This is explained in the last chapter, cusps and their functional role in K.P. of 
volume 5, page 855 that. . . for each query the relevant house cusp sub lord is to be examined first before fixing the 
period of the favorable significator for the event to happen. So it Is crystal clear in KP that if the relevant cuspal sub 
lord does not promise a matter through its constellation and sub lord, that matter does not come to pass at all. .

Origin of Badhaka 





1. In J/ataka Parijata of Vaidyanatha Dikshita, Chapter /1, Sloka 48, houses 11, 9 and 7 are Badhaka houses for 
Ascendants falling in movable (chara), f ixed (sthira) and common (ubhaya) signs (rasis) respectively. 


2. An additional condition is that the badhaka lord for a particular lagana should be treated as an actual badhaka, if it 
Simultaneously be the lord of the house tenanted by Mandi (Gulika) or Kharesha (Lord of 22 nd drekkana from the 
lagna). 


3. In Prasna Marga of Harihara, for all movable signs, the 11th house therefrom is the badhaka sthana, for all fixed 
Signs, the 9th therefrom are their badhakasthana and for all the dual signs, the 7th therefrom are their badkasthanas. 
Thus for the 12 signs of the zodiac, the badhakasthanas are shown in the table below: (For example, if the Lagna is 
Aries, then the 11" sign from Aries is Aquarius, and it is the Badhaka sign and its lord J upiter becomes the Badhaka 
planet. )

Bhadhaka in KP Readers 


4. In KP Reader ///1, pages 161-162 (1971 Edition, Practical Part 2, pages 9-10), according to Hindus, Badhaka Sthana 
Adhipathis are the worst malefics who will never hesitate to put an end to one's life. 


5. Of the twelve signs, Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn are the movable-chara signs, and the 11th house counted 
therefrom are Badhaka Sthanas i.e., to Aries born, Aquarius is the Badhakasthana and the lord of Aquarius is the 
Badhakasthana Adhipathi. To Cancer-born, Taurus is the Badhakasthana and the lord of Taurus, Venus is the 
Badhakasthana Adhipathi to Cancer-borns. Similarly to Libra, the sign Leo and the luminary Sun and to Capricorn, the 
Sign Scorpio and its lord, Mars are the Badhakasthana and Badhakasthana Adhipathis. 


6. For people born in fixed signs Taurus, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarirus, the 9th sign from those houses are the 
Bhadhakasthanas and their lords are Badhakasthana Adhipathis. 


7. For people born in common signs Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces, the 7th sign there from and the lords of 
those houses are the Badhakasthanas and Badhakasthana Adhipathis. 


8. /n KP Reader VI: Horary Astrology, pages 154-155, if the Asc. is in a movable sign, the 11th house is the 
Badhaksthana; if the Asc. falls in a fixed sign, 9th house is the badhakasthana; if the Asc. falls in a common sign, the 
7th house is the Badhakasthana. If the sub-lord of the Ascendant is deposited in the Star of the significators of 
Badhakasthana and Marakasthana the life will be short after the time of judgment.

Badhaka Effect 


9. Of all the planets, those which occupy the constellation of the occupants of Badhaka Sthana are the most evil. 
Next, the occupants of Badhaka sthana; of the planets occupying the constellation of the lord of the Badhakasthana, 
and the lord of that evil sign, those in the constellation are stronger. Also, the planets conjoined with them or being 
aspected by them acquire unfavorable effects. (KP Reader ///, pages 161-162 (1971 Edition, Practical Part 2, pages 9- 
10), 


10. If the sub-lord of the Ascendant is deposited in the constellation of the significators of Badhakasthana and 
Marakasthana, the life will be short after the time of judgment. Death Is indicated only by the significators of 
Marakasthan and Badhakasthana. In the case of missing person, if the sub-lord of the Ascendant (of the missing 
person) Is in the constellation of Badhaka and Maraka sthanas, the missing person Is ad. (KP Reader V/; Horary 
Astrology, pages 154-155,159) 


11. Badhkasthana may effect only the health if its Dasa or Bhukti is operating or the Dasa or Bhukti is ruled by the 
planet in the constellation of Badhaka planet. (KP Reader V, page 263/ 1971 Edition page 226). 


12. The lords of the houses 3,88 and 11 houses being evils in Jataka Chandrika, stanza 5, 
is supposed to be- only’ for’ one's’ health and _ =Ilongevity and =not’ for other aspects 
in one's life. (KP Reader V, page 131/ 1971 Edition page 125) 


13. In KP it has been found that the Badaka sthana, Its lord, occupant and the planet in the constellation of occupant 
or the lord playing an important role at the time of death. The Marakasthanas and Badakasthanas and the planets 
Signifying them according to the method taught in “Krishnamurti Padhdhat Readers” are the strongest death - 
influences, followed by houses 12 (mokshasthana or libration), 8 and 3. It is no to take the literal meaning of the term 
‘Badhaka’ and think that it has to do harm in every walk of life. (Your Doubts Resolved by K. Ganapathi, Astrology 
and Athrishta July 1976 issue, pages 42-43). 


14. The jJataka  Parijata originated Badhaka and well known 2,7 #4=x.‘Maraka concepts are 
Originally rasi (sign) based. But in the Placidus unequal bhava applied KP system, they are bhava based and it Is just 
to follow what indicated by the Placidus cusps. 


15. Caution is needed when two or four’ signs are intercepted or blank without = any 
cusp falling in these signs, as shown in the example charts below:. 


e Example Chart 1: In the example chart (Chandrakant. R. Bhatt: Further Light of Nakshatra Chinttamani pp 
31, 156-158), Virgo and Pisces 2 signs are intercepted. The Ascendant Aries is a movable sign, and so 
the 11™ house is Badhaka. In the Placidus unequal bhava based KP chart, the Capricorn sign with the 
11" cusp is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord Saturn is the Badhaka planet. According to the rasi based 
Badhaka concept as shown in the above table, the 11" sign from the Ascendant Aries, Aquarius is the 
Badhaka sign and Its sign lord Saturn is the Badhaka planet, which is the way not applied in the KP analysis. 


e Example Chart 2: |n the example chart (K. Hariharan: How to Judge Longevity? page 67-70), Leo and 
Aquarius 2 signs are intercepted. The Ascendant Capricorn is a movable sign, and so the 11" house is 
Badhaka. In the KP chart, the 11" cusp falls in Sagittarius, which is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord 
Jupiter is the Badhaka planet. According to the rasi based Badhaka concept, the 11" sign from the 
Ascendant Capricorn is Scorpio, which is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord Mars is the Bdhaka planet, which 
is not applicable in the KP analysis. 


e Example Chart 3: I[n this chart, Aries- Libra and Virgo- Aquarius 4 signs are intercepted. The 
Ascendant is Taurus, a fixed sign, and so the 9" house is Badhaka. In the KP chart, Sagittarius with the 9" 
cusp Is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord Jupiter is the Badhaka planet. According to the rasi based 
Badhaka concept, the 9" sign from the Ascendant Taurus, Capricorn is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord 
Saturn is the Bdhaka planet, which is not applicable in the KP analysis. 


e Example Chart 4: I|n the chart, (Chandrakant.R. Bhatt: Further Light of Nakshatra Chinttamani po 51-53), 
Gemini and Sagittarius 2 signs are intercepted. The Ascendant Virgo is a common sign, and so the 7" 
house is Badhaka. In the KP chart, Pisces with the 7" cusp is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord J upiter is 
the Badhaka planet. According to the rasi based Badhaka, the 7" sign from the Ascendant Virgo is 
Pisces, which is the Badhaka sign and its sign lord J upiter is the Bdhaka planet. In this case, both the bhava 
based and rasi based Badhakas are the same even though two signs are intercepted.

Thirty four years ago, the World News came with the birth of the First Test Tube Baby of the World, Joy Brown on 
25" | uly 1978, creating a new era in the medical field and she must be celebrating her birth day now. 


So we will join with her celebrations, wishing her long life and happiness and hope to see many happy returns of her 
birth day, as she has created history in the medical world and consolation to many ladies more than twenty million 
now, who were struggling to become a mother. 


The first test tube baby was born by a method called In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) by which the conception has taken 
place out side the womb of the mother and the fertilized egg Is introduced into the womb and allowed to grow there. 


With the thirty fourth birth day celebrations of Joy Brown, her mother Leslie Brown passed away a few weeks age due 
to a minor ailment on 6™ June 2012. So the major news in the world was the passing away of a great lady, who 
created a new era In the medical world, specially to millions of mothers who has fallopian tube disorders, preventing 
fertilization in side the womb. 


Mrs. Leslie Brown gave birth to the world’s first test tube baby on 25" July 1978 in Oldham, England, by being the 
first successful mother for this IVF programme, and to continue it again by giving birth to another daughter. 


This is an attempt to discuss about the astrological indications in the birth chart of Louise Joy Brown, and at the same 
time it is our duty to appreciate the work of the pioneers who made this miracle to reality in spite of a large number 
of objections and criticisms came from the public. Dr. Patrick Steptoe and Dr. Robert Edwards had successfully made 
this miracle which gives a solution to millions of mothers who were suffering from problems of fertilization in side the 
womb. 


According to the records, Dr. Steptoe had taken an egg cell from Mrs. Brown and Dr. Edwards mixed it with sperms 
from her husband John on the tenth of November 1977. The fertilized egg was introduced into the womb by IVF 
method. The fertilized egg cell matured successfully in side the womb and the baby was born by a caesarian 
operation as the first test tube baby of the world.

Date of birth: 25-07-1978; Time 23:47 PM (DST); Place: Oldham- England 
Lat/ Long: 53 N 33; 2 W 7. Aynamsha: 23.28.03

the details of the delivery.

trine. This combination show some secrecy and hidden facts in her birth. Further, these Mercury and Saturn are 
deposited in the star of Kethu. Again, the trine aspect of Sun to Kethu is making popularity and publicity to the native. 


In the analysis of the death of her mother Leslie Brown, we consider the fourth as the ascendant of the mother. This 
is falling in the sign of Gemini ruled by Mercury and occupied by J upiter. This J upiter is aspected by Moon by square 
aspect. This is not favourable indication for her mother. 


On the date of demise, the fourth bhava of the native was empty. In her birth chart Sun is occupying it showing the 
leadership and the popularity of the mother, when the daughter was born. 


At the time of death of her mother, the native was under the influence of Sun, Saturn and Moon as dasa, bukthi and 
antara lords respectively.

A recent query in the Yahoo Groups by Mr. Prasath is related to the birth of a male child who has had to undergo 
Surgery on his kidneys. The birth details were provided in the discussion thread. | have, therefore, taken those details 
and tried to analyse the problem and its progression through KP. The birth chart of the child is attached. 


Disease, danger to life and hospitalized treatment: 


1. The Ascendant sub lord is Rahu (strong with no planets in its stars) and Is placed in 3. It is sub lord for 1, 5 and 
9. Rahu represents Venus, Jupiter and Saturn by aspect. Jupiter is in 9 and rules 5-8; Saturn is in 2 and rules 6-7. 
Rahu Is in the sub of Venus. Venus is strong with no planets in its stars. It is in 9 and rules 3-10 and Is SL for 4; 


The Asc clearly links with 6 and 8 showing both disease and danger. It also links with 2 & 7 (Marakas) and 9th 
(Badhaka). At the same time it shows 3 and 5. The longevity of the child is that of middle age. Hence, although there 
is danger and disease, it cannot take life. 


2. The 6th & 8th SL Is strong Mercury (no planets in its stars). It is in 11 and rules 2-11 and Is SL for 2, 6, 8 and 10; 
It is in the star of Saturn in 2 and rules 6-7. It is in the sub of Jupiter in 9 and rules 5-8. 


The 6th and 8th bhava are linked with 6 and 8. The 6th house confirms the illness, danger and hospitalisation. 


3. The SL of the 12th is strong Ketu (no planets in its stars) placed in 9. It is sub lord for the 12th alone. It 
represents Venus and Jupiter by conjunction. Venus Is strong with no planets in its stars. It is in 9 and rules 3-10 and 
is SL for 4; J upiter is in 9 and rules 5-8. 


The 12th bhava links with the 8th and shows the danger that must receive hospitalised treatment. However, the Sub 
lord of the 12th, at the stellar level, links with Sun that shows 11 and 1. It is clear that the treatment will be 
successful. 


4. as per KSK's dicta, the nature of the danger and serious disease is shown by an analysts of the 8th 
house primarily and the 6th house in a secondary sense. 


The 8th Sub lord is Mercury, as be discuss above. This itself shows serious complications and danger. Mercury Is in 
the star of Saturn. Here a clear pointer emerges to the long-term chronic nature of the health problem and danger. 
Saturn is a planet of constriction and obstruction. Saturn in Virgo. Virgo rules the belly region and organs below the 
belly. Going by the significations of Saturn, it is posited in the star of Mars indicating surgical intervention. Again, Mars 
is deposited in Virgo as well pointing to the organs in and around the belly region. 


Cure and recovery: 


Cure comes when the significators of house 1, 5, 9 and 11 operate after the joint period of significators causing the 
ailment has finished. 


5. The Lith SL is Mars placed in 1 and rules 4-9; It is in the star of Sun placed in 11 and rules 1; It is in the Sub of 
strong Ketu (no planets in its stars) placed in 9. Ketu is sub lord for the 12th alone. It represents Venus and J upiter by 
conjunction. Venus Is strong with no planets in its stars. It is in 9 and rules 3-10 and is SL for 4; Jupiter is in 9 and 
rules 5-8. 


6. It must be noted that at the stellar level, Mars signifies 1 and 11. Thus both Mars and Sun will contribute to the 
recovery of the child. Sun denotes doctors and surgeons and Mars signifies surgery and surgical interventions. 


Longevity: 


For an assessment of longevity, it is essential to examine the maraka and badhaka indications from the Lagna 
(primarily) and from the 3rd and 8th in a secondary sense. 


7. The Ascendant has been assessed earlier. The ascendant sub lord is Rahu (strong with no planets in its stars) and 
is placed in 3. It is sub lord for 1, 5 and 9. Rahu represents Venus, J upiter and Saturn by aspect. Jupiter is in 9 and 
rules 5-8; Saturn Is in 2 and rules 6-7. Rahu is in the sub of Venus. Venus is strong with no planets in its stars. It is in 
9 and rules 3-10 and is SL for 4;

Role of the Cuspal Sub Lord 





Question: Why the cuspal sub lord alone Is considered without giving attention to the star lord of the cusp? 


Answer: 


1. In KP the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of a house indicates whether the matter of the house Is promised or not. For 
example, if the 7 CSL signifies house 2 or 7 or 11, marriage is promised. 


2. Therefore only the relevant cuspal sub lord (CSL) is considered in judging whether a matter Is promised or not, 
without giving much attention to the star lord of the cusp. 


3. The possible rationale is as given under: 


1) To take the sub which can distinguish the unique feature of a native's 
horoscope and not to consider the star lord of the cusp which may be the same 
for a native and other borns like twins or under similar astrological circumstances; 

2) The difference in twins by the CSL only led Guruji KSK to postulate his Krishnamurti Padhdhati of sub lord 
theory; 

3) A star lord is stronger than a planet and a sub lord is more powerful than a 
star lord; 

4) The cuspal sub lord is supposed to divert the dasa lords under certain conditions. 

5) Since a matter is promised as long as any of the required houses Is siginified by the relevant CSL regardless 
of the signification of negative houses, any matter can be promised for any native by taking into account of 
the signification of both the CSL and the star lord of the cusp. 


4. There are two parts in fructification of marriage: 

1) Ifthe 7th CSL signify house 2 or 7 or 11, marriage is promised; 

2) If it's promised, marriage will fructify during the DBAS of the significators 

of house 2,7, 11 when transit agrees. 

5. The promise does not ensure that marriage will take place. If marriage is not promised, it will not happen at all. 
6. The difference in judging the CSL and DBAS lords at all three levels of ‘planet, its star lord and sub lord’ by 
occupation and lordship is that as long as the 7" CSL signifies any of house 2,7,11, marriage is promised but in the 
case of DBAS lords, not only required house 2,7,11 but also negative houses 1,6,10,12 are to be considered in 
judging whether the DBAS lords are the fruitful significators for marriage or not. 


7. Whether happy or unhappy married life is to be judge by the 11™ (relations) CSL. 


8. There is no role of star lord of 7th cusp in fructification of marriage and happy or unhappy married life as per KP of 
the six KP Readers. 


9. As per Guruji KSK's guidance, "We have come up to this (six KP Readers)- you 
should continue the research and you may reach to further truth", only research, requiring a minimum of one hundred 


carefully documented case studies (J udith Hill: Medical Astrology, A Guide to Planetary Pathology, 2004, p 58) can 
make a rule or break a rule.

Will Saif al-Islam be extradited to the Hague - a KP analysis [Rares 


Ezine 





Arvind Gupta 
E-mail: guptaa@unhcr.org 








\ p?, } 1 

The following news item in the BBC has raised my curiosity as to the fate of the powerful son of former Libyan 
dictator, Gaddafi. Militiamen in Libya are currently holding Saif al-Islam since November 2011. It is interesting to note 
that his detention Is not by the formal government of Libya but by informal forces. Extradition to the Hague can only 
be negotiated with the formal government authorities. The question, therefore, is whether the government of Libya is 
in a position to negotiate Saif’s handover to the formal authorities and further to hand him over to the Hague. 

“Saif al-I slam Gaddafi seeks Hague trial 
Militiamen in Libya have held Saif al-Islam since November 2011 


Col Gaddafi's son has said he wants to be put on trial in the 
Hague, rather than in his home country, his lawyers have said. 


Saif al-Islam said if he was executed after a trial in Libya, then it 
would be tantamount to murder, according to documents 
Submitted to the International Criminal Court. 


Sots = The 40-year-old is being held by militia in the city of Zintan. 
He has been indicted by the ICC for crimes against humanity. 


Libya's interim government has so far refused to hand him over for trial in the Netherlands, where the international 
court is based, arguing that he should face justice in his own country. 


Col Gaddafi, whose autocratic rule lasted for 42 years, was killed in unclear circumstances after being captured by 
rebels in October, in an act criticised by rights groups. 


‘Fake guard’ 


"| am not afraid to die but if you execute me after such a trial you should just call it murder and be done with it," Saif 
al-Islam was quoted by lawyers as saying. 


In June, a team sent by the ICC were arrested after meeting Saif al-lslam, and held for more than three weeks. 


The documents filed to the court said that during that meeting an official who had pretended to be an illiterate guard 
had stopped an ICC lawyer from taking a sworn statement from Saif al-Islam. 


"The 'guard', who Is actually Mr Anmed Amer - a councillor who speaks several languages - was planted in the room 
to deliberately trick the delegation," the filing said, according to Reuters. 


"He came back into the room and (in the presence of the ICC interpreter), started shouting that this statement was 
very dangerous, violated Libyan national security, and that the defense could not have it back." 


The meeting was cut short after 45 minutes and their documents were confiscated, the lawyers said. The team were 
later detained. 


The actions of the authorities appeared to show they viewed It as "illegal, treason, or a violation of national security 
for either Mr Gaddafi or his Counsel to indicate that Mr Gaddafi does not wish to be tried before Libyan courts", the 
lawyers said in the filing. 


Libyan officials accused lawyer Melinda Taylor, who was leading the ICC delegation, of smuggling spying devices and 
a coded letter to Saif al-Islam during the meeting. 


http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-19073600”

Will Saif al-Islam be extradited to the Hague - a KP analysis [fas 


Ezine 





The Question: Will Saif al-|slam be extradited to the Hague? 
Horary number: 222/249 


Date: 1 August 2012. 
Time: 13:01:20 
Place: Pretoria, South Africa (25:45:00South; 28:10:00East) 


In this question, the issue is one of Saif having to leave Libya and be taken abroad to the Hague to stand trial at the 
[International Court. While it is a mundane question, this chart focuses on Saif as an individual. 


Rule 1: For moving out of one’s place and going abroad, the 12" CSL must be connected with 3, 9 and 12. Bhavas 2, 
4,10 and 11 do not allow one to move from where he or she is. 


Rule 2: If the 12 CSL is linked with 2, 3, 8 and 12 one is imprisoned and has to face trials. 

Extradition: 

12 CSL 

12" CSL is strong Venus (no planets in its stars) placed in 4" and rules 4-9. Venus is CSL for 6, 10 and 12; It is in the 
star of Mars in 8 and rules 3-10; It is in the sub of strong Mercury (no planets in its stars) placed in 5 and rules 5-8. 
Mercury Is CSL for 2 and 4. 

Here the 12" CSL is linked with 2, 3, 8 and 12 clearly showing his detention. 

The 12" CSL is also linked with 3,9,12 showing his extradition and movement abroad. 

Note the 12" CSL is also linked with 4 and 10, which does not support his movement out of his present country. 

4" CSL 

4'" CSL is strong Mercury (no planets in its stars) placed in 5 and rules 5-8. Mercury is CSL for 2 and 4. Mercury is in 
the star of Saturn in 8 and rules 1-12. It is in the sub of strong Venus (no planets in its stars) placed in 4‘" and rules 
4-9, Venus is CSL for 6, 10 and 12. 

The 4" CSL lilnks with 2, 4 and 10 showing lack of movement. 

It also links with 9 and 12 that supports his extradition. 


It further links with 8 and 12 showing punishment and detention. 


THUS 
This chart shows both movement and lack of movement. Which occurs will depend upon the DBAS operating. 


lf Saif has to be extradited, the significators of 3,9,12 must operate without 2,4,10 and 11, and the movement would 
occur In the appropriate DBAS when transit also agrees. 


SIGNI FI CATORS 

3 = Ketu, Venus, Saturn, Mars 
9 = Rahu, Venus 

12 = Sun, Mercury, Rahu, Saturn 


Ketu is strong (no planets in its stars) and Is placed in 3. it represents J upiter (no planets in its stars) placed in 4 and 
rules 2-11 being CSL for 1, 5, 11. Ketu Is in the star of Sun in 5 and rules 7. It is in the sub of itself. Thus, Ketu 
strongly signifies 3 at the planet level. It also strongly signifies 2, 4, and 11. 


Venus is strong (no planets in its stars) placed in 4" and rules 4-9. Venus is CSL for 6, 10 and 12. It is in the star of 
Mars in 8 and rules 3-10. It Is in the sub of strong Mercury (no planets in its stars) placed in 5 and rules 5-8. Thus, 
Venus signifies 3,9,12 along with 2,4,10. 


Saturn in 8 and rules 1-12. It is in the star of Mars in 8 and rules 3-10. It is in the sub of itself. Again, Saturn shows 
3,12 along with 10. But, it is stronger than Venus to bring about extradition if its DBAS operate.

Mars in 8 and rules 3-10. It is in the star of Moon in 11 and rules 6. It is in the sub of strong Venus (no planets in its 
stars) placed in 4‘ and rules 4-9. Mars indicates 3, 9 but also strongly indicates 4,11. 


Rahu |s strong (no planets in its stars) placed in 9. It is CSL for 7. Rahu represents Mars in 8 and rules 3-10; strong 
Jupiter (no planets in its stars) placed in 4 and rules 2-11 being CSL for 1, 5, 11; and Saturn in 8 and rules 1-12. Rahu 
is in the star of Saturn. It Is in the sub of strong Ketu (no planets in its stars) and is placed in 3. It represents J upiter 
(no planets In its stars) placed in 4 and rules 2-11 being CSL for 1,5,11. 


Thus, Rahu signifies 3,9,12 and also 2,4,10 and 11. 


Sun in 5 and rules 7. It is in the star of Saturn in 8 and rules 1-12. It is in the sub of strong J upiter (no planets in its 
stars) placed in 4 and rules 2-11 being CSL for 1, 5, 11. Thus, Sun links with 12. It also strongly shows 4 and 11. 


Mercury Is strong (no planets in its stars) in 5 and rules 5-8 being CSL for 2, 4. It is in the star of Saturn in 8 and 
rules 1-12. It is in the sub of strong Venus (no planets in its stars) placed in 4" and rules 4-9. Venus is CSL for 6,10 
and 12. 

Thus Mercury also shows 9 and 12 but strongly links 2,4,10. 


From the above, it is clear that none of the significators of bhavas 3,9,12 clearly point to movement abroad. 
Extradition is therefore doubtful. 


To narrow the possibilities and take a deeper consideration of the DBAS, RPs have been taken at 13:15:33 
on 1/8/2012. These are: 


Ascendant = Jupiter, Saturn, Mars 
Moon = Mercury, Sun, Saturn 
Day Lord = Mercury. 


Note that Mercury is retrograde but does not hinder the results. None of the planets are in Mercury star and 
retrogression is not an issue. Rahu has been added to the RPs as it represents Mars. 


DBAS 

1. Current Dasa is that of Sun up to 25 January 2014). Sun is in both significators and RPs. However, as 
analysed above, Sun can cause extradition (by virtue of its signification of the 12") but only when 
Supported by a Bhukti that is clearly in favour of movement. 

2. The Bhuktis running and yet to run in Sun Dasa are those of Mercury, Ketu and Venus.

This is an attempt to find the possible planetary pattern to become astrologer. In this regard, the connection 
of the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of 1% (native oneself), 9" (astrology in general), 10" (profession for astrological 
counseling) and 11" (success and Siddhi) to Mercury (chief karaka for astrology, intellectual thought-cells 
of a studious astrologer), J upiter (chief karaka for higher learning and knowledge, intuition, ability to attract 
patronage), Ketu (occult knowledge, Enlightener), Saturn (spiritual concentration), Moon (mind, mental 
inclination), Uranus (astrology), Neptune (intuition) Aquarius (astrological sign), Gemini (sign of intellet) and 
simultaneously signification of house 2 (speaking ability, prediction), 3 (mental inclination), 5 (intelligence, 
intuition, past life credit), 7° (public relations in counseling), 8" (mysterious arts), 9 (astrology in general), 
10 (profession for counseling, name, honor), 11 (success and Siddhi) and 12 (occult knowledge) have been 
studied on the fifteen charts of successful astrologers. 


The results are compiled in the tables 1-4 and summarized as under: 


1) For the interest in astrology, the 1% CSL is mainly connected to Moon, Saturn, Mercury and Ketu and 
primarily signifies house 11,5,9 according to the order of appearing frequency; 

2) For astrology in general, the 9°" CSL is mostly related to Mercury, Jupiter, Moon, Ketu and largely 
signifies house 2,3,9,11 in order of frequency; 

3) For profession of astrological counseling, the 10" CSL is principally connected to Saturn, Jupiter, 
Moon, Mercury and chiefly signifies house 2,7,9,10 in order of frequency; 

4) For success in practicing astrology, the 11" CSL is mostly connected with Moon, Mercury, Ketu, 
Jupiter and mainly signifies house 5,7,9,2/12 in order of frequency; 

5) In general the well placed Mercury, Saturn, Moon, Jupiter and simultaneously signification of house 
9,11 appear crucial to become a successful astrologer with additional support of other related planets, 
houses and signs; 

6) In particular the well placed Mercury can be found pivotal to become a mathematics-minded 
astrologer along with support of Mars.

Background

research. | will show only a few examples for benefit of readers to explain the new finding. 


New rules for sport competition: 


1) 1%, 6" and 11™cusp sub-lord must signify 1,6 or 11" houses. 
2) 6 is stronger than 1 & 11 and 11 Is stronger than 1. 
3) The 6CSL must signify 6 more than 1 or 11.

factor. In many cases, Dasha lord will give victory to opponent if not signifies 1,6 or 11 house, same for sookshma 
lord.

manner 


A= 6, 11 & B= 6, 1 =A Is stronger. 
A= 6& B= 1, Gori, 6 =B Is stronger. 
A= 1 & B= 11 =B Is stronger. 


Count also the DBAS level and decide the winner. If there is totally equal results it could be a draw or a victory for the 
strongest team or team playing in own field.

Vipul Mehta wins Indian Idol 6 


Published: Sunday, Sep 2, 2012, 0:57 IST 

Place: Mumbai | Agency: PT! 

Vioul Mehta, a Mass Communication graduate, won the sixth season of singing reality show Indian Idol which came to 
an end tonight. There were three contestants, all from Punjab -- Vipul Mehta, Devendra Pal Singh and Amit Kumar -- 
in the fray during the finale. Vipul walked away with a cash prize of Rs50 lakh, a Nissan Micra car, and a Suzuki 
Hayate bike. Vioul, who learnt Indian classical music from the age of eight and is a mass communication graduate, 
wants to make a career in sound engineering. He was a finalist in another singing reality show Voice of India (season 
2). Filmmaker Madhur Bhandarkar and actress Kareena Kapoor were present for the the final to promote their 
upcoming film ‘Heroine’. Indian I!dol season 6 was judged by Asha Bhosle, Anu Malik, Salim Merchant and Sunidhi 
Chauhan.

Bhi 


Question-1: Planetary Pattern for Astrologers 





| have a small question about KP astrology. Is it possible to know whether one can learn astrology or not from his/her 
horoscope? 


| mean suppose a person wants to learn astrology. Is it possible to know from his horoscope whether he has the 
ability to learn it or not? 


Answer- 1 


In the charts of successful astrologers, the sub lord of 1° (native oneself), 10 (profession for counseling) and 11" 
(success and Siddhi) cusp is found connected primarily with Mercury (chief karaka for astrology, intellectual thought- 
cells of a studious astrologer), Jupiter (chief karaka for higher learning and knowledge, intuition, ability to attract 
patronage), and signifying mainly 2" (speaking ability, prediction), 5‘ (intelligence, intuition, past life credit), 7 
(public relations in counseling), 11° (success and Siddhi). And to some extent the connection to Ketu (occult 
knowledge, Enlightener), Saturn (spiritual concentration), Moon (mind, mental inclination, and signification of 8" 
(mysterious arts) and 9" (higher mind, astrology) house are also prominent. 


Question- 2: Hindu and Western Aspects 


The K.P. astrologers are using freely both Western aspects and Vedic aspects. In a chart the planetary position Is as 
follows: Saturn ts in Virgo (15.45.05) and Venus is in Scorpio (15.18.45). As per Western system the aspect Is sextile 
and therefore considered good. But where as as per vedic system the aspect of Saturn (3rd aspect) Is bad. | shall be 
grateful if you could kindly clarify this matter. 


Answer-2 


In the solved examples of the KP six Readers, only the Hindu aspects are used without considering the orb, although 
it is encouraged to study the Western aspects. (Question & Answer section, KP E-zine June 2012 issue) 


2. The main differences between Hindu and Western aspects are as given under: 


1) The Hindu aspects are counted from rasi to rasi but in the Western aspects, the aspect is reckoned from 
degree to degree. 

2) The magnitude of Hindu aspects between two planets is different whereas in the Western aspects it is the 
same. The Western five basic aspects are the same for all planets, e.g. sextile (60° / Hindu 3™ aspect) is for 
all planets, not for Saturn only as in the Hindu aspects; square (90° / 4°" Hindu aspect) is also for all planets, 
not for Mars only like in the Hindu aspects; trine (120° / 5" Hindu aspect) is also for all planets, not for 
Jupiter only similar to the Hindu aspects. 

3) The Western sextile and trine aspects are clearly marked as beneficial and square and opposition as evil. 
Whereas in the Hindu aspects there Is no such classification and they are generally based on the signification 
of aspecting and aspected planets. 

4) Hindu aspects are always forward looking unlike in Western aspects where both 120° and 240° are the same 
aspect which Is called trine. 


3. As the favorable of unfavorable effects of aspects in the two systems can be different, it is better to use the Hindu 


aspects in the KP or Vedic analysis, if necessary by taking consideration of the closer an aspect on any located planet 
or cusp Is, the stronger the result would be.

A Student's Text-Book of Astrology 

by Vivian Erwood Robson, B.Sc. (1890-1942) 

Vivian Robson Memorial Edition 

Astrology Classics (The Astrology Center of America) 
2010, 297 pages (was first published in 1922) 





“Hindu Predictive Astrology” by Pandit Gopesh Kumar Ojha, 93, Daryaganj, Delhi 6 and “A Student’s Text Book of 
Astrology” by Vivian E. Robson are worth reading for the basic knowledge of Astrology. 

- Chandrakant Ratneshwar Bhatt 

Dated 28-3-1975, in preface of his Nakshatra Chintaman 


He will be remembered best by his two chief books, A Student's Text-book of Astrology and The Fixed Stars ana 
Constellations in Astrology. Of these the former is deservedly popular and the latter Is a classic, containing as it does 
a mass of information dating from the days of Greek mythology up to modern times. 

- C.E.O. Carter 


This is one of the most comprehensive astrology text books covering a variety of topics as shown in the contents. For 
each topic, the author gives specific rules of judgment and then supplies aphorisms collected from many ancient 
sources. This work offers traditional natal chart interpretations of planets, signs, houses and aspects. For example, in 
the chapter, "Health and Accidents", pages 102, 105, the house position of the ruler of 6° often shows the source of 
illness but the houses ruled by the inflicting planets must also be considered. In general the effect of the ruler of 6" in 
1* house, much ill health, often caused through the native own fault. . . in 5 house, illness through pleasures etc. . . 
The houses correspond to the signs, malefic in say the 2"? may affect the health not only through the sign containing 
it but also through Taurus, the sign normally corresponding the 2"? house. . .For Cancer disease the astrological 
Indications are not yet certain. As a rule the Moon is badly afflicted and there are afflictions from Jupiter, Saturn or 
Neptune, and the signs, Aries, Taurus, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn. Saturn in Cancer sign often indicates the death of 
a parent, usually the father from cancer disease. In the chapter, “Finance”, pages 109, 114, the 2™ house rules 
money and property; the 5‘ speculation; the 8 loss but also legacies, inheritance, and the money of the wife, 
partner and general public, and the 11" , income from business... If the significators of wealth are in houses 12,11 or 
10, money will be obtained in youth; if in 9,8 or 7, between the ages of 25 and 35 or 40; if in 6,5 or 4, between 40 
and 50; and if in 3,2 or 1, late in life.

When shall I get a job of my choice? 





Er. V.K. Sharma, B.E (Elect.), Supdt. Engineer (Retd.), 
Punjab State Electricity Board. 

#104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, 

Mohali (Chandigarh). 

Cell - 09417117370, nickO885@gmail.com 





A querent from Ludhiana who was anxiously looking for some good jobs contacted me to know astrologically when 
She will get a job of her choice. | asked her to intimate any horary number between 1 and 249, accordingly the 
querent told me the number as 5. | made calculations on dated 6-7-2012 at 5:28 PM at Chandigarh. 


Moon the reflector of mind 

Moon is posited in 11 and its star lord Mars in 6, lord of 1 & 8. its sub lord Jupiter in 2, lord of 10 & 9. As Moon 
Signifies 6 [service], 2 [monetary gain], 10 [occupation], 11 [gain, fulfillment of desire] and 8 [tension]; so Moon 
reveals the nature of enquiry and tension in getting a proper job. 


Confirmation through ascendant sub lord 

In the horary map ascendant indicates efforts of querent. In this case ascendant sub lord Mars is posited in 6" house; 
its star lord Sun ts lord of 6and its sub lord Ketu is posited in 2. Moreover Ketu having no planet in its star is the 
cuspal sub lord of 11" bhava; so Ketu becomes a strong significator of 11. In this way ascendant sub lord is the 
Significator of 2, 6 & 11. Hence querent effort will be fruitful for getting a job. 


Gulberga theory 

If sub lord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon star lord or lagna star lord among ruling planets, 
then the query is to be answered affirmative otherwise not. In this case Ascendant sub lord of horary number is Mars, 
also Moon star lord of R.P. is Mars. Hence | told the querent that she will surely get the desired job of her choice. 


Fortuna 
Fortuna is posited in Leo sign of Sun and Sun is a significator of 6" house as Sun is owner of 6" house, so querent 
will be fortunate in getting a job as desired. 


Rule for getting a job 
If the cuspal sub lord of 6" or 10" be significator of 2, 6, or 10, service or job is promised during the joint period of 
Significators of 2, 6 and 10. 


Ruling planets on dated 6-7-2012 at 5:28 PM at Chandigarh [u.t] 


SIGN LORD STAR LORD SUB LORD 
ASC MARS MER MARS 
MOON SAT MARS J UP 
DAY LORD VENUS 


6" Cusp sub lord 
6" cusp sub lord Sat is in 6, lord of 11 & 12. Star lord Mars is in 6 lord of 8 and 1 and its sub lord Sat is in 6 and lord 
of 11 & 12. So 6" cusp sub lord signifies 6 and 11 which is conducive for getting a job. 


10™ Cusp sub lord 

10" cuspal sub lord Mer is in 4 lord of 3 & 4. Mer is not having any planet in its star; so Mer is a strong significator of 
2 and 10 by being sub lord of 2nd and 10th cusp. Star lord of Mer is Sat in 6, lord of 11 & 12. Sub lord of Mer is Jup 
in 2, lord of 10. 

So 10" cusp sub lord is the significator of 2, 6, 10 and 11. So it is favourable for getting job. 


2™ and 11" Cusp sub lord 
2"’ cusp sub lord is also Mer as discussed above. 


So in view of above analysis a job Is promised. 

Dasha, bhukti and antra analysis 

On dated 6-7-2012 Mars dasha and bhukti of J upiter was running from 07-3-2012 to 11-2-2013. 

Mars dasha 

Mars is in 6, lord of 1 & 8. Its star lord Sun is in 3, lord 6. its sub is Ketu in 2 and Ketu having no planet in its star is 


the sub lord of 11th cusp, so it becomes a strong significator of 11th house. Hence dasha lord Mars is the significator 
of 2, 6 and 11 which is conducive for getting a job. Mars is also a ruling planet.

Double Role of the 8th House in Judgment of Longevity 











TinWin 
tw853@yahoo.com 


Bis al 


The 8" house plays the confusing double role as the ‘house of longevity’ in judgment of longevity or life span and as 
the ‘house of death’ by its signification. The houses 1, 3, 8 are examined as the houses of longevity in judging one’s 
longevity. However the significators of the 8 and 3™ houses by the 1% and 8 cusp sub lords or the 
running DBAS lords or transit are undesirable malefics for one’s health and longevity due to chronic 
diseases, serious accidents, suicide, murders, assassinations etc., as presented below: 


1) 


2) 


3) 


4) 


5) 


9) 


In the judgment of longevity, the Ascendant sub lord is mainly examined as the Ascendant sub lord shows 
one’s health, vitality, immunity and longevity. Among the significators of the Ascendant sub lord, the 
houses 1,5,9,10 support the longer longevity and the houses 6,8,12 cut the longevity short. (KP Reader ///, 
pages 159, 165/ 1971 edition Practical part, pp 12,18; KP Reader VI, po 155-159); C.R. Bhatt’s Nakshatra 
Chintamani, p 30; Further Lights on Nakshatra Chintamani pp, 24-25; P.V.K. Punneswara Rao’s Theory ana 
Practice of Stellar Astrology, po 45) 


To the longevity of father, the houses 2 and 3 counted from the 9" house is evil. (KP Reader V/, p 85) The 
marakasthanas and bhadakasthanas and the planets signifying them according to the method taught in 
“Krishnamurti Padhdhati Readers” are the strongest death influences, followed by houses 12 
(mokshasthana or libration), 8 and 3. (K. Ganapathi: Your Doubt Resolved, Astrology & Athrishta, July 1976 
ISSUC, 423) 


The 8th house denotes longevity or span of life, ‘house of death’, suicide, danger, incidents. (KP Reader VI, 
po 118, 155, 258, 308; KP Reader //1, p 165/ 1971 edition, Practical part, ~p 12, KP Reader I/, p 20; KF 
Reader IV, p 249) 


The 8" house is known as the house of death in the Western astrology. (Ru/ership Book by Rex Bills, p 33; 
Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology, by H. L. Cornell, 0 142; A Student’s Text-Book of Astrology by Vivian E 
Robson, 2010, p 16 ) 


The 8th house is called the house of "longevity". Therefore planets in the constellation of evil planets in the 
8th house, except Saturn, occupants of the 8th house, planets in the constellation or in the sub of lord of 8, 
lord of the 8th cusp and planets in any manner connected with them indicate "(a) danger to one's life", (b) 
the cause of death and (c) the place of death. (KP Reader ///, oo 160-161) 


The 4,8,12 houses are called trigonal houses causing fatal incidents (Astrosecrets & KP Part ||, pp 94-97 /4- 
8-12 and Accidents by Kundanthai Nathan/, and K.M. Subramanian’s Sublord Speaks- 3 by p 66) \n the 
Western astrology the 4,8,12 triangle houses are called terminal houses which concern the end of life and 
death of physical body. (Encyclopedia of Medical Astrology, by H. L. Cornell, p 857; Explore the Power Oj 
Astrology by A. P. Parashar, V.K. Parashar, p 52) 


Danger to life is indicated during the conjoined period of the lord of the sign, the lord of the star, the lord of 
the sub and the lord of constellation where the 8th house was deposited. (KP Reader ///, p 169/ 1971 
edition Practical part, p 16) 


Out of the twins born in the same Lagna and in the same constellation, the child with the Lagna sub 
governed by lord of 8 or 6 suffers and dies early. (KP Reader ///, po 175/ 1971 edition Practical part, p 22) 


The influence of 8th house could be seen in the majority of unnatural death cases. (Dr. B.V. Raman’s How 
to /udge a Horoscope Vol. Two, pp 71, 153) 


10) The 8" house represents longevity of the native, but "whether it denotes death as well?" is a mute 


question. (Lf Co/. Raj Kumar's Longevity, Prologue) 


11) The 8" house of longevity is also called the house of death because the end of longevity is the death after 


having lived the allotted span of life. (KP Reader //, p 205) 


12) The 2nd house being 8th from 7th house signifying the ‘death’ of first soouse (7th house) or the ‘end’ of 


7th house matters (eg. partnership) is referred for the 2nd spouse; 9th house being 8th from 2nd Is 
referred for 3rd spouse and so on. (Kalidasa’s Utara Kalamrita, translated by Dr. D.S. Sastri, 2001, p 107; 
KP Reader //, po 189; KP Reader IV, pp 83, 181, 184; O.S. Agarwal’s Practical Vedic Astrology, 2002, p 89; 
Sanjay Rath’s Crux of Vedic Astrology, po 291 and Vimsottar! & Udu Dasas, po 138-144)

In the traditional astrology, the gender of a new born baby could be determined according to the masculinity or 
femininity of the Navamsa of the Ascendant. If the Ascendant is in an masculine or odd Navamsa sign, Aries, Gemini, 
Leo etc., the child is male; if It is in an feminine or even Navamsa sign, Taurus Cancer and Virgo etc., the child is 
female. 


However it is not the Navamsa, which decides the gender of a child. It goes beyond Navamsa to other finer divisions 
of the Ascendant and aspects to confirm the gender. 


The latest quintuplet’s birth occurred in Dallas, United States on the 9" August 2012 at 10.00 am. The birth of these 
five babies occurred within five minutes according to the news published. This was possible to make these births 
happened due to the involvement of five groups of medical specialists each of which was monitoring each child, since 
the time of announcement of the conception of these five foetuses. 


The five babies, three boys and two girls, were delivered at 27 weeks pregnancy and weighed between 1 pound and 
12 ounces and 2 pounds and 11 ounces. Generally most of the multiple births are delivered prematurely. 


“The infants are doing as expected for quintuplets born at 27 weeks,” said Dr. Gary Burgess, Medical Director of the 
Neonatal Intensive Care Unit, who Is overseeing care for the five children. 


The babies’ names are: Will Edward, David Stephen, Marcie Jane, Seth Jared, and Grace Elise. They are in stable 
condition and will be in the care of the neonatal intensive care unit at St. Paul University Hospital. 

As these five babies were born within five minutes time, the Navamsa should be one or two only, not more than two 
Navamsas, as one Navamsa rises for about twelve minutes only. 


The KP birth chart of the first born baby is attached herewith. 


It is seen that the ascendant is Virgo and the navamsa is Capricorn for Virgo 03.15.10, a female Navamsa. But 
according to the reports, the first child is a boy.

Education - Aeronautical Engineering 





MK Viswanath 
Astrologervishy_nair@yahoo.co.in 





Recently i.e., on Aug 02, 2012, | had a casual visit to the home of an old friend, who was slightly perplexed and 
anxious, did enquire with me If his granddaughter could get admission into Aeronautical Engineering, and the natal 
chart was placed before me. 


Personally | am always keen to read and decipher the horoscopes of female children, especially the subject of 
education. When women become educated, well qualified, employed and economically independent, the society 
automatically grows vertically and horizontally. Among many advantages, it also controls the excessive growth of 
population of these biped humans which helps the State to build a strong economy. 


The native was born on 22 Oct 1994 at 2-10 a.m., Hyderabad, Andhra Pradesh, and the natal horoscope Is attached 
herewith. 


After careful consideration of various aspects of the natal chart, as presented below, | told him that his granddaughter 
could get admission to an engineering college in the desired branch of Aeronautical Engineering. 


The sub lords of 04, 09 and 11" cups for education are Mercury, Rahu and Rahu respectively. 


Out of the combinations of Mercury, Mars and Saturn for Engineering, only Mercury, lord of 11, is appearing in the list 
of the relevant cuspal sublords. But on further scrutiny of the chart, one could see that Mars Is aspecting Rahu by its 
04" aspect, while Mars is lord of 04 and 09 for higher education. Moreover Rahu is conjoined with Mercury, Sun. 
J upiter and Venus in the 3 house of one’s ability and inclination to learn. Thus Rahu, being a catalyst, looks strong to 
take the native forward in education. 


Rahu Is posited in an airy sign viz. Libra and is conjoined with Mercury and Venus. Rahu offers result of 04 and 09 
through Mars. It is further offering the results of Venus, Mercury and an airy sign. 


The counseling for Engineering by the Government was set for last week of August / 01° week of September this 
year. During this period, the native shall run the joint Vimshottari das period of of Mars-Saturn-Rahu. 


Dasa lord Mars and Antra lord Rahu, as discussed above, are favorable for higher education by signifying 04, 09 or 
11. Bhukti lord Saturn is posited in the star of Satabhisha ruled by Rahu in Aquarius and it is under 8" aspect of Mars, 
lord of 04 and 09. 


During the 3 week of September, when | spoke to the father of the girl, he told me that the girl has indeed got 
admission into a College, and the branch allocated was Aeronautical Engineering. 


Indeed if one looks at the chart, Sun and Mars could be seen debilitated, and Mars is posited in 12" house. But these 


points are not always reliable in astrology. An astrological student is required to evaluate a chart scientifically and 
logically, rather than giving in to beliefs connected to superstitions and astrological myths, by learning more.

Astrology & Arithsha February 1970 isue- page no 52 
“DIAGNOSIS OF DISEASE.” (Horary) 


“Good Morning, sir.” 

“Yes, Good luck, come in.” 

“ Sir, | would like to know whether | also suffer from the same disease from which my wife suffers. | want 
Clarification. Your name has been mentioned to me by a friend ofmine residing in Kerala. He gave me your address 
and asked me to meet you in person. So, | have come to consult you here.” 

(/f at alla person were to suspect that he and his wife may have the same disease, we elderly people doubt what 
It might be; but an astrologer could not guess. He has to go only by the indications given by the planets.) 

So, | wanted him to give one number to find out the nature of the disease of his wife and another number to fina 
out whether he ¢ suffers from the same disease or he has something else. 

“Now, Sir, please give me two numbers between one and 249. The first one on behalf of your wife; the secona 
one to denote you.” 

“ Sir, let number 231 be for my wife and 226 for myself.” 

“By 231, it is meant that Meena lagna, one degree 20 mts. rises. This number ts given for your wife ; so the 
seventh house reoresents your wife; so seventh cusp would be one degree 20 mts in Virgo. 

“12th cusp represents your wife’s disease and also the planet connected with 12th house. 12th cusp falls at 24 
degrees 13 mts. in Capricorn and Rahu Is in the 12th house. 
12th house means sixth to the seventh. /t indicates the nature of the disease of your wife. As the 12th Cusp has fallen 
in Saturn sign, Mars star and Rahu sub, we have to see the /ord of the constellation by occupation and the sub-/ora 
also. 

Mars, the lord of the constellation Is in the 3rd house counted from the seventh and the sub-lord is in six to 
seven. Therefore, the indication Is that she must have affliction of the lungs. Mars is in a watery sign. Hence there 
should be phlegm also. As Rahu, the sub-lord is in the sign of Saturn and also an airy sign, she must suffer from 
chronic cough also. Therefore, it shows that she must suffer from T.B. 

“You gave the number 226 for you. After the judgment is made in the same manner, | find that you also have

Answer- 1

disease, as usually done in the KP practice below:

Question-2: Too Much I mportance Given to Badhaka 


In KP the Badhaka is given too much importance in the judgment of longevity and 8" as house of danger to life is 
generally neglected. Could you explain for better understanding in this regard. 


Answer-2 


1. The Bhadhaka houses are the worst malefics in cutting one's life without hesitation. However it may effect only the 
health if its Dasa or Bhukti is ruled by the planet. (KP Reader II! pp 155-161 /1971 Original Addition, Practical Part pp 
3-9; KP Reader V p 226) This KP research finding has been found significantly valid in practice, and so the Badhaka 
has been given importance for death. 


2. For longevity or life span of a native, it is to judge the cuspal sub lords of 1st, 3rd and 8" houses of longevity, 
basically and most importantly 1st CSL (one self) by experience. If there is an indication of possible unnatural death 
by 1st CSL, the 8th CSL is also to be judged for confirmation. 


3. It is worthy to note that the 8th signification by the 1° or 8" CSL or the DBAS lords will give the ‘negative’ effect 
on health and longevity, conducive to death, as 8" being house of danger to life, chronic ailments, serious accidents, 
death especially in experience of Western astrology. 


4. Generally death comes during the conjoined dasa period of significtors of primarily Badhaka (11 or 9 or 7), Maraka 
(2,7), Moksha (12), along with terminal or trigonal houses 4 = end of everything including life, 8 = accident, danger 
to life, and 12= end of lie especially in serious accidents or unnatural death and in some cases also 10 = retirement 
from this world or life and 6 = injury in accident). Badhaka house is 11th for moving sign Asc., 9th for fixed sign and 
7th for common sign according to the cusp position in the Placidus bhava chart, not rasi chart. (KP Rules for Death 
Prediction, KPE-zine J une 2010 Issue)

Answer-3: 


This is not to make the prediction but just to give some clarifications regarding the article “A Study of 100 Prisoner 
Charts” (KP-Ezine March 2009 issue) in order not to have too much unnecessary worries . 


2. The KP Rule for Imprisonment (KP Reader VI pp 313-314) is as under: 
It is to judge the 12th cusp and find out whether the following three conditions are simultaneously satisfied: - 
1) The sub-lord of 12th cusp should be Rahu; 
2) It should not be deposited in the constellation whose lord Is retrograde; and 
3) It should be a signifcator of either 2nd or 3rd or 8th or 12th house. 
4) \f any one of these conditions is not satisfied, one will not be imprisoned. For imprisonment all the above 
three conditions must necessarily be satisfied simultaneously. 


1) The second condition is for horary analysis only. 

2) The first condition of karaka Rahu to be the 12th CSL is not significantly found valid in "A Study of 100 
Prisoner Charts" (KPE-zine March 2009) i.e. one may be imprisoned without the 12th CSL being Rahu. 

3) The third condition of signifying 2,3,8 or 12 house Is the really necessary condition to be satisfied in the 
analysis of a natal chart.

KP Horary Chart 





1. Only the horary analysis of the numbers 1-249 subs is found to be the KP horary as it is consistently used in the KP 
Reader VI: Horary Astrology. (Horary of Numbers 108, 249, 2193 and Time Chart, KP-Ezine, J uly 2012 issue). 


2. A KP horary chart is for the person who gives the hoary number. (KP Reader 
VI, pp 89, 253, 269-270) 


3. So if a person asks the question for himself, there is no need to rotate the horary chart. For example, “Will | marry 
Mary?” 


Rotation of the Chart 


4. |f the query is for someone else other than the horary number giver, the KP horary chart is found rotated in the KP 
Reader VI, based on the relation between the querent and the person in question, as follows: 


e Take that house which represents the relationship.. For father and for strangers take only the 9th house... 
3rd counted from the house representing the relative. (p 160) 

e The number given by the guerist shows his lagna. The query is about his third son... the 3 is shown by 3™ to 
7‘", i.e. 9" from lagna. Therefore the lagna of the third child is the 9" house. (p 174) 

e The query may be for the querist himself or for some relative or friend. If the query is for himself, make all 
the calculations from lagna. If it is for younger brother or sister, take the third house counted from the lagna 
as the ascendant for that younger brother or sister. If it relates to mother take the 4th house, to son or 
daughter take the 5th, to wife or partner take the 7th, to father take the 9" and to elder brother and sister 
take the 11 ...( p 213) 

e Since that person (your uncle) is your father’s elder brother, then the 11th house counted from the 9" 
(father) represents your uncle. (p 257) 

e As the 9" house represents father, his walking out of the house should be judged from the houses 3, 9 and 
12 counted from the 9" house ... (pp 259-260) 

e To leave one’s home, to go away and to live in an unknown quarters is indicated by the houses 3 and 12, 
counted from the house indicating that relative. (p 309) 


5. The rotation of the horary chart has also been found applied by the followings: 


e Astro secrets & Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Part ||, 2003, “Hints for judging a horary chart”, pp 214-221, 
particularly para 4. 

e Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Prashna J yotish, Chart 1, 2 and 3 (Longevity of son, aunt and wife respectively), Chart 
39 (News about missing wife), Chart 52 (Missing brother), Chart 53 and 54 (Return of absconding son), Chart

e K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi: “Guidelines for preparing and judjing a horary chart”, KP-Ezine Feb 2007 issue, 
particularly para 4. 

e Ivy Goldstein-J acobson Simplified Horary Astrology, Frank Severy Publishing, 1975 - “Turning the Wheel”: 
When the querant asks a question regarding himself and his affairs we take the first house for him and also 
the house ruling the matter he asks about. When he asks a question regarding another person’s affairs, we 
either start with that other person’s affairs and then move on to the one ruling HIS affairs as asked about, 
make the chart easier to read by turning the wheel to bring the other person’s house rising as his Ascendant. 
(p 75)

person who makes the query, in this instance the doctor... The 7 house is said to show his patient. So the 7" 
house is ... to represent the patient. (p 97).

Rotation of KP Horary Chart

Deborah Houlding: Learning Horary Astrology - “Turning the Chart”: Imagine that you are drawing a chart to 
discover whether your mother would be suited to a new job. Since it is your own question you would be 
signified by the lst house and its planetary ruler, and your mother by the 10th house and its ruler. Career 
decisions generally are shown by the Midheaven and 10th house, but the specific details of your mother's 
profession would be found by counting the 10th house as the lst house for your mother, and the 10th house 
on from that as the house that indicates her professional concerns. This takes us to the radical 7th house - its 
planetary ruler will act as the significator for the mother's turned house of career matters. Turned houses are 
sometimes referred to as derived houses. Also, be sure to base the significations upon the relationship to the 
querent - the person asking the question. As the astrologer, if you are drawing a chart to answer your own 
mother's question, your mother becomes the querent, signified by the 1st house. 
http://www.skyscript.co.uk/horarylea.htm 
T. Rajendra Kumar: “KP Horay- The Ultimate Astrological Guide- III”, K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2010, 
Krishman & Co.- Case 1: As the querent asking the question whether Mr. Chandra Babu Naidu will become 
the CM, claims the direct access with the leader and calls him Chandranna (brother) and hence the 11™ house 
is taken as lagna. (p 59); Case 2: For the astrologer’s question “Will Chiranjeevi become the CM?”, the 9" 
cusp Is taken as the Ascendant because the astrologer does not know Chiranjeevi personally. (p 60); Case 3: 
For the question “Will Mr. Rajasekhar Reddy continue as CM for the next term?”, the 10" cusp is taken as the 
Ascendant as he is the CM. (p 61); “KP Horary- The Ultimate Astrological Guide- V”, K.P. & Astrology Year 
Book 2012, Chart 4: As the issue relates to the second born, 7" house is taken as ascendant. (p 58) 

William Lilly’s Overview of the Houses: Lilly summarized the house rulerships as follows: The Ascendant 
represents the person of the Querent, the second his Estate, the third his Kindred, the fourth his Father, the 
fifth his Children, the sixth his Servant or Sickness, the seventh his Wife, the eighth the manner of his Death, 
the ninth his Relegion or journets, the tenth his Estimation or honor, the eleventh his Friends, the twelfth his 
secret Enemies. Lilly added that if the question is about the querent’s wife, the astrologer takes the 7" house 
as the new first house and counts derivative houses from there. In other words, in all manner of questions 
the house signifying the party shall be his Ascendant or first house, the next his second house and so 
continuing round about the whole twelve houses. (William Lilly: Christian Astrology, Books 1 & 2, Editor David 
R. Roell, Astrology Center of America, 2005, (p 127)/ Anthony Louis: Horary Astrology Plain & Simple: Fast & 
Accurate Answers to Real World Questions, Llewellyn Publications, 2011, (p 123)/ William Lilly, Zadkiel: An 
Introduction to Astrology, Forgotten Books, 1939, “Whether one absent be dead or alive?”) 

Anthony Louis: Horary Astrology Plain & Simple, Llewellyn Publications, 2011 - “Derived Houses”: If a 
question involved something belonging to or related directly to the querent, then the usual house system 
holds for interpretation of the chart. When the querent asks a question about someone else’s belongings or 
relationships, it necessary to use the system of derivative houses. To determine derivative houses, we regard 
the house representing the person or matter asked about as a new first house. For instance, because the 
question (“My absconded mother, is she dead or alive?”) is about the querent’s mother, we need to use 
derivative houses. The 10" is the mother’s Ascendant. (pp 15, 41, 124) 

Dr. Arastu Prabhakar: New Dimensions of K.P. Astrology (Horary), 2007, Example 29 (Wellbeing of wife) 

M.P. Shanmugam: Astro secrets and Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Part |, 2003, horary pp 253-264, particularly p 
260 

K. Subramaniam: Medical Astrology for All, 2005, “Diagnosing the Disease by K.P. Horary Method”: The query 
is about his mother’s health. Hence the 4" house should be taken as lagna for mother. (p 224) 

Umang Taneja: Prashna, 2007, Chapter 9: Health, Illustration 1 (mother's health), Illustration 4 (Wife's 
Iness), Illustration 6 (Operation of elder brother), Illustration 8 (surgery of father), Illustration 9 (Health of 
mother)

parliamentary elections?” (Chandrakant.R. Bhatt: Prashna J yotish, Chart 42)

is transfer back”, K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2003, p 66)

One can be selected as a candidate for election, if 3rd (view of people) cusp sub-lord signifies 6 (victory), 10 (one’s 
political position), 11 (gain).

(gain of opponent), the opponent will be selected as a candidate.

Hints 


If the sub lord of the 5th cusp (female) and the 11th cusp (male) is the significator (in the star of the 
occupant or owner) of 2 (increase in family), 5 (conception, child) or 11 (5th from 7); or connected 
with 2, 5 or 11 child birth is promisedduring Joint period of 2,5,11. If it is the significator of 1,4 or 10 
(being 12th from 2, 5 and 11) child birth is not promised. 


Sun, Mars, Jupiter are male planets and Moon, Venus, and Rahu is female planets. Mercury and Ketu 
are neuter gender. Odd number sign indicates male and even number signindicates female. However it 
is most difficult to predict about child gender. 


Analysis: 


Predicting the gender of a child is always difficult. In this case 7 (Second child) cusp Sign lord is 
Saturn; Saturn is in the star of Mars and sub of Mercury. Saturn is in sign of odd number Libra and 
occupant of even number house 2. Star lord Mars is in the odd sign Libra and occupant of the even 
number house 2; Sub lordMercury is in the even number sign Cancer and occupant of the odd house 
11. Saturn is in male Sign, Star lord Mars is in male sign and male planet. Sub lord Mercury is in 
female sign, and female planet, Saturn is conjoined with Male planet Mars, hence all indicate male 
child. 


Actual Outcome: The baby boy was born on 1-09-2012 @ 01.36PM Ahmedabad

Question 1: Order of House Numbers 





| hope it is not out of place for me to ask here in this email, why Is it that all authors including the likes of Kanak 
Bosmia Ji, Vedico Ji or Tin Win Ji, in fact with no exception whatsoever, mention the house numbers (in the language 
of mathematics)in a disorderly manner rather than presenting in an ascending or descending manner ? If it’s not clear 
| will exemplify. Take for example the 5 episodes Tin Win Ji wrote about house matters titled KP Grouping, first page 
first item a, very strong lagna, 2,3,9,10,11,4 which could have been 2,3,4,10,11 ? Same page short life 6,8,2 and not 
2,0,8 ! It doesn't stop there and in every house or matter to be analyzed same presentation. Could you kindly throw 
some light on this and educate me as to whether | have to keep such irregular sequence undisturbed and also 
delineate in that prescribed order or am | allowed to shift the numbers in ascending or descending order ? Your 
Clarification will be much appreciated. 


Answer 1 

There is no prescribed order in mentioning the house numbers and it is up to the preference. However more 
important houses for the matter under consideration are generally mentioned earlier and less important ones later, 
although not followed consistently. For example, the main house in the house grouping, the house occupied in the 
significators of a planet and the Badhaka house among the death causing houses are generally mentioned earlier. 
Question 2: Orb in KP Analysis 

Could you clarify what kind of orb is preferable in the KP analysis. 


Answer 2 


In the solved examples of the KP Readers, the sign (rasi) to sign Hindu aspects without any orb have been practically 
used. This practice has been generally followed by the KP astrologers. 


In the case of a planet very close to the next cusp, the 3° 20’ orb has been used to take into consideration of the 
next house results.

Book Review 
Tin Win 

r “tw8&53@yahoo.com 
Bi.) 

This is a combined volume of three classical books on mundane astrology. The books of H.S. Green and Raphael are 
the fundamentals and a comprehensive guide to the classic rules of mundane astrology. Green organizes his book 
planet by planet, Sun through Neptune, telling what each planet will do in the 12 houses. Raphael organizes his book 
by houses telling how mundane houses work when planets are in them. In addition, both authors deal with solar and 
lunar eclipses and earthquakes. Green shows the effects of eclipses in the houses, while Raphael describes them by 


decanate (10 degree sections of the zodiac). The two books are complimentary and written about the same time in 
1910. 





C.E.O. Carter's book, building on the above two books, was published in 1951. He discusses why astrologers in 
London failed to foresee the outbreak of World War II. This book was the result of his studies. His plea for better data 
has largely been met, but the need for more work remains. All three authors give astrological rulerships for countries 
and cities, e.g. India and Delhi ruled by the sign Capricorn, pages 205 (Book 2), 300 (Book 3). These are centuries old 
and are weighted to England and Europe. Carter's rulers are the most up-to-date. 


Dr. B.V Raman had successfully predicted the outbreak of WW II, his grandfather Prof. B.S. Rao had predicted WW |. 
In this, they scoop western astrologers. (David R. Roell, astrologer and owner of the Astroamerica book store)

Parolisi sentenced to life imprisonment 


(AGI) - Teramo, Oct. 26 - Corporal Major Salvatore Pa- 
rolisi was sentenced on Friday to life imprisonment for 
the murder of his wife Melania Rea. The woman was 
stabbed to death on April 18, 2011 in the woods close 
to Ripe di Civitella, near Teramo in central Italy. Follow- 
ing Summary proceedings, preliminary hearing 
magistate Marina Tommolini entered the sentence after 
about four hours of deliberation. Parolisi's attorneys had 
filed for full acquittal. Parolisi had been 

arrested for the first time after a detention order on J uly 
18, 2011, when the investigation was still in the hands 
of the Prosecutor of Ascoli Piceno. Another 

restrictive measure was issued by the _ investigating 
magistrate of Teramo, Giovanni Cirillo. Since then, Pa- 
rolisi has been detained in the Castrogno jail in Teramo.

Moon cannot indicate querent’s mind in the 
KP Horary Chart with No: 1 - 249 





TinWin 
tw853@yahoo.com 
3 

Baia 


KP Horary 








The KP horary using the numbers 1-249 has been found consistently applied in the KP Reader VI: Horary Astrology. 
Querent’s Role 


2. When a querent asks a horary question, the astrologer asks the querent to concentrate on the question and give a 
horary number between 1 and 249. The querent gives a number that fits well with his karmic patterns by divine 
guidance for his or her strong urge to know the correct answer to a question. (KP Reader VI, p 253) 


3. The querent's urge is reflected in his given number which refers to a particular sign, star and sub as the Ascendant 
according the table of 249 subs. (KP Reader V/ pp 89-97) 


Time of J udgment 


4. In the KP horary analysis, the time of judgment is taken when astrologer actually starts analyzing the horary chart 
whatever may be the date and time of query by the querent. This moment when the astrologer sits for judgment Is 
similar to the moment when the whole body of child has got separated from the womb of the mother. (KP Reader V/ 
pp 88, 243) 


Moon’s Position 


5. The Moon position in the KP’ horary chart using the number 1-249 depends on the time 
of judgment which is supposed to be reflected the astrologer's urge and this time of judgment is flexible for the 
astrologer, according to Guru ji’s saying, “Note the time when the urge Is there ----- immediately work out”. 


Querent’s Mind 


6. In this way the querant’s role is just to give the horary number with urge and his or her mind Is connected with a 
particular horary number which in turn refers a particular Ascendant. The querent does not play any role in selecting 
the time of judgment by the astrologer which indicates the Moon position. 


Checking Moon 


7. In the KP horary analysis, the Moon has been generally checked as a precondition for the genuineness of the query 
with the belief that the Moon indicates the mind of querent. Only if the query is found genuine by the signification of 
required house(s) for the query by the cuspal sub lord of Moon, then it is to proceed the analysis of the horary chart, 
otherwise not to proceed further. 


Observation 

8. As discussed above, the general belief of Moon at the time of judgment indicating the mind of querent is found 
unreasonable as the querent does not play any role in selecting the time of judgment which decides the Moon 
position. And the KP astrologers like Dr. K.R. Kar, T. Rajendra Kumar, Kanak Bosmia do not follow this practice of 
checking Moon as a precondition in the KP horary analysis. 

9. It cannot be traced form where this general belief has been started. Perhaps it is based on the horary using the 
time chart for the time of query by the querent. One thing is sure that this precondition has not been applied in the 
KP Reader VI: Horary Astrology. 

An Alternative 


10. A reasonable alternative is to check the signification of the cuspal sub lord of Ascendant which reflects the mind of 
querent. 


11. Here an important point is that the 1% cuspal sub lord’s signification of 11" house indicates fulfillment of the 


desire under query, as shown in the review of failed horary predictions. (“Inference from a Honest Retrospection" by 
Prof. T. Rajendra Kumar, K.P. & Astrology, 2005 Year Book, pp 50-52)

respectively.

and the Moon.

Hint: 


When astrologer start work for BTR the ruling planets at that time should be cast for the Asc and Moon position. 
Moon's position in RP will show the birth Asc position and the RP Asc. shows Moon's position at the time of birth. 


1) When in the birth time has no confusion, may be difference of 1 or 2 minutes. we have to follow the following 
procedure to rectify birth time. 


Moon's position in the RPs indicates Star lord, Sub-lord, Sub-sub lord, Sub-sub-sub lord. Whether it is matched with 
the Asc is to be found. The Asc sub lord and sub sub lord at the time of birth is to be checked whether it matches 
with the RP Moon's sub sub or sub sub sub. If these do not agree with 5 minutes additions or deductions, then leave 
this and take Asc sub-sub only. 


2) Birth time of the native, if found to have difference of more than 15 to 20 minutes : 


At the time of birth Asc sub lord should be tally with RP's Moon position of Star-Sub-Sub Sub or anyone from this 
three. We have to give weightage in order as; Sub is stronger than Star; Sub Sub is more stronger than Sub. We 
have to adjust according to availability. 


3) There is doubt in birth time for 1 or 2 hours difference. In this type of situation we have to follow the following 
procedure to rectify birth time. 


First let us take the Asc RP. Note the difference of time that required birth Moon tallies with the RP Asc. We may be 
found 2 or 3 Moon's positions. To find out within these 2 or 3 positions of Moon we have to be check the birth Asc 
position which tallies with RP Moon. For the birth Asc Sub lord or Sub Sub Lord to tally with RP Moon, we should 
move the birth time back and forth within few minutes with the Moon remaining at the same position.

Kanak Bosmia

Before proceeding to analyse the case let me first explain the relevant K.P. rules : 


01. Vehicle is signified by the 04 cusp and Venus is the chief governor for vehicles. 09 and 10 houses speak of 
enjoyment of past good karma and 12" house for investment. 


02. 11" house indicates fulfillment of one’s desire. 
03. Hence for purchase of a car- houses 4, 9, 10, 11 are to be considered. 


04. So if 4 cusp sub lord is connected to 4 or 11 and /or 12 and if it is connected to Venus, owning a vehicle is 
assured. 


05. If 4° cusp sub lord is connected to 3, 4, 5, 10, sale of vehicle will take place. 
06. If 4 cusp sub lord is also connected to 6" it indicates purchase of vehicle by borrowings. 


Taking into consideration the above K.P rules, on analyzing the chart of my brother-in-law, the following observations 
are made: 


01. 4th cusp sub lord is Venus. Venus is the lord of 04 and 11" posited in 12" cusp. Venus is in Jupiter star, lord of 6 
and 9 posited in 5th. Venus is in Mercury sub, lord of 12 and 3 posited in 2". So 4" cusp sub lord Venus signifies 4, 
11, 12, 5, 6, 9, 3 and 2. 


02. Hence house 4, 11 and 12 indicate purchase of car, fulfillment of desire and investment on a new property. Venus 
signifies acquisition of a four wheeler. 


03. Houses 3 and 5 indicate sale of the old vehicle and 11 and 2 indicate monetary benefit out of It. 
04. Venus connection to 6th indicates that he has taken a loan. 
05. 6" cusp sub lord is Rahu and it is posited in 09" but near to 10" cusp within orb of 3.33 deg. 


Rahu is in Venus star and Venus sub. Rahu signifies 11" house through Venus which strongly shows that the native 
would borrow money for acquisition of a new vehicle (4 and 11). 


The present Dasa is of J upiter (from 2-7-2002 to 2-7-2018) 
The Dasa lord Jupiter is in 5 and in the star of Mercury lord of 3, 12. So Jupiter as dasa lord has given him the new 
vehicle by disposing the old car. 


The Bhukthi lord is Venus from 15-5-2010 to 13-1-20153. 
We have discussed about Venus above. Venus signifies house 4, 11, 12, 6, 3, 10 to get the new car. 


The Anthara lord is Saturn from 30-01-2012 to 02-07-2012. 

Saturn signifies house 4 by its 3rd aspect and 11" by its 10" aspect. Saturn is in Kethu star and Moon sub. Kethu is 
in 4, oonj. Mars lord of 5, 10 posited in 3 and Moon signifies 12 by having no planet in its stars and Moon being the
