A middle aged querent who was worried about his deteriorating health asked me to check by K.P. about his illness 
and recovery. | asked him to intimate any horary number between 1 to 249. He gave me a horary number 11. | 
calculated the horary chart for number 11 on 9-2-2007 at 3: 30 PM at Chandigarh. 


Moon reveals the Nature of Query 

Moon is lord of 4 in 6 [near to 7" (Maraka) within orb of 3.33 deg], in the star of Rahu in 11 and sub of Venus in 11 
lord of 2 and 7. So Moon Is the significator of 6 [sickness], 2, 7 [maraka], and 11 [Badhaka]. So Moon reveals the 
nature of query about deteriorating health of the querent. 


Ruling planets on 9-2-2007 at 3:30 pm at Chandigarh 


Lagna signlord Mercuray 
Moon starlord Rahu 
Moon signlord Venus 
Day lord Venus 


As per K.P. astrology, if Asc sub lord and its star lord are the significator of 1,5,9 and 11, then the querent will have 
long life, more than 66 years; If the Asc sub lord and its star lord signify 2,7,6,8 and badhaka houses, then the 
querent will have short life that is up to 33 years; if the Asc sub lord and its star lord signify 2,7, 6,12 and badhaka 
houses along with 1,5,9,11, then the querent will have medium life that is between 33 to 66 year. 2 and 7 are maraka 
houses and for movable lagana 11 Is badhak house; for fixed lagana 9 is badhaka house and for common lagana 7 is 
badhaka house. 


In this case the querent’s lagna Is in movable sign, so 11 is the badhaka house. Lagan sub lord Sun is in 11 
(Badhaka). Star lord of Sun is Mars in 9, lord of 1-8 and its sub lord is Jupiter in 8, lord of 9-12. Asc sub lord is the 
significator of 1,9 and 11 (Badhaka), 8 (danger to life). So lagna sub lord denotes evil to long life and the querent will 
have medium age between 33 to 66 years and he would be facing serious health problems, complications as per then 
prevailing Dashas, Bhukti, Antra and Sookshma which will be discussed later. 


6 th cusp sub lord 

The sub lord of 6th cusp is Saturn [chronic disease] in 5 lord of 10-11 (Badhaka). The star lord of J upiter is Mercury 
[complications] in 11 (Badhaka), lord of 3, 6 [disease]. The sub lord of Saturn is Jupiter [enlargement of organs, 
blood poisoning, diabetic] in 8 [serious disease], lord of 9, 12 [hospitalization]. So 6th cusp sub lord Saturn indicates 
the chronic disease of diabetic which may create complications and hospitalization for getting treatment and may 
become fatal. 


11 th cusp sub lord 
11th cusp sub lord is also Saturn as explained above. It is also the sub lord of 6th cusp having no planet in its stars. 
Hence 11th cusp sub lord Is also significator of Badhaka and sickness. 


Verification of maha Dasha and Bhukti dasha 
On the day of enquiry on 9-2-2007 Dasha of Rahu and Bhukti of Venus was running. 
Rahu dasha/Venus Bhukti is from 13-11-2006 to 13-11-2009. 


Rahu Dasha 

Rahu is in 11. Rahu is conjoined with Venus lord of 2 & 7. Rahu Is conjoined with another planet Mercury lord of 6. 
Rahu is in the star of Jup lord of 9 & 12. So Rahu Dasha signifies 2, 7, 11, 6 and 12 which shows 6[sickness] 2 & 7 
[maraka], 11 [badhaka], 12[bed ridden sickness, hospitalization] Hence Rahu Dasha is not conducive for good health. 
Moreover Rahu Is also a ruling planet. 


Venus Bhukti 

Venus Is in 11 lord of 2 and 7. Venus Is in the star and sub of J upiter in 8 lord of 9 and 12. So Venus Bhukti signifies 
2,711, 8 & 12 that is maraka [2 & 7], 11 [badhaka], 8[danger to life] and 12 [hospitalization]. Hence Venus Bhukti is 
not conducive for good health, and there Is danger to life and hospitalization. Moreover Venus Is also a ruling planet.

Question: Effect of the Same Cuspal Sub Lord for More than One Cusp 





There is a positive and negative opinion for the same cuspal sub lord (CSL) for more than one cusp. The positive 
opinion for the cusps with the same sub lord is to be harmonious to one another. For example, if the 5" and 11™ CSL 
is the same, both cusps will co-operate with each other for the 7" (life partner) as 5" will be 11 to 7 and 11" will 
be 5" to 7. The negative opinion for the same sub lord of different cusps is to give undesirable results if a Badhaka 
related cusp is involved. For example, if the sub lord of 1% and 3 cusps in chara rasi is the same, then the native 
and younger brother will have the difference of opinion as the 1° is 11 Badhaka from 3™ chara Lagna. 

Please kindly clarify the above matter. 


Answer 


1. In KP, if sub lord of more than one cusp is the same, then they are deemed to be connected. For example if the 5" 
and 7‘ CSL happens to be the same planet, it gives the tendency of a love marriage. If the 1% and 11" CSL is the 
same, they are mutually related and so fulfillment of desire is promised. (T. Rajendra Kumar in K.P. & Astrology Year 
Book 2002, p 45) 


2. Such connection would be stronger if the same CSL happens to be the strong significator of houses for which it is 
the CSL having no planet in its stars. For example, 

F, 19-03-1983, 3:00 am IST, 23n30, 77e50, KPNA 23:31:57, as the CSL of 7th & 5th cusps Mars has Rahu in its stars, 
Mars is not a strong significator of 5,7 houses by being the sub lord of these two cusps and there was an arranged 
marriage, not love marriage . 


3. The KP original source for the rule of “a planet with no planet in its star is the strong significator of the 
houses, for which it is the cuspal sub lord” or the Golden rule, successfully applied by K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi, 
Vikari Ramamurthy, Kanak Bosmia and many others, has been found thanks to R. Dhanabalan as follows: 


e Here Anthara lord Mercury is very important as it is the sub lord of 11‘ cusp from Asc. as well as for 7" . 
Besides this Mercury is also the sub lord of Ac, 2°%, 5", 6", 7, 8", 11th and 12™ cusps. 
- KP Reader III, New Edition, page 309 (971 Edition, Practical Part, page 145). 

e 3rd, 7th and 9th cusps fall in the sub of Saturn. Hence take Saturn too as a very strong significator. (for 
foreign going) 
-KP Reader III, 1971 Edition, Practical Part p 151 

e Please note that Saturn Is the sublord of 3rd and 9th cusp and no planet is tenanted in his star except himself. 
So as | mentioned in the beginning of the article, Saturn has emerged as a strong significator in the above 
case (for foreign going), by owning the sub of relevant cusps and not from analysis of bhavas. 
-KP Reader II1, New Edition p 316 

e It is related to the so-called “Golden Rule” in KP for the strong significators: “Take the planets which are 
posited in the sub of the significators whose constellations are not tenanted.” 
- Astro Secrets & KP, Part II, 2003, p 195 


2. In addition, Hussein's example below with Mercury in own star but Sun in the stars of Mercury gives the clue to 
understand the difference between a planet having no planet in Its stars and a planet being in its own stars. 


Male, 03/Apr/1930, 06:12 am (hr 1 East or 05:12 am GMT), Sid. T 18:28:43, 
Oggersheim, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany, 49n29, 08e22, Asc. Pi 22:54:31, KPNA 22° 
47' 36", by KPAstro 4.0 


3. A planet with no planet in its stars has not only positional status but also is the strong significator of the houses 
under its sub lordship because there is no planet in the star level to give its result. A planet in its own stars having no 
planet in its stars can have positional status but cannot be the strong significator of the houses under its sub lordship 
because that planet has to give the result of own in the star level. A planet in its own stars having any other planet(s) 
in its stars can have neither positional status nor the role of strong significator of the houses under its sub lordship 
because that planet has to give the results of own and other planet(s) in the star level.

KPNA, Placidus House Division, Mean Nodes, Geographical Latitude 


Hints: 


If 11"cusp sublord signifies 2 (Liquid Assets, Ornaments, Gold), 6 (Opponent’s Loss), 11 (gain, fulfillment of desire) in 
the DBA of significators of 2, 6, 11, recovery of lost or missing ornament Is possible. 


If 11"cusp sublord signifies 5 (Opponent’s Gain, Success, fulfillment of desire), 8 (Hindrances, Obstacles, Difficulties), 
12 (Querent’s loss) in the DBA of significators of 5, 8, 12, recovery of lost or missing ornament is not possible.

Moon ts the reflector of querent’s mind. 


Moon (Gemini 05-38-35) is in the star of Mars and sub of self (Moon). Moon is the occupant of 2 (Liquid Assets, 
Ornaments, Gold), owner of 4 (Home/House/Flat). Star lord Mars is the occupant of 9, owner of 1, 8 (Hindrances, 
Difficulties, Obstacles). Sub lord Moon is the occupant of 2 (Liquid Assets, Ornaments, Gold), owner of 4 
(Home/House/ Flat). 


Here Moon clearly indicates the genuineness of query by the querent.

assumed that the querent is sure in mind that ornament is not lost and may be misplaced at home.

Some Theoretical Views 


6. The view of Ketu governing the last part of our lives is not found in the “Alan Leo: Everybody's Astrology”, 
Publisher: Kessinger Publishing, 2003, as quoted for the mis-concept of Ketu being the giant killer. It is said there that 
finally the sinking into the death stage is attained from 77 to 84 (Pisces). The grand circle of Uranus (84 years) marks 
the limit of ordinary human life; beyond that stage is usually the chaos of abnormal old age... (p 77A) 


7. The view of Ketu representing old people usually above the age of sixty-nine, and Ketu being the planet governing 
endings is found in the “Prashant Trivedi: The Key of Life: Astrology of the Lunar Nodes”, Sagar Printers and 
Publishers, Lotus Brands, Inc., 2002. (pp 86, 95) 


8. The possible physical problems or weakness related to the South Node (Ketu) in the zodiac signs are found 
mentioned in the “Bernice Prill Grebner: Lunar Nodes, New Concepts”, American Federation of Astrologers, 2006 ( p 
14), and “Judith Hill: Medical Astrology, A Guide to Planetary Pathology”, Stellium Press, 2004 (pp 62-63); “The Lunar 
Nodes”, Stellium Press, 2009, (pp 107-108). For instance, Ketu in Aries, headache, eye problems, insufficient brain 
development; Taurus, poor hearing, weak voice, food addictions, throat problems; Gemini, sensitive, respiratory 
system, speech impediments; Cancer, weak stomach, sensitive breasts; Leo, heart problems, weakness in back; 
Virgo, digestion problems, sluggish liver, blood sugar problems; Libra, insufficient kidney action ; Scorpio, weak 
reproductive organs, miscarriage, sexual problems; Sagittarius, neuromuscular diseases, weakness in hips; Capricorn, 
arthritis, osteoporosis, skin problems (rheumatism); Aquarius, poor circulation, too high or low blood pressure, 
anemia; Pisces, weak feet or elusive illnesses, foot and shoe problems, weak immune system. 


9. As one of the health giving luminaries, the Moon contacting the South Node (Ketu) could reflect upon health 
disturbances, or it may mean decreased longevity. Some individuals with this conjunction are Bonnie Lee Bakley, 
Vincent Van Gogh, Jamie Lee Curtis, Natalie Cole, Michael Bolton, Donald Trump, and Anna Nicole Smith. (Celeste 
Teal: Lunar Nodes: Discover Your Soul's Karmic Mission, Llewellyn Worldwide, 2008, p 97) 


10. Whenever anything goes wrong in one's life, the person wants to revert to the South Node (Ketu) position where 
he is safe and secure. The South Node (Ketu) reveals the lessons, talents, and abilities you mastered in past lives, 
while the North Node shows you how to best use your past-life skills for spiritual growth, happiness, and success in 
this life. (Kevin Burk: The Complete Node Book, Understanding Your Life's Purpose, Llewellyn Worldwide, 2003)

On dated 2-7-2008 a retired Col of army who was worried about recovery of huge amount of money lent to someone 
for some business purpose came and asked me to check astrologically if the entangled money will be recovered or 
not. | asked him to tell any horary number between 1 to 249. Accordingly he told the number as 151, | made the K.P. 
horary chart in his presence on dated 2-7-2008 at 16:56 hours at Chandigarh. 


MOON REVEALS THE NATURE OF QUERY 
Moon Is lord of 9 In 8, in the star and sub lord Rahu in 3. So Moon signifies 8 [tension] revealing the querent’s mind. 
WHAT KRISHNAMURTI PADHDHATI SAYS? 


On page 229 of HORARY ASTROLOGY, 6TH READER, written by SH K.S. KRISHNAMURTI: 
Whether one borrows money or get back one’s dues, judge the 6" cusp and find out whether the lord of the sub of 
6" cusp is either retrograde or deposited in the constellation whose lord is retrograde. If either is retrograde, one 
cannot either borrow or recover that which had lent or given or deposited. If sub-lord and the lord of the constellation 
in which the sub lord being situated Is in direct motion, then one will recover the money. 


In this case the 6" cusp sub lord is Venus in 8, lord of 7 and 12; it is deposited in the star of Jupiter which is 
retrograde. Hence as per K.P. astrology entangled money cannot be recovered. So | told the querent that in my 
opinion he would not be able to recover the money lent.

DAY LORD MERC

planets are not conducive for recovery of entangled money.

On dated 2-7-2008 Mahadasha of Rahu and Bhukti dasha of Rahu was Running. Rahu dasha \ Rahu Bhukti from 27- 
3-2006 to 8-12-2008. 


As Dasha and Bhukti lord Rahu is in the Sub of retrograde planet Jupiter, it does not support for recovery of 
entangled money. So | reiterated my opinion with regret that as per K.P. astrology he may not recover his entangled 
money.

Ezine 





GUNTI NAGARA] U, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer

12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, Tarnaka, Secunderabad- 500 017

Medical astrology is helpful for diagnosing the disease conditions and provides a better picture and methodology for 
dealing with diseases that come from internal causes. 


Here | would like to submit a case study on “Rheumatoid Arthritis- Swan Necked Fingers” to all our esteemed 
readers. The chart is of a native who has been suffering and living with this problem since thirty years. Before 
proceeding further let me explain what is arthritis in simple terms. 


Rheumatoid arthritis is a autoimmune disease where the body immune system attacks normal joint tissues, causing 
inflammation of the joint linings. This inflammation of the joint linings can cause pain, stiffness, warmth and redness. 
The effected joints may also lose its shape, resulting in loss of normal movement. R. A. is an Ongoing disease, with 
active periods of pain and inflammation, Known as flares, altering with the periods of remission when pain and 
inflammation disappear. It can affect the ability to go about the daily activities about the individual. If left untreated, 
it can worsen and destroy the joints. After the onset of the disease some of the effects of R. A. are as follows— 
*Tendons become inflamed and may rupture. 

*swelling can severely damage or destroy the ligaments that hold the joints together. It can also damage joint 
cartilage and bone. 

*Erosion of the bones of the joints can cause pain and deformity. 

All this may result in severe deformity of the fingers called as “swan necked fingers.” 


Swan-Neck Deformity is 2 bending in (flexion) of the base of the finger, a straightening out (extension) of the 
middle joint, and a bending in (flexion) of the outermost joint. The most common cause is rheumatoid arthritis. Other 
causes include untreated mallet finger, looseness (laxity) of the fibrous plate inside the hand at the base of the 
fingers or of the finger ligaments, muscle spasm affecting the hands, and misalignment in the healing of a fracture of 
the middle bone of the finger. Normal bending of the finger may become impossible. The deformity can therefore 
result in considerable disability. 


True swan-neck deformity does not affect the thumb, which has one less joint than the other fingers. However, in a 
variant of swan-neck deformity, called duck-bill deformity, the top joint of the thumb is severely over straightened 
with a bending in of the joint at the base of the thumb to form a 90° angle. If duck-bill deformity and swan-neck 
deformity of one or more fingers occur together, the ability to pinch can be seriously reduced. 


Planetary lords -The lord of the 6th house causes injury, accidents, acute diseases, low vitality, poor digestion and 
poor resistance. 

The lord of the 8th causes poor vitality, chronic and wasting diseases including permanent death. 

The 12th causes sorrow, grief, emotional disorders, and shows confinement to bed or hospital -often chronically a 
sick person.

Analysis of Dasa Lords and its Effects on the Disease 


(1) The dasa lord Moon (2-7-1967 to 2-7-1977), in Venus star and Mars sub, significator of the lagna , 10’,11 ,12 , 3 
and 5, made him to suffer on account of psoriasis- severe skin infections in the head and feet. During the said period 
the native underwent allopathic treatment for his skin problems and had intermittent reliefs, as indicated by thre™ 
signification. 


(2) The dasa lord Mars (2-7-1977 to 2-7-1984), in own star and Mercury sub, signifies 3, 10, 5, 2 and 12. During that 
period the native continued his allopathic treatment, through which he got relief to some extent, but the suppression 
of the skin disease resulted into rheumatoid arthritis in the hands and fingers. 


The dasa lord Rahu (2-7-1984 to 2-7-2002), in star and sub of Venus, signifies 10, 11, 12, 1, 3, 4 and 5. It gave him 
acute pain in both the hands and fingers due to arthritis. As the native was vexed with different forms of medication 
and its futile results, he resorted to yoga for its treatment around June - July 1991 to gain control over the disease. 
And interestingly the bhukti running during the said period was that of Jupiter, lord of 9" placed in 5" aspecting the 
9'" as well as lagna and also in own sub. 


Since the present dasa Is of Jupiter from 2-07-2002 he resorted to ayurveda treatment (Jupiter is the karaka for 
ayurveda) for some years. Now he Is under homeopathy treatment in Jupiter dasa Venus bhukthi and Sani antara 
(Sani is Karaka for homeopathy) from Jan 2012 with more in control of the disease. 


From the above analysis of the native’s chart it is clear that the K.P system provides clear cut clues for the nature, 
treatment of the diseases and system of medical treatment to be employed for effective results. With all the 


reverence | prostrate before such an illustrious astrologer of our times Sri K.S. Krishnamuthy garu, for guiding the 
astrologers in a clear and lucid style of reading the charts for accurate results.

position will tally with the RP Moon. For the birth Asc Sub lord or Sub Sub lord to tally with RP Moon, we should move 
the birth time forth or back within few minutes with the Moon remaining at the same position. 


4) There is doubt in the birth year; in this type of situation we have to follow the following procedure to rectify birth 
time. 

First let us take Asc RP. Note the difference of time that required birth Year tally with RP Asc. We may find the birth 
Asc Sub lord or Sub Sub lord tallying with the RP Asc.

Question & Answer 


Mr TinWin answers the questions of readers 





TinWin 
tw853@yahoo.com 








a 


Question- 1: Why does the conjoined planet not give results of the node? 


A node gives the results of its sign lord, not vice versa. 

A node gives the results of its star lord, not vice versa. 

A node gives the results of the planet that aspects the node, not vice versa. 

A node gives the results of the planet with which It is conjoined, not vice versa? 

When two planets are in conjunction, let us say Sun and Mars, they work for each other. In case of the nodes why 
this rule is not applicable? 

Why does the conjoined planet not give results of the node? 

It may kindly be clarified. 


Answer- 1 


Nodes do not aspect any planet or any house since they are only the sensitive and powerful intersecting points in 
the pathway of Sun and Moon and they are not having any physical body which can be seen through a telescope 
as we Can see all the other planets. This is the reason why they are called shadowy planets. 

- K.P. Kupou Ganapathi: Guidelines for Preparing and Judging a Horary Chart .. (KPE-zine Feb 2007) 


None of the astrological treatises ascribed to any of the Rishis gives aspects to Rahu and Ketu. .. . | have found that 
trying to use planetary aspects for Rahu and Ketu will be misleading and a source of confusion when making 
predictions. 

- Ernst Wilhelm: Vault of the Heavens: Treatise on Vedic Astrology, Kala Occult Publishers, 2001, p 196 


The effects of the nodes in conjunction or in aspect by a planet is more or less the same; though the conjunctions are 
much more powerful than aspects. 


Question- 2: Nodes’ Conjunction with Planets in Transit 


The nodes do not aspect any planet or cusp. That is OK. But they can come in to conjunction with any planet during 
transit. The question is on this conjunction. Suppose Mars conjoins. It is accepted fact that Rahu gives result of Mars 
and it is stronger than Mars. But what debar Mars to give results of Rahu, Please? 


Answer- 2 


Whether in natal or transit, the same reason for Rahu of not throwing aspects for not being a substantial heavenly 
observable body, shape, mass or color like the other planets debars the conjoined Mars to give the results of Rahu. 


It’s to follow the following KP fundamental rule rather than sticking to Rahu, which is shadowy in nature and does not 
have clear relationships like the other planets: 


The source is indicated by the transiting planet and what will happen is shown by the lord of constellation; whether it 
will materialize or not, whether it is favorable or not is indicated by the sub-lord according to the houses signified by 
the sub-lord. 

- KP Reader V, 1971, p 153/ New Edition p 161 (under Systematic Procedure to Adopt K.P. Method for Transit 
Results) 


Question-3: Karaka and Signification of Rahu 


1) Why Rahu is considered as a strong karaka for jail in KP rules although it is a node? 
In every case of imprisonment great importance is given to Rahu.. 
2) | have seen many cases in which it is found that Mars is spoiled due to aspect of Rahu or with conjunction of 
Rahu. 
3) Rahu or Ketu firstly gives the result of which planet: 
(a) the planet which conjoined with the node or 
(b) the planet aspecting node ? 
Please enlighten me. 


Jan 2013 KP-Ezine 33 


Question & Answer 


Mr TinWin answers the questions of readers 





Answer- 3: 


1. As Rahu can send a native to jail and Rahu is also karaka for 12" house, ruler of imprisonment, Rahu is considered 
as a chief karaka for imprisonment to be the 12 CSL. However, in KP the signification of relevant houses for an event 
under consideration Is a deciding factor for an event to be promised and happen, and the Karaka can play only a 
supportive role, e.g. Rahu alone as the 12" CSL can't send a native to jail unless it signifies the required houses of 2, 
3, 8 or 12 for imprisonment. Adversely, one may be sent to jail without having Rahu as the 12" CSL. (A Study of 100 
Prisoner Charts, KPE-zine March 2008 issue) 


2. 1n KP, when Rahu Is in conjunction with Mars or Rahu is aspected by Mars, the Rahu is to give the results of Mars, 
not vice versa since Rahu does not throw aspect on any planet or house. 


3. Theoretically Rahu or Ketu is supposed firstly to give the results of planet which Is conjoined with Rahu or Ketu 
since conjunctions are stronger than aspects, in the KP Reader V/, p 312 or as given under. 


) Rahu or Kethu indicates the results of planet which it is conjoined; 

) If no planet in conjunction, the results of planets aspecting it; 

) If neither conjoined nor aspected, the results of the constellation in which it is deposited; 
) Lastly the result of the sign in which it is deposited. 

- KP Reader II], 1971, p 123/ New Edition, p 130 


BR WN 


However, practically in the KP Readers, for the signification of Rahu/Ketu, the house occupied by them, planets in 
conjunction and aspect with them, their star lord, and sign lord are found considered depending on relevance to the 
matter under consideration without giving much attention to the order of priority . (Rahu/Ketu Rules in KP (KP E-Zine 
May 2007 issue)

2. According to the book, Guru ji KSK had compiled and

only six not ten Readers. (p 5) KP Is the theory of sub that 
crowned Guru ji KSK with success (p 33), aS crowed by Guruji 
himself simultaneously in the KP Readers III, V and VI. 


3. An essential feature of KP is testing the cusp for assessing 
the nature and strength of bhava result without recourse to 
bhavadhipathi or owner of bhava. (p 9) Uranus, Neptune and 
Pluto are not considered in KP for any delineation. (Part II p 
85) But these outer planets are found considered here and 
there. (pp 206-207) Transit of dasa period lord in the subs of 
retrograde planets is found not denying to gives the results. 
(p 115) Retro-gradation cannot deny the result completely if 
the planets become the significator of required houses. 
Hence the retro-gradation is nothing but only it can cause the 
delay in fructification. (Part Il p 69) The five original ruling 
planets (Part Il pp 78, 85-87, 90) and the extended six 
including the sub lord of Ascendant (p 189) and seven 
including the sub lords of both the Ascendant and Moon (Part 
[| » 66) are applied in the articles. 


4. The following habits of consideration in some articles of 
this book have been observed not consistent with the 
practice in the KP Readers: 


a)The nodes, Rahu/ Ketu, throw aspects including mutual 

aspect on each other (pp 256, 267, 270, Part Il p 84); In 
fact the nodes are always opposite to each other with different characteristics and they cannot aspect any planet 
or any house since they are only the intersecting points in the pathway of Sun and Moon without having any 
physical body like all the other planets; 





b) The planet conjoined with Rahu/ Ketu gives the results of Rahu/ Ketu. (Part II p 83) The KP rule for the 
nodes is that only the nodes are to give the results of conjoined planet, not vice versa. 

c) The star lord of a planet's star lord is taken into consideration for the significators of that planet; (Part II p 
83) For the signification of a planet, the ‘planet, its star lord and sub lord’ are to be considered, but not the 
Star lord of its star lord. 


5. In the last article of the book Part |, titled ‘Node is stronger than other planets.’ (pp 242-271), Ketu is regarded as 
a giant killer to take away our lives by inflicting diseases on the part of the body ruled by the sign or house tn which it 
is placed. Among the referred twenty two horoscopes without providing the full charts details, Guru ji KSK, having 
Ketu in his 12 house (leg), expired on 16-08-1977 due to hip-bone structure from falling in the birth-room after 
hospitalization of four months; Guru ji KSK’s wife, having Ketu in her 8" house (uterus), died of cancer in the uterus, 
Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy, having Ketu in the 4™ house (heart), died of an unknown neurotic pain in the heart, etc. 
Ketu Is also Supposed to confer both good and bad results, when placed in angles or in trines, mentioning the names 
of well-known persons like Adolf Hitler, Mahatma Gandhi, J ohn F. Kennedy, Sardar Vallavohai Patel, who have Ketu in 
angles or trines of their horoscopes. Such kind of statements based on the ‘mere placement’ of Ketu are not in line 
with the fundamental KP rules, “The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a 
deciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not." , and they are open to further empirical research.

Dear Readers, 


KPEzine publication has completed 6 year and is now entering into the 7 year. During 
these six years we have got lots of thanks, love and blessing from the KP community and 
we are very grateful for their support. 


During this period graph of our activities has moved only upward. We are the only one, 
world first free KP astrological e-magazine; we are first who started free daily Pechanga 
for every year; we are first who started to provide free software on KP; we are only one 
who publishes only and only KP based articles. We only have editorial board that check 
the entire articles in order to avoid any inconsistency or incorrectness in analysis. 


Although we are trying our best to propagate KP, it is unfortunate that some are target- 
ing us in some places for unknown reasons. But we don’t have any problem with this 
kind of activity. We are here to publish the valuable articles in KP, not to criticize others, 
and so we never reply any one or we never publish any reader’s view which criticize oth- 
er. Let them do their work and we will do our job for the sake of KP. 


Many ask why don’t I publish editorial each month? I don’t want to vest single page 
without KP write-up, so I occasionally write editorial. Also I don’t want to use editorial to 
target any one, or our aim is not to give any harsh word, or we are not publishing this 
magazine with any hidden agenda to spoil any one’s reputation. 


We give you guarantee that we follow our strict standard at any cost, and publish only 
KP articles or not to allow incorrect analysis in the world’s first KPEzine. 


With regards, 
Kanak Bosmia

Discharge from hospital 
By 
Arvind Gupta 
suptaa@unhcr.org 










Bt 
; 
Ezine | 





The use of RPs and transit of the Ascendant and the luminaries to arrive at an accurate 
timing of an event is critical to the system of KP. The process of horoscope analysis, both 
natal and horary, starts with an assurance that the event in question is, first and fore- 
most, promised and that it will occur. This is done by an examination of the main house 
concerned and its significations of other related houses. The significators of the matter 
under study are then worked out. Dasas are then analysed to see the broad range of 
timing when the event is expected to manifest. RPs allow selection of the most powerful 
significators that will bring the event to fruition. Transits, finally, permit pin-pointing the 
time of the event. 

Each stage in the analytical process requires a fair degree of judgment on the part of the 
astrologer. Thus, a good understanding of the principles of KP that need to be applied is 
essential if any degree of accuracy is to be obtained. These judgments are not easy or 
simple and, I confess, have been difficult to master. Even after years of study and appli- 
cation of the principles, one may not be able to entirely master them. However, every so 
often, correct application of the principles lead to accurate results. It is from both the 
failures and the successes that one must learn and improve. 

The present case analysis concerns a young girl child, aged 12 years, who had to under- 
go spinal correction surgical procedures. Within the space of 10 days, she was operated 
upon twice. On the first occasion, she came home after a week in hospital. On the se- 
cond one, the surgeon and doctors attending on her said that she would again have to 
stay hospitalized for about a week. As a friend of the family, I was closely associated 
throughout her operation, hospitalization and thereafter. I had earlier made a horary 
analysis concerning the success of her surgical ordeals. Those were done in the classical 
KP way by examining the 6t house (and Lagna) for links with 6,8 and 12, as well as the 
11th house (and lagna) and its links with 1,5,11 for cure and recovery. The analyses also 
involved considering longevity through houses 1,3 and 8 and the involvement, if any, of 
maraka and badhaka houses. 

Having assured myself of the longevity of the child and the success of the surgical proce- 
dures conducted upon her, I was now curious to know as to when she would be dis- 
charged from hospital and return home. She was operated upon on the 20 of Decem- 
ber. The doctors had said, as mentioned earlier, that she would most likely remain in 
hospital until the 27. The family was hoping that she would be able to return home for 
Christmas. Hence the question posed was: 

When will the child be discharged from hospital and be able to return home? 


For analysing this question, a random computer generated horary number was taken i.e. 
115/249. The analysis was done on 22.12.2012 at 15:56:07 hours at Pretoria (South 
Africa) Latitude 25:47:00 South and Longitude 28:15:00 E. The horary chart is attached 
below: 

As the question pertains to return home, involving movement, it would help if the chart 
showed indications of quick moving signs and planets. In this chart, the cusp of 11th 
bhava (the house of success) is in Cancer, a movable sign. Its lord Moon is the fast 
moving planet. 

1) Moon is in 7 and is the ruler of 11. It is in the star of Ketu placed in the 8th. (Ketu

represents Jupiter, placed in 9th and rules 4-7. It also represents strong Venus [no 
planets in its stars] placed in 3rd and rules 2 and QY). The sub lord of Moon is Moon itself 
placed in 7 and rules 11. 
Moon, as 11th lord clearly shows quick movement as it links with 11th both at planet 
level and at sub level. 
This situation of the Moon actually provides us an insight into what Guruji KSK has 
always emphasised in his KP Readers. According to Guruji, a planet gives the results of 
the houses indicated by its star lord. It is the Sub that decides whether those matters 
indicated at the stellar level will be beneficial or will suffer. (Note that our current 
thinking includes the indications at all three levels as ,,significators“ as well as using the 
sub level as ,decider“). In analysing the position of Moon, please note that it indicates 
the following: 

e At the star level it activates the houses 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, and 9. The 2nd is family, 3rd is 
journey back from hospital, 4th is clearly ,home’. The 8th is the serious nature of the 
problem she has just faced leading to surgical procedures. 9th is the recovery. 7th 
shows the doctors in attendance. 

e At the sub level it indicates houses 7 and 11. 


e Now looking at both levels as propounded by Guruji, 2 and 11 is reunion with family, 
3 and 11 is successfully making the return journey, 4 and 11 is reaching or coming 
home. 8 and 11 is success in the medical procedures. 9 and 11 is the recovery from 
the danger. 7 and 11 show the competence of the doctors and their success in 
conducting the procedures (also note that the 4th is the profession of the doctor 
[being 10th from the 7th] and shows the treatment and care that he or she conducts. 
Thus 4,7, and 11 show the success of the doctors). 


2) The Lagna sub lord is Jupiter. It is placed in 9th and rules 4-7. It is in the star of 
Moon placed in 7 and rules 11. It is in the sub of Jupiter itself placed in 9 and rules 4-7. 
As with the Moon, let us look at the stellar and sub indications closely. 

e At the stellar level, Jupiter indicates 7 and 11; 

e At the sub level, it indicates 4,9 and 7. 


e Once again, the relevant sub lord has shown that there is 4 and 11 (return home), 9 
and 11 (recovery from the dangerous procedures), 7 and 11 (success of the attending 
doctors). 


3) The main issue in this query is one of quick return home. The main house, therefore, 
is the 4th. Its links with the 11th will show return home. If it indicates the 2nd it will 
show reunion with family. If it links with the 3rd, the journey home will be made. The 
time factor will be determined by the nature of the planet that is the sub lord of the 4th. 

4) The sub lord of the 4th is Saturn placed in 1st and rules 5-6. It is in the star of Rahu 
placed in the 2nd. Rahu represents strong Venus (no planets in its stars) placed in 3rd 
and rules 2-9. Venus is not a sub lord for any houses. Saturn is in the sub of Ketu 
placed in the 8th. Ketu represents Jupiter, placed in 9th and rules 4-7. It also 
represents strong Venus (no planets in its stars), placed in 3rd and rules 2-9. 

e At the stellar level, Saturn indicates 2,3, and 9; 


e At the planetary level (weaker indications than at the stellar level), Saturn indicates 
1,5 and 6; 

e At the sub level, it indicates 2,3,4,7,8, and 9. 

eThus, the 4th bhava sub lord is indicating 2 (family); 3 (journey); 9 (long journey). At 

the sub level, all these indications are supported with the addition of 4th which shows

5) No analysis would be complete without an examination of the 11th house which is 
essential to the successful manifestation of any event in one’s life. The 11th cusp sub 
lord is Mercury (a fast moving planet), placed in 3rd and rules 1-10. It is in its own star. 
It is in the sub of Moon (another fast moving planet), placed in 7 and rules 11. 

The indications of the 11th cusp sub lord are that there is journey (3rd) and at the 
orders of the doctors (7th). The cusp sub lord itself and its sub lord are both fast moving 
planets. It is reasonable to conclude that it will take place quickly. 


6) How does this indication of the 11th house (and also lagna) balance out with 
the indications of Saturn? Saturn is in the 2nd and aspects the Moon causing 
Punarphoo. Saturn also aspects the 4th house and 11th house thus causing 
delay‘. Will Punarphoo cause delay in the discharge of the child from hospital? 
7) The RPs taken for the time of judgment were: 


Ascendant Sub lord = Moon 
Ascendant Star lord = Sun 
Ascendant Sign lord = Mars 
Moon sub lord = Moon 
Moon Star lord = Ketu 
Moon Sign Lord = Mars 
Day Lord = Saturn 


8) I reasoned that Saturn may not cause delay in the present case (although it 
causes Punarphoo and also aspects 4th and 11th bhavas). Saturn itself is placed 
in the star of Rahu which, in turn, represents the fast moving Venus and Mercury. 
Therefore, in my view, Saturn because of its indications at the star level, may not 
contribute to any delays. 

9) Working on that basis, I did not work out the DBAS. The child’s discharge from 
hospital was assured; it was to happen soon. Therefore, the transits were more 
important to work out for the time of discharge. 

10) As the event was to occur in a few days time, the transit of Moon was considered. 
Moon was to transit in Aries (Mars sign) on 23rd December. Moon would be in Mars sign, 
Ketu star, Saturn sub and Moon sub-sub at 05:30 am on 23.12.2012 at Pretoria, South 
Africa. 

11) On that date, the Ascendant will transit in Sagitarius sign: Jupiter sign, Ketu star, 
Saturn sub and Venus sub-sub. 

12) Thus both transits agree with the RPs. 

13) It was opined, thus, that the child will be discharged on 23rd December 2012, much 
before the time frame indicated by the doctors. 


Outcome: 

14) My colleagues did not think this would be possible, especially as Punarphoo was 
strong. However, I received a call on the 23rd December 2012 at 07:00 am telling me 
that the doctors attending the child had discharged her that morning at 05:30am. They 
examined the child’s progress on their usual early morning ward visits, and after a brief 
discussion among themselves decided that the child was fit and capable of returning 
home. The family called me and I happily helped them bring the child back home from 
hospital.

Short History: 











The Meghalaya Progressive Alliance (MPA) was the ruling coalition of political parties 
that formed the Government in the state of Meghalaya, India from 2008 to 2009. 

It was led by the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) and the United Democratic Party 
(UDP) who are the second and third largest parties in the 8th Meghalaya Legislative As- 
sembly. Chief Minister Dr. Donkupar Roy and the other ministers in the Government 
belong to the MPA. 

In March 2009, Meghalaya was put under President's Rule. By May 2009, the United 
Democratic Party and the Hill State People's Democratic Party had left the Progressive 
Alliance, and the United Alliance returned to power with D.D. Lapang as chief minister. 
From 20 April 2010 Mukul Sangma of Indian National Congress is as CM.

Introduction 

CARACAS, Venezuela Rescue crews used boats and aircraft on Saturday to search fora 
small plane that disappeared off Venezuela carrying the CEO of Italy's iconic Missoni 
fashion house and five other people. 

But more than a day after the BN-2 Islander aircraft disappeared from radar screens on 
its short flight from the Venezuelan resort islands of Los Roques to Caracas, no sign of 
the plane had been found, officials said. 

“'We have no other news" about the plane carrying 58-year-old Vittorio Missoni, the 
head of the company; his wife, Maurizia Castiglioni; two of their Italian friends; and two 
Venezuelan crew members, said Paolo Marchetti, a Missoni SpA official. He spoke briefly 
to reporters as he left company headquarters in the northern Italian town of Sumirago 
on Saturday afternoon. 

The Italian newspaper La Repubblica reported that Venezuelan aircraft, boats and heli- 
copters took off at dawn Saturday to resume the search for the missing plane, which 
had been suspended on Friday night.

Question. My brother T.S.L is missing from yesterday (31-7-2012). When he will return 
to the house? Is he safe? 

Number; 5 (out of 249). Date of Judgment; 02-08-2012, Thursday; Time of Judgment; 
13-34-27 PM IST Place of Judgment. Kankariya-Ahmedabad Lat/Long; 23° N 00', 72° 
E 36’, Aynamsha 23.56.33 


| Ezine 








Hints 

For missing person always need to change lagna connected to missing person. 

Consider the house 3,9 and 12 for the missing person counting from his Ascendant and 
the houses 2, 8 and 11 (being 12 to 3, 9 and 12) for returning home. 

If the cuspal sublord of 12 be the significator of 3 (away from home), 9 (unknown place) 
or 12, a person runs away during the joint period of the significators of 3, 9 and 12. 

If the cuspal sublord of 11 be the significator of 2, 8 or 11 (reunion), a person returns 
home during the joint period of the significators of 2, 8 and 11. 


Cuspal Sub Lord 

Ist cusp (Aries 04°.46’.40’): The cuspal sub lord of the 1st house is Mars. Mars is in 
the star of Moon and sub of Sun. Mars is occupant of 6, owner of 1, 8. Star lord Moon is 
occupant of 10, owner of 5. Sub lord Sun is occupant of 4, owner of 6. So lst cusp sub 
lord Mars is the significator of 10, 5 and connected with 6, 1, 8, 4, 6 Hence your brother 
has no danger to life; he is safe. 


11th cusp (Capricorn 23°.16’.51’): The cuspal sub lord of the 11th house is Sun. Sun 
is in the star of Saturn and sub of Jupiter. Sun is occupant of 4, owner of 6. Star lord 
Saturn is occupant of 6, owner of 11, 12. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 2, owner of 9, 
10. So 11 cusp sub lord Sun is the significator of 6, 11, 12 and connected with 4, 6, 2, 
9, 10. Hence your brother will come back home for sure. 


Joint Period 
At the time of judgment, balance dasa is Moon up to 6-11-2015. At that time joint period 
of Moon-Mercury-Rahu is running up to 07-09-2012. 


Dasa lord is Moon. Moon is in the star of own and sub of Mercury. Moon is occupant of 
10, owner of 5. Sub lord Mercury is occupant of 4, owner of 3, 4. No planet is in the 
stars of Mercury and Mercury is the CSL of 2, 8. Hence dasa lord Moon signifies 10, 5 
and connected with 4, 3, 2, 8. Moon is in the RP. 


Bhukti lord is Mercury. Mercury is in the star of Saturn and sub of Venus. Mercury is 
occupant of 4, owner of 3, 4. No planet is in the star of Mercury and Mercury is the CSL 
of 2, 8. Star lord Saturn is occupant of 6, owner of 11, 12. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 
3, owner of 2, 7. Hence Bhukit lord signifies 6, 11, 12 and is connected with 4, 3, 2, 8. 
Mercury is the strong significator of 2, 8, 11 and strong in the RP by being twice. 


Antra lord is Rahu. Rahu is in the star of Saturn and sub of Ketu. Rahu is occupant of 
8. Rahu is aspected by Saturn. Saturn is occupant of 6, owner of 11, 12. Star lord Sat- 
urn is occupant of 6, owner of 11, 12. Sub lord Ketu is occupant of 2. No planet is in the 
stars of Ketu and Ketu is the CSL of 3, 4, 6, 10, 12. Ketu is conjoined with Jupiter. Jupi- 
ter is occupant of 2, owner of 9, 10. Hence Antra lord Rahu signifies 6, 11, 12 ad is con- 
nected with 6, 11, 12, 2, 3, 4, 6, 10, 12. 


My opinion: Your brother will come back home before 07-09-2012.

BEER E EEE HERE EERHER HEHEHE EERE ERHEEEEEEEEE EE 

This is a horary analysis for a query made by a person who was expecting a transfer from 

his present station to a place near to his home town. 

According to the number given by him, No. 111, the horary chart was prepared and is 

given on next page. 

In a horary chart, we normally see the position of Moon to ascertain whether the querant 

has made the query with good faith. This could clearly be judged from the placement of 

Moon in the horary chart. If the query is not made honestly, the out come will not be ac- 

curate. 








In this horary chart, Moon is the lord of the 11 bhava. This bhava represents expecta- 
tions and their fulfilment etc; This Moon is deposited in the 8 bhava and which indicate 
sudden gains, accidents and wealth of the partner. Further Moon was deposited in a star 
of Venus. Venus is the owner of 274 and 9th bhavas. The second bhava shows gains and 
increase in wealth etc; ninth bhava for leaving the present employment and having long 
journeys and involvement in higher education. 

Accordingly, the horary Moon is clearly showing the mind of the querant. 


After the conformation of genuineness of the query, we need to proceed to see whether 
the expectation of the querant is fulfilled. The eleventh bhava gives the clue. The eleventh 
bhava falls in Cancer in a star of Saturn and a sub of Mercury. This sub lord Mercury is 
the owner of the 1st and 10 bhavas and deposited in the 1st bhava. This Mercury was 
deposited in a star of Mars, who is occupying the 24 bhava and the owner of 3'™4 and 8th 
bhavas. These indications show that the expectation is fulfilled. 


Now we need to see when he will proceed on the transfer. 

The bhava siginificators for transfer are as follows; 

The 34 bhava show that the querant will leave the present station and the 9th bhava 
show that he will also leave the present job. After the transfer, he will regain employ- 
ment, which is indicated by the 10th bhava. The 11 bhava shows his expectation and its 
fulfilment. 


The bahava significators are as follows; 


The 34 bhava is owned by Mars. Mercury and Saturn are deposited in the stars of 
Mars. The 3" bhava is not occupied by any planet. 


The 9th bhava is owned by Venus. Moon is occupying a star of Venus. Jupiter is oc- 
cupying the 9 bhava. No planets are deposited in the stars of Jupi- 
ter. 

The 10 bhava is owned by Mercury. No planets are deposited in the stars of Mercu- 


ry and in the 10 bhava. 


The 11 bhava is owned by Moon and occupied by Venus. Jupiter and Moon are de- 
posited in the stars of Moon and Venus respectively.

Question: Will my bail from court be promised or not? If promised - when? 
(Question asked by native from jail by means of communication i.e. over phone) 
Horary Number: 101 (out of 249). 

Time of Judgment: 25-02-2012 (Saturday), 21:24:23 Hrs. (IST). 

Place of Judgment: Park Street, Kolkata, W.B. (Long/Lat: 22N27, 88E20) 


Hints: 

If 12 cusp sublord signifies 2 (increase of family member), 4 (residence, return home), 
11 (success, fulfillment of desire, house negating 12th house i.e. jail) in the DBA of 2, 4, 
11, then bail is promised. 

If 12h cusp sublord signifies 8 (hindrances, obstacles, difficulties in obtaining bail from 
court), 12 (jail) in the DBA of 8, 12, then bail is not promised. 


Matters signified by Cusp/House 


2nd Cusp : Family, Increase of Family Member 

3rd Cusp : Communication. 

4th Cusp : Residence, Return Home. 

6th Cusp : Court Matters like Preparation & Filing of Bail Papers to Court. 
8th Cusp : Hindrances, Obstacles, Difficulties in release from imprisonment. 
9th Cusp : Court. 

11% Cusp — : Success, Fulfillment of desire, House negating 12th house (Jail). 
12%» Cusp ~ : Jail, Imprisonment 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon (Pieces 24-50-20) is in star of Mercury and sub of Rahu. Moon is the occupant of 
8, owner of 12. Starlord Mercury is the occupant of 7, owner of 2, 11. Sublord Rahu is 
the occupant of 3. Rahu acts an agent of Mars. Mars is the occupant of 12, owner of 4, 9. 
Here Moon signifies 2, 3, 4, 8, 9, 11 and 12 which clearly indicates the genuineness of 
query by the querent. 


Ruling Planets — 

Day Lord: Saturn — occupant of 2. 

Moon Sign Lord: Jupiter - occupant of 8. 

Moon Star Lord: Mercury - occupant of 7. 

Moon Sub Lord: Rahu - occupant of 3, agent of Mars who is the occupant of 12. 
Lagna Lord: Venus - occupant of 8. 

Lagna Star Lord: Mars — occupant of 12. 

Lagna Sub Lord: Sun - occupant of 6. 


Ketu is in sign of Venus — a ruling planet. So, Ketu is also a ruling planet who is the oc- 
cupant of 9, agent of Venus who is the occupant of 8. 


Note: Occupancy is stronger than ownership. Here the ruling planet signifies 2 (increase 
of family member) but does not signify 4 (Return to Home) or 11 (Success, Fulfillment of 
desire) through their occupancy. Hence, bail from court is not possible immediately. 
Since ruling planets also signify 8 (Hindrances, Obstacles, Difficulties in release from im- 
prisonment) and 12 (Jail), there would be delay in getting bail from court.

On January 14, 2013 I was reading a book on KP when my father who was there with 
me at Calicut asked me, “OK, tomorrow is the cricket match between England and In- 
dia .Will England beat India?, What does your KP say? 
I asked him to give a horary number from 1 to 249 and he gave me 33. I casted the 
chart on that day at 10.55.12 PM, Calicut, 11 N 15, 75 E 46, using KPNA 23.56.56. 











KP Rule 
To win in competition the lst, 6th and 11th cusp sub-lords must signify 1, 6, 11 houses, 
mainly the 6th. 


Let us analyze the Ist, 6th and 11th cusps of England and India from the chart.

Why Moon can't indicate the querent's mind 9&4 — 
in the KP horary chart (1-249)? acne 


By: Tin Win 
E-mail: tw853@yahoo.com 








‘BEER HEHEHE EERE ERERE EERE E EEE EEEREEEEEE EE 
1. This note is to explain why Moon can't indicate the querent's mind in the KP horary 
chart (1-249) by looking from the different angles of the querent and the astrologer. 


2. When a querent asks a horary question, the querent has to give a number between 1 
and 249 that fits well with his karmic patterns by divine guidance for his or her 


strong urge to know the correct answer to the question. (KP Reader VI, p 253) 


3. Consequently only the horary chart that calculated for the given horary number, at 
the time and date of giving the number and for the place where the question is asked can 
reflect the query’s mind and none other chart else. 


4. In the KP horary analysis, the time and date and place of judgment is taken when as- 
trologer actually starts analyzing the horary chart at the place where he is located, what- 
ever may be the date and time of query and the place where the question is asked. This 
moment when the astrologer sits for judgment is similar to the moment when the 


whole body of child has got separated from the womb of the mother. (KP Reader VI 
pp 88, 243) 


5. In this regard, the positions of the planets in the havens at the time an astrolo- 
ger takes up the query for answer will bear a definite relation to the query - the 
urge to answer ts created in the astrologer's mind only at a such time when there 


is an inter-relation between the matter in question and the heavenly positions of 
the planets. (KP Reader VI p 294) 


6. According to “the urge to answer is created in the astrologer's mind”, the Moon 
in a horary chart at the time and date of judgment by the astrologer at the place where 


he is located is the astrologer's mind, not the querent’s mind. So such Moon can't indi- 
cate the querent's mind in the KP horary chart (1-249). 


7. In addition “there is an inter-relation between the matter in question and the 
heavenl ositions of the planets” means an inter-relation between the matter in 


question and the positions of all the nine planets from Sun to Ketu to give the correct 
answer. 


8. This is food for thought and up to the preference of an astrologer whether to follow 


“Moon indicates the querent's mind in the KP horary chart (1-249).” or not as practiced 
in the KP horary analysis in general and in the KPE-zine articles in particular.

Question- 1: Some Doubts in KP 
Question- 1:1: Four Fold and Six Fold Significators 


I request you to clear the following doubts of an ardent amateur KP student as you are the 
dictionary of KP. Pls help. I shall be grateful if u could reply in seriatim with an example. 


1-- First i request you to clarify whether 4 fold significators should be used or 6 fold . Let 
me explain. In Volume 2 of Sagar Publications , Guruji KSK has used at 3 places 6 fold sig- 
nificators .ie planets in the sub of occupants , planets in the star of occupants , occupants, 
planets in the sub of owners , planets in the star of owners and owners . Why did KSK use 
6 fold if 4 fold is the actual KP? 


Answer- 1:1 


In the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, the six fold significators 
"with the sub" were used in three example charts on pp 113-114, 274 and 319-320. 

But the four fold significators "without the sub" were used in thirteen examples on pp 
97, 74, 118, 139, 236, 244, 256, 269, 276-277, 301, 303, 308 and 333. : 
http://id.scribd.com/ doc/43833007/24500319-Krishnamurti- Padhdhati 


Only the first six fold example chart on pp 113-4, born on 9-3-1923: "According to Krish- 
namurty Paddhathi, one can borrow money during the dasas and bukthies of: 


a) planets in the star or "sub" of occupants of 6th house 

b) occupants of 6th house 

c) planets in the star or "sub" of lord of 6th house. 

d) the lord of 6th house; 

e) planets conjoined with or aspected by any of these planets." 
is included in the KP Reader III under "Free from Debts", 1971 Edition, Practical Part pp 
59-62, New Edition pp 216-219 “without the above a) to e) write up”. 


The second and third six fold example charts are not included in any of KP Readers. 


Moreover, the four fold significators are also found applied in the KP Reader III pp 342; 
KP Reader IV pp 118, 128, 201; KP Reader V pp 149, 201; KP Reader VI pp 157, 197, 
247 etc., KP SWs and the KP literature in general. 


Based on the above references, the R. Dhanabalanin’s proposal in July 2008 in the Ya- 
hoo KP group to convert the existing four fold general significator table into the six fold 
table as below to get better results according to Guruji K.S. Krishnamurti had been dis- 
cussed not to be acceptable.

Question 1:2: Selection of Fruitful Significators 


2-- Secondly, how to select the fruitful significators? Is it that the significators of the con- 
cerned houses are compared with the ruling planets at the time of judgement or is it that 
before coming to ruling planets itself you have to eliminate the temptors from the significa- 
tors. How to time an event say marriage by selecting fruitful significators? 


Answer 1:2 
Here is the selection method of fruitful significators: 


Significators of planets having no planets in their stars, which are the strongest signifi- 
cators of houses under consideration to give the results of the houses by being the sub 
lord to them; (Same as in Golden Rule in Astrosecrets & KP, Part II, p 195): to take the 
planets which are posited in the sub of significators whose constellations are not tenant- 
ed.); 

Significators which are posited in the stars of the cuspal sub lords of 
required houses for a matter under consideration, for instance house 2,7,11 for mar- 
riage; 

Significtors which are common with the ruling planets; 

Significators appearing many times amongst the ruling planets and significators: 
Significators which are the cuspal sub lords of houses under consideration.

Exact Time of Train’s Arrival Predicted Using RPs 


On 27-9-1978 I was to travel from Chipurupalle to Khurda Road by Waltair-Puri first 
passenger. The train was scheduled to arrive Chipurupalle at 8-55 pm. I reached to the 
Chipurupalle Railway Station at about 8-15 pm. .. . Just after 8-30 pm, I went to the 
A.S.M. on duty to know if the train was running late and got the information that the 
train would be late by about 30 minutes. ... I, myself, being an ardent follower of K.P., 
sat down to find out the Ruling Planets at that moment (8-36 pm).

Chipurupalle stands on 17-30 N. Latitude and 83-12 E. Longitude. The Lagna rising at 
that time was O-51 in Taurus. This position is represented by Venus, Sun, Rahu as the 
lords of sign, star and sub. Moon was at 17-59 in Cancer. This position is ruled by 
Moon, Mercury and Mercury as the lords of sign, star and sub. The day was Wednesday 
ruled by Mercury. Rahu was conjoined with Mercury and Sun in Virgo. So Rahu repre- 
sents them both. Moon was conjoined with exalted Jupiter. 


At that time Taurus Lagna just commenced and it would last for about two hours. More- 
over Lagna lord Venus is in her own sign Libra. So, for the arrival time of train I fixed 
the Lagna as Taurus itself. Taurus contains the asterisms of the last three quarters of 
Kritika, centre Rohini and first two quarters of Mrigasira ruled by Sun, Moon and Mars 
respectively. Moon was in her own sign conjoined with exalted Jupiter, lord of 11. Now 
Moon was in the star and sub of Mercury who was posited in his own sign Kanya. Mer- 
cury appears three times as the ruling planets and is conjoined with Sun, lord of 4 Va- 
hana Sthanadhipathi. Rahu is conjoined with Mercury and Sun and Rahu is the sub 
lord of Lagna at the time of analysis. So I came to the conclusion and fixed up the mo- 
ment for the arrival of the train when Lagna position is at Venus sign, Taurus, Moon 
star, Mercury sub and Rahu sub-sub. Another point to be noted here is that Saturn was 
posited in the 4 house representing Vahana Sthanam and was aspecting Lagna by the

-47-50 p.m. 1.S.T.

Question 1:4: Three Level Significators 


4-- Next is the significators. Some use ABCD significators . Some astrologers use the 
Chandrakant Bhatt’s connection method where in significators of a planet are: 
Cuspal sublord -Owner ship and occupation 

Cuspal sublord’s starlord -Ownership and occupation 

Cuspal sublord’s sublord -ownership and occupation (connected with) 


Is the connected with of Mr. Bhatt the correct method? 
Answer 1:4 


The cuspal sub lord (CSL) or DBA lord is a planet. Using planet and its star in two steps 
is the stellar method, and also using up to its sub in three steps is the KP method. 
Without considering the signification of sub, it is not a KP analysis, since KP is the sub 
lord theory only, nothing else. 


According to the KP fundamental rule, “The planet is the source, constellation indicates 
nature of the result and the sub is a deciding factor whether the matter is favourable or 
not." , the signification of a planet, its star lord and its sub in three steps, by occupa- 
tion and lordship, are to be jointly considered like Chandrakant R. Bhatt, K.M. 
Subramanium, Umang Taneja and other reputable KP astrologers. 


Almost all the KP article contributors in the K.P. & Astrology 2011 Year Book, have been 
found considering the Sub whenever it is relevant. (Book Review: K.P. & Astrology 2011, 
edited by K. Subramaniam, KPE-zine March 2011 issue)

The retrograde cuspal sub lord of the concerned cusp, if deposited in the star of a planet

Reader VI pp 145-146, 170, 178)

retrograde planet, the event cannot materialize. [KP Reader VI pp 146, 171, 178, 222,

had found in hundred of Horary cases that the retrograde planet has failed to offer the

9-- K.M Subramaniam has said in his sublord speaks that many times contrary to the re- 
sults of the star lord, sub lord decides the result. Say starlord indicating all bad or negative 
houses. If the sub of Dasa lord signifies positive houses 2,6,11 etc, he will flourish in the 
dasa. Is it true ? 


Answer 1:9 


Although there are cases with the fructification of events by the sub lord's signification 
without star lord’s signification, it may not be so by looking at his references from the KP 
Reader III, for instance, page 128 of KP Reader III: If the planet is in a constellation de- 
noting evil results, but the sub lord is a, benefic, even though he may suffer, yet tempo- 
rarily during the period he has little relief from the adverse results. (Astro-secrets & 
K.P. Part V, pp 125-127/ also K.M. Subramaniam: Sublord Speaks- 1, pp 113-115)

Question 1:10: Cuspal Sub Lord or Cuspal Star Lord 


10-- I have seen some KP astrologers using cuspal starlord at times. Some say Saturn 
was the 9th and 12th Cuspal star lord. Hence Saturn played the role in going abroad. Did 
Guruji KSK use cuspal star lord ever? 

I shall be indebted to you if u could help in answering the above queries in seriatim. 
Looking forward to your reply... 


Answer 1:10 


Only the cuspal sub lord (lord) of main house governing the matter under consideration 
should be scrutinized by the significators of three levels. For instance, the 12 cuspal 
sub lord should signify house preferably 9 or 3 or 12 for foreign going. 


The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is promised or 
not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara (transit) 
must agree. (KP Reader V page 224 / 1971Edition p 211; KP Reader III pp 226, 362/ 
1971 Edition, Practical Part pp 68, 194) Since the cuspal sub lord of a house is a plan- 
et, we have to look at the significators of the cuspal sub lord planet at all three levels of 
planet, its star and sub by occupation and lordship. 


It is the Bhava sub lord that decides the life span events. This is what we have to real- 
ise. The secrets of K.P. system lies in the Bhava sputa. (K.M. Subramaniam: Sub-Lords 
who divert the Dasa Lords, Sublord Speaks- 3, pp 167-171)

This annual magazine contains thirty one articles by twenty six contributors on various

longtime regular contributors like Prof. Vaikari Ramamurthy, T. Rajendra Kumar. 


Regarding the references of KP Reader IV and Astro-secrets & K.P. - Part 1 about Kuja 
Dosha (59 of this year book), it is to note that only the traditional Mars Dosha is ex- 
plained there but not Mars Dosha in KP. The traditional criteria of Mars Dosha explained 
in KP Reader IV pages 51-69 ‘up to 4th paragraph’ is the exact reprint of content on pag- 
es 215-228 of the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications. On 
the las tpage 69, three paragraphs are added to give a clear opinion that “not Mars alone, 
any planet can cause such undesirable effect of disagreement, dispute, divorce etc 
among the couple provided they happen to be deposited in such a position of the signifi- 
cator of 6 or 10 or 12”. (KP Reader IV page 69, ‘5th paragraph’) Each one will have their 
own say according to their whims and fancies, and due to this it is the general public 
pushed to run from pillar to post. (Sri M.P. Shanmugam: Astrosecrets & KP, Part 1, 2003, 
page 42) (Not to worry about Mars Dosha, see ‘Analysis of Mars Dosa as per KP Princi- 
ples’, KPE-zine August 2007 and ‘Mars Dosha in KP’, December 2008 issues)

karakas. (pages 66-76). But it may not be serious concern as the karaka alone can’t

For sale of property to fructify 10 cusp sub lord should be a significator of houses 3 or 
5 and 11 (pages 82, 131). These are two more valid cases of the common KP rule in 
practice which considers sale of property from the buyer’s side. (10% is 4th /property/ 
from 7th /buyer/.) 


Why we use Mean position of Rahu and Ketu although we are using all the planets Sun 
to Saturn in True position (page 88) is that the True nodes are true only twice a month, 
viz. at the times when the Moon crosses the ecliptic. The Mean nodes are always retro- 
grade, whilst the True nodes may occasionally be direct, as if it's wobbling. 


The divergent views are found regarding remedies. One view Referring Varahamihira's 
Brihat Samhita Brihat Samhita it is said that KP followers too recommend stones but 
subject to condition, if they are favorable to their querers. (page 112) Based on Guruji 
KSK ‘s writings, a conclusion is that performance of Shanti or parihara would not give 
any beneficial results. Even performance of Shanti would be predestined. (page 147) 


According to K.N. Rao, these astrologers will say, "Come to me for remedial measures. 
I'll do graha shanti for you, and change your fate." This is nonsense. How can one man 
change another man's fate? There are stupid fellows in the country who fall into that 
trap. Indian astrologers go on and spread this fraud in other countries also. In the USA 
you'll find people wearing stones and going for these remedial measures. This is all non- 
sense. Parashara has not prescribed these remedial measures. He has prescribed only 
mantras like the Vishnu Sahasranam, Mrityunjaya, Durga Saptasati etc., and some 
charity, which is called “dhan.' In the 17th chapter of the Bhagavad Gita, dhan is de- 
scribed properly....

Question: We hear rumor that serial “Yeh rista kay kahelata hai” will end soon, is it 
false or true rumor? 

Number. 96 (out of 249). Time of Judgment. 07-05-2012, Monday; 16-39-31 PM IST 
Place of Judgment. Kankariya- Ahmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36". 
Aynamsha 23.56.21 


Note: This question was asked to me by one of the actors of this serial Mr. Abhijit La- 
hiri. 


Hints 


If the cuspal sub lord of 3rd house (in the star of the occupant or owner) happens to be 
Saturn, the rumor is false. If it is Mars, then it is mischievous. If it is Jupiter, it is 
true. And if the lord happens to be a planet connected with Saturn in any manner, the 
report is false; but connected with Jupiter, the report will be correct. This is the way to 
find out whether a rumor is believable or not. 


Cusp 3rd. (Libra 15.54’.48”): The sub lord of the 3rd cusp is Venus. This Venus is in 
the star of Mars and sub of Saturn. Here 3rd cusp sub lord is connected with Mars 


and Saturn, hence rumor is false; the serial will be continued. 


My opinion: what you have heard is rumor only and there is nothing true in this ru- 
mor, hence the serial will be continued. 


Actual outcome: Prediction comes true. Till date the serial is continuing.

Purchase of House 
By: Er. V.K. Sharma 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA 
Superintending Engineer (Retired.), Punjab State Electricty 
Board, #104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, Mohali (Chandigarh).

A famous eye surgeon who has shifted to Punjab from another state was eager to pur- 
chase a house in Punjab and asked me to check astrologically when he would purchase a 
house. I asked him to intimate a horary number between 1 to 249. He told me the num- 
ber as 96, and I made the calculations on dated 30-7-2012 at 5:59 P.M. at Chandigarh. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 


Moon is lord of 12 in 4. Star lord Ketu is in 9; Ketu is conjoined with Jupiter and no 
planet is in the star of Jupiter and Jupiter is the CSL of 4. Hence Moon is connected with 
4 [house] and 12 [investment]. So Moon reveals the true nature of query regarding pur- 
chase of house. 


Ascendant sublord shows the effort of the querent. 


Ascendant sublord Mars is in 2, lord of 9 and 4 and its star lord is Moon in 4, lord of 12. 
As ascendant sublord signifies 4 [house] and 12 [investment] and is connected with Mars 
[land or building], it shows the effort of the querent.. 


K.P. Rule for purchase of house 


As per K.P. horary of sixth reader pages 174-175, whether one will be able to purchase a 
house at all is to be seen from 4th cusp. So judge whether the sub-lord of 4th cusp is ei- 
ther retrograde or deposited in the constellation whose lord is retrograde. If either is ret- 
rograde, then one will not be able to purchase a house; If the sub lord of the 4th cusp 
and the lord of the constellation in which it is deposited are in direct motion and if the 
sublord is also a significator of either 46 or 11 or 12th house, then one will be able to 
purchase a house in the joint period of significators of 4, 11 and 12. The 4th house 
shows one’s own house, landed property, estate etc. ; the 11t* house shows fulfillment of 
desire and 12th house shows investment. 


4th cuspal sublord 


4th cusp sublord is Jupiter in 10, lord of 5 and 8; as Jupiter is not having any planet in 
its star, it becomes the strong significator of 4th cusp by being sublord of 4th 
cusp. Jupiter is in the star of Moon in 4 and lord of 12. Hence 4th cusp sublord signifies 
4 and 12 which is conducive for purchase of house. 


11th cuspal sublord 


11th cusp sublord Moon is in 4, lord of 12 and it is in the star of Ketu in 9, and Ketu is 
conjoined with Jupiter and no planet is in the star of Jupiter and Jupiter is the CSL of 
4. So 11th cusp sublord is the significator of 4 and12 which is conducive for the pur- 
chase of house. 


12th cuspal sublord 


12th cusp sublord Ketu is in 9 and is conjoined with Jupiter which is the significator of 4 
[having no planet in its star and being sublord of 4th cusp]. Further 12th cusp sublord 
Ketu is in the constellation of Sun which is posited in 11. So 12th cusp sublord is the 
significator of 4 and 11 which is conducive for purchase of house.

What planetary combinations made Allan Leo 


a great astrologer? KP 


By: Gunti Nagaraju, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer yA hse 
KP astrologer | 

12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar,

If we regard the life of Alan Leo we shall admit that he was of that noble race. To set out to 
purify Astrology from dross and superstition, to rescue maiden Urania from the dragon as 
it were, was an heroic enterprise for one who had neither money, backing nor education. 
Like many Leos, he had a saving common sense and a sense of the practicable. He was an 
idealist, but no dreamer. 

- Charles E.O. Carter 


Dr. David Frawley is one of those few scholars who came from the west, sees astrology as 
a “means of converting all the universe into symbol , a language for the development of 
the soul”. Astrology is the most comprehensive study conceivable, a science which no 
mortal mind could invent, being the direct work of immortals. Astrology helps us to open 
the inner vision so that we can navigate safely across the swirling sea of life. Astrology is 
a symbol of development or the evolution of consciousness. Astrology should be a spir- 
itual science. Our birth chart is a mirror of our soul and its particular incarnation. Our 
stars reflect the growth and evolution of our inner being from life to life. Astrology, 
properly employed, shows us a world within ourselves. Perhaps this must be the reason 
why astrology is called as “VEDANGA” and considered inconceivable without its spiritual 
angle. It is based on the VEDAS, the original scriptures of India and perhaps all the Indo 
-European people. 


When we look at the history, we find that the time has produced many great astrologers 
and Allan Leo is one of the greatest astrologers of the West who belongs to later half of 
the 18 century. Allan Leo, a British astrologer, businessman, author and a theosophist 
who is considered the father of modern astrology, wrote a series of astrological text- 
books, founded a successful astrology magazine, and established an organization that 
remains vibrant some 90 years later. He shifted the focus of astrological work from pre- 
diction to personal analysis and is responsible for articulating the popular astrological 
precept that “character is destiny”. He kept his day job as a salesman, however, until 
1898 according to “The Astrology Encyclopedia.” On November 12, 1889, Allan Leo 
launched “The Astrologer's Magazine”, later renamed “Modern Astrology”. In the early 
1900’s, he wrote several substantial books as well as a number of short works on astrol- 
ogy. His books were so popular that they were repeatedly reprinted, and almost a centu- 
ry later they are still in print.

Alan Leo was a Theosophist, as were almost all the leading intellectuals of his time and 
founded the Astrological Lodge of the Theosophical Society. It is learned that Bessie and 
Alan Leos went to India in 1911, arriving back to London on 5 May 1911 with Annie Bes- 
ant and Juddi Krishnamurti after leaving Bombay on 22 April on the S.S. Mantua. They 
were the first to join the new Theosophical Society that revolved around Juddi Krishna- 
murti, The Order of the Star in the East. 


Leo was famous in his day and twice attracted the attention of the authorities. He was 
accused and acquitted of fortune-telling in 1914. He was again accused in 1917, losing 
in July of that year. He was fined some 25 Pound Sterling (about £1000 in today's 
terms). Just one month later on August 30, 1917, 10:00 AM he was dead from a stroke 
in Bude, England. Some think the strain of the second legal case brought on his death. 
His autobiography was published after his death, in 1919. 


The impact of his court cases was to be far-reaching. Advised by counsel that predicting 
vague generalities would spare him further legal harassment, in the last years of his life 
he turned from "event oriented astrology" to character description and psychological 
tendencies which unfortunately led to the not much useful astro-psychology approach of 
the present day. 


For the benefit of the readers, I would like to make a comparative analysis of the chart 
both in a traditional way and in K.P. system, and try to elucidate what planetary combi- 
nations made Allan Leo such a great astrologer. 


His birth details are - D.O.B. —O7 August 1860; T.O.B. — 05.49.00A.M.; P.O.B. — West- 
minster - Middlesex -United Kingdom; Day of birth-Tuesday; Longitude-00:09:00 West, 
Lattitude-51:30:00 North. 


Traditional System of Analysis 
Planetary combinations that contributed for astrology — 


(1) To be an astrologer, Mercury being the planet of intelligence, should be in a strong 
position in the birth-chart.—In the referred chart, though Mercury is placed in enemy’s

Background History 


The second term of President Obama poses an interesting test to astrologers be- 
cause there are two swearing in charts — one for the private oath of office he took on 
Sunday, Jan. 20, 2013 and the other for the public swearing in that took place on Mon- 
day, Jan. 21. The necessity of two ceremonies was caused by the fact that the inaugura- 
tion date mandated by the Constitution fell on a Sunday, which it also did for Presidents 
James Monroe on March 4, 1821, Rutherford B. Hayes on March 4, 1877, Woodrow Wil- 
son on March 4, 1917, Dwight D. Eisenhower on January 20, 1957 and Ronald Reagan 
on January 20, 1985. 


Prior to January, 1937, inaugurals were held on March 4th. According to the 20th 
Amendment to the U.S. Constitution (1933), the administration of the Oath of Office 
usually takes place at or around noon on January 20 in the year following a presiden- 
tial election. Sometimes the actual inauguration moment can be delayed as much as an 
hour with John Kennedy in 1961 or even a day in the case of Zachary Taylor in 1849. 


Two Swearing in Charts 


In accordance with the requirements of the US Constitution, Barack Obama was sworn 
in on Sunday, January 20, 2013, at 11:55 a.m., Eastern time, 5 hrs west of GMT, in the 
ornate White House Blue Room, Washington D.C., 38° 53’ 42” N, 77° 2' 12" W. The fol- 
lowing day, Monday, January 21, 2013, a ceremonial swearing-in that is open to the 
public took place at 11:55 a.m., Eastern time, 5 hrs west of GMT, on the West Front of 
the United States Capitol, Washington, D.C., 38° 53’ 56" N, 77° O' 17" W. (Source: CNN 
TV News coverage) 


The Sunday's private swearing in ceremony was a function of the calendar and the Con- 
stitution, which marks the legal start of Obama’s second term as President. 


The swearing in chart reflects the nature of the presidential term. It cannot reflect the 
future of the country which needs the analysis on other relevant charts. Sunday’s oath 
chart can say what Obama’s second administration will bring and more about his rela- 
tions with the Congress as it was in official nature. Monday’s chart can tell us what 
Obama is hoping for and more about his relations with the people. 


1st Cuspal Sub Lord 


The Ascendant denotes Mr. Obama and how far he could control the rivals and with- 
stand the irregularities through his ambitious agenda for the second term. 


In both of the private and public oath charts, the lst cuspal sub lord (CSL) is Rahu 
which is in house 7, conj. Saturn+ in house 7, lord of houses 10,11; having no planet in 
its stars Saturn is the CSL of house 2, 9 in Private Swearing in; and 6, 9 in Public 
Swearing in chart. Rahu’s sign lord Venus is in house 9, 1/o house 2, 7. Rahu is in the 
star of Jupiter in house 1, 1/o house 9, 12 and in the sub of Venus in house 9, 1/o house
