Transfer to a new station, horary analysis 
according to Krishnamurthi Paddhathi 


ry By: G.H.W.Silva, SREEPALEE 

| Astrological Services, Ketawala-Leula, Sri Lanka. 
"i 7 shwsilva@gmail.com 

BEBE BEBE EB RBRB ERB RB RB RE RE RRR RRB REE EE 
One of our colleagues posed a check to inquire the date of transfer of his daughter, as 
this girl was on transfer orders. There was a delay in leaving the station due to non- 
arrival of her replacement. This is a horary analysis for the query made to find the date 
of transfer according to the Krishnamurti Padhdhathi. 











According to the number given by him, No. 78 on 13 July 2012 at 12.03 p.m. in Anu- 
radhapura, the horary chart was prepared. In this horary chart, the lagna represents 
the querent. As this question was made on behalf of the daughter, the 5th bhava is con- 
sidered as the ascendant of the daughter. 


In timing the transfer, we could rotate the horary chart making the 5‘ bhava of the fa- 
ther as the 1st bhava of the daughter. The rotated chart is given here. 


This rotation will result in the consideration of relevant bhavas to be considered with 
respect to the daughter. In this rotated chart, for the transfer the person has to leave 
the present station and come the daughter’s 1st bhava is Scorpio to a new station, work 
and join the family. Now we need to see when she will proceed on the transfer. 


The bhava siginificators for transfer are as follows; 

The 3 bhava show that the person will leave the present station and the 9% bhava 
shows that she will also leave the present job. After the transfer, she will re gain em- 
ployment, which is indicated in the 10 bhava. The 11 bhava show her expectation 
and its fulfilment. 


The bahava significators are as follows: 


The 274 bhava This is owned by Jupiter. No planets are deposited in this bhava 
and Sun is deposited in a star of Jupiter. 

The 3" bhava is owned by Saturn. Rahu is deposited in a star of Saturn. The 34 
bhava is not occupied by any planet. 

The 6 bhava is owned by Mars. Kethu, Jupiter and Venus are occupying the 6% 


bhava. Saturn is deposited in a star of Mars. Sun is deposited in a 
star of Jupiter and Moon is deposited in a star of Venus. 

The 10 bhava is owned by Sun. Mars is deposited in the 10 bhava. Ketu is de- 
posited in a star of Sun. Saturn is deposited in a star of Mars. 


Bhava Significators: 
Kethu is in conjunction with Jupiter and Venus and occupying a sign owned by Venus. 
Therefore, Kethu is a very powerful representative of Venus and Jupiter. Kethu is in 


trine aspect to Mars in the 10 bhava. 


Therefore bhava significators for the analysis are: 
Jupiter, Sun, Saturn, Rahu, Mars, Moon, Venus and Kethu. 


The Ruling Planets at the time of judgement were 
Venus, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Jupiter by considering 7 RPs. 


The common planets among the significators and the ruling planets are: 
Venus, Mars and Jupiter. 


These are the fruitful significators for the transfer.

Hints

work), 10th (profession/business/reputation), one can get success as a cinema actor/ 
director.

them, one gets success as a cinema actor/director.

about his profession.

marriage. 


Present Bhukti Lord — Rahu (from 02-04-2010 to 20-10-2012) 
Next Bhukti Lord -— Jupiter (from 20-10-2012 to 25-01-2015) 


Rahu is a fruitful significator. But Rahu is another weak grade E significator. 
Jupiter is a fruitful significator. Jupiter is the three time appeared grade C and D signifi- 
cator. Hence, Jupiter bhukti is taken into consideration for marriage. 


Now, in Mercury Dasha and Jupiter Bhukti, 


First Anthra Lord -— Jupiter (from 20-10-2012 to 07-02-2013)

of 7). So, Jupiter signifies all the relevant houses (2 and 7 and 11) for marriage. Jupiter 
is in sub of self and having positional strength as there is no planet in stars of Jupiter. 
Hence, Jupiter Anthra is taken into consideration for marriage. 


Now to select Sookshma lord we have to select one among the left fruitful significators 
i.e. Sun, Rahu and Ketu. 


Sun is not a significator of 11 through self or its starlord (Moon). 

Ketu does not signify 11 through its occupancy or its starlord (Moon). 

Rahu does not signify 11 through its occupancy or its starlord (Saturn). 

But in the horary chart, both Ketu and Rahu are the agent of Mercury (Dasha Lord) and 
Jupiter (Bhukti-Anthra Lord). Moreover as agent of Jupiter (which signifies all relevant 
houses of marriage i.e. 2 and 7 and 11 through ownership and its starlord), both Ketu 
and Rahu signify 2 and 11. Hence, in the Sookshma Dasha of Ketu or Rahu, celebration 
of marriage will take place.

Telugu is mother-tongue and this language is spoken in Andhra Pradesh in India. It is 
one among the Dravidian languages. It’s origin is SANSKRIT. C.P. Brown named it as 
“ITALIAN OF THE EAST”. 


te 
Ezine 





Avadhaanam is an unparalleled literary performance which is very popular in India 
from the ancient days. (Avadhaanam = attention; care; devotion; regard; intentness; at- 
tentiveness). It requires the deepened mind to give greater power of concentration, inten- 
sive memory power, an in-depth knowledge of literature, prosody, talent in performing 
the multiple tasks simultaneously, and also framing up a poem spontaneously. 


One who performs the avadhaanam is known as “AVADHAANI”.(The correct dictionary 
meaning of avadhaani is quoted in bold letters ---“HE WHO IS ATTENTIVE OR CARE- 
FUL OR GIVES ATTENTION; A VERSATILE GENIUS IN FEATS OF MEMORY, PER- 
FORMING MANY OF THEM SIMULTANEOUSLY”. ) 


Avadhaani will occupy the honourable seat which is arranged in the middle of the stage 
along with the coordinator. Four pruchakaas occupy their seats on right side and anoth- 
er four occupy on the left side to avadhaani. Every one among these eight pruchakaas 
will ask eight different kinds of things. The answers should be in poems as requested by 
each pruchakaas. In the first round a question will be asked by each pruchakaas and 
the avadhaani gives the first line of the poem. In the second round he gives the second 
line of all the eight poems and so on. For this purpose he should not use the paper or 
pen. To speak the truth avadhaani must and should remember the questions, their or- 
der, and the lines of his previous poems. This is a very good test for the brain. At last the 
avadhaani should recite all the questions and his answers in the correct order. 


The eight pruchakaas will be kept in-charge of the following items in ASTAVADHANAM: 


1) NISHIDHAAKSHARIT;- — Avadhaani will be asked to mention a poem on any subject. 
Now he tells each letter of the first line, pruchaka can ask him not to use a particular 
letter that should not follow the letter avadhaani said. For example, avadhaani says 'sri 
ra' as first two letters, pruchaka thinks avadhaani would say 'sri ra ma' so he 
astavadhaani not to use 'ma’' as the third letter. So avadhaani can use 'gha' to make 'sri 
ra gha va'. Like this avadhaani completes the first line of the poem in the first round, se- 
cond line in the second round and so on up to four lines. 


2) (NYASTAKSHARI:- Pruchakaa can ask the avadhaani to tell a poem on any subject. 
Now the restriction is avadhaani has to use the letters as asked by the pruchaka. 
(Describe the Sun rise.) 

For example pruchakaa can ask avadhaani to use 'maa' as the 4 letter of the first line, 
"taa” as the 8t» letter of the first line, “nna” as the 4 letter of the second line, “kaa” is 
the 20 letter in second line, “maa” as the 1* letter in the third line and “jaa” as the 4th 
letter in the fourth line. Avadhaani told the following poem on Sun rise as follows- 


BHAANUNI MAADHUREEGATIKI PAAVANA CHITTULU VECHI TA MATAN 
POONUKONANGA BIMBAMADI MUCHATA NUNNADI YANCHU TAARAKAA 
MAANINI GUDIYUNNA RAVI MAADHURI GOLPEDU TEJAMADDI TAA 
NUNENU JAATADHEEGARIMA NURVARA SURYUDU MODAMANGAAN. 


(3) DATTAPADI:- Pruchakaa can ask the avadhaani to tell a poem on any subject.

(Describe on MANTRAYALA RAGHAVENDRA SWAMY.). Now avadhaani has to use these 
4 words (“loka - naaka - draka - maaka”) specified by the pruchakaa, one in each line. 
Avadhaani told the following four lines of poem using the given 4 words “loka—naaka— 
draka—maaka. 


LOKAMUNANDU BHAKTA JANULUN NUTIYINCHEDI DIVYA MOORTHYGAA 
NAKAMUNUNDI VACHINA YANANTUDATANCHUNU GOLVA MOHANI 
DRAKALUSHATMULELLARU HRUDABJAMUNANDUNA TELVI BOONUCHO 
MAAKATU LOTU LEDU GADA! MANYA MAHODAYA SREE YATEESWARA 


(4) SAMASYAURANAM:- Pruchakaa gives the 4th line of the poem. Avadhaani has to 
complete the poem. Usually the 4‘ line is so ridiculous that it requires great imagination 
on the part of avadhaani to complete the poem which makes any sense. Example- 
“VIDHAVAKU MANGALYA PHALAMU VEGAMAKALGEN” is the 4 line given to 
Avadhaani. The poem told by Avadhaani is as follows- 


VIDHICHEDAGA BHARTA JACHENU 
MADANAANTRAU GAASI MEERE MAANINIKANTAN 
MADILONA KORKE LURENU 
VIDHAVAKU MANGALYA PHALAMU VEGAMAKALGEN 


So avadhaani has told the following poem which gets rid of this meaning when read as a 
whole. 


(5) VARNANA:- Pruchaka can ask avadhaani to tell a poem on “THE WELL ESTABLISH- 
MENT OF LITERACY IN EACH AND EVERY VILLAGE IN OUR COUNTRY’ Then 
Avadhaani told the poem as follows:- 


SARASA GUNA PRAPURNULU VISHARADA CHITTULU NENDARENDARO 
PARAGUCHU GRAMA VEEDHULANU BHARATI LASYAMU CHEYUNATLUGAA 
VARALEDI ROJU RAVALENU BHARATADESHAMU AKSHARA PRABHAN 
GURUTARADEEKSHALAN PENAGI KOODAVALEN SUKHASHANTULELLEDAN. 


(6) AASUVU : - Avadhaani has to tell a number of poem/poems as requested by the 
pruchaka very fast on the subject spontaneously and in the format. 


(7) KAAVYAPATHANAM:-_ Pruchaka can ask avadhaani to recite any part of the great 
kavyaas of the telugu. For example, Manucharitra, Haravilasam, panduranga mahathy- 
am etc. 


(8) APRASTUTA PRASANGAM:- This is the most entertaining part (not for the 
avadhaani). While the avadhaani is thinking about a poem, this pruchaka tries his level 
best to divert his attention. Usually avadhaani gives him such a fitting reply that this 
pruchaka will keep quiet for a while. 


In avadhaanam, if 8 pruchakaas are involved, it is called “ASTAVADHANAAM”. When 16 

pruchakaas are involved, it is called “DWIGUNITA ASTAVADHAANAM”. When 100 
pruchakaas are involved, it is called “SATAVADHAANAM”. When 1000 are involved, it is 
called “SAHASRA AVADHAANAM”. When 2000 are involved, it is called “DWI-SAHASRA 
AVADHAANAM”.

ma Sree Gandluri. Dattatreya Sarma, “SATAAVADHAANI” Garu). They are 20 in number

3) In the natal chart of Sri. Madduru Rama Murthy garu, both Saturn and Moon are Tu-

Moon. Moon is the “A” grade significator for 12. Saturn is in the sub of Rahu, the occu- 
pant of 12. Thus both are the significators for 12. 


5) In the natal chart of Sri. M. Siva Rama Raju garu, Squ(S) aspect is constituted in be- 
tween Saturn & Moon. Moon is the lord of 12. Saturn is the occupant of 12 in its own 
star. Moon is “D” grade significator. Saturn is ”A” grade significator for 12. 


6) In the natal chart of Sri. Avadhaanam Sudhakara Sarma garu, Saturn and Moon are 
in Dwirdwadasa (2/12) position. Moon is the occupant of 12. Venus, (Karaka for poetry, 
prosody and fine arts) and Moon (Karaka for mind) are aspecting each other. So this na- 
tive is inclined towards Avadhaanam. 


7) In the natal chart of Sri. Kadimella Vara Prasad Garu, Saturn aspects Moon. Both 
Saturn and Moon are in the sub of Mercury. Both are the significators of 12 through 
Mercury as it is the owner of 12. 


8) In the natal chart of Sri. Kadimella Venkata Satya Ramesh Garu, the Moon is in the 
sub of Saturn. Saturn aspects Moon with his 3rd aspect. Saturn is not only the owner 
of 12 but also “A” grade significator for 12. Moon is in the sub of Saturn who signifies 
12. Thus both are the significators for 12. 


9) In the natal chart of Dr. Amalladinne Venkata Ramana Prasad Garu, Moon is “C” 
grade significator for 12 as it is in the star of Venus, the lord of 12. Saturn is not having 
any planets in his stars and holding sub lordship for 12‘ cusp. 


10) In the natal chart of Sri. Loka Jagannatha Sastry garu, Moon is in the sign of Sat- 
urn (Makara sign). Saturn is a strong significator for 12th.

urn and Saturn is in the sub of Moon. They aspect mutually with each other. 


12) In the natal chart of Sri. Chenchu Subbaiah Garu, Moon is in the sub of Saturn. 
Moon is also aspected by Saturn. 


13) In the natal chart of Sri. Kondapi Murali Garu, Opposite (S) aspect is constituted 
between Saturn and Moon. 


14) In the natal chart of Smt. B. Aparna garu, both Saturn and Moon are in the star of 
Jyeshta 2 (in Mercury star). Thus they are well connected through Mercury. Both Sat- 
urn and Moon are closely conjoined in Scorpio. 


15) In the natal chart of Smt. Naga Santhi Swaroopa garu, Moon is in the star and sub 
of Saturn. Sext (S) aspect is constituted in between Saturn & Moon.

the sub of Saturn. Saturn aspects the Moon with Deci (A).

(V) Great Logic of 6-8-12 in Avadhaanam 


“Lagna or Ascendant indicates the borrower. The 7 house indicates the lender or bank- 
er. Discharge of loan is to be determined not only from the 12th but also from the 8th 
house. The 6 house indicates borrowing, then the 7‘ house automatically indicates he 
who lends. The 6 house is the 12‘ to the person who has lent money represented by 
the 7 house. The native’s 12‘4 house is the 6 reckoned from the 7‘ and so he has to 
do with discharge of debts.” 


Lagna indicates avadhaani and the 7‘ house indicates the pruchakaas (questioners) in 
avadhaanam. Generally in Avadhaanam, Pruchakaas put the questions to avadhaani. 
In turn he has to give correct and prompt replies to the pruchakaas. This type of ques- 
tioning and answering is to be considered or determined not only from the 12‘ house 
but also from the 8 house. The 6 house is the 12 to the pruchakaas who have ques- 
tioned the avadhaani represented by the 7 house. The avadhaani’s 12 house is the 
6th reckoned from the 7‘ and so the avadhaani has to do perfectly answering the ques- 
tions. 


It is well known to every astrologer generally, the 6 is loss to the opponent and it indi- 
cates gain to the native. In the same way 6" is loss to the Pruchakaas and it is gain to 
the avadhaani. 


At the end of aadhaanam, both the pruchakaas and the audience agree or accept the 
great abilities and performance of avadhaani and also honour him in an appropriate 
way. 


(VI) Mercury, (the planet of intellectual and memory) also signifies 1, 2, 5, 10, or 
12. 


1 denotes self (avadhani); 
2 indicates vak (speech), Dhanam(money), finance bank balance etc. 
5 shows buddhisthana, thinking capacity, Manthrasthanam, etc.

Marriage with a girl having affair? 


By: Pt Akash ( BE Electronics )( Jyotish Shiromani ) 
Nakshatra Jyotish Kendra, Vedic and Krishnamurti 
Paddhati Astrologer; Mob: 9827374626 , 9329265779 


’ | akash2311@gmail.com; Wwww.ptakash.com 


BEBE BERBER REE RE RE RE RERE RE RERE REPRE ee 
Teenage romance is a very common thing now. Most of the teens consider their infatua- 
tion as love and think about marriage even when they have not yet settled. And to be 
successful in affair these teenage persons often fall prey in the hands of so called astrolo- 
gers and tantriks giving solution in three hours . Newspapers are filled with that kind of 
advertisements. Anyhow I am not here to criticize but to share my knowledge with the 
readers. One such teenager who is hardly 20 years old has approached me. He was deep- 
ly in love and asked whether he will marry the girl having affair with him. The parents of 
the girl came to know about the affair and have left their home. The querist is worried 
about the future state of his affair and also asked whether the girl will come back or not. 
Let us see how to solve the query using Krishnamurti Padhdhati principles. 








Query : Marriage with a girl having affair? 
Horary No: 179 (1 —249) ; Date : 15-02-2013 ; Time: 14:18:44 
Place : BHOPAL 77E26 , 23N0O7 (Geocentric ); Ayanamsa : KPNA 23:56:48 


HINTS 


1. The 5 cusp is for love affairs and romance, so the 5 cuspal sublord must signify 
2nd, 7th and 11 house for affair to materialize in marriage. 


2. The 5t cuspal sublord must not signify the house 4 and 10 being 12 from 
the primary house. 


Moon & Ascendant sublord 

Before proceeding to analyse any horary chart one must check whether the Moon sup- 
ports the query being put up by anybody. Also the ascendant sublord should be consid- 
ered for further confirmation. Let us check Moon first. Moon is placed in 4 house, 12 
from the primary 5 house but Moon is in the sub of Mars in 2 and lord of 5, so Moon 
clearly states the query is genuine. Let us see the ascendant sublord which is Mars, 
Mars is placed in 2™4 house and hence is connected to a supporting house, i.e. 2. 


Cuspal analysis 

Primary Cusp : 

oth Cusp --Aries -28:25:44 (Ma-Su-Mo ) 

Moon is the cuspal sulord of the 5 cusp. It is placed in 4 house. It is in the star of 
Ketu' which is placed in 4th house. Hence it becomes a strong significator of 4th house. 
So Moon is negating the matter through its star. 


Supporting Cusps 

2nd Cusp —- Capricorn — 21:31:36 (Sa — Mo - Ve) 

Venus is the cuspal sublord of the 2™¢d house. Venus is placed in the 24 house. It is in 
the star of Moon which is placed in 4 house. So Venus is strongly signifying 4 house. 
It is in its own sub. So the connectivity of Venus with 5 house is not there. 


7th Cusp -- Gemini — 17:20:00 ( Me- Ra—Ve ) 
As discussed above Venus is not favourable through its star and sub level signification. 


11% Cusp - Libra — 28:25:44 (Ve -Ju-Ve ) 

As discussed above Venus is not favourable through its star and sub level signification. 
As cuspal sublord is not signifying the primary and supporting houses, there is no need 
to analyse the dasha and bhukti and the ruling planets.

Question-1: Role of 11: Badhaka in Recovery from Disease and Return of the 
Missing Person 








In KP system, Badhaka sthana puzzles me like retrogression. Please make the following 
problem clear. 
For a movable Lagna, 
1. In considering recovery from disease, if the Ist CSL signifies 11 house strongly, then 
does this indicate recovery or Badhaka? 
2. In considering a missing person, if 11% CSL and also Ist CSL signify 2,8,11 house, then 
does this indicate return of the mission person or death? 


Answer- Il: 


Recovery from disease: 

If the 1st cuspal sub lord signifies 11 house (Badhaka for a movable Lagna), the longevity 
is not promised. 

If the 6% or 11% CSL signifies 11 house (Badhaka for a movable Lagna), it indicates 
Badhaka, not recovery from illness. 


Return of the missing person: 

If the 1st CSL signifies 2 (Maraka), 8 (danger to life), 11 (Badhaka for a movable Lagna), it 
may indicate the missing person’s death. 

If the 11 CSL signifies 2,8,11 (12 to 3,9,12: runaway from home), it indicates return of 
the missing person. (Note: Badhaka is bad for longevity and health only.) 


Question- 2: Raphael Table of Houses 


As a new lerner, I would like to study manual calculation of a KP chart first. There is a 
very good example of casting KP chart given by Shri. Jyotindra Hasbe sir in marthi book 
"Vedh Naksharache’”. 


Referred to above mentioned book, for casting KP chart, we should have 1.0 Krishnamuthy 
Panchang for finding "Sampatik time” and 2.0 Raphael table of houses. If someone have 
both Krishnamurthy Panchang and Raphael table of houses, then kindly send copy for 
study purpose. 


Answer- 2: The Raphael Table of Houses and Krishnamurti Sayana Ephemeris 1900- 
1910 & 1911 to 1940 are now just history. 


Raphael ephemeris and table of houses ruled the astrological world when Guruji KSK 
was doing research and writing KP. These days, the highly accurate Swiss ephemeris 
dominates the current astrological SWs like KPAstro 4.0, Jagannatha Hora (J Hora), As- 
tro-Kundli, Jyotishya Deepika, Astracadabra and Solar Fire in providing better results 
with high precision than hand calculation. (Casting a Horoscope by Computer, KP for 
Beginners - Part 3, KPE-zine June 2008 issue, pp_- 17-26) 


The drawback of the Raphael's Tables of Houses (first published in 1821) is 
that only ascendant position is given to the degree and minute and other cuspal 
positions to the nearest degree only. The current Universal Table of Houses,

Michelsen Tables of Houses and AFA Tables of Houses give the cuspal positions up 
to the degree and minute and Krishman KP Tables of Houses up to the second. The 
manual calculation by using these Tables of Houses provides the cuspal positions 
very close to the SW results. In the new era of high precision drive by SWs like 
Astrodienst/ KPAstro 4.0, the Raphael's Table of Houses and Ephemeris are now just 
history. 

The manual calculation of planetary positions from the American Ephemeris can 
give the nearest accuracy of Astrodienst/ KPAstro 4.0. The Raphael's Ephemeris or 
Swiss online Ephemeris do not provide up to the second positions of all planets, except 
Sun and Moon, and so they cannot give the same accuracy of the American Ephemeris 
in manual calculation. (Book Review: Raphael's Table of Houses for Northern Latitudes, 
KPE-zine February 2010 issue, p 2)

Election of New Pope 

On March 138, 2013 at the 19:06 p.m. (GMT plus one hour) Roman time the white smoke 
poured from a chimney on the roof of the Sistine Chapel in Vatican City to signal 115 
cardinal electors had chosen Cardinal Jorge Bergoglio, 76, of Argentina as the new pope. 


2. Cardinal Jorge Bergoglio is the first non-European pope since Syrian-born Gregory III 
in the eighth century, and the third successive non-Italian pontiff. "Francis", the name 
the new pope has chosen, is the much-beloved 13th-century Italian Saint Francis of As- 
sisi, who is identified with peace, poverty and a simple lifestyle. 


3. He is the Jesuit intellectual who was the runner-up in the previous papal election in 
2005 that elected Joseph Ratzinger who became Pope Benedict XVI. His humility is cele- 
brated; before his papal election, he rides a bus to work, wears an ordinary priest's robe, 
lives in a simple apartment rather than the archbishop's luxurious residence and usually 
cooks his own meals. 


http: //en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pope_Francis

K.P. Analysis - Cataract Operation of the Eyes 
By: Gunti Nagaraju, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
KP astrologer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar,

“Sarvendriyaanam nayanam prdhanam” is the saying which means eyes are the most 
important indriyas of the human being. Close your eyes and imagine that you had never 
seen the world and yourself. You will not have an idea with what something looks like 
when you only feel it. Eyes are very important for the human body. It helps the human 
body to do its tasks with coordination. Eyes are the windows of the soul. Without eyes, 
the five basic senses would not be complete. So when the eyes and their vision are af- 
fected we feel as though every thing is affected and we become restless. The affectation 
may be eyes sore, eye infection, night blindness, glaucoma of the eyes, partial blindness, 
shot sight or long sight, cataract and many more eye diseases. Now I would like to dwell 
upon very common vision problem that comes due to cataract of the eyes in the old age. 


What is cataract? 


According to the WHO’s definition: "Cataract is clouding of the lens of the eye which im- 
pedes the passage of light. Although most cases of cataract are related to the aging pro- 
cess, occasionally children can be born with condition, or a cataract may develop after 
eye injuries, inflammation, and some _ other eye’ diseases." 
Globally, cataract (opacification of the lens) is the single most important cause of blind- 
ness, and cataract surgery has been shown to be one of the most cost-effective health- 
care interventions. Mostly cataract is related to aging and cannot be prevented, but cata- 
ract surgery and insertion of an intraocular lens are highly effective, resulting in almost 
immediate visual rehabilitation. In well-managed eyes high-quality, high-volume surgery 
is possible. 


In terms of astrology Sun , Moon and Venus are the planets that control the eyes. The 
sign Aries controls the head where the eyes are embedded and the vision is being con- 
trolled. For a male Sun controls the right eye, and Moon controls the left eye. In the case 
of the female it is the reverse. Rahu and Ketu, the shadow planets, obstruct the vision 
and Saturn also adds to the problem whenever it afflicts the particular signs, houses or 
planets signifying these and connected with relevant parts of the body. 


The houses connected with this particular problem are — 2" house for right eye,12‘ 
house for left eye, 6 house for the disease, 12‘ for hospitalization for the operation and 
expenses for the operation, 11 and 5 houses for treatment and cure of the disease. 

In medical astrology, 2nd house governs right eye and 12th house indicates left eye of 
the native. Sun is karaka for the right eye for male and left eye for female. Moon is the 
karaka for left eye for male and right eye for female. In natural Zodiac, Taurus rules right 
eye , Pisces left eye and vision is controlled by Venus. 


When 2nd /12th house or Taurus /Pisces and planets Sun, Moon, Venus are afflicted 
and connected to evil houses 6-disease, 8-chronic, 12-hospitalisation would lead to eye 
diseases. Connection with planets Mars & Rahu would lead to defects in the vision. 
(“Medical Astrology for All” by Sri K Subramaniam S/o Sri KSK Guruji). (see NAVA- 
RATHNA MAALA SERIES III — SRI OVN MURTHY) 


2) If the 126 cusp sub lord is in 6 — the house of disease, and its sub lord is in the con- 
stellation of the planet occupying or owing 6 or 8 or 12, it is definite that one will have 
the defect from the time when the significators conjointly operate.

Exiled Pakistani former president Musharraf plans to retul 
to Pakistan by March end, Is it possible? RP 
By: Kanak Bosmia (KP Astrologer/Editore KPEzine) aA ine

Islamabad: Former Pakistani president Pervez Musharraf, currently living in exile in the UAE, announced on 
Friday that he would return to his country later this month to take part in parliamentary elections, a media re- 
port said. 

Musharraf, 69, has been living in exile in Britain and the UAE since he resigned as the president in August 
2008, fearing impeachment by parliament, Xinhua reported. 

He had earlier on a few occasions announced he would end his exile but postponed the plans over concerns at 
his possible arrest in connection with the 2007 assassination of former Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto. 
Musharraf announced his plans at a press conference in Dubai, which was aired live by Pakistani TV channels. 
He, however, did not announce the exact date for his return but said he will come back a week after the estab- 
lishment of a caretaker government likely on March 16. 

The current National Assembly or lower house of Pakistani parliament will be dissolved on completion of its five 
-year term and new elections will be held within two months. 

"I will land either at Karachi airport or Islamabad,” said Musharraf, flanked by several leaders of his All Paki- 
stan Muslim League (APML) party. 

He said his party will field candidates for almost all seats in the upcoming parliamentary elections. 

"My return is in the interest of Pakistan. The country’s future is at stake and there is a need of a positive 
change in the country,” Musharraf said. 

He called for free, fair and transparent elections, adding that fair polls could only be held under the army. 

The former army chief who seized power in a coup in 1999 said he would face courts on return and did not 
care if there was a threat to his life. 

In 2011, an anti-terrorism court issued an arrest warrant for Musharraf in connection with the assassination of 
Benazir Bhutto in a bomb blast. 

In October 2012, a court issued a warrant for his arrest over the killing of Baloch leader Akbar Bugti in a mili- 
tary operation in 2006. 

Musharraf denies all charges and said he will defend himself in courts.

On 20% October, 2009, at 20:10 PM, I received a call from Alleppey, in South Kerala, 
from a father who sounded very worried . He said, “Sir, I have my daughter married on 
the 14th September 2009. The groom who works in Germany has a confirmed return 
flight ticket for 30 October 2009. My effort to get visa for my daughter who wants to ac- 
company her husband in his journey, has not found fruition till this date. I AM VERY 
WORRIED and would like to know whether she can join him in this journey. For horary 
analysis I am selecting no. 24. Please inform what is in store.....” 











To solve this query, I decided to look at the Ruling Planets at the time of analysis. 


When I decided on this in Palghat and looked at the clock, it was then 20:15 PM. 


Ruling Planets on 20/Oct/2009 at 20:15 PM, Palghat, Kerala, India 
Sgl Stl Sbl 

Lagna Taurus 99.22’.27" Ve Su Ve 

Moon Scorpio 29.50’.30” Ma Ju Ra 

Day Lord: Mars 


Lagna was transiting in sign Taurus at 9°.22’.27”. This portion of the Zodiac is ruled 
by the combination of planets: Venus, as the sign lord, Sun as the star lord and Venus 
as the sub lord of lagan. The sub-sub lord is Saturn. 


The Moon was transiting in Scorpio at 2°.50’.30”, the sign is ruled by Mars. The star 
lord is Jupiter, the sub lord Rahu, and the sub-sub lord Venus. 


The day was Tuesday, ruled by Mars. 


A look at the time chart showed that Rahu is conjoined with Jupiter in the sign Capri- 
corn owned by Saturn, while the other node Ketu is conjoined with Mars in Cancer 
owned by Moon. It can be seen that the lagna is being aspected by Jupiter, the Moon’s 
star lord, while Moon is aspected by Saturn, from the 5 house representing his child. 
Both Mars and Saturn, gets aspected by Jupiter who is lord of 115 from lagna.. 


Thus at the time of analysis, the ruling planets were: Venus, Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Rahu 
and Ketu , besides Saturn . 


The horary number given by the father was # 24. The area, referred by this number in 
the Zodiac, has planets Venus, Sun and Jupiter, as its combined rulers of sign, star and 
sub. 


A quick deliberation on the group confirms the appearances of the same planets ruling 
the time of analysis as well. 


Applying the “Gulbarga Theory” which says that if the sub lord of the horary number 
happens to appear as the star lord of Moon at the time of analysis, among the ruling 
planets, then the matter pertaining the query is sure to come to happen. Since Rahu ap- 
pears as an agent for both Jupiter and Saturn, while Ketu represents both Moon and 
Mars, the Jupiter-Rahu conjunction is aspected by Mars, his daughter is destined to go 
on a day influenced by Jupiter-Saturn-Rahu.

Last month I had written about a director asking me about the possibility of directing a 
film within this year. Another famous cinema director in Kerala called me on 23rd Febru- 
ary and asked me, “Will I be able to direct a movie at the earliest? If so when?” I told him 
to give a horary no and he gave me no 111. Accordingly, the horary chart was calculated 
at Calicut at 21:49:08 pm on 23.2.2013. 








Hints 

If the cuspal sub lord of the 5th cusp be the significator of 5 (art), 6% (efficiency in 
work), 10% (business/job/reputation), one can get success as a cinema actor/director. 

If the significator of 6 and 10th be connected with 5, then during joint period of them, 
one gets success as a cinema actor/director. 


Role of Moon: Moon is in the 11th house and in the star of Saturn, lord of 5 and 6 in 2. 
Hence query is related to career. 


Analysis: 5th cuspal sub lord is Mercury. There are no planets in Mercury’s star. Mer- 
cury is the 5th and 11th cuspal sub lord. Mercury is the lord of 1 and 10, occupant in 
6. Mercury is in the star of Jupiter, lord of 4 and 7 in 9. Mercury is in the sub of Ketu. 
Ketu is in the sign of Mars, lord of 3 and 8 in 6. Ketu has no planet in its stars. Ketu is 
the 7th cuspal sub lord. 


Sth cuspal sub lord signifies 4, 7 and 9 and is connected with 1, 10, 6, 3, 8, 7, 5, 11. 
oth cuspal sublord indicates 5, 10, 11 and hence he would be able to direct a movie. 8 
indicates delay/dejections. 


Next question is when? 

Let us look at DBA. 

Saturn Dasa is running. Saturn is the lord of 5 and 6 in 2. Saturn is in the star of Rahu 
in 2nd house. Rahu is conjoined with Saturn, lord of 5 and 6 in 2. Saturn is in the sub 
of Sun. Sun is lord of 6 in 12th. 

Hence Saturn dasa shows positive outcome as it indicates 5, 6 and 2. 


Jupiter bhukti is running. 

Let us analyse Jupiter. Jupiter is the lord of 4 and 7 in 9. Jupiter is in the star of Moon. 
Moon is the lord of 11 in 11 itself. Jupiter is in the sub of Rahu. Rahu is in 2nd house. 
Rahu is conjoined with Saturn, lord of 5 and 6 in 2. Jupiter bhukti gives ok for directing 
a film as houses 5, 6, and 2 have come up. 


Now which anthara? 

The significators of houses 5, 6, 10 are Venus, Moon, Saturn, Ketu, Sun, Mars, Mercury 
and Jupiter (as Jupiter is in the sub of Rahu which represents Saturn). 

Ruling planets are Mercury (Asc sub lord), Jupiter (Moon sub lord), Mars (Asc star lord) 
(Ketu), Venus (Asc sign lord), Saturn (Moon star lord), Moon (Moon sign lord), Saturn 
(Day lord) . 


The common planets are Venus, Moon, Saturn, Ketu, Jupiter, Mars. 

Saturn dasa and Jupiter bhukti are running. Both give the green signal. 

I will take Venus anthara. Venus is lord of 2 and 9 in 5. Venus is in the star of Mars, lord 
of 3 and 8 in 6. Venus is in the sub of Venus itself i.e. 2, 5, 9. Venus has no planets in 
its stars. Venus is the cuspal sub lord of 1, 3, and 9.

Background Note 

According to media sources, former Pakistan President Mr. Pervez Musharraf has an- 
nounced his return to Pakistan on 24th March, 2013 to lead his party in the upcoming 
general election, after spending five years in exile in Dubai. Pakistan's parliament is due 
to be dissolved on 16th March. 2013. An election has to be held within 90 days, allowing 
for a period for campaigning and other preparations. Musharraf plans to lead his party, 
the All Pakistan Muslim League into Pakistan’s elections, which are scheduled for May. 
Pervez Musharraf is blamed of failing to provide necessary security to the first elected 
female Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto, who was killed in a suicide bomb attack in Rawal- 
pindi in 2007. The former military ruler had denied the charges for killing of Bhutto. 








Pervez Musharraf has been cautioned that he could face arrest over allegations that he 
failed to provide enough security for the assassinated former Prime Minister, Benazir 
Bhutto. Khurram Harris, the former general’s press aide, said he had not committed a 
crime and did not expect him to be arrested when he arrives. He also said that the 
charges against him are politically motivated. “When he lands he will voluntarily hand 
himself over to the court,” added Mr. Harris.

Note: Question is asked by son about his mother’s longevity. Hence, horary chart is ro- 
tated to 4 cusp treated as Lagna of mother. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 
Moon (Leo 06-41-32) is in the star of Ketu and sub of Rahu. 


Moon is the occupant of 2, owner of 2. Starlord Ketu is the occupant of 11. Ketu is posit- 
ed in the sign of Venus (Taurus) and thus acts an agent of Venus. Venus is the occupant 
of 3, owner of 4 and 11. Sublord Rahu is the occupant of 5. Rahu having positional 
strength i.e. untenanted (there is no planet in stars of Rahu) and CSL of 2, 8, 10. Rahu 
is posited in sign of Mars (Scorpio) and thus acts an agent of Mars. Mars is the occupant 
of 1, owner of 5 and 10. 

Moon signifies and is in connection with the relevant houses, hence query is genuine. 


Consider the cuspal sub lord of mainly 1st house, and also 34 and 8 house for lon- 
gevity (life span). 


Maraka Houses: The 12‘ to any particular houses denotes non-existence of the matter 
signified by the particular house. So, the houses 12 (12t to 1), 2 (12 to 3) and 7 (12% to 
8) are known as Maraka (death dealing) houses. (12** house indicates Moksha, end of 
life. 44 house indicates graveyard, end of everything.) 


Badhaka House: The house 11 is badhaka (harmful to life) for those born in movable 
signs (Aries, Cancer, Libra and Capricorn) as their Ascendant; the 9 for those born in 
fixed signs (Taurus, Leo, Scorpio and Aquarius) and the 7 for those born in common 
signs (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pieces). 


Death: The Badhaka house is more harmful than the Maraka houses. So for death it is 
to consider first the Badhaka house and then the Maraka houses. Saturn is the chief 
governor of longevity. 


Life Supporting Houses: 1, 5, 9 (not for fixed lagna as Badhaka), 11 (not for movable 
lagna as Badhaka). 


Hints: 

If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significator (in the star of occupant or 
owner) of Badhaka and Maraka houses, the life span is short (within 334%years). There is 
a danger to life during the joint period of the significators of the badhaka and maraka 
houses. 


For short, medium or long life, also check 3™4 CSL and 8 CSL with above mentioned 
rule.

is in star of Moon and sub of Mercury.

Question- 1: Menatal Depression 





Which combination of planets and group of cusps shows a person under negative thoughts 
and immense depression? 


Answer- lL: 


Based on the ‘medical astrology’ by H.N. Cornell, K. Subramaniam, Dr. K.S. Charak, 
Shanker Adawal, S.K. Duggal etc. and after looking at some horoscopes of depression, 
the following astrological pattern for depression has been basically found: 


The 6th (disease, sickness) cuspal sub lord signification of 1 (head, brain, mental stabil- 
ity), 3 (mental tendency), 5 (intelligence, emotional peace of mind and depression), 8 
(serious illness, disappointment) houses, and connection to Moon (significator of mind, 
giver of visions and imagination), Saturn (ruler of sorrow, gloom and depression, ob- 
struction) and Mercury (nervous system and mental activity) can cause depression. In 
addition Moon connection to Saturn or Uranus (erratic and fanatic) and Mars (impulse 
and recklessness) connection to the Ascendant may also give rise to depression. 


Question- 2: Internal Transfer 


In KP system normally we analyse the potentials for cusps 3,10,12 for transfer of job. Here 
the query is pertaining to internal transfer from one project to another project (or may be 
from one department to another department). I think this grouping (10,3,12) is unrelated to 
this query. 


I request your opinion for house grouping for this query (either same will suffice or it should 
be simply 9,12 or some other grouping of house). 


Answer- 2: 


Since it is the query for a change of place of work in the same organization where one 
has been working, the house 3 (shift or change of place of work to a near by place) and 
10 (present job, employment, profession) are reasonable to be considered. And the house 
9 (change in the nature of job itself and also shifting to a far off place) and 12 (life ina 
completely unfamiliar atmosphere or new environment) seem irrelevant in this case. 


Question- 3: Three or Four Steps 


In KP, how do we analyse ? 

Method 1. 

We see the sub lord of relevant cusp.. let’s say it is A. 

A is in the star of B and in the sub of C. 

By seeing B's ownership and placement--- we answer What is the matter. 
By seeing C’s ownership and placement ---we answer What is final outcome. 
Method 2. 

We see the sub lord of relevant cusp.. let’s say it is A. 

A in the star of B and in the sub of C. C is in the star of D. 

By seeing B's ownership and placement--- we answer What is the matter. 
By seeing C’s star Lord D's ownership and placement ---we answer. 
What is final outcome. 

Kindly guide me which is correct method. 


BEE HEHE EEE EERE ERE eee eee eee eee 
KPEzine April-2013 47 








Answer- 3: 


The Method 1 is KP. And generally the ownership and placement of all the "A, B & C’, 
i.e. at all the three levels of ‘planet, star and sub’, are to be considered, giving C not only 
deciding but also connected role, as done by Shri Bhatt and followed by Kanak Bosmia, 
because in some horoscopes the event happens without any relevant signification in the 
A & B (star and sub levels) but by signification only in the C (sub level). 


In his ‘Sub Lord Speaks’ articles, Shri K.M. Subramaniam goes up to the ownership and 
placement of D (sub’s star level) for the final outcome, although the C (sub level) is con- 
sidered as the deciding factor. 


Question- 4: Lagna Sub Lord’s Connection to 11th House 
Is there any rule for Yes/No type questions in KP? 


I have tried matching the RPs of time of judgement and RPs of the horary number. Many 
times it works but sometimes it doesn’t. 


Does Lagna sub lord should have connection with 11th cusp to fulfill the desire ? Can u 
share any of your experience ? 


Answer- 4: 


Dr. Kar's TSP method, advocated and tried by Kanak Bosmia and supported by the 
KPAstro 4.0 SW, is the one to answer a "Yes or No" question. 


According to the experience of Prof. Rajendra Kumar (Inference from a Honest Retrospec- 
tion", KP & Astrology Year Book 2005, page 52) and Dr. Arastu Prabhaker (The Times 
Horary Astrology, Based on KP, 2006, pages 76-77), the Lagna sub lord should be 
checked whether it is connected to 11» house or not in order to know about fulfillment 
of desire in the horary analysis. 


Question- 5: Return to Homeland 


I’m dealing with a horary chart. The person wants to know if she can return to

In such case which cusp sub lord to be judged first? Some say 3,9 & 1lhouses along with 
4th house to be judged. But start from where. Which cusp sub lord will tell if she returns or 
not to her homeland? 


Answer- 5D: 


Referring the KP Reader IV, page 207 (Return and Reunion) and Chamatkar Chintamani 
of Bhatt Narayana, by S. S. Sareen, Sagar Publications, 2008, and based on a quick re-

abroad, i.e. 12th to house 4), 9 (long journey) or 11 (reunion with kith and 
kin with whom one was originally living), one can return to homeland during the 
joint dasa period of significators of house 3,9,11.

Book review 
Krishnamurti Padhadhati = Nirayan + Sayan 


By: Tin Win 
oa E-mail: tw853@yahoo.com : 
(‘BEER ERE ERE REE RRR RRR RR Ree eee eee 








Krishnamurti Padhadhati = Nirayan + Sayan 
enatae C. Joshi, 2000, 92 pages 





This is a serial review of some of over one hundred KP based books in English. The book 
‘Krishnamurti Padhadhati = Nirayan + Sayan’ gives fairly good knowledge about KP and 
a basic comparison with Nirayan- Vedic and Sayan- Western systems in a simple, easy 
to understand language. 

In the first part of the book, the basic concepts of KP have been mentioned and a basic 
comparison has been done among the KP, Nirayan- Vedic and Sayan- Western systems. 
In KP the transit has to be studied by its star lord and sub lord only (page 5); Except 
Punarphoo not a single yoga is to be considered (pp 5, 8); The number system 1-249 is 
used for horary chart; The retrogression is to be considered in the hoary chart, but not 
so strictly that as experience it cannot always deny the results, if it is a strong significa- 
tor or the chart is more positive. So it is up to one’s own experience to consider case by 
case. (pp 5, 13) The birth time rectification is done through the ruling planets (pp 7, 44); 
No planet is fully benefic or malefic depending upon a matter under consideration (p 8); 
The house grouping for each matter is given clearly, but not so in the Nirayan or Sayan 
system (p 9). 

Regarding the KP, Nirayan and Sayan systems some other topics have been included ac- 
cording to the author’s experience and view like ruling planets, how to judge dasa, trans- 
it, solar return chart, horary and natal chart etc. as shown in the contents. In KP the da- 
sa lord cannot give any result against the cusp’s indication (p 16); One can cast the 
‘horary’ chart according to his convenience of time and place, but one has to finish prep- 
aration and judgment of the chart in one sitting; if there is any break for some reason, 
then one has to cast the chart again when one sits again for judgment (p 37,40); Horary 
chart can be used as a supportive tool for natal as well as separate when it is needed, 
but natal is more important in all aspects (p 43), i.e. horary is not a substitute for a reli- 
able natal chart. 

In second part, the matters related all the 12 houses are explained how to judge, which 
are the positive and negative houses with karaka planets etc. And in last chapter, a

ready reference of summarized house grouping for each house matter has been given. In 
line with the KP Readers, the main house for sale of property is 10 house, for going 
abroad is 12‘ house. (pp 84, 88)

Question. When will I get loan from bank? 

Number. 208 (out of 249). Time of Judgment. 14-08-2012, Tuesday; 12-42-24 PM IST 
Place of Judgment. Kanakariya — Anmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36'., 
Ayanamsha 23°.560’.35” 


Hints 
If the cuspal sub lord of the 6 be the significator of 2, 6 or 10 or 11, borrowing from bank is 
promised during the joint period of the significators of house 2, 6, 10 and 11. 


Cusp 6th (Gemini 29°.56’.29”): The sub lord of the 6** cusp is Moon. Moon is in the star of 
Rahu and sub of Sun. Moon is occupant of 5. Star lord Rahu is occupant of 10. Rahu is in 
Scorpio, hence representing Mars. Mars is occupant of 8, owner of 3, 10. Sub lord Sun is oc- 
cupant and owner of 7. Thus 68 CSL Moon signifies 10 and is connected with 10. Hence you 
will get loan from bank. 


Ruling Planets 
Day lord Signlord Starlord Sub lord 


Day. Tuesday Mars — — - 
Asc. Libra 24°.42’.02” — Venus Jupiter Mercury 
Moon. Gemini 17°.42'.09" — Mercury Rahu Sun 


Ketu is conjoined with Jupiter. The ruling planets are Mars, Venus, Jupiter, Mercury, Sun, 
Rahu and Ketu. 


Joint Period 


At the time of judgment the querent is running Rahu dasa up to 21-09-2015. Joint period run- 
ning is Rahu-Sun up to 03-03-2013. 

Dasa lord Rahu is in the star of Saturn and sub of Mercury. Rahu is occupant of 10. Rahu is 
in Scorpio, hence representing Mars. Mars is occupant of 8, owner of 3, 10. Star lord Saturn is 
occupant of 8, owner of 1. Sub lord Mercury is occupant of 6, owner of 6, 8. Thus dasa lord 
Rahu signifies 8 and is connected with 10, 6. So getting loan from bank is sure. Rahu is in the 
RP. 


Bhukti lord Sun is in the star of Mercury and sub of Saturn. Sun is occupant and owner of 7. 
Star lord Mercury is occupant of 6, owner of 5, 6, 8. Sub lord Saturn is occupant of 8, owner 
of 1. Thus bhukti lord Sun signifies 5, 6, 8 and is connected with 8. So getting loan from bank 
is sure. This antra runs up to 03-03-2013. Sun is in the RP. 


To get a narrowed timing we need to check antra lord. Running antra is Jupiter up to 12-09- 
2012. As 6t8 cusp sub lord indicates 8, dasa lord indicates 8 and bhukit lord also indicates 8, 
giving indication of late event. So I look for next Saturn antra. But Saturn is not in the RP, so 
it needs to check next antra Mercury from 03-11-2012 to 19-12-2012. Mercury is in the RP. 
Mercury is in the star of Saturn and sub of Venus. Mercury is occupant of 6, owner of 5, 6, 8. 
Star lord Saturn is occupant of 8, owner of 1. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 5, owner of 4, 9. 
No planet is in the star of Venus and Venus is the CSL of 2, 5, 8, 10. Thus Mercury signifies 8, 
and is connected with 6. 


My opinion: You will get loan from bank during 03-11-2012 to 19-12-2012.

2012.

K.P. Analysis - Hip bone fracture and 


replacement surgery 
By: Gunti Nagaraju, M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
KP astrologer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27172206; 9490752371 
Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 





Background 


The hip is prone to several types of injuries. Sometimes these happen in otherwise healthy 
joints also through-— an automobile accident or a fall in the bath room resulting in breaking of a 
bone or forcing the femoral head out of its socket. In other cases, joints compromised by con- 
genital deformities or osteoporosis, for example, leave the hip vulnerable to injury upon the 
slightest trauma. The following are some of the more common hip injuries. 


Hip Joint 

Broken hip. A broken hip, or hip fracture, can occur at any 
age, but they are most common in people aged 65 and older, 
particularly women, with osteoporosis. In a younger person 
with healthy bones it may take a serious injury, such as a 
car accident, to break a hip, but when osteoporosis weakens 
remoraitead | DOMES, even a minor fall due to a slip either in the bath 
rooms or on smooth surfaces can result in a fracture. 


Articular Cartilage 





‘ ; Femoral Neck Fracture 
What is a hip replacement surgery? 


Hip replacement, also called total hip arthroplasty, is a ecaine 
surgical procedure to replace a worn out or damaged 

hip with prosthesis (an artificial joint). This surgery may 
be considered following a hip fracture (breaking of the 
bone) or for someone who has severe pain due to arthri- 
tis. 


Femur 


(Thigh Bone) 


Femoral 
Neck Fracture 


Pelvic Bone 





Various types of arthritis may affect the hip joint. Osteo- 

arthritis, a degenerative joint disease that affects mostly middle-aged and older adults, may 
cause the breakdown of joint cartilage and adjacent bone in the hips. Rheumatoid arthritis, 
which causes inflammation of the synovial lining of the joint and results in excessive synovial 
fluid, may lead to severe pain and stiffness. Traumatic arthritis, arthritis due to injury, may al- 
so cause damage to the articular cartilage of the hip. 

The goal of hip replacement surgery is to replace the parts of the hip joint that have been dam- 
aged and to relieve hip pain that cannot be controlled by other treatments. 

A traditional hip replacement involves an incision several inches long over the hip joint. A new- 
er approach that uses one or two smaller incisions to perform the procedure is called minimally 
invasive hip replacement. However, the minimally invasive procedure is not suited for all candi- 
dates for hip replacement. The physician will determine the best procedure for a person, based 
on that individual's situation.

Example of 
an Artificial Hip 





Osteoporosis is the leading cause of hip fracture. Age is also a major risk factor. Other possible 
risk factors for hip fracture may include, but are not limited to, the following: 


e excessive alcohol and caffeine consumption 
e lack of physical activity 
e low body weight 
e tall stature 

e vision problems 
e dementia 

e medications that cause bone loss 

e cigarette smoking 

e institutional living, such as an assisted-care facility 

Increased risk for falls, related to conditions such as weakness, disability, or unsteady gait. 
Other preventive measures may include: 

e taking medications as prescribed by your physician to prevent bone loss 

eating a calcium-rich diet including milk, cottage cheese, yogurt, sardines, and broccoli 
stopping smoking 

avoiding excessive alcohol use 

keeping objects off the stairs and floors, such as electrical cords, to prevent falls 

using slip-resistant rugs next to the bathtub and installing grab bars in the tub 
positioning night lights from the bedroom to the bathroom 

using rug pads or non-skid backing to keep rugs in place 

not using unsteady furniture or step ladders to stand on 

Visiting an ophthalmologist every year to have vision checked annually and vision loss treated. 


K.P. RULES FOR ACCIDENT (KP-Ezine July 2009) 


If the Asc. or 8th cusp sub lord is the significator of house 8 (accident) or 12 confinement to the 
bed or hospitalization) and in connection to Mars (Karaka for accident), Saturn, Rahu and 
Ketu, then the native is likely will meet with an accident during the joint period of significators 
of house 8 or 12. 


The 6 house signification indicates injury or sickness. Death is indicated only by the significa- 
tors of Maraka and Badhaka houses. 


RECOVERY FROM AILMENT 
If the sub lord of the 6th cusp is also the significator of house 1, 5 and 11, there are chances of 
recovery from ailment.

On a Saturday dated 30% August of 1997, in the afternoon, my colleague and Doctor 
(Ayurveda), Mrs. V, who was in an advanced pregnancy condition, posed a question: “ Can 
you tell me : When will I deliver ? Is it possible to know the gender?” 


My wrist-watch showed that the time was 15 hours 15 minutes and I decided to use the rul- 
ing planets of that time to guide me in solving this query. 


The place of analysis: Palghat — Kerala State. 
K.P. New Ayanamsa value used in this calculation was: 23°.44’.03”. 


At the time of analysis the Lagna was transiting, in the Zodiac, at 2619.55’.53”, in the sign 
Sagittarius ruled by Jupiter, and in the star “Purvashada” ruled by Venus, while the sub- 
portion as well as the sub-sub portion got ruled by Saturn. 


The Moon was transiting at 105°. 02’.45”, in the sign Cancer owned by the Moon, in the star 
of Saturn: “Pushya”, while the sub-portion as well as the sub-sub-portion being held by Ju- 
piter . 


The genuineness and eagerness of the queries is reflected in her query and is amply project- 
ed, for, the Moon, which is the karaka planet for mind, is placed in the star of ‘Pushya’ 
whose lord also happens to be the ‘kutumbha bhaavanaatha’, as far as this horary is con- 
cerned, receiving aspect from the karaka for child-birth’, Jupiter, who is currently in retro- 
gression, and in the sub-portion, again, of Jupiter. 


Thus, we see here that the ruling planets appearing at the time of analysis, is a Jupiter- 
Venus- Moon-Saturn combination. The node Ketu represents Saturn, being in occupation of 
the sign Aquarius owned by Saturn while the other node, Rahu, is conjoined with Sun, and 
Mercury who traces the path of travel in retrogression, in the sign Leo. Lagna lord Jupiter, 
who is also the Karaka planet for children’, aspected by Mars, the lord of 5t8 bhaava, which 
represents child-birth. Mars himself, by occupying the sign Libra, aspects the 5th bhaava as 
well as the lagna lord, who is in Capricorn. Libra happens to be the 11t, a bhaava- pointer of 
fulfillment of desires. The node Ketu, who stands as a representative for the kutumbhabhaa- 
vanaatha Saturn, is getting aspected by other fast moving planets: the Sun and Mercury. 
Representing these two planets we have the node Rahu, in the star ‘Purvaphalghuni’ owned 
by another fast moving planet: ‘Venus’. It is also seen that this Venus is receiving aspect 
from the lord of 2"4 house, Saturn. 


The day lord was Saturn and since the star ruling on that day too being that of Saturn, who 
is aspecting the lagna-star-lord ‘Venus’, I concluded that the momentous event too could 
take place on such a day where these planets should be ruling and significant by their pres- 
ence. 


As explained above, the birth is to take place quite soon. When that would be is the golden 
query. The RP was examined on a day, ruled by Venus and Saturn, and the day is almost 
over. The next day is Sunday, ruled by the fast moving planet ‘the Sun’. It is possible that the 
event takes place on this day for, the lord of the day’s star is ruled by Mercury (star: Asle- 
sha). But this is not to be, since lagna of the RP is aspected by Saturn, a slow moving plan- 
et and who is in retrogression, which is capable of posing delay. Besides, Mercury too is ret- 
rograde and is conjoined with Rahu. As a node, Rahu will not sanction the event, till on any 
other opportune moment, when the planet itself can exert her influence strongly. This is an- 
other pointer to the delay in execution.

The next day is of ‘the Moon’ and star is of Kethu. Will the birth take place on this day? Kethu, 
as we have noted, represents the lord of 2.4 bhaava which is having a bearing on the ‘increase 
in members into a kutumbha’. See closely: Kethu occupies the star of Jupiter who is in retro- 
gression. Hence we can rule out the event taking place on this date as well. 


The next day is ruled by Mars and Mars is the lord of 5t# bhaava, which signifies child-birth. 
Though this can trigger the event, this too may not to be so, because Mars has not appeared 
among the ruling planets at the time of analysis and hence conspicuous, by its absence. 


The next day that is to follow is one ruled by the planet Mercury and star of the day is 
“Uthraashada”, ruled by the Sun. Any chance for the event to happen on this day? NO! For, the 
node Rahu is conjoined and will not allow the event to happen till on such a day when her in- 
fluence can be revealed! 


Following next are days ruled by Jupiter (in retro) having Moon’s star; then Venus’ day having 
Mars’ star. These also are eliminated from the list of possible dates. Now what remains of the 
week is ‘Saturday’. 


On Saturday, the star lord would be the node Rahu. This would be the 6t8 September. But wait! 
The star “Swaathi” begins in the afternoon (12.27.37 PM) of the day only and this extends to 
the next day, Sunday, too. Here, then, the node Rahu can represent the day lord also, besides 
being lord of the star. Hence the child birth can take place only on this combination, I 


concluded. This information, that the birth will be after the Sunset of Saturday and before that 
of Sunday, was passed over to the querist. She appeared settled emotionally. 


Then, the next query she put startled me. She asked: I am unable to contain my curiosity, so 
tell me, what the gender would be, of the baby to come out ‘. Again I looked up at the ‘ruling 
planets’ for any clue. 


On the day and at the time of analysis of this horary, it can be seen that the following was the 
disposition of planets: 


The self effulgent Sun was tenanting the star “Purvaashaada”, ruled by Venus, a feminine plan- 
et; 

The reflecting Moon was in “Pushya”, owned by Saturn, who receives aspect from Venus; 

Both Mercury and the node, Rahu, were tenanting “Purvaashada” ; 

Venus was in “Hastha”, ruled by the Moon, another feminine planet, while Mars was in 
“Swaathv’; 

Jupiter tenants in “Sravana”, ruled by the planet Moon, receiving her aspect; 

The node Kethu in “Purvabhaadrapada” and Saturn in “Revatht”. 

As we have seen Lagna rises in “Purvaashaada”. 


Thus it is seen that most of the planets were tenanting the star belonging to planets which are 
feminine, serving as a pointer for an answer to the specific query. Thus the ruling planets have 
given me their decision and direction. 


I answered her that the child would be a female as revealed by “the ruling plants at the 
time of analysis of her query “. 


What happened.....

ceived a call from another colleague to tell that Mrs. Dr. V became the mother of a female child 
at 04-48 AM on this day. 

The child has lagna rising in Cancer (28°.51’.46”), a sign ruled by Moon, and star on that day 
was “Swaaathi” ruled by the node Rahu, falling in the sign Libra ruled by Venus.

Points in Identifying the Medical Persons 


“VAIDYO NARAYANO HARI” is a very popular statement given by our ancestors. So let us try 
to know clearly how to predict that a birth chart which is given to us belongs to a medical 
doctor. 


Now-a-days we are considering the following points to identify the medical persons according 
to K.P. 


(1) The profession is indicated by the combination of the co-rulers of the 10t cusp, the dasa 
lord and the planets situated very close to the 10t® cusp. 


(2) 2nd house represents the income received, the money earned on account of service, pro- 
fession, business etc. The second house is the fifth from the tenth house which promotes the 
tenth house matters. 

6th house indicates the daily attendance, the daily labour put in by a person in one’s job. The 
sixth house is the ninth house for the tenth house which is a trinal (Kona) house and also has 
a very good relation in regard bhagyam. 

10th house denotes the name and fame, highest position gained by one in the professional or 
business field. 

“One’s profession is judged from 10th bhava. The sign lord, star lord and the sub lord and fi- 
nally along with the planets near the 10t* cusp within the prescribed Orb. In any profession 
be it agriculture, service, business, legal, medical or engineering; the period i.e. Dasa, Bhukti 
are the prime factors and they must signify 2,6,10 and 11*t) for the prospects and the 10th 
cusp sub lord should signify 2,6,10 and 11 houses” 

So, we are considering 2, 6 , 10 & 11 houses at the time of judging the profession of a person. 


(3) Sun, Jupiter and Mercury are the Key planets for medical profession. 


(4) Mars is for surgery; Rahu also has a good link for medical education and medical pro- 
fession as it indicates poisons; Sun is known as “DHANWANTARI” chief karaka for medical 
profession. Mercury stands for quick diagnosis and judgment; Jupiter stands for good 
knowledge in “Materia Medica.” Mars-Jupiter- Venus-Sun = Ayurvedic; Jupiter-Sun-Saturn = 
Homeopathy; Sun and Jupiter = Nature cure. 


(5) Generally watery signs/fruitful signs (Cancer, Scorpio & Pisces) and Virgo (Hospital 
Sign) are connected to 24, 6th and 10th houses. Scorpio indicates medicine, chemicals and 
mortuary. Pieces show isolation, hospital, sanatorium, asylum etc. Leo denotes medicine. 

For people who enter into the medical services as indicated by Sun, the following combina- 
tions of planets will indicate the nature of their specialization. 

Sun with Jupiter produces good Physicians and Mercury gives intuition and helps to diagnose 
correctly. 

Sun receiving beneficial aspects from Mars brings out able Surgeons a Mars indicates use of 
sharp instruments. 

Sun, Venus and Jupiter help specialization in maternity, since Sun denotes medicine, Venus 
women and Jupiter the chief governor for children. 

If Venus receives aspects from the active and bold Mars and the secretive Saturn and con- 
joined with Sun, the person will be an expert in Venereal Diseases. 

If Sun and Saturn are mutually connected the person will specialize in skin diseases as Sat- 
urn spoils the beauty given by Venus. 

Sun and Venus devoid of other planets influences occupying the sixth or the eighth house 
show that he will be an Optician.

Significations of Related Houses 
Let us recollect the karakatwas of 6th, 8th, 12th, 10%, 1st and 11th bhavas only. 


6th house: - This house is known as “House of Sickness”. The Kanya the sixth house of natu- 
ral zodiac is the house of health, dietary habits and hygiene, dealing with doctors and medical 
professionals. It indicates disease, sickness and sanitation. The 6th is concerned with diseases, 
the 12th with hospitalization, and the 11t which is 12th to the 12th house and 6 to the 6th 
house gives discharge from the hospitals. This is an important house for those who have to do 
with nursing and treatment of the sick. This house is also connected with work and service 
rendered by the individual. It is also the house of debt or borrowing. It also rules the working 
class, industries, sanitation and public health. 


8th house: - This house is called the “House of Death”. The lagna indicates carnation and the 
8th indicates discarnation. It is also being considered as the end of the man’s life in this world. 
It denotes surgeons, medical officers, health inspectors, slaughter houses, butchers etc. The 
Scorpio the eighth house of the natural zodiac indicates all affairs of death, accidents, opera- 
tions, surgeons and medical officers. 


12th house: - This house indicates expenses, life in foreign places, hospitalization, feet, intrigue 
and imprisonment, and also the secret inimical activities, (6 house related to open inimical 
activities). If the planet in the 12th house has anything to do with houses 2, 6 & 10, service in 
hospital is indicated. If the planet in 12 has no connection with 2"4 and 10t* but has to do with 
6th house alone, then one may be admitted in hospital for treatment. The twelfth house of the 
natural zodiac is Meena which denotes nursing homes, asylums, sanitation, hospitals. 


1st house or Ascendant or Lagna: - Lagna signifies the native’s general appearance, character 
and temperament. It is an important factor in the matter of health. It describes the native’s 
status in life, honour, dignity, prosperity, and general well being, native’s residence abroad. 
This house is the signification of any changes in the individual’s life. 10t#house: - It is related 
to all matters affecting one’s name, fame, honour, and recognition, public esteem, power and 
prestige, credit and conduct, all over success, rank and renown, reputation and respect, ambi- 
tion and authority, popularity among the public, honour from Government, seal of authority, 
doctor, medicine, retirement from the world, connection with the people in high position, moral 
responsibilities, one’s promotion, advancement appointment, affluence through profession, 
service or business etc. 2, 6 & 10 houses are called the material trinity houses because they 
correspond with the natural zodiac which are earthy signs representing material gains. 


11th house: - It is known as “Labhasthana” denoting profit or gain.

Marriage of Son, When? 
By: Er. V.K. Sharma 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA 
Superintending Engineer (Retired.), Punjab State Electricty Board, 
#104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, Mohali (Chandigarh). 

Cell — 094171 17370, nickO&885@gmail.com 
HH Sa 
A lady from Chandigarh brought a birth horoscope of her son on dated 2-8-2009 and she 
asked me check astrologically when her son would be married. The birth particulars are as un- 
der: 





Date of birth of boy 2-6-1983 
Time of birth 9:02 P.M. 
Place of birth Chandigarh 


KP Straight Line (Adjusted) Ayanamsa is applied. 


What does K.P. Astrology say about marriage? 
If 7+ cusp sublord is significator of 2,7 or 11, then marriage is promised in the joint period of 
significators of 2, 7 and 11. 


7th cuspal sublord 

7th cusp sublord is Saturn in 10 lord of 2 and 3 and its starlord is Mars in 5 lord of 5 and it is 
in the sub of Venus in 7 lord of 11. Hence 7t8 cusp sublord is significator of 2, 7 and 11. So as 
per K.P. Astrology marriage is promised. 


224 cuspal sublord 
2nd cuspal Sublord is also Saturn as in the case of 7 cusp sublord. So as stated above, 2nd 
cusp sub lord is also significator of 2,7 and 11 which is conducive for marriage. 


11t: cuspal sublord 

11th cusp sublord is Mercury in 4, almost exact on 5t* cusp, lord of 7. Mercury having no planet 
in its star becomes the strong significator of 11t* house by being the cuspal sublord of 11th 
house; it is in the star of Venus in 7 lord of 11 and it is again in the sub of own. Hence 11% 
cusp sublord is significator of 7 and 11 which is conducive for marriage. 


On the day of judgment dated 3-8-2009, the boy was running Jupiter Mahadasha and Ketu 
Bhukti from 2-8-2009 to 10-7-2010. 


Mahadasha of Jupiter 
Jupiter is in 11 lord of 1 and 4, and in the star of Saturn lord 2 and 3 and in the sub of Moon 
in 2. Hence Jupiter mahadasha is significator of 2 and 11 which is conducive for marriage. 


Ketu Bhukti Dasha 

Ketu is in 12. Ketu is aspected by Saturn lord of 2 and 3; it is in the star of own and in the sub 
of Venus in 7 lord of 11. Hence Ketu Bhukti is significator of 2,7 and 11, conducive for mar- 
riage. 


Check Antra Dasha 

Jupiter / Ketu / Venus 23-8-2009 to 18-10 2009 

Reject this antra of Venus as Venus is in the star of retrograde Jupiter. 
[Jupiter is retrograde from 16-6-2009 to 13-10-2009.| 


Jupiter /Ketu /Sun 18-10-2009 to 5-11-2009 
Reject this antra of Sun as Sun is not the R.P. of birth. 


Jupiter / Ketu /Moon 5-11-2009 to 3-12-2009 
Reject this antra of Moon as Moon is not in the R.P. of birth.

Sub Lord tally with RP Moon, we should move the birth time ahead or previous within few

Question & Answer 


By: Tin Win 
E-mail: tw853@yahoo.com 








Question- 1: 


Is tt possible to predict from one’s birth chart whether one would be selected or not in the medical 
entrance exam.? 


Is it necessary to know the date of declaration of results? 
Answer- 1: Entrance Exam. 


It is possible to predict from one’s birth chart whether one would be selected or not in the medi- 
cal entrance examination. Because the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of a house of the natal or horary 
chart indicates whether the matter of the house is promised or not, and the significators point 
the time of event by the joint dasa period which agrees with transit. 


Here for college entrance exam. , if the 4t8 CSL is the significator of house 4, 9, 11, also 6 in 
competitive nature, one would be selected during the joint dasa period of significators of house 
4,9, 11, also 6 in competitive nature. 


It is not necessary to know the date of declaration of results because it should be judged by the 
joint dasa period on the day of sitting the examination when the event takes place. 
In addition the date of declaration of results may not be generally known in advance. 


Question- 2: Combination for Paralysis 
How occurrence of paralysis can be predicted using the K P principles? 
Answer-2: 


Paralysis is mainly due to the blockage of blood circulation affecting the tissue and nerves that 
controls the muscle. It is usually caused by nervous affection of sudden strokes, polio, paresis, 
muscular dystrophy etc. An alternative kind is caused by rupture of blood vessels when an ac- 
cident , fall or hit occurs causing severe injury. 


The following most common combination has been found for paralysis in looking at the 15 hor- 
oscopes of the paralysis disease. 


The 6 cuspal sub lord’s connection to house 12 (bed ridden, hospitalization), 9 (paralysis), 8 
(fatal disease, incident, injury), 6 (sickness) and Saturn (tissue, giver of a chronic disease like 
paralysis), Mercury (chief governor of nerves), Mars (giver of all sort of inflammation, pains and 
high fever, accident, ruler of blood,) would cause paralysis during the joint dasa period of sig- 
nificators of house 6,8,9,12, Badhaka, Maraka and connected with Saturn, Mercury or Mars. 


The 3" house (hand and leg in general and paralysis) signification and Saturn-Uranus connec- 
tion for paralysis in Western have been found valid in some cases only, and they may be con- 
sidered as supporting indicators. The most common rasi-signs cannot be pinned down. 


Out of 15 charts under observation, the 2 charts have attached and analyzed as follows: 


Chart- 1: Male, April 24, 1979, 9:52 am IST, Kolkata - WB; 22n32, 88e21, had a stroke (right 
side paralysis) on August 22, 2007. 


6th cusp (Scorpio 19° 56' 49") is ruled by sign lord Mars, star lord Mercury and sub lord Venus.

This is a serial review of some of over one hundred KP based books in English. The present 
book “The Times Horary Astrology (A Novel Approach to Predictions)” is found reprinted under 
the new title as shown below: 


New Dimensions of K. P. Astrology (Book Review in KP-Ezine June 2012 issue) 


by Dr. Arastu Prabhakar 
Diamond Pocket Books, New Delhi, 2007, 238 pages 


Sos ae 








KPEzine May-2013 59 


The book “The Times Horary Astrology (A Novel Approach to Predictions) or New Dimensions of K. 
P. Astrology” is the English translation of the Times Prasna Jyotish (Hindi). It is based on the KP 
horary, where a randomly chosen number between 1 and 249 by the querent is co-related with 
a randomly chosen time of judgment by the astrologer to arrive at a specific answer to a specific 
question. And the Placidus cusps and KP ayanamsa are used. However in some cases there are 
different views from the common practice of KP, and some principles of traditional astrology 
have been incorporated with the K.P. system. 


In the theory part of this book, the background and basic principles of horary astrology have 
been explained, and the practical examples are presented with details in the second part of case 
studies according to house by house - first to twelfth- as shown in the contents. 


Ruling planets mean the planets which rules the moment at the time of judgment of any ques- 
tion. (page 62 of Horary Astrology/ page 60 of New Dimensions of K.P. Astrology; the same as in 
the KP Reder VI, pages 138, 141, 201). Consequently in the KP horary using number 1 - 249, 
the sign lord and star lord of the rising Ascendant or 1st cusp at the “time of judgment” by the 
astrologer are considered as the ruling planets. But according to the view in this book, such 
way of selection of the ruling planets is to be applied only when the query is solved by the “time 
chart’ without using a horary number. And the sign lord and star lord of Ascendant or 1st cusp 
of the “horary number’ are worked out as the ruling planets when the question is solved with 
the help of horary number 1- 249. (page 66 of first book/ page 64 of second book) Regarding 
the day lord in the ruling planets, the day of cwil time changing after 12.00 midnight is used. 
(page 20 in both books) In KP the period from the sunrise to next sunrise is taken as day like in 
the traditional astrology. ((KP Reader VI, page 138) 


There are also some different views in considering the main house in the house grouping, for 
instance 9th house, not 12th house in KP, for foreign going; 4th house, not 10‘ house, for sale of 
house/ property. (pages 148-149, 182-183 of first book/ pages 174-176,222-224 of second book, 
KP Reader III pages 134, 321; KP Reader VI pages 177, 268, 301) 


The positive and negative impacts of retrograde planets have been considered in line with the 
KP horary astrology. (pages 73-74 of first book/ 71-72 of second book) 


The book is unique blending of K.P. as well as traditional astrology. K.P. astrology is getting mo- 
mentum day by day due to its practical utility and for making scintillating predictions.

Background Note: The Querent is doing manufacturing business of machinery parts. One day, 
he received an e-mail from a company belongs to Geneva stating that his company is selected 
for Credential Award Programme 2012 on company’s behalf. He is suggested to fill the Appli- 
cation Form and deposit/transfer the money to get participation/nomination of his company, 
so that his companies will able get the Credential Award Certificate alongwith prize money. But 
there is a doubt in Querent’s mind about the genuineness of the mail received by him through 
company of Geneva. The Querent is sure that he is not contacted in any manner to any compa- 
ny belongs to Geneva. Neither his company exported any products to any company belongs to 
Geneva. So, the question arises in Querent’s mind that if he accept the offer by Geneva’s Com- 
pany by transfer or deposited the money, whether he will be cheated or not? 











BEING CHEATED OR NOT - A KP ANALYSIS 

Question of the Querent: Will I be cheated by accepting the Credential Award Winning Certifi- 
cate & Prize Money Offer which is offered on e-mail by the company belong to Geneva? 

Horary Number: 121 (out of 249). 

Time of Judgment: 16-12-2012 (Sunday), 16:14 Hrs. (IST). 

Place of Judgment: Park Street, Kolkata, W.B. (Long/Lat: 22N27, 88E20) 


Moon reveals the nature of query 

Moon (Capricorn 13-49-18) is in the star of Moon and sub of Rahu. Moon is the occupant of 4, 
owner of 11. Starlord Moon is the occupant of 4, owner of 11. Sublord Rahu is the occupant of 
2. Rahu acts an agent of Mercury and Venus. Mercury, being untenanted, is the occupant of 2, 
owner of 1-10, CSL of 6, 12. Venus, being untenanted, is the occupant of 2, owner of 2, 9, CSL 
of 9. Moon signifies the relevant house i.e. 2 (Money), 12 (Loss or Expense), hence query is gen- 
uine. 


Being Cheated or Not? 

If the cuspal sub lord of 12th (Loss or Expense) be the significator of 5 (OQpponent’s Gain or Prof- 
it) or 8 (Hindrances, Difficulties, Obstacles, Money blockage) or 12 (Loss or Expense of native) 
and in connection with Saturn or Mars, one will be cheated during the joint period (DBA) of sig- 
nificators of 5, 8 or 12. 


CUSPAL ANALYSIS 


12%» cusp: Leo 25-06-40 (Sun-Venus-Mercury): The sublord Mercury is in star of Saturn and 
sub of Rahu. 


Mercury, being untenanted, is the occupant of 2, owner of 1, 10, CSL of 6, 12. Starlord Saturn 
is the occupant of 1, owner of 5, 6. Sublord Rahu is the occupant of 2. Rahu acts an agent of 
Mercury and Venus. Mercury, being untenanted, is the occupant of 2, owner of 1-10, CSL of 6, 
12. Venus, being untenanted, is the occupant of 2, owner of 2, 9, CSL of 9. 


12th CSL Mercury, being connected to Saturn, signifies 2 (Money,) 5 (Opponent’s Gain or Prof- 
it) , 12 (Loss or Expense of native) and in connection with 2 (Money), 12 (Loss or Expense of na- 
tive). Hence, being cheated from Chit-Fund Company is assured. 


DBA Analysis: On the day of judgment, DBA of Moon-Rahu-Mars (From 03-12-2012 to 02-01- 
2013) was running. 


Moon posited is in sign of Saturn and signifies or in connection with 2, 12. 
Rahu posited in sign of Mars and signifies or in connection with 2, 12. 
Mars, aspected by Saturn, signifies or in connection with 8, 12.

Hints 


If the cuspal sub lord of the 6th or 10th be the significator of 2, 6 or 10 service or earning is 
promised during the joint period of the significators of 2, 6 and 10. 


6th cusp. (Virgo 04°.43’.04”): The sub lord of the 6th cusp is Saturn. Saturn is in the star of 
Mars and sub of Mercury. Saturn is occupant of 6, owner of 10, 11. Star lord Mars is occupant 
of 6, owner of 1, 8. Sub lord Mercury is occupant of 4, owner of 3, 6. Thus 6 sub lord Saturn 
is signifies 6, 8 and connected with 6, 10, 11. 6th sub lord signifies 6, 10, 11 so there is a 
chance for job but 8 indicate delay. 


Hints 

If the cuspal sub lord of the 2nd (9th from 6th) be the significator of 9(abroad/long journey) or 
12(Stay in abroad) and connected with 2, or 6 or 11, the foreign travel for job is promised dur- 
ing the joint period of the significator of 3, 9 and 12. 


Cuspal Sub lord

Saturn and sub of Mercury. Rahu is occupant of 7. Rahu is in Scorpio sign, hence represent 
Mars. Mars is occupant of 6, owner of 1, 8. Star lord Saturn is occupant of 6, owner of 10, 11. 
Sub lord Mercury 4, owner of 3, 6. Thus 2"¢ sub lord not signifies 9 or 12 so there is a no 
chance for job in abroad.
