Will I be able to fulfill my desire and let out my entire building on commercial basis? 


On 21 March 2013, at 8.30.00 AM, my brother-in-law came to me and posed the above ques- 
tion, giving me horary no. 12. Immediately I took up the case and erected a horary chart- the 
details of which are furnished below. 


Date of judgement-21 March 2013: Time of judgement-8.31.39 AM : 
Place- Hyderabad; Horary number - 12/249. 


As my brother-in-law wanted know the instant answer for his query, I erected a chart as per 
the “theory of shot prediction” (T S P) of Dr. Kar, taking Saturn’s effect also. (Planetary positions 
for 05-30 AM on 21 March 2013) As per the chart — 


Asc. lords are — Mars(SGL)-Venus(STL)--Moon(SBL)---Moon(SSBL); 
Moon lords are-Merc(SGL)-Jupiter(STL)-Jupiter(SBL)-Saturn(SSBL). 
Day lord- Jupiter. 


As per T S P of Dr. Kar- the ascendant sub sub lord is Moon and so the expected outcome is 
positive. Hence the answer is YES. 


As per the horary chart prepared, the ascendant sub lord is Moon and Moon is the lord of 4‘ 
house placed in 3 cusp. This shows that the question/wish contemplated is about his own 
house. 


Moon is the lord of 4 house placed in 34 house. Third house also indicates about his wish to 
issue an advertisement for letting his house. 


Moon is aspected by Mars, lord of 8 shows that he is worried about the outcome of his pro- 
posal. 


Ruling planets on 21 -03 -2013 @ 08-31-39 AM 

Asc —Aries- Mars-Venus-Moon: 

Moon rasi- Gemini-Mercury-Jupiter-Saturn 

Day lord— Jupiter. 

So the RPs are — Mars, Venus, Moon, Merc, Jup and Saturn. 


Materialisation of the event- Since the event has to happen within days we have to consider 
lagna and Moon. Both should transit in star and sub of the above ruling planets. 


A. Moon transits in Mercury sign, Moon star, Jupiter sub on 27-3-2013. 
B. Moon transits in Saturn sign, Jupiter star, Mercury sub on 8-4-2013. 


Result— my brother-in-law entered into lease agreement with an educational institution on 8 
March 2013 at 21.29.05 hours at Hyderabad. 

The lagna rising at that time was— Scorpio-Mars(SGL)-Sani(STL)-Mer(SBL)-Jup(SS_ L). Jupiter 
was aspecting the lagna.

joined with Mars, Venus and Sun. All the planets are in the ruling planets.

Let us see the swearing in chart . 
First, we will check the longevity of the Government.

Here the Asc cuspal sublord is Venus. Venus is lord of 4 and 11 (Badhaka) in 10% house. Ve- 
nus is in the star and sub of Moon. Moon is lord of Lagna in the 11t* House (Badhaka). Asc 
cuspal sublord represents 1, 10, 11 (Badhaka) and so the longevity of the government is ex- 
pected to be medium. 


Wealth of the Govt : 

If 2.4 cuspal sublord signifies 5,8,12, then no wealth. If 2.4 cuspal sublord signifies 5,8,12 
along with 2,6,10,11, then some wealth. If 2.4 cuspal sublord signifies 2,6,10,11 without 
5,8,12, then enormous wealth . 

Here 224 cuspal sublord is Mars. Mars is lord of 5 and 10 in 10. Mars is in the star of Venus 
and sub of Saturn. Venus is lord of 4 and 11 in 10% house. Saturn is lord of 7 and 8 in 34 
house. Hence 2™4 cuspal sublord signifies 10,11 along with 5 and 8. Hence some wealth is indi-

Mrs. P D, who is employed in an European Country, asked through her mother in India: 

"I have remitted the required Euro Dollars, towards examination fee for taking my ‘driving li- 
cense test that is scheduled for the coming Wednesday. My friends have informed me that the 
test would not be an easy one. Will I clear the test successfully?”..... 

Horary number selected by the aspirant is “3” (between 1 — 249). 

This query was analysed as per details below: 











RULING PLANETS 
The ruling planets according to the horary chart for the given number and time chart at the 
time of judgment, 07/12/2011 : 15:33:00 : Palakkad (previously known as Palghat), Kerala, 
are as given under: 
Ruling Planets 

Horary Time 


Chart Chart 
Day Lord Mer Mer 
Moon Sign Lord Mar Mar 
Moon Star Lord Ven Ven 
(015-41-32 ) 
Moon Sub Lord Sun Sun 
Asc. Sign Lord Mar Mar 
Asc. Star Lord Ket Ven 
(014-27-38 ) 
Asc. Sub Lord Sun Ven 
Analysis : 


Ruling Planets for the selected horary number and those appeared at the time of analysis are 
same; normally, this array of planets should point to an encouraging outcome. But the ascend- 
ant star lord as well its sub lord in the Ruling Planets, Venus, receives aspect from Saturn , as 
lord of 12 . Not only that, the planet Venus happens to be the star lord of Moon in the Ruling 
Planets, also. Moon herself is conjoined with Jupiter, which is coursing a retro motion, pointing 
to the uncertainty about the result (lurking in the mind of the querist). Thus, the planets are al- 
ready acting as pointers that though she may be poised towards attempting and completing this 
exam, the _end result would be dissatisfying. 

This inference was conveyed to the concerned people. 

Days later, I was informed that : The test was for 45 minutes ; though she could satisfactorily 
manage till 444 minute, something went wrong in the last minute, and she could not get the 


anticipated license. 


When we vide the chart and positions of planets, we can see that the 11 cuspal sub lord is Ra- 
hu, who is strongly signifying 8 & 4 and is in the sub of Venus, and signifies houses 9 & 7. 
Besides, the node Rahu is conjoined with Sun and retrograde Mercury, both having significa- 
tion of house ‘8’ though they signify 6 & 11 also...!!!! However, here, we may note also that, Ra- 
hu is aspected by Mars, the lagna lord with significations of 9 & 5, thereby indicating the denial 
of the desired outcome in the native’s favour.

When will I have a child? a. 
Ezine | 


By: Er. V.K. Sharma 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA 
Superintending Engineer (Retired.), Punjab State Electricty Board, 
#104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, Mohali (Chandigarh). 
Cell — 09417117370, nickO885@gmail.com 




















A lady came to me along with her daughter who was quite worried about the birth of her first child, she 
asked me to check astrologically her daughter's delivery. I asked her daughter to intimate any horary 
number between 1 and 249, and her daughter told me a number as 7. 

Accordingly, I prepared the chart for the said number on dated 4-12-2010 at 4:29 pm at Chandigarh. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon is lord of 5 and posited in 7; its star is Jup [chief governor of child birth] is posited in 12 lord of 9 
and 10 and it is in the sub of Rahu in 9. Rahu is conjoined with Mars lord of 8. So Moon is linked with 
5[child birth], 8 [worries/tension], 12 [hospitalization]. Hence Moon reveals the nature of query. 


Gulbarga theory 

As per Gulbarga Theory, if sublord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon starlord or 
lagna starlord among the ruling planets, then query is to be answered in the affirmative, otherwise not. 
In the query under reference, the sublord of horary number is Jupiter and Moon starlord of R.P. is also 
Jupiter. So I told the querent that answer to her query is affirmative and she should not have any fear/ 
tension and she will be blessed with a child with the grace of God. 


K.P. rule for child birth 

As per horary astrology sixth reader written by Sothida Mannan K.S. Krishnamurti page 191-192 
‘whether one is promised children or not’ is to be judged from the 5} cusp. 

One will be able to produce children if the following three conditions are simultaneously satisfied: 


[1] The sublord 5th cusp is not retrograde; 
[2] It is not posited in a constellation of a retrograde planet; and 
[3] It is a significator of either 2nd or 5th or 11th house. 


If any one of these three conditions is not satisfied, one will not be able to produce a child at all. 
To judge the time of birth of child one has to select the significators of houses 2, 5 &11 and predict the 
time during the conjoined period of the significators. 


5th cuspal sublord

Question: Why there is difference in Lagna Su-Ve-Sa [Sgl, Stl, SL] as seen from horary chart 
(21°:53':20") & Lagna mentioned in Ruling Planets Ve Ra Ju [Sgl, Stl, SL] at chart time &

99, judgment was on 25-02-1981 at 10.00 PM at Madras 80E17; 13N04 as mentioned in the

Answer- lL: 


Ruling planets mean the planets which rules the moment at the time of judgment of any ques- 
tion. (KP Reder VI, pages 138, 141, 201). Consequently in the KP horary prediction using 
number | — 249, the sign lord and star lord of the rising Lagna or 1st cusp at the “time of judg- 
ment” by the astrologer are considered as the ruling planets. 


The 1st cusp Libra 09:00:29 (Venus-Rahu- Jupiter) (Sgl-Stl-Sbl) of the attached Time Chart 
at the time of judgment, Wednesday, 25/Feb/1981, 10:00:00 PM IST, CHENNAI(MADRAS), 
TAMIL NADU, India, Lat: 13:04:00 N Lon: 80:17:00 E is considered for the ruling planets. 


The 1st cusp Leo 21:53:20 (Sun-Venus-Saturn) (Sgl-Stl-Sbl) of the attached Horary Chart of 
given no. 99 is not considered for the ruling planets. 


The Lagna of the time chart is variable and the Lagna of horary chart is constant according to 
the given horary number. The common KP practice is to take the Lagna of time chart at the 
time of judgment for the ruling planets. 


However, according to the Dr. Arastu Prabhakar’s view in his books, such way of selection of 
the ruling planets is to be applied only when the query is solved by the “time chart” without 
using a horary number. And the sign lord and star lord of Lagna or 1st cusp of the “horary 
chartr’ are to be worked out as the ruling planets when the question is solved with the help of 
horary number 1- 249. (The Times Horary Astrology: A Novel Approach to Predictions, page 66

When will I go overseas to meet my daughter? 
By: Er. V.K. Sharma 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA 
Superintending Engineer (Retired.), Punjab State Electricty Board, 
#104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, Mohali (Chandigarh). 
Cell — 09417117370, nickO885@gmail.com 


BREE EHREEREHEEHREREEHEEEHEEEEEEHEEEEEEEEEE EE = 
My wife was planning to travel overseas to meet her daughter who is settled in a foreign coun- 
try. Although I was also to accompany her, due to her curiosity which was quite evident, I 
asked her to intimate any horary number between 1 to 249. Accordingly she told me a horary 
number as 47, I made the K.P. chart for the said number on dated 7-5-2012 at 5:15 PM at 
Chandigarh. 


oo 
Ezine | 

















Moon reveals the nature of query 

Moon lord of 3 is in 6. Moon is in the star of Saturn deposited in 5, lord of 9 &10. It is in sub of 
Mars deposited in 3. Hence Moon is linked with 5 [daughter], 3 [12 to 4, moving out of resi- 
dence] 9 [long journey]. So query relates to quernt’s visit to her daughter in a foreign country. 


Gulberga theory 

If sublord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon star lord or Lagna star lord 
among the Ruling Planets, then query is to be answered in the affirmative, otherwise not. In the 
case under consideration sublord of horary number is Rahu and Rahu is in the sign of Mars 
and Lagna star lord of R.P. is also Mars. So the answer to the query is affirmative and I assured 
the the querent that she will surely travel to foreign country to visit her daughter. 


Confirmation through Ascendant Sublord 

In this case under reference, Asc sublord is Rahu in 6. Rahu is aspected by Venus in 12 lord of 
12. Rahu is the constellation of Saturn in 5 lord of 9 & 10. It is in the sub of Mars in 3. As Asc 
sublord signifies 5, 3, 9 and 12, the querent’s effort for travelling abroad to visit her daughter 
will mature. 


Ruling Planets of Dated 7-5-2012 at 5:15 PM at Chandigarh 


ASC SIGN LORD Venus 
MOON STAR LORD saturn 
MOON SIGN LORD Mars 
DAY LORD Moon 


K.P. rule for going abroad 

As per Horary astrology, Sixth Reader written by SOTHINDA MANNAN JYOTHISH MARTHAND 
K.S. KRISHNAMURTI, page 301, one is to judge 12‘ cusp and find whether the lord of the sub 
of 12th cusp is either retrograde or deposited in a constellation whose lord is retrograde . If ei- 
ther is retrograde one cannot go abroad. If the sublord and lord of the constellation in which 
The sublord is situated are in direct motion and if the sublord of the 12t4 is also a significator of 
either 3° or 9th or 12th one goes abroad. 


12th cusp sublord 

In this case 12th cusp sublord is Jupiter in 11. Jupiter having no planet in its stars becomes 
the significator of 12th house, by being the sublord of 12th cusp. Further sublord Jupiter is in 
the star of Sun in 11 and it is in the sub of Moon lord 3. Hence 12th cusp sublord and its star 
are not retrograde and it signifies 3 and 12 so it fulfill the necessary condition for foreign travel. 


Check for Mahadasha and Bhukti 


Mahadasha of Saturn 

Saturn is in 5 lord of 9 and 10. It is in the star of Mars in 3 lord of 6. It is in the sub of Mercury 
in 11. So Saturn Mahadasha is the significator 3 and 9 which is conducive for foreign travel 
and Saturn is also a ruling planet.

Bhukti of Mars 

Mars in 3 lord of 6. It is in the star of Ketu in 12. It is in the sub of Merc in 11. So Mars bhukti 
signifies 3 and 12, which is conducive for foreign travel and Mars is also a ruling planet at the 
time of judgment on 7-5-2012. Saturn Mahadasha- Mars Bhukti was running from 27-11- 
2011 to 06-1-2013. I told the querent that she will certainly go abroad to meet her daughter 
before 06-1-2013 i.e. before the expiry of Mars Bhukti on 06-1-2013. 


To check exact timing of event 

The event will take place when a planet passes in Rashi [sign] of Mahadasha lord and Star lord 
of the bhukti dasha lord or vice versa. When planet passes in a rashi of bhukti dasha lord and 
star lord mahadasha lord Sun will transits in Vrishak sign of Mars [bhukti lord] and anurada 
nakshtar of Saturn [mahadasha lord] from 20-11-2012 TO 2-12-2012. 


After making calculation as above, I further intimated the querent that, she will fly to the for- 
eign country between 20-11-2012 to 2-12-2012 to meet her daughter there. 


Actual facts of the case 

My wife who was planning to go abroad since long to meet her daughter but the visit could not 
be materialized due to one reason or other. As some discrepancy was pointed out by the offi- 
cials in Visa Office during 6 /2012 and same was got rectified only in 11 /2012 and Visa was 
issued in 11/2012. We were able to fly abroad on 6-12-2012. The delay was caused due to ef- 
fect of Saturn on Moon as Moon is having the starlord of Saturn [Punarphoo].

Question: Is the rumor about Beyonce's pregnancy is correct? 

Number. 228 (out of 249). Time of Judgment. 18-06-2013, Tuesday; 15-32-07 PM IST 
Place of Judgment. Kankariya- Anmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00’, 72° E 36'., 
Ayanamsha 23°.57'.17" 


Hints 

If the cuspal sub lord of 3™ house happens to be (in the star of the occupant or owner) Saturn, 
the rumor is false. If it is Mars, then it is mischievous. If it is Jupiter, it is true. And if the sub 
lord happen to be a planet connected with Saturn in any manner, the report is false; but con- 
nected with Jupiter, the report will be correct. This is the way to find out a rumor is believable 


or not. 


Cusp 34, (Taurus 06°.15’.41”): The sub lord of the 3rd cusp is Mercury. Mercury is in the star 
of Jupiter and sub of Venus. Here 3'4 sub lord connected with Jupiter, hence rumor is true. 


My opinion: Yes, Beyonce's is pregnant and rumor is true.

Short Background 

Edward Joseph Snowden is a former technical contractor for the National Security Agency 
(NSA) and Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) employee who leaked top secret U.S. surveillance 
programs, which were published by The Guardian and The Washington Post on June 6, 2013. 
According to Snowden, the leaks were an effort to expose what he believes is excessive govern- 
ment surveillance of the American people. 


On 14 June 2013, US federal prosecutors filed a sealed complaint, made public on 21 June, 
charging Snowden with theft of government property, unauthorized communication of national 
defense information and willful communication of classified intelligence with an unauthorized 
person; the latter two allegations are under the Espionage Act. 


Following Snowden's work for US government agencies and contractors, he left the United 
States on May 20, 2013, first for Hong Kong and then boarded a flight to Moscow on June 23, 
He has been still stuck in legal limbo in a Moscow airport transit area at the time of writing this 
article on June 28, 2013. 


http: //en.wikipedia.org /wiki/Edward_ Snowden 
Horoscope Analysis 


1. The triple conjunction of the Rahu (future destiny) to the Sun and Mars (motivation, warrior) 
in the sign Gemini (information, communication), in the 1st house, indicates someone who 
needs to communicate what he knows; 


2. This triple conjunction is in opposition to Neptune (04:16:37 Sagittarius), which indicates 
willingness to take risks, and also adds more seeming mystery about his motives and source of 
the information; 


3. The conjunction of two libration planets Jupiter-Uranus (12:38:34 Scorpio) in Scorpio 
(secrets) in the 6t house (his work) is opposite Mercury (information) in 12th house (exile, con- 
finement and secrets) and the Ascendant. This indicates the perfect chart for someone who 
handles confidential information and who actually have fierce desire for freedom. This also de- 
scribes his extraordinary intelligence as well as his tendency to get himself into international 
intrigues;

PROFESSION AS PER KP ASTROLOGY 


Profession is indicated by 10s house. Which profession the native will enjoy throughout life is 
determined by 10 cuspal sublord (CSL). 10 CSL will not indicate whether the native is going 
to make profit or losses in profession. It will only tell the native whether he/she will do busi- 
ness or service or both. Service is indicated from 6t house while business is indicated from 7‘ 
house. Business also includes independent profession like doctor, astrologer, engineer, self- 
employed profession, which is also indicated by 10 house. Therefore, if 10 CSL signifies 6 
house, the native will be in service. If it signifies 7" house, the native will do business. And if it 
signifies 10th house, the native will engaged in self-employed profession. 


If 10t CSL is Mercury or any other planet posited in dual sign (Gemini, Sagittarius, Pieces) or

TO OPEN A RESTAURANT AS A PROFESSION

there is an amusement involved in every restaurant business. Any business that caters to our 
pleasures or providing entertainment like restaurant comes under 5 house. 5th house also 
represents house of “people”. In every restaurant, there must be catering services through 
which orders of customers are met. 6 house denotes any type of services and Saturn is the 
chief karaka of service because Saturn in astrology is termed as “servant planet”. For enjoy- 
ments and pleasures Venus is considered as a chief karaka planet. Mercury is considered as a 
karaka of business. Mercury is also the karaka of 274 house and thus important for a restau- 
rant business.

Applying the KP rules for accident and death 


Rule 1- If a planet signifies Lagna bhava and it is in the sub of the significator of 8th house, 
one meets with danger. (KP Reader V, p 144/ 1971 edition p 138) 


Interrogation- 

Lagna bhava significator Sun is in house 8 and in the sub of Mars, which is in the star of Sun 
in 8. Another Lagna bhava significator Jupiter is in the star of Venus, lord of 8, and in its own 
sub. 


Rule 2 - If the sub lord of the Ascendant cusp (Pi 12:43:11) is deposited in the constellation of 
the significator of the 8th house, one will meet with accident. (KP Reader VI, p 155)

Dasa and Transit Analysis 


Accident 

At the time of the accident, the native was running Ketu-Jupiter- Jupiter- Ketu DBAS. Dasa 
and Sookshma lord Ketu is in 5, aspected by Mars in 10 (retirement from this world, treat- 
ments not effective, Paralokasadhana, Karmasthana), owner of 2 (Maraka), 9, placed in Can- 
cer representing Moon in 8 (accident, danger to life), owner of 5. Ketu is in the star of Mercury 
in 9, owner of 4 (end of everything), 7 (Badhaka, Maraka), and sub of Mars in 10, owner of 2, 
9. 

Bhukti and Antara lord Jupiter is in 2, owner of 1,1 O, in the star of Venus in 9, owner of 3, 8 
and sub of own Jupiter. 


Dasa and Sookshma lord Ketu was transiting in the star of Venus, owner of 8 (accident, dan- 
ger to life) and sub of Saturn in 7 (Badhaka, Maraka), owner of 11, 12 (Moksha, end of life). 
Bhukti and Antara lord Jupiter was transiting in the star of Mars in 10 (retirement from this 
world), owner of 2 (Maraka) and sub of Saturn in 7, owner of 11, 12. Luminary Sun was 
transiting in the star of Sun in 8 and sub of Mercury, owner of 4 (end of everything), 7. Anoth- 
er luminary MOOn was transiting in the star of own Moon in 8 and sub of Jupiter in 2, lord of 
1, 10. 


Death 

At the time of death, Sookshma lord Ketu changed to Venus, and the running DBAS was Ke- 
thu-Jupiter- Jupiter- Venus. 

As discussed above, Dasa lord Ketu signifies houses 5, 10 (retirement from this world, death), 
2 (Maraka), 9, 8 (death), 4 (end of everything, death), 7 (Badhaka, Maraka). 

Bhukti and Antara lord Jupiter signifies 2, 1, 10, 9, 3, 8. 

Sookshma lord Venus is in 9, lord of 3, 8, in the star of Ketu in 5, aspected by Mars in 10, 
owner of 2, 9, placed in Cancer representing Moon in 8, owner of 5, and sub of Jupiter in 2, 
lord of 1,10. 


Dasa lord Ketu was still transiting in the star of Venus, owner of 8 (death) and sub of Saturn 
in 7 (Badhaka, Maraka), owner of 12 (Moksha, end of life). Bhukthi and Antara lord Jupiter 
was also still transiting in the star of Mars in 10 (retirement from this world, death), owner of 
2 (Maraka) and sub of Saturn in 7, owner of 11, 12. Sookshma lord Venus was transiting in 
the star of Moon in 8 and sub of own Venus, owner of 8, as house of death. Luminary Sun 
was transiting in the star of Sun in 8 and sub of Venus, lord of 3, 8. Another luminary MOOn 
was transiting in the star of Mars in 10, owner of 2 and sub of Sun in 8, owner of 6. 


The DBAS lords at the time of both accident and death have been found signifying accident 
causing and death inflicting houses, especially repeated 8 and 4, 12, 6, Badhaka, Maraka, 
superseding weakly signified life saving houses 1, 5, 11. Similarly the DBAS lords and lumi- 
naries have been also found transiting in the stars and subs of significators of accident caus- 
ing and death inflicting houses. 


Observation 

For an accident it is firstly to check whether the 1st cuspal sub lord signifies particularly 
house 8 (accident, danger to life), also 6,12 and is connected with Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu; 
if it is found so, to check further whether the 8+ cuspal sub lord also signifies 8, 6, 12. If the 
Badhaka, Maraka are also involved, the accident may be fatal during the joint dasa period of 
significators of 4, 8, 12, 6 and Badhaka, Maraka when the longevity is no more promised. 


This analysis may be a strong evidence for the efficacy of applying the rational, simple and ac- 
curate KP rules for any type of event in a human life.

I was woken up from my mid-night dream-sleep on Sunday, the 26 June, 2011, by the non- 
stop telephone ring. A male voice, with perceptible urgency, introduced himself as Mr. M from 
U K, asked me: “I am faced with a potential catastrophe in my life, now, and I need a job im- 
mediately to get over my difficulties.....will I get a job that may lift me from the present situa- 
tion ?, please answer” . 

I asked him to choose a horary number between 1 -249, (despite the unearthly hour, that is ap- 
plicable to me in India only!) and to contact me the next day. The horary number selected by 
him was: # 11. 

The next day, I checked the query for an answer applying the principles of ruling planets. De- 
tails of analysis done at Palakkad, Kerala, are provided hereunder. 

This horary number locates the Lagna in the sign Aries, and is under the influence of the com- 
bination of planets: Mars —Venus —Sun, appearing as co- rulers for the sign, star and sub 
lords. 








RULING PLANETS : 27/06/2011 - 14:57:00 


RULING PLANET HORARY TIME 


Day Lord Moon Moon 
Moon Sign Lord Mars Mars 
Moon Star Lord Venus Venus 
Moon Sub Lord Mercury Mercury 
Asc. Sign Lord Mars Venus 
Asc. Star Lord Venus Rahu 
Asc. Sub Lord Sun Moon 


It is seen that the Moon has appeared as the time chart Ascendant sublord and the day lord. 
Moon is in the star of Venus, ruler of the 2™¢ bhava, thereby portraying the anxiety of the que- 
rist on his present condition and preservation of status in life. The issue concerned has been 
shown as a matter connected with money, since Venus has appeared both as the sign lord of 
time chart Ascendant as well as star lord of Moon. Venus is in the sub of Jupiter, karaka for 
money; besides Jupiter is in the star of Ketu, occupant of the 2™4 house denoting wealth . 


It is also further seen that the planets which rule the horary chart as well as the time chart are 
very similar acting as a pointer to the outcome. The horary Ascendant sublord Sun is in the 
star of Rahu, who is the star lord of the time chart Ascendant, and thus completes the loop. 


On this day of analysis Rahu is in the star of Mercury, who is occupying its own sign Gemini as 
owner of 3'4¢ bhava, and is conjoined with the horary Ascendant sublord Sun. Since the ruling 
planets are in full agreement with the horary chart, the outcome should be positive and good 
news must put his anxiety at rest. And this has to be in a near future, as all the ruling planets 
are fast moving ones. Since the time chart Ascendant’s star lord Rahu is in the star of Mercury 
who is conjoined with the horary chart sub lord Sun, and occupies the sign Gemini of Mercury 
of ‘duality’ nature. The event can take place only when the energizing planet Sun transits 
through the sign owned by Mercury. 


A look at the planetary disposition at the time of analysis shows that, the 10% and 11» house 
lord is the delay-causing planet Saturn, who occupies Virgo, a sign owned by Mercury, and 
throws its aspect on both the Sun and Mercury in Gemini, and Rahu as well. Does it not indi- 
cate that when the Sun transits in Gemini (the earliest time that can be reckoned for fruition), 
the expected event may not/ cannot find fruition ?

In every human being’s life health, wealth and marriage play the most important role. Whenev- 
er the individual fails to achieve success in these fields, he looks for external help, the first 
source of which being God and the second one being an astrologer. 

An astrologer, when approached with an enquiry, would probe the tenth house, or mid-heaven, 
which denotes the fame, honor, worldly status of the native, the percentage and hereditary 
tendencies, and governs all matters connected with profession, business, employment and 
worldly occupation. It would not be an easy task to reveal such vital information, which is like- 
ly to be accepted as a direction by the querent. Most of the practicing astrologers knew that the 
Jyotishya sastra has given many yogas, combinations, preparation of various charts to arrive 
at the strength of the dasama sthana, bhaghya sthana, dhanasthana, labha sthana etc. to 
guide the astrologer to arrive at a particular type of profession and income there from, from the 
natal chart. 

















With the passage of time, like any other subject, astrology too has undergone many changes 
with many stalwarts propounding their own theories like Vedic astrology, Nadi astrology, 
Sreepathi paddhathi, and K. P. SYSTEM. 


In KP astrology stellar influences are taken into consideration by taking Star lord as an im- 
portant component and applying Sub lord theory of Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti. Thus KP astrology 
gives more promising results than other known systems. This is an excellent system 
(Padhdhati) of astrological predictions conceived, created by the Great Indian Astrology master, 
late Prof. K.S. Krishnamurti. KP System is based on finer points of Indian and Western astrolo- 
gy and borrows important concepts from many branches of astrology. Regarded as most accu- 
rate system of present times, the KP System of astrology is easy to learn and easy to apply. KP 
goes beyond stellar and makes use of the sub lord of houses and planets. The basic principle of 
KP method is that the results are offered by the star lord (constellation) of any planet and 
whether it is good or bad will materialize or not, will be decided by the sub lord. Hous- 
es’ (cuspal) sub lord promises various events during the lifetime of the native. Planetary sub 
lord decides if it is going to materialize during its dasa period. 

With this background on the importance of K.P System of sub lord theory, I would like present 
a chart of my friend who is a public sector employee and a cinema/T.V. artist with dual earn- 
ings simultaneously. The details of the chart of the individual are furnished hereunder.

significators of houses 5th, 6th ( success and winning over opponents) and 10 (name and fame), 
one can be popular as an actor, and if it has connection with the 11 (success and fulfillment 
of desire) one will be prosperous. If Mars is connected with these houses, he or she can be a 
leader among them as there will be free from inferiority complex and stage fear, but success 
alone. 

2) Cinema is associated with Pisces sign (an emotional sign). 

3) Neptune is karaka for cinema and Venus for fine arts. 

4) Cancer is also an emotional sign and a sensitive sign. Pisces and cancer are watery signs 
producing strong characters who can play upon the feelings and emotions of others. 

5) Acting, dancing and singing are creative expressions and associated with 5 bhava. Imagi- 
nations, interest in music, dramas, opera sports and mental reactions all come under the pur- 
view of 5t house. 

6) Mercury which represents skill, intellect and perception should be favorable in the chart.

Question 1: Navamsa Chart in KP 








I ama regular reader of your thought provoking, well researched, informative articles in KP-Ezine. 
From the very beginning of my quest into KP Paddhati, two questions are haunting me. One of 
them is the use of Navamsha Chart (D 9) in KP. 

In the first book, Guruji not only taught how to cast Rashi-Cuspal Chart, but meticulously de- 
scribed how to cast Navamsa Chart. But to our great astonishment, in all subsequent readers, 


Guruyji is total silent about it. Why? If there is no usage of it, why so much pain is taken to cast 
it?? 


I request you to cast little light on this area in next issues. 
Answer Il: 


Initially Guruji KSK started taking the ideas of traditional astrology such as navamsa, Lagna or 
Moon sign whichever is stronger, 108 based horary and tried to merge them with his research 
results of cusps, subs, significators and 249 based horary etc. [“Lagna or Moon sign whichever 
is stronger” is changed to Lagna alone according to the further research after 1967. The main 
reason is that in a twin birth, only the cusps of the house including the ascendant change 
whereas Moon is in the same position. (Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 
1966, pp 82, 118, 255, 261-262, 264, 313, 316; KP Reader Hl, pp 243-244, 432-433/ 1971 
Edition, Practical Part, pp 85, 259) Only 249 subs based horary is found consistently used in 
the KP Reader VI since 1969, although it was started with 108 based horary. (KP Reader VJ] 


Navamsa Chart 


A very detailed self-explanatory three-page table to erect both the rasi and navamsa chart orig- 
inally appeared in the "Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966", pp 146-148, 
then was reprinted in the KP Reader I, pp 78-80. 


The navamsa chart was shown side by side with rasi chart in 25 charts in the "Krishnamurti 
Padhdhati Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966" on pp 50, 56, 66, 90, 110, 116, 117, 125, 146, 
167, 230, 233 (two charts), 241, 255, 261, 264, 267, 278, 283, “300”, 310, 312, 314 and “321” 
as usually done in the traditional chart presentation but without practical application. 


But out of above 25 navamsa charts, only two navamsa charts of the rasi chart under heading 
“Nature of Service” on p 300 and navamsa chart of Guruji KSK's self calculated rasi chart un- 
der heading "Time of Sanction of Pension" on p 321 of the "Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 
Sagar Publications, 1966", are found reprinted in the KP Reader III, pp 339/387 (1971 Edition, 
Practical Part page 171/217). [The first navamsa chart is used to explain the nature of service 
according to the traditional system.]

http: //www.scribd.com /doc/7299 1742 /K-P-Reader-2-ok

It means that KP system does not need to use the navamsa chart. It replaces the navamsa 
chart by it own exclusive and most wonderful "star and sub" theory. The equal navamasa divi-

Question 2: 
On page 76 of KP Reader I, author says: 


As it will appear clumsy to devide a sign into 9 equal parts, and insert planet in its na- 
vamsa position in a sign and because the Hindus say that the lord of Navamsa sign is 
the same as the lord of the sign and the planets, according to their position in each 
sign, will occupy a sign in navamsa chard and hence, the lord of the rasi is the owner 
of the sign in which a planet was, wherea the lord of the Navamsa sign is the owner of 
the sign, as in rasi. 


To a self learner like me, its a confusing sentence. Too much of infrmation in a single sentence; too 
many ANDs to combine it. 


Could you help me understand this by breaking the shared info into smaller sentences? What is 
the author teaching here? 


Answer 2: Recommendation for KP Beginners 


1. As it will appear clumsy to divide a sign into 9 equal parts, and insert planet in its navamsa 
position in a sign and ... 


because the Hindus say that the lord of Navamsa sign is the same as the lord of the sign and ... 
the planets, according to their position in each sign, will occupy a sign in navamsa chart and ... 


hence, the lord of the rasi is the owner of the sign in which a planet 
was, whereas the lord of the Navamsa sign is the owner of the sign (as in rasi). 


The author is explaining here how to find the rasi lord and navamsa lord of a planetary position 
from the Navamsa table on pages 78-80 of this KP Reader I, e.g. for a planet Aries 11° , from the 
position line in the Zodiac 10.00- 13.20 on page 78, it can be seen that this planet is in the Ar- 
ies sign ruled by Mars, and in the Cancer Navamsa ruled by Moon. 


The above quoted sentence in the KP Reader I is the "exact reprint" from the second para on 
page 144 of the "Krishnamurti Padhdhati (Advanced Stellar Astrology) Vol. I, by Jyothish Mar- 
thand K.S. Krishnamurti, Sagar Publications, 1966". 


KP Reader I to V are the exact reprint of the "Krishnamurti Padhdhati (Advanced Stellar Astrol- 
ogy) Vol. I & I, by Jyothish Marthand K.S. Krishnamurti, Sagar Publications, 1966, with re- 
movals and add-ons, and the KP Reader VI was newly written one. There is no change of lan- 
guage style but the significant changes in some topics would be confusing for the KP beginners. 
So only the KP’ Readers I-VI are recommendable for the _ beginners. 
The best narrated KP books recommendable for KP beginners are the "Nakshatra Chintamani, 
Further Light on Nakshatra Chintamani and Prashna Jyotish” by late Sri Chandrakant R. 
Bhatt.

This English version of “Prashna Jyotish” by late Shri Chandrakant R. Bhatt, B.A. L.L.B., isa 
unique K.P. reference book after his two very well received books, “Nakshatra Chintamani” and 
“Further Light on the Nakshatra Chintamani” which are regarded as the best K.P. books. 


What makes Prashna Jyotish unique is its unparalleled wealth of depth of details. Practical part 
covers major life events, such as health and longevity, financial and professional prospects, as- 
sets and properties, foreign travels and relocations, marriage and relationships, children and 
family matters, and much more. They are supported by eighty five practical solved examples 
where horoscopes are presented in four types of South, North and Eastern Indian chart styles 
and Western cycle chart style. Under each topic, detail subject matters are discussed further. 
Professional topic, for instance, includes interviews and examinations, getting a desired job and 
promotion, employment opportunities and career changes, job relocation, leaving a job, retire- 
ment, reinstatement, independence business and partnership, and much more. For each sub- 
ject matter, the author gives the hints of specific rules for judgment and then supplies con- 
sistent analysis of relevant cuspal sub lords, joint dasa period lords and transit. 


In predicting any life event of a native, promise of the event is considered by the relevant main 
cuspal sub lord; if it is promised, timing of the event is fixed by the fruitful significators of joint 
period dasa-bhukti-antra-sookshma lords when transit agrees. It is consistently based on the 
significations of the relevant cuspal sub lord and joint dasa period lords at all the three levels of 
‘planet, star and sub’ according to the sub lord theory within the framework of the six K.P. 
Readers. 


This book Prashna Jyotish will be of great help for KP analysis of both horary and natal charts 
as original K.P. principles, rules and comprehensive house grouping have been explained and 
applied in very clear, concise and consistent manner with support of over one hundred practi- 
cal solved examples.

Update...I downloaded the June KP EZine issue on my Windows 7 OS, and it opens and reads 
fine, but I cannot read your June issue on my MacBook Pro (OS X Version 10.8.3). It crashes on

ALL open just fine on my Mac, so I am a bit perplexed about this. Then I re-downloaded Adobe 
Reader for MacBook, and same problem with opening current issue on my Mac, while earlier 
issues open fine on my Mac. A mystery, I guess. 


I don't know if any other KP EZine subscribers are also having problems opening the June Is- 
sue on a Mac computer, that is why I gave you the OS and version above - so you can inform 
your web developer. I also sent several reports to Apple, reporting the crash.

Dear Kanak, 


Problem SOLVED! I researched this problem with the Mac crash, and discovered that the Mac 
(Apple) OS (operating system) has now decided to set an application, called "Preview", to be 
their (Apple's) default .PDF Reader (rather than the familiar ADOBE .PDF READER.) So when 
trying to open the new June issue of KP Ezine, Adobe Reader was no longer working as the de- 
fault Reader, as it has been changed by Apple (or changes as the Mac operating system's de- 
fault .pdf reader). 


So if you encounter a problem with any of your other subscribers having a 'crash problem’, 
simply tell them to right click on the newly downloaded (unzipped KP EZine) issue, and select 
"Open with Adobe Reader". Access is then granted WITHOUT crashing. :) 


I hope this information is helpful for others who own Mac computers. 


Warm regards, 
Sandy

Question: Is imprisonment possible for Sooraj Pancholi for the suicide of actress Jiya Khan? 
Horary No. : 161/249 


Date: 20/06/2013; Day: Thursday, Time: 10.40.50 AM 
Place : C. T. M. Ahmedabad. 23° N 00’, 72° E 38’; Ayanamsha : 23°.57’.18”. 


Hints: If 124 cusp sub lord signifies house 2, 3, 8, 12, imprisonment is possible during the 
DBAS of significators of house 2, 3, 8, 12. 


12s Cusp ( Libra 27 : 36: 17): The sub lord of the 12 cusp is Venus. Venus is in the 
star of Jupiter and sub of Venus. Venus is occupant of 8 and owner of 7, 11, 12. Star lord 
Jupiter is occupant of 7, owner of 2, 4. So here 12% cusp sub lord signifies 2, 8, 12, so the 
imprisonment is possible. 


On the day of prediction, the ruling planets are Sun, Ketu, Jupiter, Venus, Rahu (Moon & 
Saturn) and Mars. 


The significators of house 2, 3, 8 and 12 are Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, & Ketu. 
Rahu conjoined with Moon, Saturn & Ketu indicates Mars. 


So the common planets among the RPs and significators are Jupiter, Venus, Ketu and Rahu. 


Joint Period: On the day of prediction, the running joint period is Rahu/Mars dasa period 
up to 11-4-2014. 


The Rahu Dasa is up to 22/4/2014. 
The Bhukti lord Mars is not in the common planets, so we have to check the next Dasa lord 
Jupiter. 


The Jupiter Dasa is from 22/04/2014 to 22/04/2030. 

The Dasa lord Jupiter is in the star of Mars and sub of Venus. Jupiter is occupant of 7 and 
owner of 2, 4. Star lord Mars is occupant of 7, owner of 1, 5, 6 and the sub lord Venus is 
occupant of 8 and owner of 7, 11, 12. Hence the Dasa lord Jupiter indicates the possibility of 
imprisonment by signifying 2, 8, 12. 


Now we have Bhukti lord Saturn which is not in common planets, next is Mercury which is 
also not in the common planets. So we take the next Bhukti Ketu which is in the common 
planets. 


Ketu Bhukti will run from 29/03/2021 o 05/03/2022. 

Bhukti lord Ketu is in the star of Venus and sub of Jupiter. Ketu is occupant of 5, and 
agent of Mars, occupant of 7, owner of 1, 5, 6. Star lord Venus is occupant of 8 and owner of 
7, 11, 12. Sub lord Jupiter is occupant of 7 and owner of 2, 4. Hence the Bhukti lord Ketu 
indicates imprisonment by the 2, 8, 12 signification. 


As discussed above Venus signifies the imprisonment houses 2, 8, 12 and it is also in the 
common planets. Venus Antra is therefore chosen under the Ketu Bhukti.

Bureaucrat is a government official especially one who follows guidelines rigidly. 
(.A.S., 1.C.S., LP.S., LR.S., LF.S., ete all come under this category.) 


First of all let us recollect the Karakatwas /significations of the following houses and the 
planets before analyzing the charts. 


Lagna: - Head is the primary limb in the human body. In the same way, the Lgna is also 
being considered as a primary one while judging the profession of a native. The Lagna 
should be strong as it indicates the natural quality of the native regarding his professional 
life. 

3rd House:- It is an important house. It indicates courage, firmness, valour, prowess and 
heroism. Short travel, correspondence, media, publicity,. (To execute the aims of the Gov- 
ernment strictly and rigidly, courage, firmness and valour are required for an Administra- 
tor.) 3m is the 6 from the 10th. And it is the 10% from the 6%, So it plays an important 
role in the horoscopes of good administrators. 

6th House: - It indicates mainly service. It is the 9 from the 10 house. To say in another 
way, it is the 10% from the 9 house. 

8th House: - It is the 11th house from the 10 house. 11 house indicates fulfillment of de- 
sires, wealth, source of income, well-wishers, supporters, success in all undertakings, 
progress in all attempts, etc. Therefore, 8 house signifies the desires which are well con- 
nected with the services. The 10ts house indicates the work of the native to earn money 
and at the same time the 8 house shows the earnings through the work which is signi- 
fied by the 10‘ house. 

9th house: - Dharmasthana, law, legal arbitration, fortune, luck, etc. 

If the 9th house is weak in the birth chart, the fortune of the native is also weak. One may 
be having a very good sound knowledge in all fields; his merits will not be recognized 
when the native’s 9 house is not strong. 

10% house:- Profession/occupation/business, Rajyasthana, name and fame, superior, 
master, employers, the Government, lordship, honor, dignity and public esteem, power 
and prestige, credit and conduct, success and status, rank and renown, respect and repu- 
tation, ambition and authority, responsibilities, etc. 

Sun and Moon are called as Royal Planets, and their signs (Leo and Cancer) are called as 
Royal Signs. Therefore, luminaries and their signs play a vital role in the horoscopes of 
bureaucrats. 

Mars is a planet of courage and brave with no fear. It is also the planet of energy, aggres- 
sion and confers executive ability and a pushful nature with a “Go-head” spirit. It is also 
said to confer royalty, authority and power to punish (magisterial powers). 

Venus plays an important role in the horoscopes of bureaucrats. Every astrologer knows 
well that all sorts of luxuries and comforts are signified by Venus only. Beautiful and com- 
fortable bungalows to reside, sophisticated and luxurious cars to travel and also many 


KP Ezine Auaust 2013 27 


obedient and faithful servants to do their works at their command are all provided to the 
bureaucrats by the Government. Pleasant and useful things etc., to make their lives easy 
and comfortable are arranged for them. For all these things, Venus is a chief planet. 
Written and oral examinations are conducted by Union Public Service Commission to select 
this cadre. Mercury is not only the planet of intellect & intelligence but also academic bril- 
liance. 

Jupiter is the planet of public finance, revenue and also the planet of law and legal proce- 
dure. It is also an advisory planet. 

7h house is the house of challenges and opportunities and also the house of administra- 
tion. 

Airy signs (Gemini, Libra and Aquarius) and fiery signs (Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius) are con- 
ducive for this cadre of profession. 

A self-strong significator of the concerned cusp: - If a planet holding the sub lordship of a 
cusp without having any planets in it’s stars, it can be deemed to be a self-strong _ signifi- 
cator for the cusps concerned. 


By taking into consideration the above mentioned facts, and after careful observation of the 
29 natal charts of bureaucrats, I came to a conclusion and framed the following rules to 
identify the bureaucrats profession. 


Rules: - 

1. Venus should be connected to the luminaries (Sun & Moon) or at least it should signify 
the 10% house or 9th house. 

2. Royal planets should be related to the 10, 9th, 8th, 6 or Lagna. 

3. 9 and 10% cuspal sub lords must be well connected to 2-6-10-11 along with Sun and 
Moon. 

4. Mars should be a significator of 10 or 6. He should be cnnected/related to royal plan- 
ets. (Sun & Moon). 

5. Either 6% or 10th cuspal sub lord should be connected to the luminaries. 

6. Ascendant cusp sub lord or star lord should signify 6-8-10-11. 

7. Sign lords of the nodes (the depositors of Rahu and Ketu) should be related with the Lu- 
minaries or they should be a significator of 9 or 10%, 

8. 8th and 10% cusp sub lords should be related to each other. 

9. 34 house should be well connected to the houses 2-6-10-11 to become a successful 
good administrator.

“If music be the food of love, play on; Give me excess of it, that, surfeiting, 
The appetite may sicken, and so die. That strain again! it had a dying fall: 
O! it came o’er my ear like the sweet sound that breathes upon a bank of violets, Stealing 
and giving odour. “-William Shakespeare--(Twelfth Night, 1.1.1-7) 





Music is such a divine knowledge that cannot be learnt like any other mundane knowledge 
unless one is blessed with the past sukarma and Mr Michael Jackson is one such a blessed 
soul whose name and fame spread internationally in the field of western music. In this arti- 
cle I would like to discuss the astrological chart of such an eminent musician of all times. 


K.P. RULES FOR MUSIC (KPEzine- 2008) 


1. If the 5 cusp sub lord is deposited in a star of a planet in Simha or Kumbha rasi one 
will be a popular musician. Venus will also contribute for one’s grand success in music. 


2. If the lord of a star in which 5th cusp sub lord is deposited, and connected with Moon 
and Venus - one will have taste for improving his talent for music. 

He will have rich voice coupled with melody and mellifluousness. Venus and Mercury - one 
will have taste for improving his talent for music composition of songs. 

Mars - one will be bold and will never have stage fear. 

Neptune - one will have harmony in music. (In a chart if 9 cusp falls in Leo sign with Nep- 
tune in it or Neptune is in conjunction with planets Moon/Venus/Mercury— the native will 
be a popular musician.) 


3. If the lord of a star in which sub lord of 5th house is posited, occupies in Gemini or Sagit- 
tarius, one can render the music to appeal to the audience. 


4. Gemini/ Libra/ Aquarius— airy signs are voice signs or music signs and cinema signs. 
Leo, the natural 5th sign in zodiac, is sign for opera, dance and other fine arts. Libra, the 
7h sign in natural zodiac, is the sign signifying all fine arts. 


o. Neptune connection with Jupiter indicates that one will render religious songs. Neptune 
connection with Saturn indicates that one will be interested in rendering malevolent songs. 
Neptune connection with Mars and Venus indicates that one will be interested in singing 
romantic songs. Neptune- in western astrology- signifies a higher octave planet of Venus, 
which gives talent in music and dance. Neptune represents an emotional attunement to 
higher levels of consciousness where dualities are united in the living truth. It represents 
the urge to lose one’s self in another state of consciousness (whether “higher” or “lower”) 
and the urge to escape from all limitations. It is a planet of mysticism and mannerisms.

ANALYSIS OF THE CHART--- 

As per the chart the 5 cusp sub lord is Rahu. Rahu is placed in the 12‘ house in Virgo. 
The connection of 5 cusp with Virgo sign shows that the native was set to have talent to 
sing with proper modulations. 

Rahu is in Mars star — lord of 2 (signifying voice and skills of the tongue) & 7 (signifying all 
fine arts) placed in 7th cusp —- Mesham sign- shows that the native was set to sing songs 
pertaining to personality and leadership qualities. It is in the sub of Mercury in 10, lord of 
9,11,12 in Leo. 

Mars aspecting Venus by its 4th aspect has given him very good taste for music and bold- 
ness. 

Mars aspecting Uranus in Cancer has given him revolutionary trends in composing and 
singing. He could also do orchestration and co-ordination of a group of musicians in public 
performances with all the boldness and ease. Mars is also aspecting Neptune in Libra sign, 
by its 7 aspect. Neptune another important planet which signifies fine arts is placed in Ra- 
hu star -which represents Mercury and significator of stringed instruments like electric gui- 
tar, has given him proficiency in instrumental music. Neptune is in Jupiter sub and Jupiter 
aspects 03" sign Gemini- in natural zodiac- an airy sign- has given him added strength for 
his proficiency in music with the help of guitar. He was set to have proficiency in singing 
both classical and light songs. Mars influence on Venus, Uranus ,Neptune and Jupiter sig- 
nifying lagna, 5's, 10% houses has given him proficiency in composing music with fast beat 
and melodious, light and jubilant tunes. The fact that he becomes proficient in using sting 
instruments like electric guitar is also confirmed by 5t cusp sub lord Rahu’s placement in 
an earthy sign Virgo. So Rahu co-rules 7‘ cusp also. It signifies 2, 7, 12, 4 and at its sub 
lord Mercury signifies 9, 10, 11, 12 houses. 

Rahu represents Mercury, which is deposited in 10 house- Leo together with its lord Sun. 
Mercury-Sun conjunction in 10th house has made him very popular, giving name and fame. 


2) 2nd cusp and 3" cusp are to be judged for vocal music and instrumental music. Second

struments like synthesizers- has made him proficient in instrumental and vocal music. The 
star lord Sun is placed in Leo — a natural O05‘ sign in zodiac — is also responsible for music 
and fine arts. 


3) 10 cusp sign lord Moon is in 4th house an airy sign —Aquarius- which is again responsi- 
ble for vocal music. Moon’s connection with Aquarius shows that he was set to sing songs

Michael Jackson as a child prodigy took to the stage at the age of just 11 as part of his fam- 
ily's function. He grew quickly into the superstardom and became unstoppable creative mu- 
sical wizard, which flooded him with an array of rewards and awards in his life. He was ti- 
tled as “THE KING OF POP”. 


Jackson was born on 29 August 1958, in Gary, Indiana, to an African-American working- 
class family. His father, Joseph Jackson, had been a guitarist, which Michael inherited from 
his father. Believing his sons had talent, he molded them into a musical group in the early 
1960s. At first, the Jackson Family performers consisted of Michael's elder brothers Tito, 
Jermaine, and Jackie. Michael joined his siblings when he was five, and emerged as the 
group's lead vocalist. He showed remarkable range and depth for such a young performer, 
impressing audiences with his ability to convey complex emotions. With the passage of time 
Michael Jackson grew and stood like a Himalayan mountain in the field of western music. 
When one looks at the list of awards (furnished below) with which he was adorned one will 
become flabbergasted.

Question of the Querent: Is foreign travel promised or not? If yes, when? 
Horary Number: 75 (out of 249). 

Time of Judgment: 02-04-2013 (Tuesday), 10:25:09 Hrs. (IST). 

Place of Judgment: Park Street, Kolkata, W.B. - 22N27, 88E20 


Hints: Foreign Travel 
12th cuspal sub lord (CSL) is the guide. Moon is the chief karaka of journey and Rahu is the 
chief karaka of foreign/foreign stay/foreigners. 


If the 12th cuspal sub lord 2 be the significator of house 3 (absence of the present resi- 
dence, 3 is 12th from 4th, change of place), 9 (long journey, foreign travels) or 12 (foreign, 
foreign stay, life in completely unfamiliar atmosphere i.e. in new environment) and/or in 
connection with 3, 9 or 12, foreign travel is promised during the joint period of the significa- 
tors of 3, 9 or 12. 


Note: The above said rule can be crossed verified with 9 CSL also as a supportive indica- 
tion of someone leaving home or running away. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon (Sagittarius 05:39:11) is in the star of Ketu and sub of Rahu. Moon is the occupant 
of 5, owner of 1. Starlord Ketu is the occupant of 10. Ketu acts as agent of Mars. Mars is the 
occupant of 9, owner of 5, 10. Mars is having stellar positional strength i.e. untenanted 
(there is no planet in the stars of Mars) and the CSL of house 3, 6. Sublord Rahu is the oc- 
cupant of 4. Rahu acts as agent of Saturn. Saturn® is the occupant of 4, owner of 7, 8. Sat- 
urn® is having stellar positional strength i.e. untenanted (there is no planet in the stars of 
Saturn) and the CSL of house 7, 8, 11. Thus Moon signifies the relevant houses (8, 9). 
Hence query is genuine. 


CUSPAL ANALYSIS 
12%: Cusp (Gemini 17-20-07): The sub lord of 12th cusp Venus is in the star of Mercury 
and sub of Self (Venus). 


Venus is the occupant of 9, owner of 4, 11. Starlord Mercury is the occupant of 8, owner of 
3, 12. Venus signifies 8, 3-12 through its starlord (Mercury). Thus 12 CSL Venus signifies 
3, 9, 12 and is in connection with 3, 12, hence foreign travel is promised. 

CROSS VERIFICATION 

9th Cusp (Pieces 11-45-23): The sub lord of 98 cusp Moon is in the star of Ketu and sub of 
Rahu. 


As explained above, Moon signifies house 3, 9, hence foreign travel is promised.

Question 1: House 6-8-12 and Disease 


In Mediacl Astrology for All (by K. Subramaniam, K. Balachandran & Vikari Ramamurthy), 
for the solved example chart on page 129: 

Dasa lord is Rahu and it does not signify house 6-8-12 at all, how does the native suffer 
from disease? 


Answer 1 


Chart: Female, 25 June 1958, 8:15 am, Calcutta 
The native suffered from disease of leukemia and died in the Rahu Dasa and Venus Bhukti. 


Dasa lord Rahu is in house 3, aspected by Mars in house 9, lord of houses 5, 10 (retirement 
from this world/ death), in the sign of Libra representing Venus in house 10 (retirement 
from this world/ death), lord of house 4 (end of everything/ death), 11 (Badhaka). Rahu is 
in the star of Mars in house 9, lord of houses 5, 10 (retirement from this world/ death), and 
sub of Sun in 11 (Badhaka), lord of 2 (Maraka). 


Bhukti lord Venus is in house 10 (retirement from this world/ death), lord of houses 4 (end 
of everything/ death), 11 (Badhaka), in the star of own Venus in house 10 (retirement from 
this world/ death), lord of house 4 (end of everything/ death),11 (Badhaka) and sub of Sat- 
urn in house 6 (disease), lord of 4 (end of everything/ death), 5. 


Although there is no signification of house 6 (disease), 8 (chronic ailment) or 12 
(hospitalization), the Badhaka and Maraka affects of Dasa lord Rahu had caused suffering 
from disease of leukemia and death in the Rahu Dasa and Venus Bhukti in combination of 
signification of lower level Antra and Sookshma lords, as mentioned in the KP Readers be- 
low: 


1) Badhkasthana may effect only the health if its Dasa or Bhukti is operating or the Da- 
sa or Bhukti is ruled by the planet in the constellation of Badhaka planet. (KP Reader V, 
page 263/ 1971 Edition page 226) 

2) Badhaka Sthana Adhipathis are the worst malefics who will never hesitate to put an 
end to one's life. In (KP Reader III, pages 161-162 (1971 Edition, Practical Part 2, pages 9-10) 
3) Death is indicated only by the significators of Marakasthan and Badhakasthana. (KP 
Reader VI: Horary Astrology, pages 154-155,159) 


Question 2: Why 5th house is considered for speculation? 


Why we astrologers judge 5th house for speculation and speculative gain? I feel that specu- 
lative gain is one type of competition to achieve profit like lottery gain, share market 
(especially in derivatives), betting game, cards game etc. So 5th house is LABH STHAN for 
your opposition; Why we take 5th house sublord? This is competition between 10 or 100 or 
1000 people to achieve one thing. So its competition and we (astrologers) judge 6th house 
for competition. Because of this I'm confused between 5th or 6h house which one to take for 
prediction. 


KP Ezine Auaust 2013 60 


We astrologers judge 2,6,10,11 for money and 5,8,12 for loosing money. So how we consid- 
er 5th house to denote money to one? 


Answer 2: 


In the KP Reader III: Predictive Stellar Astrology, p 425/ 1971 edition Practical Part p 252, 
“(5) According to you, 5th house is gain to the opponent, but you say that 5 house sig- 
nificator must operate to make money by speculation. How do you reconcile? 

If the significtor of 5 (giving you the mind, money and opportunity to speculate) is also the 
significator of 6 and 11 you gain in speculation. But if the significator of 5 is the significa- 
tor of 8 and 12 you lose. 5 house shows the mode of gain or loss. The other houses indi- 
cate how you fare.” 


Speculation or gambling is one of the matters governed by the 5‘ house. Accordingly the 
5th CSL is to be judged for gain or loss in speculation or gambling. 


Extent of gains or loss in gambling according to Guruji KSK (Astrology & Athrishta July 
1971 issue, p 23/ also KP Reader V: Transit, p 198-199/ 1971 Edition p 187-188): 

1) Find out the sub lord of the 5 cusp. If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in 
any sign, in any star, but in the sub of significators of 6 or 11, one win most satisfactorily. 
2) If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in the sub of significators of 2 or 10, the 
gain is moderate. . 

3) If the sub lord of the 5th cusp is deposited in the sub of significators of 1 or 3, there is 
gain, but insignificant. 

4) If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in the sub of significators of 5 or 12, there 
will be great loss and one will necessitate even to borrow money or run to bankcruptcy. 

5) If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in the sub of significators of 4 or 8, one will 
not over trade and the loss will be moderate. 

6) If the sub lord of the 5 cusp is deposited in the sub of significators of 7 or 9, the los 
will be feeble or negligible. 


The cuspal sub lord (CSL) of a house indicates whether the matter signified by that house 
is promised or denied. The significators of dasa, bhukti lords point the time of event 
when gochara (transit) agrees. (KP Reader V, page 224/ 1971 Edition p 211, KP Reader III, 
pp 226, 362 /1971 Edition, Practical Part pp 68, 194) 


For example, if the 7 CSL is connected with the main house 7 governing marriage or any 
one of the supporting houses 2,11 marriage is promised. The promise is not a guarantee 
for the matter to be materialized. If marriage is promised, then marriage will be fructified 
only during the joint dasa period (DBAS) of the significators of the relevant houses 2,7,11 
when transit agrees.

Question 3: Time of Examination or Time of Declaration of Examination Results 


One of my friend’s daughter is going to appear for a medical entrance examination in the 
near future. 


Is it possible to predict from her birth chart whether she would be selected or 
not? 


Is it necessary to know the date of declaration of results? 
Answer 3: 


It is possible to predict from her birth chart whether she would be selected or

Answer 4: 
Doubt 1: Rule of CSL becoming the Significator 


If a planet has no planet in its stars, then that planet is the strong significators of hous- 
es for which that planet is the cuspal sub lord. For example, Jupiter has no planet in its 
stars and it is the cuspal sub lord of. So Jupiter is the strong significator of houses 2,3 and 
7. In other words, the sub lord of a cusp is a strong significator of that cusp, if there is no 
planet in the stars of that sub lord (planet). (KP Reader III, p 309/ 1971 Edition, Practical 
Part, p 145; Golden Rule in Astrosecrets & KP, Part II, p 195; KP & Astrology 1991 July is- 
sue p 1 & November issue p 8); 

If a planet having no planet in its stars is not the cuspal sub lord of any house, the above 
rule is not applicable. It is applicable if and only if such planet is the cuspal sub lord of 
any house(s). 


If a planet having no planet in its stars is not the cuspal sub lord of any house, that planet 
will be the strong significator of the house occupied by that planet by its positional sta- 
tus. (KP Reader III; Sublord Speaks 1, 2, 3) For example, Jupiter has no planet in its stars 
and it is not the cuspal sub lord of any house. If Jupiter is the occupant of house 2, it will 
be the strong significator of house 2.

What Is intercepted sign? 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





An intercepted sign is a zodiac sign that does not fall on any house cusp. In other words, 
this is the sign when two houses sandwich it between them. When one sign is intercepted, 
the opposite sign is also intercepted. Intercepted signs always occur in opposing pairs, and 
elsewhere in the chart there will be two pairs of cusps with only two signs on them. For ex- 
ample, in the attached MP Jain’s chart, Gemini is intercepted, and its polar opposite, Sagit- 
tarius is also intercepted. Gemini is sandwiched by 8th and 9th houses, and Sagittarius by 
2nd and 3rd houses. A pair of two cusps (1st and 12‘) falls in Libra sign, and another pair 
of two cusps (6 and 7+) falls in Aries. 


Interceptions are pairs of signs which do not show up on any house cusp. A sign (Gemini) is 
intercepted when the sign is not upon any of the cusps of houses, but included between one 
house (8th cusp in Taurus) and another (9th cusp in Cancer). (Christian Astrology, Books 1 
& 2, William Lilly, edt. David R. Roell, Astrology Center of America, 2005, p 37) 


When the same sign appears on two cusps (Libra on the 1st and 12 ), with opposite sign 
Aries on the opposite cusps 6th and 12th ), another pair of signs (Gemini and Sagittarius) is 
missing. The Gemini sign between them is squeezed to the 8 house and Sagittarius sign 
into 2nd house. 


Which charts have intercepted signs? 
Whether or not there are intercepted signs in a chart depends on various factors: 


1) The latitude of the birth place: the closer to the poles, the more likely it becomes that 
there are extremely large houses with intercepted signs; starting with a) ‘two’ cusps 
falling in a sign even at the lower level of latitude like Indian charts, e.g. MP Jain’s 
chart with two cusps (1*t and 12‘) falling in Libra, two signs Gemini and Sagittarius 
are intercepted; b) ‘three’ cusps (2™4 , 3t¢ and 4 ) falling in one sign Gemini, conse- 
quently ‘four' signs (Aries & Libra and Virgo & Pisces) intercepted in the chart of Gre- 
ta Garbo, 18 September 1905, 19:30 pm, Stockholm, Sweden, 59n20, 18e03, h 1 e, 
Asc. Taurus 12° 52' 41", KP New Ayanamsa 22° 27' 3", by KPAstro 4.1 SW; similarly 
three cusps (8rd , 4th , 5th ) falling in Gemini sign of Juha Vainio’s chart, 10 May 
1938, 03:35 am, Kotka, Finland, 60n28, 26e55, h2e, using KPNA 22° 54' 23"; then c) 
‘four ‘ cusps (4th , 5th 6th and 7th ) falling in Taurus sign, and ‘six’ signs ( Gemini 
& Sagittarius, Cancer & Capricorn and Virgo and Pisces) intercepted in a Russian 
chart, 16 February 2009, 05:48 am, Tarko-Sale, ‘64’n55, 77e49, h 5 e, Yekaterinburg 
time, Asc. Scorpio 26° 58' 45", KPNA 23° 53' 39"; finally d) up to the chart of Polar 
region born Marie Peary, daughter of Polar explorer Robert Peary, 12 September 
1893, 18:45 p.m. LMT, h 4:34:12 w, Anniversary Lodge, South shore of Bowdoin Bay 
(McCommick Bay), Inglefield Gulf, Greenland , 77n40, 68w30, Asc. Pi 3° 56' 2", KPNA 
22° 16' 59", for which "a symposium of astrologers" had been then invited by Alan 
Leo to settle the matter of the reversed order of the houses compared to the usual or- 
der as per Regiomontanous and Campanus house systems). (see A Case Study of Po- 
lar Region Chart, KP-Ezine Oct. 2010 issue) 


2) Choice of the house system: almost all house systems calculate houses in relation to 
the latitude, and have therefore different house sizes, except the equal house system 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 4 


with all houses 30 degrees each, making intercepted signs impossible. 
For example, in William Lilly's “Where is my fish?” horary chart, 20 Febru- 
ary 1638, Hersham, UK, O0w23, 51n22, 9:00 a.m. LMT, h 0:01:32 w, three cusps 
(3rd @ 0°58'33" , 4th @ 14° 4'41" and 5th @ 29°46'34") falls in Cancer sign by _—Re- 
giomontanus house system; two cusps (2nd @ 5°54' 9" and 3rd @ 27°20' 1") fall in 
Gemini sign by Koch house system; no intercepted signs at all by Placidus house 
system, according to tropical charts calculated by Astrodienst, www.astro.com . 
(Chart details: courtesy of The Real Astrology, John Frawley, ‘Chapter 3: Horary 
Astrology’) 


3) Tropical or sidereal chart, for instance, John Macauley Brown, 17 October 2003, t 
09:28 am GDT, hle (daylight saving time), Edinburgh (same birth place of Tony Blair 
with ‘four’ intercepted signs), Scotland, ‘55n57’, 3w13 has no intercepted signs at all 
in tropical (Sayana) chart but contains two intercepted signs of Cancer and Capri- 
corn, two cusps (5th and 6th) falling in Pisces and two cusps ( 11th and 12th ) in 
Virgo in the sidereal (nirayana) chart using KP New Ayanamsa 23° 49' 11"; similarly 
the tropical chart of Carl XV, King of Sweden, 3 May 1826, 14:15 pm LMT, Stock- 
holm (birth place of Greta Garbo), Sweden, 59n20, 18e03, does not contain any inter- 
cepted signs, but in the sidereal chart using KPNA Gemini and Virgo signs are inter- 
cepted with 1st and 12 cusps falling in Leo sign; in the case of Greta Garbo, in trop- 
ical chart 1st and 2™4 cusps fall in Gemini, and 34 and 4 cusps in Cancer; but in 
sidereal chart 2™4 , 3'¢ and 4th cusps fall in Gemini by using PKNA 22° 27' 3"; 


4) Adjustment of birth time, for instance when the charts are rectified; in the 
above Russian chart, 16 February 2009, 06:18 am, Tarko-Sale, ‘64’7n55, 77e49, h 5 
e, Yekaterinburg time, KPNA 23° 53' 39", if the birth time is adjusted to 06:06 am, 
only ‘three’ cusps (10th, 11th and 12th ) fall in Taurus with only ‘four’ intercepted 
signs (Cancer & Capricorn and Leo & Aquarius).

Conclusion 


Whether or not, or how one interprets intercepted signs is a matter of taste and of the 
choice of the individual astrologer. 

The beliefs of intercepted signs creating limitations and delays and having karmic implica- 
tions and other ideas have not yet been supported by convincing evidence. 


So KP analysis is to be continued as usual applying existing rules - as practically applicable 
additional rules are not yet available.

The 2013 Australian federal election will elect members of the 44th Parliament of Australia

third term for the incumbent Labor government against the opposition Coalition led by Op- 
position Leader Tony Abbott of the Liberal Party of Australia. The proclamation dissolving 
parliament and formally beginning the election period, was issued by the Governor-General, 
Quentin Bryce on 5 August 2013. The writs of election were subsequently issued by Bryce

A querent brought a horoscope of his daughter during the month of October 2011, and 
asked me to check the marriage of his daughter as he was worried a lot about the matter as 
many marriage proposals have failed 

The birth particulars of the girl are as under: 


D.O.B. 5-7-1985, T.0.B. 6:23 AM, 
Place of Birth - Amritsar 


As per KP astrology, if the cuspal sub lord of 7th house be the significator of house 2,7 or 
11, marriage will take place during the joint period of the significators of houses 2,7 and 11. 
Also if 5th cuspal sub lord is a significator of 7 and 11, love marriage is indicated. 


7th Cuspal Sub Lord 

Here 7 cusp sub lord is Saturn in house 4, very close to 5 cusp, lord of 7 and 8. Saturn 
is in the star of Jupiter deposited in 7, and in the sub of Venus in 11, lord of 4 and 11. 
Hence 7th cuspal sub lord signifies 7 ,11 and marriage is promised. As it also signifies 5 by 
tight orb and 11, it indicates love marriage. Besides it is a significator of 4 which indicates 
the partner [Boy] may be co-tenant or live in one’s street, town etc. and after marriage it 
does not involve any journey to reach husband's place. 


5th Cuspal Sub Lord 

Here 5th cuspal sub lord is Rahu in 10. It is in star of Venus in 11 lord of 11 & 4. It is in the 
sub of Jupiter deposited in 7, Hence 5th cusp sub lord signifies 7 and 11. So love marriage 
is confirmed, According to the above finding I told the querent that there is possibility of love 
marriage of her daughter and the boy will be of same locality/city /town. 


Dasha Analysis 
On the date of analysis of horoscope in October 2011, the girl was running Jupiter Ma-

Why Virgo is not a dual sign? 


-Research Study 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Classification of the Zodiac Signs 

The signs of the zodiac are classified in various ways. The relevant way for our study is the 
division of zodiac into three qualities or modes of four signs each known as the quadruplici- 
ties, namely the movable or cardinal (Aries, Cancer, Libra, and Capricorn), fixed (Taurus, 
Leo, Scorpio, and Aquarius), and common or mutable (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pi- 
sces) signs. 


Common, Mutable or Dual Signs 


A reading about the common or mutable or dual signs of the zodiac through the whole 
bunch of the astrological literature reveals four types of dealing with these signs as follows: 


¢ mentioning the basic concept of the movable, fixed and common signs or the cardinal, 
fixed and mutable signs, the more familiar terms in the West (References - Part 1); 

¢ mentioning the common or mutable signs as dual or double signs, including Virgo sign 
(References - Part 2); 

¢ calling only the three common or mutable signs, Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces, exclud- 
ing Virgo, as dual or double signs (References Part 3); 

¢ not mentioning the classification of common, mutable or dual signs at all (References 
Part 4). 


Common or Mutable Signs with Virgo 


In the 'References - Part 1’, the basic classification of the movable, fixed and common signs 
or the cardinal, fixed and mutable signs has been mentioned in a standard manner. 


Dual or Double Signs with Virgo 


The dual or double or double-bodied or bicorporeal signs are generally presumed by their 
pictorial symbols representing two figures: Gemini, the twins; Sagittarius, half-man, half- 
animal; and Pisces, the two fishes, and they are believed to signify a dual nature. However, 
the common or mutable signs with Virgo, are also called dual or double-bodied or bicorpo- 
real signs in the ‘References — Part 2’. 


Symbols of the Four Common or Mutable Signs 


The descriptive symbols of the four common or mutable signs as given in the classical texts 
are as follows: 


Brihat Jataka (Chapter 1, Stanza 5) 

Mithuna: a man with a club and a woman with a lute, in close embrace 

Kanya: a virgin in a boat with a crop in one hand and a light in the other 

Dhanus: a man armed with a bow and arrow, the hinder part of the body being that of a 
horse 

Meena: two fishes lying close to each other with their heads pointing in opposite directions 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 35 


Jataka Parijata (Adhyaya I, Sloka 9) 

Gemini: a pair of human beings bearing a harp and a mace 

Virgo: a woman standing in a boat carrying with her corn and fire 

Sagittarius: a man armed with a bow, the hinder part of the body being that of a horse 
Pisces: two fishes with their two tails and heads in reversed positions 


Varmana Purana (sage Pulastya’s answer to sage Narada’s enquery) 

Mithuna: a man and a woman bearing a trumpet and a harp 

Kanya: a woman standing in a boat and holding a spike of corn and a lamp in her hands 
Dhanu: a man holding a bow and arrow, the legs like those of a horse 

Meena: two fishes lying side by side, the head of one being beside the tail of other 


Brihat Parashara Hora Sashtra (Chapter 4) 

Gemini: a male and a female, holding a mace and lute 

Virgo: a girl having grains and fire in her hands 

Sagittarius: first half being biped and second half quadruped 
Pisces: a pair of fishes, one tailed with the head of the other 


It is clear that three common signs Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces are associated with the 
pictorial symbols of two figures but not the Virgin sign with symbol of a maiden. 


However, the symbol of the Virgin sign is complicated in the Western astrology. The roots of 
the symbolism of Virgo as the earth goddess holding a spike of corn can be traced to the an- 
cient Mesopotamian (Babylonian) period around 1000 BC. (Rupert Gleadow, Origin of the 
Zodiac, Jonathan Cape Ltd, 1968, pp 169, 213) 


The illustration of winged maiden has been found in a 17th century book: Firmamentum 
Sobiescianum, by Johannes Hevelius, 1690, and Poeticon astronomicon, a 1482 book by 
Higenus. Virgo is traditionally depicted as a winged maiden carrying a sheaf of wheat. 
(Manilius, Astronomica, tran. GP Gold, Harvard University Press, 1977, p xxv) 


The fourth-century Roman astrologer Paulus Alexandrinus wrote in the Introduction to as- 
trology that a ‘double-bodied’ sign is said to be between two seasons, such as Gemini be- 
tween the two bodies of spring and summer, ending the spring and beginning the summer. 
By the time Lilly wrote Christian Astrology, in 1647, he described Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius 
and Pisces as ‘double-bodied’ signs. 


In this context, the ‘double-bodied’ signs with Virgo are not linked with the visual presenta- 
tion of two pictorial figures, and perhaps the same is with the ‘double-bodied’ signs in the 
translation of Bhirat Jataka, Chapter IV, Stanza 11, translated by Bangalore Suryanarain 
Rao, Motilal Banarsidass Publications, 1986, p 131, and also by N. Chindambaram Aiyar, 
Thompson & Co., 1905, p 39-40. However, the ‘mutable’ signs are used instead of the 
‘double-bodied’ signs in the translation of Brihat Jatak by Prof. P.S. Sastri, Ranjan Publica- 
tions, 1995, Chapter 4, Sex of Child, pp 48-49. 


Also in the translation of Jaimini sutramritam, by Iranganti Rangacarya, Chintala Narasim- 
hulu & Co., 1995, p 3, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces are called ‘dual’ signs. But in 
the translation of Jaimini Sutram, by P.S. Sastri, Ranjan Publications, 2006, p 10, and in 
the Studies in Jaimini Astrology translated by Bangalore V. Raman, Motilal Banarsidass 
Publishers, 1996, pp 24-25, these signs are called ‘common’ signs. 


In ancient times ‘bicorporeal’ term was originally used by Claudius Ptolemy, referring to all 
the four mutable signs, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces. His twist is that the bicorpo- 
real signs which "follow the solid (Fixed) signs, and are so called because they are between 
the solid and the solsticial and equinoctial signs and share, as it were, at end and begin- 
ning, the natural properties of the two states of weather." Similarly the Ptolemy’s ‘double- 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 36 


bodied’ signs with Virgo, are not based on the visual symbol of two pictorial figures. 


In the ‘References - 2’ the common or mutable signs including Virgo are also called dual or 
double or double-bodied or bicorporeal signs without linking to the visual representation of 
two figures, particularly for the Virgo sign. 


The expression of “Common (dual, mutable) sign to be dual, fluctuating, flexibility, plastici- 
ty, intellectual, sympathetical, sensitive, subtle, versatile, changeful, inconstant, indecisive, 
vacillating and restless.” in the KP Reader VI: Horary Astrology, p 108, may have caused the 
misunderstanding of the common signs and dual signs being the same signs which includes 
the Virgo sign. 


Dual or Double Signs without Virgo 


As shown in the ‘References 3’, the Virgo sign is no more included in the dual or double or 
double-bodied or bicoporeal signs of the modern Western astrology by Alan Leo, Charles E. 
O. Carter, A. Sepharial, Robert Hand etc. 


It is the same with KP in considering ‘only three common signs’, Gemini, Sagittarius and Pi- 
sces, with visual representation of two pictorial figures, without Virgo sign, as dual signs. 


No Mention of Classification of Movable, Fixed and Common Signs 


Some books which do not mentioning the classification of movable (cardinal), fixed and 
common (mutable) signs at all are listed in the ‘Reference - 4”. It may be due to the system 
or the school of thought or the field under study. It is the system or school of thought that 
does not apply the Badhaka concept which is based on the Ascendant of movable, fixed or 
common signs. 


KP Second Marriage Rule 
The dual signs are applied in the KP second marriage rule, saying that the 7th cusp sub 
lord be deposited in a dual sign or in the star of a planet in or owning a dual sign or the 


same sub lord be Mercury, and simultaneously the same sub lord be a significator of house 
2 or 11. (KP Reader VI: Horary Astrology, p 165) 


This second marriage basic rule is found valid in 74 charts out of one hundred AA (with B/ 
C, B/R) rated multi-marriage charts in a research study done by Mr. Kanak Bosmia in 
2006. 

Conclusion 

It appears more reasonable to consider only three common signs, Gemini, Sagittarius and 
Pisces, as dual signs, based on the linkage to the visual symbol of two pictorial figures of 


more duality, although Virgo sign is also found working in some cases. 


Further research is suggestible to apply the KP second marriage rule to the twin birth and 
more than one job by using the 5th and 10th cusp sub lord respectively.

they are between the solid and the solstitial and equinoctial signs’ and thus share the 
properties of other two groups.)
