Marriage- Divorce- Second marriage 


- KP analysis 
By: Gunti Nagaraju 
M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
KP astrologer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27 172206; 
9490752371 


Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 


In the field of astrology, the topic of “Marriage” has been always an intriguing subject, as 
it is in the life of every human being. Recently it has gained importance in view of a lot of 
failures in the marriages of the present generation, more so with the case of younger ones. 
Hence this aspect needs to be addressed on all fronts lest there should be a danger of los- 
ing faith in the very institution of Hindu marriages. When I say of addressing the problem, 
I feel astrology goes a long way in sorting out to some extent by knowing the prospects of 
marriage from the chart of the proposed couple. With this view in back ground, I would 
like to present an article on the marriage- divorce and second marriage of a native for the 
benefit of our readers. 

For marriage we need to see and analyze 2, 7 and 11 cusps. 2nd house denotes family. 
That is to say by marriage one more member will be added to the existing family. 7 
house denotes marriage bondage. 11tt house denotes permanent friendship between the 
couple and fulfillment of one’s desire to get married. 

The K.P. rules say that— 





1) For marriage- if the sub lord of the 7‘ cusp is the significator of houses 2 or 7 or 11, 
marriage is promised. The marriage will take place during the conjoined period of the sig- 
nificators of 2,7,11 in their Dasa, Bhukthi and Anthara periods. 

2) Delay in getting married- a) there will be some delay for marriage if Saturn is con- 
nected with Moon either by conjunction or by aspect and in any of the house 2,7,11. 
Whenever Saturn has got any connection whatsoever with Moon there will be some obsta- 
cle or impediment not only during the negotiations but also at the time of settlement of 
the marriage and even at the time of celebrations of the marriage. The connection between 
Moon and Saturn is said to be “PUNARPHOO”. Saturn causes delay, dejection, disap- 
pointment, and denial, if it occupies 5 house where from it aspects 7, 11 and 224 houses 
by 34, 7th and 10 aspects respectively. 

3) For happy married life- if the sub lord of the 7 cusp is connected with any of the 
houses 2,5, 7,11, the married life will be peaceful and harmonious. Alternatively if sub 
lord of the 11 cusp is connected with 7 house, the life will be happy and harmonious. 
Conversely if the 7+ cusp sub lord happens to be the significator of 6 or 8 or 12 houses, 
there will be disharmony and unhappiness between the couple. 

4) Divorce - K.P. rules say - (KP-E zine July 2007) - - Divorce is caused when the signifi- 
cators of 2, 7 and 11 are also the significators of the houses of 1 & 6; or 6 &10; or 1 & 10. 
Therefore the negative houses (12th) to 2, 7, and 11 are all detrimental for smooth and 
pleasant family life with the spouse. 

A)- If the significators of 2, 7 &11 happen to be the significators of 1,6 & 10, then separa- 
tion will surely take place and then it may lead to separation/divorce. 

B)- If the separation is caused by the wife, then in one’s chart the significators of 7th will 
also be the significators of 6 and 9. 

C)- If the husband does not like wife and if he goes away - then we have to judge the 
houses 3 and 12. 

D)- The 4th is the place of residence and 3rd is the negative to 4th. Therefore one will go 
away from his residence and thereby get separated. 

E)- For married life, planets connected with 6th house that is the significators of 6th 
house bring separation due to partners walking out or desertion. 

F)-12th house significators denote that the native will seek separation and get out. 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 51 


G)- 8th house significators denote disharmony and quarrels and it does not threaten sepa- 
ration. The native will only experience difficulties/problems and will continue to live togeth- 
er. 


5) Second Marriage — K.P. rules say - second marriage is indicated in the following cases 1. 
Note the 7th cusp sub lord- 

(A) If it is deposited in dual sign (Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) or 

(B) In a star of a planet in or owning a dual sign or 

(C) If 7th cusp sub lord is Mercury or Jupiter, 

(D) If the 7th cusp sub lord is also significator of houses 2 or11, 

2. If 2nd cusp sub lord is connected to house 7th, second marriage is promised. 

3. If 9th cusp sub lord signifies 2, 9, 11 houses, second marriage will take place. (As per Sri 
Kanak Bosmia). 


6) Married Life - Disturbances - Rules - (K.P ANNUAL NO. 2012) 

1. IF 2 ,7 and 1lcusps sub lords signify 1,6,4,8,10,and 12, then misunderstanding between 
husband and wife; differences of opinion; quarreling; frequent separations etc; are the re- 
sults. 

2. If 7th cusp sub lord signify 6th house, then life partner will initiate to have divorce. 

3. If the 7th cusp sub lord signify 12th house - then the native himself will initiate for ap- 
plying for divorce. 

4. Significators of 6th house bring about separation due to partner walking out or disserta- 
tion. 

5. Significators of 12th house indicate that the native seeks separation, get out and lives 
singly. It also indicates disharmony and quarrels. 

6. 8th house significations do not threaten separation, but the native will experience diffi- 
culties even then he continues to live together. 

7. When Sun is posited in the 7th house - it is not favourable for married life, except when 
it is posited in Leo. Due to illegal relations with more than one partner gives disturbances in 
married life. 

8. When Mars is posited in the 7th house - it indicates unhappy married life except its own 
sign. 

9. When Sani is posited in 7th house - it indicates lack of warmness and hence disturbed 
married life. 

10. If Sani is in 5th house it aspects 2,7,11 houses. This aspect will spoil the good family 
life. 

11. Uranus in the 7th house is most dreaded placement for married life. When it is in 7th 
house of both husband and wife’s charts or lagna it may lead to separation between the 
two. 

12. Neptune in 7th is a favorable placement for happy married life. 


In a natal /prashna chart, the harmonious life with wife is promised if Lagna, 5th and 7th 
cusp get involved with the 11th house. The marital discord starts from the 6th house and 
12th house involving the 7 house. The healthy marital life shall be realized only if the 11th 
cusp indicates its linkage with the Lagna, 5th and 7th house without getting linked to the 
adverse houses.

Answer - 1: 


This is not the cuspal displacement but some zodiac signs are intercepted with no cusp fall- 
ing in and consequently more than one cusp falling in a sign in some charts as a result of 
applying the Placidus unequal house division system. Here any additional or special rule 
applying up to sub level is not yet available for the KP system of the sub lord theory. So the 
KP analysis is to be done in usual manner i.e. business as usual,following the significators 
given by the KP SWs. Please see the article “Intercepted Signs’ for details.

Answer -2 


1. There is a TSP method of late Dr. Kar for a yes or no type of question. The original article 
‘Theory of Short Prediction (TSP) by Dr K R Kar’, was published in K.P. & Astrology Year 
Book 2002, pp 95-101, also 2003 pp 76-79. This TSP method was represented in the KP E- 
zine June issue by Kanak Bosmia. It is incorporated in the KP SW like KPAstro 4.1. 


SALIENT POINTS OF TSP 
(from ‘Dr. Kar's Theory of Short Term Prediction (TSP)’ by Kanak Bosmia, in KP E-Zine June 


2007 isue, http://kpastrologer.com) 


Effectiveness 
a. For the answer YES or NO (like in Gulbarga theory) 


Casting of the Chart 

b. In casting the Horary chart (1-249) or (1-2193), to take the Time always at 5:30AM IST’ 
of the day of judging the query, irrespective of whatever time of judging on that day, ie. 
00:00 GMT for casting the chart outside India. 


Three Basic Rules 
c. If all or 2 out of the following 3 rules are met, the answer is YES; if all or 2 out of the 3 
rules are not met, the answer is NO. 


1. If the Sub sub lord (Ssl) of the Asc Ssl is tallied with Starlord (Stl)/ Ssl of Moon or Stl/ 
Ssl of Asc, the answer is YES; otherwise NO. 


2. If the Stl of Asc Ssl is tallied with Stl/ Ssl of Moon or Stl/ Ssl of Asc, the answer is YES; 
otherwise NO. 


3. If the Stl of the Ssl of Asc Ssl is tallied with Stl/ Ssl of Moon or Stl/ Ssl of Asc, the an- 
swer is YES; otherwise NO. 

Note: 

1) For Rahu/Ketu, to consider its Stl, Sgl, Planet conj and aspecting (as per KP) 

2) KPAstro 3.0 gives the results of the above 3 basic Rules. The outright results of the 
above 3 basic rules are to be adjusted by the following special rules. 


Special Rules 
d. They are as given under: 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 60 


1. If the Asc Ssl is Moon, the result is always YES. 

2. However, if Moon is in the Stl of Saturn or aspected by Saturn, the result is NO. If Moon 
is conj Sat but connected with Sun by way of conjunction, star or aspect, the result is 
YES but in a delayed way. (Punarphoo and Dr. Kar's Cancellation Theory) 

3. If the Asc Ssl is Moon Stl or Asc Stl, the result is always YES. 

4. Not to consider Retrograde.

2. If Asc cusp sub lord does not signify the related houses of the query, we should not reject 
the prashna and also do not need to ask for a new horary number from the querent. Be- 
cause this is not a precondition to be fulfilled. It’s a cross checking about the query as the 
Ascendant of horary number given by the querent reflects the mind of querent. For the re- 
cent practical case of no fulfillment this condition, please see the article ‘Will I clear exam 
for PG and get seat?’ in this month September issue of KP E-zine. 


3. If Asc cusp sub lord indicates house 11 (fulfillment of desire or success in general), then 
a) the querent can get success in general ((C. R. Bhatt: Nakshatra Chintamani, p 105) or b) 
fulfillment of desire is promised. (T. Rajendra Kumar: K.P. & Astrology Year Book 2005, p 
52). Promise is not a guarantee for the matter to be materialized. But a support to the anal- 
ysis of concerned cuspal sub lord, dasa and transit. 

If Asc. cusp sub lord does not indicate house 11, a support for positive answer is not there 
but the answer cannot be decided for ‘No’ depending the result of further comprehensive 
analysis. 


4. Arastu Prabhaka says, the result will be positive, vi) if the sub-lord of the 1st cusp be- 
comes one of the ruling planets. (The Times Horary Astrology (based on KP), Nishkaam 
Peeth, Prakashan, 2006, p 77; also reprinted under new title ‘New Dimensions of K.P. Astrol- 
ogy’, Diamond Pocket Book, 2007, p 75). It is the rule of thumb of horary astrology and es- 
pecially based on K.P., if the sub-lord of 1st cusp becomes ruling planet, then the desire of 
querent, how odds it may be, is fulfilled. (New Dimensions of K.P. Astrology, p 151) Here it is 
also to note Arastu Prabhaka’s opinion that the ruling planets of Horary Ascendant as per 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 61 


chosen number help to reach right conclusion. [ibid p 64] Reason is that the Ascendant 
cusp derives the fate of querent and fate cannot be changed. 


The sub-lord of the 1st cusp becoming one of the ruling planets, including 1st sign lord and 
star lord, alone may not be much reliable for the positive result, without further analysis. 


5. Arastu Prabhaka says, the result will be negative if the Rahu or Ketu is placed in Ascend- 
ant. (ibid p 75) The possible reason is that ‘if Rahu is placed in Ascendant, the Ascendant is 
completely spoiled. The desire of querent is not fulfilled. But it is also said that Rahu and 
Ketu in Ascendant and aspected by Jupiter portends fulfillment of desire after some delay 
and problems. (ibid p 74) This is not theoretically sound for KP where no planet is wholly 
benefic or malefic. And practically it is found not valid because out of 85 example horary 
charts in the Prashna Jyotish by Chandrakant R. Bhatt, only 3 charts (no. 1, 7 and 68) with 
Rahu or Ketu in the 1st house the result is negative but 9 charts (no. 9, 35, 53, 54, 59, 65, 
66, 82 and 85) with Rahu or Ketu in the 1st house the result is positive. 


6. It may be generally so, based on the followings: 


Sub lord of 11 in a movable sign, or in the star of movable sign, denotes early _ fructifica- 
tion. (KP Reader VI, p 151) The 11 house shows fulfillment of one’s desire. Whether the de- 
sire will be fulfilled or not is to be decided from the planet or planets in the 11t* bhava and 
its owner. Saturn delays. Fast moving planets fufill the desire early. Others fulfill it in medi- 
um time. (pp 214) The planets in] 1th bhava and its owner indicate whether one’s desire will 
be fulfilled early or not. Sun and Mercury are in 11t* bhava and Moon owns it. All these are 
first moving planets. So your desire will be fulfilled at the earliest opportunity. (p 277) 
Whether your desire will be fulfilled early or not is to be decided from the owner of 11% 
house and planet posited in it. Here it is owned by Saturn which indicates delay. (p 302) 


A few hints on the fructification of an event, mostly in horary predictions in K.P. system: 
If the 11 cusoal sub lord is a fast moving planet and in a — 


1. movable sign, the matter fructify within a very short period, and here move the Lagna; 

2. fixed sign, the matter fructify within a few days, and here move the Moon; 

3. common sign, the matter is very complicated and throw much doubt in judgment. How- 
ever move Sun to find out the correct period. (Astro secrets & Krishnamurti Padhdhati 
Part VI: Ruling Planets, Krishman & Co., 2011, p 69) 


If the 11 cusoal sub lord is a slow moving planet and in a — 


1. movable sign, move the Moon to find out the period of fructification:; 

2. fixed sign, move Sun; 

3. common sign,it is very difficult to come to a judgment. Here move the Jupiter to find out 
the period of fructification. 
(Astro secrets & Krishnamurti Padhdhati Part VI: Ruling Planets, Krishman & Co., 2011, 
p 69) 


After many year of research, the sign is not so important as the constellation, which is 
stronger the sign. The sub is more important. (KP Reader VI pp 78-79)

9. Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are usually known as outer planets as explained in ‘The Outer 
Planets in Vedic Astrology, MP3 Course of six 2-hour classes, by Ernst Wilhelm’ and ‘The 
Outer Planets and Their Cycles: The Astrology of the Collective, by Liz Greene, CRCS Publica- 
tions, 1966’. 


But here the question seems about the brilliant KP astrologer M.P. Shanmugham’s theory of 
outer planets and inner planets, as follows: 

Here next to Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto are known as outer 
planet. Moon along with Earth, Venus and Mercury are known as inner planet. 

The three outer planets Mars-Jupiter-Saturn by their aspects bring about changes. In a Na- 
tive’s birth chart, Saturn and Mars might be in a position to give favorable results. But by 
their aspect on other planets, the aspected planets loose their identity, and under the con- 
trol of Saturn or Mars. Here what happens is the aspected planets supposed to give a favor- 
able result is prevented to give that favorable result. Similarly the aspected planets sup- 
posed to give adverse results are made to increase the adverse results. (Astro secrets & 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati Part 1, Krishman & Co., 2003, p 70, also pp 271-272) 


This theory have not been much come across in practice, except Kanak Bosmia’s explana- 
tion regarding a KP blind chart quiz 5 in a Yahoo KP group long ago in January 2005, as

aspects inner planet, inner planet has to work for outer planet (in our case, MOON 
works for MARS, but MARS does not work for MOON.) 

Node gives result of planet firstly who aspect him. 

For Dhanu Lagna 7th is Maraka and Badhaka, 2nd Maraka. We consider 2,7,11 for mar- 
riage and 2, 7 as Badhaka and Maraka. I think most of our will consider as accident. 


DBA on 19/2/1990 was SAT-SAT-MOON. 

SATURN signifies house 2 but MOON does not signify directly house 2,7,11. However MOON 
gives result for MARs (conj) and RAH (SL). MARS is lord of 11 and RAHU is aspected by SUN 
and MERCURY. Sun is in 2, and MERCURY is also in 2 and lord of 7. Badhaka for Dhanu 
Lagna is 7th. And Maraka is 2.7. So most of us are confused whether it was marriage or ac- 
cident. 


However, in KP 'only' the planets, which are conjoined with or aspected by KP Grade A, B, C 
and D significators are to be considered as very weak KP grade E significators. (KP Reader 
IV, pp 118, 128, 20; KP Reader VI, 157,197, 247). Consequently there may no place for the 
outer planets to prevent the results of inner planets in the framework of grade A, B, C. D 
and E significators of KP system.

Joanne Wickenburg 





Te author says that when signs are intercepted, instead of providing constructive feedback 
and encouraging you to investigate the needs of your intercepted signs ... to delve more 
deeply into the experiences available through your intercepted signs ... to uncover the hid- 
den potentials they define ... the environment challenges you to move on to the 

next obvious step in life (the experiences of the next house). The environment simply does 
not see, or understand, the degree of complexity involved with finding fulfillment in the are- 
as of life shown by the houses containing intercepted signs. Due to lack of encouragement, 
feedback or role models offered by the outside world, the needs of these signs are often hid- 
den until later in life when some crisis (brought on by transits) brings them to the surface. 
The needs and potentials of intercepted signs, and the powers of intercepted planets, are 
sometimes delayed in expression because of lack of external stimuli.". (p 18,) 


KP Ezine Sentember 2013 66 


In her idea, a house with an intercepted sign inside it won't work all that well, and it is 

then said that affairs of this house will be ignored. There are only twelve houses. Intercept- 
ed signs come in pairs. One of them might possibly be ignored. One of them cannot be. All 
we need to do is consider the six possible pairs. For example, in 1st and 7 pairs, can one 
try to ignore the 1st ? 

It may be that one is unaware of the difficulties with the intercepted sign until it is touched 
off by some transit, but it may also be the intercepted sign is a long-running sore that never 
quite goes away. It may not be so that resolution of this problem waits until one is 50 or 60. 
The problem is solved much earlier, but awareness of that solution may not come until 
much, much later. 

Wickenburg's notes on intercepted houses (pp 52 - 58) are theoretical. In theory, houses 
with the same signs on them would be linked in some fashion, but we need to do a deeper 
analysis. 

Wickenburg's retrograde theory is that the first of the two signs a planet rules is its primary. 
The second is its "retrograde" position. Mercury is naturally Gemini. When it is retrograde, 
it functions more like Virgo. Saturn is just fine as far as Capricorn is concerned, but if you 
have it retrogarde, you have to deal with Aquarian issues. 

The author covers the eight stages to planetary circles to fully understand the significance 
of retrograde planes. The stage at which a planet was operative at the time of birth define in 
very specific terms how the planet function in your life. These stages include: 


. Solar conjunction (Superior) to retrograde zone 

. Pre-retrograde to retrograde station 

. Retrograde station 

. First half of retrograde phase 

. The solar opposition or (Mercury/Venus) inferior conjunction 
. Second half of retrograde phase 

. Stationary direct 

. Stationary direct to solar (Superior) conjunction (p 131) 


CONDOUPWNH 


Wickenburg's writing on the various planets when retrograde is quite knowledgeable, and 
almost completely free of mythical references. The retrograde appendix gives the dates/ 
locations the planets enter their retrograde zone (i.e, area of the sky they are about to back 
over), the dates/locations of the retrograde station, the solar conjunction/ opposition, the 
date the planet goes direct, and the dates/locations the planets left the retrograde zone. All 
of which are helpful to focus more clearly on retrogrades. 


In the author’s conclusion, intercepted signs can be defined as personal needs that society 
does not readily recognize, Interception works from the inside out. Retrograde planets de- 
scribe functions of personality that work counter to the norm or main stream of society. Ra- 
ther than being the environmental factor, the retrograde planets describe the need for intro- 
spection. Retrograde planets take outside in. It is important to note that you do not fall into 
the trap of considering retrogrades or interceptions as weakness or handicap in the chart. 
These conditions can result in creative genius once they are understood and integrated (p 
197), keeping her earlier saying in mind, "Don't take for granted the power of (retrograde 
planets) or intercepted signs. They make the chart unique. They make life complex. They 
describe powers and potentials waiting to be unleashed." (p 2)

Short History: 
http: //www.thesuardian.com/world/2013/aug/20/czech-parliament-dissolves-election - 





communists-power 


Election could lend Communists share of power as Social Democrats seek to form partner- 
ship 

The Czech parliament has voted to dissolve itself, triggering an early election which could 
hand the Communist party a share in power for the first time since a bloodless revolution 
ended its totalitarian rule two decades ago. 

Opinion polls show that the centre-left Social Democrats will be the biggest party, but they 
will need support from other groups to govern. The party's leader said he would talk to the 
Communists about forming a partnership. 

In the eyes of many people in this country of 10 million people, the Communists are asso- 
ciated with 41 years of repression, but by being out of power for so long, the party has es- 
caped the taint of sleaze and corruption that has troubled successive governments since 
the revolution. 

Tuesday's vote to dissolve parliament came about after the previous elected government 
folded under charges from prosecutors that an aide to the prime minister, who was also 
his lover, had his wife put under surveillance. The dissolution was supported by 140 mem- 
bers of the 200-seat lower house of parliament. 

The president, Milos Zeman, must now schedule an election, likely to be at the end of Oc- 
tober. 

In an interview with Reuters before the dissolution vote, Social Democrat leader Bohuslav 
Sobotka said that after the election he hoped his party would form a minority government 
backed by other groups. 

"It is definitely possible to expect negotiations with KSCM [the Communist Party]," Sobotka 
said. "The Communists are in a number of town halls and in regional leaderships, and I do 
not see it causing problems." 

But he said his party would not accommodate the Communists’ programme or bring them 
into a governing coalition. 

That was a nod to the toxic reputation the Communists still have for many Czech people, 
and to worries about backtracking on market reforms in the Czech Republic, one of the 
more stable emerging markets, which has attracted heavy foreign investment.

and connected with 1-5. 10 sub lord of opponent does not indicate 3-10-11 at all.

A Study of Forty Mothers’ Charts for Twin 
Birth Rule -Research Study 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Twin or multiple birth is indicated tf the 5th cuspal sub lord is connected to dual 
signs (Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) and also signifies house 2, 5 or 11, and to 
be fructified during the joint dasa period of significators of 2, 5 or 11 with connec- 
tion to dual signs. 


This twin birth rule is a particular planetary pattern which is significantly found in the 
study of forty natal charts of mothers who gave birth to twins or multiples. This study is a 
further research on the role of dual signs which is observed in the last month research 
study, “why Virgo is not a dual sign?” in the KP second marriage rule. 


For promise of twin or multiple birth, analysis of the 5 cuspal sub lord and its sign lord 
is shown in the attached table 1. Regarding timing of twin or multiple birth, the lords of 
Dasa, Bhukti, Antra and Sookshma at the time of twin or multiple birth is given in the at- 
tached table 2. 


In the table 1, twin or multiple birth is clearly found promised if the 5th cuspal sub lord is 
connected to dual signs and also signifies house 2, 5 or 11 by taking consideration of dual 
signs themselves and also their lords, dual planet Mercury and Jupiter, planet of expan- 
sion and karaka for child birth. It is generally significant in 35 charts (87.5 percent) out of 
total 40 charts under study, except chart no. 4, 18, 25, 27 and 34. Here only 5 cuspal 
sub lord is considered for child birth in general, in stead of going to 7 , 9th , 11th etc , one 
of which may always indicate twin birth. 


In the table 2, twin or multiple birth is significantly found in 36 charts (90 percent) out of 
total 40 charts under study, except chart no. 2, 4, 27 and 38, during the joint dasa period 
of significators of 2, 5 or 11 with connection to dual signs. Of course signification of house 
7,9, 11 will appear for the 254, 3rd, 4th issue of children respectively. 


The twin or multiple is therefore significantly found when the 5t cuspal sub lord is con- 
nected to dual signs (Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) and signifies house 2, 5 or 11 and 
materialized during the joint dasa period of significators of 2, 5 or 11 that are connected to 
dual signs, in 33 charts (82.5 percent) out of total 40 charts under study, except chart no. 
2,4, 8, 25, 27, 34 and 38.

Om Gan Ganapataye Namah 


Nowadays students appear in various exams and hence are stressed a lot regarding the 
result. Sometimes astrology can work as stress buster for them. Many students feel anx- 
ious about the result of exam and so approach me for consultation. I do feel that these 
students know how they have fared and hence get stressed or anxious. One student ap- 
proached me with a query regarding his passing the exam, which he had appeared in first 
week of July 2013. 


Let us see how KP astrology helps their cause. I told him to give me a number from 1 - 
249. 


Query : Will I succeed in the Final Exam? 

Horary No: 133 (1 —249) 

Date : 30-07-2013; Time : 21:23:50 

Place : BHOPAL, 77E26 , 23NO7 (Geocentric); Ayanamsa : KPNA 23:57:10 


HINTS AND RULES 


1. If the sub lord of the 4th cusp is the significator of 4,9 and 11th house , the success in 
examination is promised. 

2. Sub lord of the 11th cusp, when connected to the houses under consideration, will give 
the positive result; here in this case it needs to be connected to 4th, 9th house. 

3. Mars, Mercury and Jupiter promise success when they are connected to 4,9 and 11th 
house . 

4. The houses which are 12th from 4th and 9th house i.e. 3rd and 8th indicate failure. 


MOON & ASCENDANT SUBLORD 


Moon always gives the indication of state of mind and query. Here Moon is placed in the 
7 house, it is in the star of Venus, which is placed in 11 house. So it signifies the 
houses under consideration and the query is genuine. The ascendant sublord is Mercury, 
which is placed in 9 house, and it is in the star of Jupiter, which is placed in 9 house. 
So it is clear that the primary houses for success in examination are signified by the 
Moon and Ascendant sublord. 


CUSPAL ANALYSIS 

4th Cusp -- Capricorn -13:47:11 (Sa-Mo-Ra ) 

Rahu is the cuspal sublord of the 4 house , it is placed in 1st house, it is in the star of 
Rahu itself which is placed in the 1st house. Rahu is conjoined with Saturn, which is 
lord of 4t+ house. Hence, it becomes a strong significator of the 1st house (self effort) and 


also 4th house. Rahu is in the sub of Moon, which is placed in 9 house. So the Rahu is 
favourable for the query.

sub of Saturn itself, Saturn as we have seen is signifying 4th and 1st house strongly. Hence 
it is favourable for the query through its star and sub level signification.

When shall I get a job? 


By: Er. V.K Sharma, B.E. (Elect), 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA 
Superintending Engineer (Retired.), 
Punjab State Electricity Board, 
Address: #104, City Enclave, Zirakpur, 
Mohali (Chandigarh). 
Cell — 09417117370, e-mail: nickO885@gmail.com 





A querent from Delhi, who has done B TECH degree was under tension for not getting a job, 
asked me to check astrologically when she will get a job. I asked her to intimate any horary 
number between 1 and 249. She told the horary number as 112. I made the horary map 
for the said number on dated 23-10-2010 at 1:40 PM at Chandigarh. 


MOON REVEALS THE NATURE OF QUERY. 

Moon is lord of 11 in 8. Starlord Ketu in 10. Ketu is in the sign of Mercury in 2 lord of 10; 
further Moon is in the sub of Jupiter in 6. So Moon has a linkage with 6 [service / job], 10 
[occupation], 2[monetary gain], 11 [fulfillment of desire] and 8[tension]. Hence Moon reveals 
that querent has tension for not getting a suitable job. 


GULBERGA THEORY 

If the sublord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon starlord or Lagna star- 
lord among ruling planets, hen the query is to be answered affirmative, otherwise not. In the 
case under reference, sublord of horary number is Moon and Lagna starlord of ruling plan- 
ets is also Moon. Hence I told the querent that answer to her query is positive and she will 
get a job as desired. 


Confirmation through Ascendant Sublord 

In the horary chart Ascendant indicates the efforts of the querent. In this case Asc sublord 
Moon is lord of of 11. It is in the star of Ketu in 10. Ketu is in the sign of Mercury deposited 
in 2 and lord of 10. It is in the sub of Jupiter deposited in 6. Hence Asc sublord is the sig- 
nificator of 2 ,6 10 and 11. So querent’s efforts will be fruitful for getting a job. 


RULE FOR GETTING JOB 

As per Nakshatra Chintamani page 133 written by Sh. Chandrakant R. Bhatt, ilf the cuspal 
sublord of 6th 10 th house be the significator of house 2 ,6 or 10, service or earning is 
promised during the joint period of the significators of house 2,6 and 10. 


6 TH CUSPAL SUB LORD 

6th sublord Saturn is lord of 6. As Saturn is not having any planet in its stars, Saturn be- 
comes a strong significator of 6 by being sublord of 6. Cusp; further Saturn is in the star of 
Moon lord of 11 and it is in the sub Saturn lord of 6. Hence 6th cusp sublord is a significa- 
tor of 6 and 11 which fulfills necessary conditions for getting job. 


10th Cuspal sublord 

10th cusp sublord Jupiter is in 6 lord of 4 and 7. It is again in the star of Jupiter lord of 6 
and is in the sub of Mars in 2 lord of 3 and 8. Hence 10th cusp sublord signifies 6, 2 and 4. 
which is conducive for getting job in her hometown. 


2nd Cuspal Sublord 

2nd cusp sublord Rahu is in 4 and Rahu is in the sign of Jupiter in 6 lord of 4 and 7. It is 
further in the star of Ketu in 10 and it is in the sub of Saturn lord of 6. Hence 2nd cusp 
sublord signifies 2,6,10 and 4 which is conducive for getting job.

Miscarriage - A K.P. Analysis 


By: C. Venkata Ravi Kiran Kumar, m.a.,B.Ed., 
# 81/310-2-E, Rukmini Nagar, 
Kurnool — 518002. 


e-mail: ravikiran.cv@gmail.com ) 
Mobile: 9440305230. 





On 5 Sep 2013 I received a phone call for homeopathic advice for a woman who is having 
pregnancy for the 2™4 time. She was having some inconvenience with her pregnancy and 
doctors told that the embryo has improper heart beat and it may lead to abortion. I advised 
her with my little knowledge, and noted down the time for astrological analysis out of my 
curiosity. 


Hints: 

1. If the 5 CSL signifies 2, 5, 11, the woman concerned is pregnant. 

2. If the 5 CSL signifies 1, 4, 6, 10, 8, 12 connected with Mars, Saturn, Rahu, Ketu, then 
it is an indication for abortion. 
As it is her 2>¢ pregnancy consider 7 CSL instead of 5 CSL. 


Moon the indicator of the mind and the condition is owner of 10 in 11, in the star and sub 
of Venus, lord of 1,8 in 12, indicates anxiety, disappointment, surgery (8), hospitalization 
(12), recovery (11). 


Is Pregnancy indicated? 

For the 254 child, 7 CSL Rahu, in self star, conjoined with Saturn owner of 4,5 and occu- 
pant of 1, aspected by Mars owner of 2,7 and occupant of 10, confirms the progeny of 24 
child. 


Is Abortion indicated? 

Here further analysis shows the 7 cusp falling at 5.49.13 in Aries, a barren sign. The 7‘ 
CSL Rahu is in the sub of Venus (1,8,12), in self star Ra(1), in the sign of Venus (1,8,12), 
conjoined with Saturn (4,5,1), aspected by Mars (2,7,10) and Jupiter (3,6,9), indicates that 
there are more chances for a surgical abortion due to the presence of 8 (accident, surgery) 
and 12 (hospitalization) and the involvement of planets Mars and Saturn. Hence a surgical 
abortion is likely and informed the same to them at about 2.00 pm on the same day. 


What happened actually? 

She was undergone D & C, a type of surgical abortion on the morning hours of 6 Sep 2013 
in the DBAS of Venus-Venus-Saturn-Rahu when Moon was transiting in the star of Sun, 
occupant and owner of 11 — Badhka for the 7 cusp in movable Aries sign. 


Here readers may observe that the shadowy planet Rahu, being the cuspal sub lord for the 
7 and 11 cusps, finally had to go along with higher level Dasa-Bhukti-Antra lords Venus 
and Saturn for abortion in its Sookshma itself giving the results of conjoined Saturn and 
sign lord Venus. 


I humbly submit my Gratitude to Sri. K.S. Krishnamurthy Garu for inventing this divine 
tool to help the mankind.

Krishnaurthi Padhdhathi says that a planet will offer the results signified by the star lord, 
and that the Sub Lord decides the nature of results offered by the planet. This sub lord the- 
ory is the cream of the K.P. Therefore, in the analysis of a birth chart, we are paying more 
concentration on the position of the sub lord of the planets and bhavas. 


The sub lord position of the ascendant is the most important part in the delineation of a 
birth chart. This sub lord gives all the details about the native starting from the life span to 
all other qualities of the person. 

The following birth chart has been analysed according to the rules laid in the K.P. and the 
details is given here. 


Birth date: 16 November 1943: Time: 8.10 hrs IST (DST -1 Hrs) 
Place: Kandy, Sri Lanka; Long/Lat: 7 N 04, 80 E 38 


In this birth chart, it is expected to analyse the significance of sub lord and its role in the 
delineation. 


The ascendant falls in the sign of Scorpio ruled by Mars, in a star of Saturn and a sub lord 
of Jupiter. This sub lord Jupiter is the owner of 24 and 5th bhavas of this chart and occupy- 
ing the 9th bhava in the sign of Leo. Again, Jupiter is deposited in a star of Kethu, who is 
occupying the 3 bhava in Capricorn. Accordingly, Jupiter becomes a significator for 3'4, 
9th, 5th and 274 bhavas of this birth chart. 


In the assessment of life span of a native according to the birth chart, we consider the signi- 
fication of the sub lord of the ascendant. If this planet is a significator for the 1st, 5th , Oth or 
11th bhavas, the native will be blessed with long life. If significators are for 2™4, 6 and 8th 
bhavas, the native is destined to have a short life. If combined bhava significators, the na- 
tive is having a medium span of life. 


As the sub lord of the ascendant Jupiter is a significator for 3™4 , 9th (badhaka), 5t and 2nd 
bhavas of this birth chart, the native is destined to have a medium life. 


This native passed away peacefully in his native place on 11th July 2013 after spending a 
life span of 69 years. 


The sub lord of the 6 cusp is judged to find the sickness. The 6 cusp falls in the sign of 
Aries ruled by Mars in a star of Venus and in a sub of Mars. Aries shows the head and face. 
Mars for blood, marrow and veins. 


According to the sub position, he will suffer from sunstrokes. This sub lord Mars is deposit- 
ed in its own star, who is occupying the sign of Taurus and the 7 bhava. This combination 
causes the native to suffer from sickness of the head, chest and blood problems. Actually, 
he was suffering from phlegm, diabetes, and other complexities for a long time. 


The sub lord for the 8t cusp indicates the place of death and the mode of death. Here the 
8th cusp falls in the sign of Gemini and a star of Rahu in a sub of Mercury. This sub lord

Time of Judgment: 29-03-2012 (Thursday), 11:21:33 Hrs. (IST).

MOON REVEALS THE NATURE OF QUERY 


Moon (Taurus 27-23-17) is in the star of Mars (R) and sub of Jupiter. Moon is the occupant 
of 11, owner of 1. Starlord Mars (R) is the occupant of 1, owner of 5 and 10. Sublord Jupi-

Progeny and twin births - K.P. analysis 
By: Gunti Nagaraju 

M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 

KP astrologer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27 172206; 

9490752371 

Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 





Hindu scriptures while speaking about the importance of the institution of marriage in one’s 
life, have laid emphasis on the aspect of procreation. Birth and death is a continuous cycle 
of every living being and the birth takes place based on each one’s prarabdha karma. Astrol- 
ogy also gives much importance to the aspect of progeny while checking the matching for 
charts of boy and girl. The fifth house in one’s chart speaks of progeny and hence much 
care is needed with regard to the judgment of fifth house before spelling out anything about 
it. 


General rules for progeny 

For children, we have to consider the 2, 5 and 11 houses and also the strength of Jupiter. 
The 24 house stands for “family” which denotes additions to the number of family members. 
5th house stands for progeny and 11 house, though it is the opposite of 5 house, it is 5th 
counted from the 7‘ house-representing wife or husband. Whether or not one is promised 
children is to be judged from the 5 house. If the 5t cusp sub lord is connected with 2 or 5 
or 11, birth of a child is indicated and will take place during the conjoined period of the sig- 
nificator of 2, 5 and 11 houses. 


Rules for child birth - for horary charts - (Reader 6-page192) 

1. The sub lord of the 5th cusp is not RETROGRADE. 

2. It is not posited in a star of a retrograde planet. 

3. It is a significator of either 2 or 5 or 11th house. 

If any one of the above conditions is not satisfied, one will not be able to produce a child at 
all. Rahu and Ketu should not be considered as retrograde as these are only nodes. 


This is only for horary charts. In natal charts, do not worry whether a planet is in direct mo- 
tion or retrograde. There is no difference. Retrograde planets neither lose strength nor are 
they are harmful. (Reader 6- page 145) So no question of retrogression arises in judging the 
natal charts. 


If the query is from the wife, we have to consider 5+ house If the query is from husband, we 
have to consider 11t* house first and only then 5‘ house. If both 5 and 11 houses are not 
favorable, then both are sterile and will not have children. 


Twin births -— 

If the 5th cusp sub lord (11th CSL in case of Male charts) is a dual planet (Mercury) or pos- 
ited in a dual sign and signifies 2, 5 & 11 houses - then we can declare that the issues will 
be twins. As per Kanak Bosmia’s observation — if 5th CSL (11th in case of MALE charts) sig- 
nifies 7th and 2nd or 5 or 11th and connected to Mercury or dual sign, it can be twins birth 
during the (Dasa Bhukti Anthra and Sookshma (DBAS) signifying house 7 along with 2,5 & 
11. 

As per Sri K. Baskaran, if the sub lord of the 5 cusp is linked to cusps 7 & 9, then there 
will be birth of twins in the second delivery. (Principles of Cuspal Interlinks, Sagar Publica- 
tions, 2000, page 104) 


Whether pregnant or not— 
In the case of a horary chart, to know if the lady is pregnant or not, we have to examine the 
oth house.

If the 5 cusp sub lord or star lord is the significator of 2 or 5 11 and also posited in a fruit- 
ful sign viz, Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces, it is an indication that the lady is pregnant. 

If the sub lord or the star lord in which the sub lord is posited were to occupy a barren sign 
viz, Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo, the pregnancy may not be promised. 


Houses for child issues 

In female charts, for judging progeny- 

-5th cusp is seen for I issue 

-7th cusp for II issue 

-9th cusp for III issue: 

-11th cusp for IV issue etc. 

In male charts- for judging progeny- 

-1 1th cusp for I issue: first cusp for II issue: 3rd for III issue: 5th for IV issue etc. 


As per-- Tin Win / Dr. K. Rangarajan, Ph. D (KP Ezine July 2008) 

1. The following four methods of child gender prediction are tested for the number of 150 
child births of the total charts of 32: 

1) As per method by V.S.N. Murthy, KP E Zine July 2008, A = Cuspal sub-sub lord, B = sub 
sub lord of A, C = Sub-lord of B, D = Star lord of C; If D is a Male star, a Male child is pre- 
dicted; if a Female star, a Female child is predicted. 

2) A simplified method of V.S.N. Murthy’s method is A = Cuspal sub-sub lord, B = Star lord 
of A; If Bis a Male star, a Male child is predicted; if a Female star, a Female child is predict- 
ed. 

3) According to 4 Step method, A = Cuspal sub lord, B = Sub lord of A, C = Star lord of B; If 
C is in the odd sign, a Male child is predicted; if in even sign a Female child is predicted. 

4) In Hora method, A = Cuspal sub lord, if A is a planet without any planet in its star A itself 
or if Ais a planet with any planet in its star, B = Star lord of A is in the Male Hora, a Male 
child is predicted; if in a Female Hora, a Female child is predicted. 


Hora for deciding sex of the child - If 5th CSL or its star lord is posited in the - 
SUN hora - odd signs first 15 degrees- even signs second 15 degrees- MALE CHILD. MOON 
hora - odd signs second 15 degrees - even signs first 15 degrees- FEMALE CHILD. 


The finding of above study is the same as guruji KSK’s saying i.e., he never had any experi- 
ence in pin-pointing the sex (of child) before birth. (KP Reader IV page 236)

Question 1: Why cuspal Sub Lord is not considered? 


To analyze the chart of a mother for her son, who is bed ridden due to an accident, as per 
my understanding, I have to rotate the mother's chart to her 5th house for 1st child and 
forecast accordingly. 


To get more understanding on this matter, I have gone through some articles in the old 
issues of Arthrishta & Astrology magazines. But all the authors have discussed only the 
planet in house but not sub lord of the relevant house. And they have looked on planets' 
star and sub but not the sub lord of cusps. 

What is the reason? Which is correct? Can you please guide me? 


Answer 1 


After rotating the chart as you've said, the following rule can be applied, after counting 
houses from the rotated Ascendant. 


If the sub lord of mainly the 11th cusp and 6th cusp be the significator of house 1, 5 or 
11, the native recovers from disease, here injury, during the joint dasa period of significa- 
tors of house 1, 5 or 11. (For a Chara or movable Ascendant, 11t* house is Badhaka, so 
consider 9th house instead of 11 house.) (KP Reader VI, pp 158, 308; Chandrakant R. 
Bhatt: Nakshatra Chintamani, pp 12, 109, Further Light on Nakshatra Chintamani, p 15, 
Prashna Jyotish, p 83). 


The 11th or 6th or any cuspal sub lord (CSL) is also a planet, the dasa period lords. The 
CSL of a house indicates whether the house matter is promised or not. Here if the 
11th CSL signifies house 1, 5 or 11, recovery from disease or injury is promised. The joint 
dasa period lords, DBAS, pinpoint the timing of event, when one will recover from dis- 
ease or injury. (KP Reader III pp 226, 362/ 1971 edition, practical part pp 68, 194; KP 
Reader V page 224/ 1971 edition p 211). 


The signification of a CSL (planet) or dasa period lord (planet) should be considered at the 
planet, star and sub levels by occupation and ownership in general, and Rahu/Ketu by 
occupation, planets conj/ aspt and its star lord in particular. In order to know what each 
planet can contribute always consider its sub lord. (KP Reader III p 362/ 1971 edition, 
practical part, p 194) CSL or dasa period lord is a planet, and the signification of any 
planet should be considered up to the “sub” level of a planet, as per KP of the “sub” 
lord theory, otherwise it is not a KP analysis. 


Question 2: Different Types of Foreign Travel 


From KP-Ezine August 2013 ,12th CSL signification of 12, 9, 3 indicates overseas journey. 
What are the houses to be judged for: 

Permanently settling in abroad 

B) Staying for few years & return 

C) Just make visit & return? 


KP Ezine October 2013 48 


* Also, for an event — person leaving home for reasons, returning back to home. (joinin 
p g g g 
parents or brothers) 


Answer 2: 


1. Foreign travel is indicated if the 12th cuspal sub lord signifies house 3, preferably 9 or 
12, and to be materialized during the conjoined periods of significators of house 3, 9 or 12. 
This is the basic rule for any kind of foreign travel, and signification of additional house 5 
for visit or leisure, 6, 10 for job, 9, 5 (intelligence) for education, 7 for business or marriage, 
6, 8 medical treatment etc. (KP Reader III, p 314; KP Reader VI, pp 300-301) 


2. If both the 12th cuspal sub lord and 1st cuspal sub lord signify house 3, 9 or 12, then 
there is settlement abroad, as per a study of 100 charts of foreign settlement, otherwise af- 
ter a temporary or long stay abroad one comes back to the home country. 


3. One returns to the home country from foreign land during the joint dasa period of signifi- 
cators of house 3, 9 or 11, as per study of 20 charts that returned to the home country. 
Here house 11 indicates reunion with kith and kin and also fulfillment of desire. In addition 
to 11 house, for joining parents signification of house 4, 9, brothers/sisters 3, 11, spouse 
7 etc. Should be checked. (KP Reader V, p 207; KP Reader VI, pp 254, 263, 301; M.S. Me- 
hta: Planets and Travel Abroad, Sagar Publications, 1996) 


Question 3: Is abortion or miscarriage counted as an issue of child? 

I would like to have your guidance on the following issue, if your valuable time permits. 

How to select the required cusp for a particular pregnancy of a woman? For e.g., a woman 
who is having her 2nd pregnancy for the second child got abortion in the 2nd month. Now if 
I would like to Know whether she has another child promised or not? Do I need to consider 
9th CSL connection to 2 and 11 or 7th CSL to 2,11. 

Sri. VSN Murthy garu of Kurnool told me that any abortion from the 3rd month onwards 
should be considered as a delivery. Is this tested and found correct? 

If the qurrent & the astrologer don't know about the abortion (some times there is a possi- 
bility for this type immediately on 35th or 40th day after previous menstruation ) is it cor- 
rect to consider 5th , 7th, 9th, 11th for 1,2,3 4th child births? 

Irrespective of abortions do we need to consider living children only for the next child birth? 


Answer 3: 

The 5th house basically speaks about offspring, precisely about first child. The 5tthouse can 
be treated as hypothetical ascendant of first child. While interpreting the results for 5th 
house, we generally take the first living child of the native. But sometimes it may not give 
accurate prediction. In some cases, there may be miscarriage, abortion, death of first child 
soon after birth or still birth. In such cases, we have to understand that 5thouse gives in- 
formation of only miscarriage, abortion, etc of first child. The second child, third child etc 
are indicated by 7, 9 house cusp respectively and so on, as the younger sibling of the na- 
tive is presented by 3™4 house from 5th house. 

So when there has been an abortion or miscarriage after 3 months from conception, the fe- 
tus is counted as one issue of child because during that time the sex of child is already 
clear physically, and baby moves from being an embryo to the fetal period, now called a fe- 
tus whose heart beat can be heard with a fetal Doppler. For twin or multiple birth, only one 
issue is to be counted. (See K. Subramaniam, edt: Progeny and Romance, p 186; K. Hari- 
haran: Handbook on Astrology, Part II, pp 86-87; Sanjay Rath: Crux of Vedic Astrology, pp 
187-188) 

Another view by some is that a child is only after the birth with the birth time, and so any 
abortion or miscarriage is not counted as an issue. It implies that no house cusp is allotted 
for abortion or miscarriage of children. 


KP Ezine October 2013 49 


Question 4: Signification in KP, only Star or all three steps up to the Sub? 


In Reader 6 , one can see Guruji mentioning that that " If the sublord of 5th cusp is depos- 
ited in a constellation of a planet , which is a significator of 7 and 11 then love marriage is 
promised " . Like this Guruji has mentioned in so many places in Reader 6 . 


Here 5th Cuspal sublords star lord should signify 7 and 11 .Signification means owner- 
ship and occupation of 5th Cuspal sublords starlord or ABCD Significations of 5th Cuspal 
sublords starlord .Like this for other examples .Pls clarify . 


Answer 4: 


AS we are aware, only the usual grade A, B, C, D significators (by occupation and lordship 
of planet and its star lord) have been found consistently mentioned in the KP Reader III, pp 
342; KP Reader IV, pp 118, 128, 201; KP Reader V pp 149, 201; KP Reader VI pp 157, 197, 
247 etc. in particular, and KP SWs and the KP literature in general. Regarding Rahu/ 
Ketu, their significators should be considered as shown in answer 7 or KP Reader VI p 288 
i.e., more than KP SW print out. 


In addition to the above grade A, B, C, D signficators, the significators of the planet’s sub 
lord by occupation and lordship also should be considered in the KP analysis of the “sub 
lord theory” considering three steps up to sub level, according to the following KP funda- 
mental rule, (otherwise it will be only “stellar theory” with two steps of planet and its star 
lord only): 


"Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the results, and the SUB is deciding 
factor whether the matter is favourable or not." (Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Volume 2, Sugar 
Publication, Jan 1966, p 41) "This discovery has crowned me with success.” (KP Reader III , 
pp 136-137/ 1971edition, theory part pp 129-130, KP Reader V, pp 136-137/ 1971 edition 
129-130 & KP Reader VI, pp 81-82; Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Nakshatra Chintamani, p 23- 
24; K.M. Subramaniam: the last ‘Sublord Speaks' article LX, in K.P. & Astrology Year Book 
1998 p 69, reprinted in SUBLORD SPEAKS - part 3, p 141) 


Guruji KSK has crowed, "This discovery (of the sub-lord) has crowned me with success." 
under "Cusps and Subs- How to Judge" simultaneously in the KP Reader III, pp 137-150/ 
1971 edition, theoretical part, pp 131-144, KP Reader V pp 131-144 and KP Reader VI pp 
77-87, which was not included in the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 1 or 2. 


In other words, the signification of a planet by occupation and lordship at all “three” 
levels of planet itself, its star lord and sub lord should be considered, as in the Chan- 
drakant R. Bhatt’s KP book, considering the sub as deciding factor, calling houses 
signified at planet and its sub levels as "connected" houses with the planet. 


However, the “six fold significator table”* (i.e. the usual “four fold significator table” of 
grade A, B, C, D significators “plus” significators of sub by occupation and lordship) is not 
applied in the six KP readers in particular, and KP practice in general, because the sub’s 
signication cannot be considered as straight significators, which will contradict with the 
above basic KP principle of sub as a decider. (* The idea of “significators with the sub” 
mentioned in three places on pp 113-114, 274 and 318-319 of Krishnamurti Padhdhati, 
Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966, but no more in the six KP Readers) 


Moreover, there will be no more role of the sub in choosing fruitful significators, if it is in- 
cluded in the significator table; for e.g. for marriage, reject those planets which are in the 
sub of planets in 1, 6 and 10, as these are the 12% houses to the houses 2, 7 and 11, and 
select the planets that are on the sub of the planets signifying 2, 7 and 11. (KP Reader IV, p 
150) To select the strongest significators, reject the planets that are not in the sub of lords

of 2, 5 and 11. (ibid p 235) 


Therefore the six fold significator table supported by the KPAsro 4.1 WS can be used with 
caution regarding the sub’s significators, although the signification of a planet needs to be 
considered at all three levels of planet, star and sub. (KPE-zine Feb 2013 issue, Question & 
Answer section) 

With regards to love marriage, late Shri A. Raichur had found the rule "5th cusp sub lord’s 
connection with 7th house" valid in more than 90 percent of AA- rated 100 foreign born 
charts which are supposed love marriages, studied by Kanak Bosmia in testing of KP multi

Fortuna (KPE-zine Dec 2010 issue, Questions & Answers section) 
Fortuna = Moon + Lagna - Sun (in longitude) (KP Reader I, p 98) 


It is only a mathematical point in the chart. Generally fortuna is supposed to improve the 
matters indicated by the house occupied by it. Fortuna gives fortune to one in the conjoined 
period and sub period of the star lord and sub lord in which it is posited. (KP Reader III, pp

improving houses in all 4 steps. 





Planet Close to Next Cusp 

A planet is supposed to be a significator of 
both the previous house in which that planet 
is posited and the next house to whose cusp 
the planet is very close. In this case, the re- 
sult of the next house may not be effective as 
the previous house is detrimental or Vyaya 
or Vrava or negative to the matters of next 
house. (KP Reader III, KP Reader IV, Chan- 
drakant R. Bhatt: Nakshatra Chintamani). 


KP Grade E to Grade A Significators 

1) If a planet is in conjunction with a cusp 
within the prescribed orb, behind or ahead 
the cusp, the planet automatically becomes 
a primary (KP grade A) significator of this 
cusp in any of 4 steps. 

2) Only if the original planet itself is a prima- 
ry significator, i) if a planet is conjoined with 
another planet within the prescribed orb, the 
planet is a primary significator of another 
planet, ii) if a planet aspects on the cusps 
within the prescribed orb, the planet be- 
comes a primary significator of these houses 
whose cusps are aspected; iii) if a planet has 
the Hindu aspect (throwing or receiving) with 
another planet within the prescribed orb, the 
planet is a primary significator of another 
planet. 

3) Ketu’s 7th aspect on the cusp is taken. 

4) A well known practitioner does not use 
the 7th aspect of planets.

In this book, Secrets of RPs & the Birth Time, the author has explained the various meth- 
ods to rectify birth times (Known & unknown) based on the different types of questions 
raised by the client by using the Ruling Planets at the moment of judgment. 

This approach is in the right path of KP, as mentioned in the KP Reader VI, “To find birth 
time--- only the Ruling Planets at the moment of judgment will be useful and innumerable 
instances are given in the magazine “Astrology & Athrishta.” 


The general rule according to the basic KP guide line is that the present (RP) Moon will in- 
dicate the birth Ascendant and the present Ascendant (RP) will indicates the Moon’s posi- 
tion at the time of birth. 


The author says in this book, “Unless the client raises specific doubts in his birth-time, we 
need not attempt unnecessarily to correct the birth-time at all. However, it is better to 
check his birth-horoscope by taking the RPs....... Like this we should practice the art of re- 
lating all the twelve bhavas with the present position of the Moon........ Only because our 
predictions fail often, it is not reasonable to jump to the conclusion that the birth time is 
wrong’. 


Although there are so many birth time rectification methods, the author’s approach based 
on his research work may be helpful for KP learners in deriving the accurate birth time, 
which is the prime requirement for correct predictions.

Application of Ruling Planets in Timing of Minor Event 


In this article I would like to share my experience about the application of Ruling Planets in 
finding out the result instantly for a minor event. 


Ruling Planets: 

According to our beloved Guruji Sri. K.S. Krishanmurthy, the planets that rule a certain 
moment are called as Ruing Planets. It is the divine tool invented by our Guruji to clear the 
ambiguity of the astrologer, to successfully pore over the situation and to help the person 
who seeks his advice. Sri. K.S. Krishnamurthi ji has treated 5 Ruling Planets primarily in 
his teachings viz. 1. Ascendant Star Lord, 2. Ascendant Sign Lord, 3. Moon Star Lord, 4. 
Moon Sign Lord and 5. The Day Lord. For Day Lord the day must be from Sun rise to Sun 
rise. 


Later the Ascendant Sub Lord and Moon Sub Lord have also been added in the list of Ruling 
Planets. Of these, Ascendant Sub Lord is the most powerful and Day Lord is the least pow- 
erful one. Along with them, the planets which are in rapt conjunction with the above RPs, 
can be included in the list. If Nodes represent any RPs, include the Nodes also in the list of 
RPs. 


Whenever there is strong urge in the qurrent’s mind cast the particulars you are searching 
for. Astonishingly the RPs will reflect the scenario and will give clues to interpret. 


Here I would like to explain how the RPs helped to pinpoint the event which would happen 
in very short duration i.e., within 24 hours. The RPs at the time of query will jointly rule the 
Ascendant at the time of fructification of the event. It means the Ascendant should be the 
composition of the Ruling Planets on first come first served basis. In this process move the 
Ascendant where all the Ruling Planets will jointly operate at a particular point in the Zodi- 
ac. 


Example: 

On 22.08.2013 my brother-in-law told me that he would meet me in my house. I called him 
in the morning and afternoon but he was not available. At about 3:30 pm he called me, and 
said that he would be in my home in 15 minutes or so. I had been waiting for his arrival. 
The time passed, but he had not come. Then out of my curiosity, I opened the time chart to 
know his arrival with the help of Ruling Planets. 


Query: When will Sagar arrive to my home? 
Time: 22.08.2013 at 4.34.44 pm, Kurnool. 


Ruling Planets: 

Ascendant SL: Saturn; Ascendant STL: Sun; Ascendant SGNL: Saturn 
Moon SL - Mercury; Moon STL - Jupiter; Moon SGNL - Saturn; 

Day Lord -— Jupiter. 


At the time of query at 4.34.44 pm the Ascendant was 3.1.24 in Capricorn. The next As- 
cendant rising will also be a Saturn one i.e., Aquarius which lasts up to 7.54 pm. Saturn

Longevity 


In the chart of Prince George, the 1st cusp or Lagna sub lord Rahu, as discussed above, is 
the significator for 8, 12 & Maraka and Badhaka. 


The 8 cusp sub lord Sun is a direct significator for house 8, and its star lord Saturn signi- 
fies the 4th (terminal house). Furthermore Sun is in the sub of Mercury, occupant and 
owner of 8. No planet is in the stars of Mercury, which is the cuspal sub lord (CSL) of 9 
(Badhaka). 


The 1st and 8 cusp sub lords’ signification of 8, 12 & Maraka and Badhaka indicates a 
short life. 


Combined Effect of 1st, 6th , 8th and 12th CSLs 


The signification of house 6,8,12, Badhaka and Maraka by the 1st , 6 , 8th and 12h CSLs, 
as shown below, indicates that the native may meet any tragedy in his life. 


1st CSL Rahu (12), conjoined with Saturn (11-3-4), aspected by Jupiter (8-2,5), located in 
sign of Venus (9 Bdk-7,12), is in own star Rahu, and sub of Moon+ (2,9 Bdk) being the CSL 
of 6th house. 

6th CSL Moon (2-9 Bdk) being the CSL of 6 house, is in the star of Sun (8-10) and sub of 
Saturn (11-3-4). 

8th cuspal sub lord Sun (8 -10) is in the star of Saturn (11-3-4) and sub of Mercury (8-8- 
11) being the CSL of 9 Badhaka house . 

12th CSL Venus (9 Bdk-7-12) is in the star of Ketu (6), sign lord Ma+ (8-1-6) being CSL of 2, 
and sub of Rahu (6), conjoined with Saturn (11-3-4), aspected by Jupiter (8-2,5), located in 
sign of Venus (9 Bdk-7,12).

9th House 


As a common practice in KP and Vedic Astrology the 9t house of a native represents the 
father. When rotate the native’s chart to the 9tt house as the Ascendant, it is supposed to 


KP Ezine November 2013 34 


show all the matters pertaining to the father of the native. Keeping this in mind when we go 
through the natal chart of Royal Baby by taking his 9 cusp as his father’s 1st cusp, the out 
come is as below. 

For his father, 1st cusp (9 cusp of Royal Baby) sub lord Mercury is the lord of 12 & 3, locat- 
ed in 12th house, in its own sign Gemini, and is in the star of Rahu that is posited in 4th 
house. Star lord Rahu is conjoined by Saturn (3-7-8), aspected by Jupiter (12-6-9) and lo- 
cated in Libra representing Venus (1-11 Bdk-4). Sub lord of Mercury is Mars the lord of 5 
and 10, tenanted in the 12 house, being the CSL of 6t house. Such 1st CSL’s indication of 
house 6,8,12, Maraka and Badhaka is undesirable for his father’s safety in life or longevity. 
Coming Dasa

Profession and Promo on in KP 
By: Gunti Nagaraju 

M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 

KP astrologer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017; Tel: 040-27 172206; 

9490752371 

Email: gunti.nagaraju@gmail.com 





In astrology when we talk of predictions of a horoscope in general, we try to look primarily 
to the aspects of health, wealth and happiness. As the present generation is giving more 
and more importance to wealth, the aspect of profession has acquired importance. Astrolog- 
ically when we think of profession we think of the tenth house or mid- heaven. This is the 
house of honor, reputation, profession, business or occupation, and represents the public 
standing or worldly position of the native. It may be taken as the apex of the horoscope, or 
that portion which is thrust out most prominently in to the busy life of the world. Good and 
evil must both alike find expression, and culminate in honor or dishonor: and the culminat- 
ing point is the tenth point. Profession means it may be either through service (job) or busi- 
ness. Here in the present article I would like to discus (service) job and promotional aspects 
of it, of an ascendant within the frame work of rules evolved in the K.P system. 


How to judge the native’s profession? - general rules (Astro secrets and K.P. by sri M.P. 
Shanmugham, pp 156,194,348) 
1) If the 6 cusp sub lord signifies 6 and 10 houses — one will be in a service, i.e. paid job. 
2) If 10% cusp sub lord signifies 6 and 7 houses, the native is destined to be in service for 
some time and to be in business for other time. This takes place according to the running 
dasa and bhukthi periods. 
3) If 10% cusp sub lord signifies predominantly the 6 house, then it is a paid job i.e service 
by employment. 
4) If 10% cusp sub lord signifies both 7 and 10 houses, then it will be an independent pro- 
fession through business, industry etc. 
4) 10% cusp sub lord if connected to 6 and 8 houses, the native is destined to go only for 
paid job (service). 
5) If 10 cusp sub lord is connected to 6 and 8 houses and also 7 and 10 houses, the native 
is destined to be in service for some time and to have independent business for other time. 
This takes place according to the running dasa and bhukthi periods. 

A) During the dasa/bhukthi of lords of 6-8 houses, the native will be in a paid 

job. 

B) During the dasa/bhukthi of lords of 7-10 houses, the native will do business. 
6) If the 10% cusp sub lord signifies the houses 7-10-11 and not at all connected to 6-8 
houses, then the native will be doing independent business only till the end of his life. 


Promotion 

1) Promotion is the realization of an ambition of name, fame, prosperity and popularity. 
Hence 11th and 10th cusps are to be get connected. 

2) As promotion results in increase in income by self -earnings and in turn bank balance — 
2nd, 6th houses are considered and they should get connected. 

3) So for promotion cuspal sub lords of 6th or/and 10th houses must signify 2nd, 6th, 10th 
and 11th houses. One will have the promotion in the conjoined period of significators of 2, 
6, 10 and 11 (ibid pp 157, 192) 


Change of Job (ibid p 192) 

1) If the 10% cusp sub lord is connected to 3,10,12 houses, change of place in the job will 
occur. 

2) If the 10% cusp sub lord is connected to 3,9,10,12 houses, change in job and change of 
place will occur.

Question- 2: Dual Signs and Second Marriage 


It is imperative that one of the three Duel houses, Gemini, Sagittarius or Pisces must be oc- 
cupied by the sublord or the starlord of the sublord of the 7th cusp. That being the case if 
these three houses in a horoscope are unoccupied, can we take it for granted that a second 
marriage is ruled out ? 

I solicit your comments and suggestions to educate me on this doubt. 


Answer- 2: 
KP Second Marriage Rules 


1. If the sub lord of the 7th cusp or the star lord of the 7th CSL is situated is in a dual sign 
(Gemini, Sagittarius or Pisces) or happens to be a dual planet (Mercury), then 2nd marriage 
is promised. 

- KP Reader IV, page181 


2. If the sub lord of the 2nd cusp is connected with 7th house, 2nd marriage, if connected 
with 11th house one will keep a keep... 
- KP Reader IV, page 146 


2nd house = addition to family members by marriage and birth of children later 
7th house = legal bondage to share property, possessions, etc 
11th = pleasure, long lasting or permanent tie of friendship 


3. Rationale: The 2nd house being 8th from 7th house signifying the “death' of first spouse 
(7th house) or the ‘end' of 7th house matters (marriage, partnership) by divorce is referred 
for the 2nd spouse; 9th house being 8th from 2nd is referred for 3rd spouse and so on - - (to 
apply in the society of one husband- one wife system.) 

- Kalidasa's Utara Kalamrita, translated by Dr. D.S. Sastri, 2001, page 107 

4. Example chart, 30/Apr/1951, 08:30 AM IST, Lat: 11:08:0N Lon: 78:27:00 E, KP New 
Ayanamsa: 23° 5' 15", Asc. Ta 23:30:42, Bal. Dasa: Mars 0 Y, 2 M, 21 D, by KPAstro 5.1. 


KP Ezine November 2013 54 


Since 7th CSL Mars or Mars' star lord Venus is not in a dual sign and does not happen a 
dual planet Mercury, the 2nd marriage is not promised. 


Question- 3: Is Virgo a dual sign? 


KP Reader - 4 page 153. 

Article is from KSK ji himself. 

Para 4, 7th sub lord Venus is conjoined with Mercury and Mercury sign. 
Now if you check chart, Mercury is in Virgo. 

Bhatt also consider Virgo in his book. 


Answer- 3: 


As concluded in the article, “Why Virgo is not a dual sign? (Research Study)” , in KP-Ezine 
Sept. 2013 issue, it appears more reasonable to consider only three common signs, Gemi- 
ni, Sagittarius and Pisces, as dual signs, based on the linkage to the visual symbol of 
two pictorial figures of more duality, although Virgo sign is also found working in some 
cases, based on tons of references, among others: 


K.S. Krishnamurti, Fundamental Principles of Astrology (KP Reader II) 1971, pp_ 67, 75; 
reprinted from Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol I, Sagar Publications, 1966, pp 208,215-216 
(Dual signs: Gemini (Mithuna), Sagittarius (Dhanus) and Pisces (Meena) are called twin 
signs or dual signs meaning plurality... Bicorporeal or double-bodied signs: Gemini 
(Mithuna) representing a boy and a girl, 1st half of Sagittarius (Dhanus) representing a bow 
and an arrow, and Pisces (Meena) representing two fishes bound together by a cord are the 
bicorporeal or double-bodied signs... Mithuna, ‘Kanya’, Dhanus and Meena are common 
signs.); Horary Astrology (KP Reader VI), p 109 (Dual signs: Gemini, Sagittarius and Pi- 
sces; Bicorporeal or double-bodied signs: Gemini, 1st half of Sagittarius and Pisces) 
Chandrakant R. Bhatt, Prashna Jyotish, tran. Kanak Bosmia, 2013, p 266 (Dual signs: 
Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) 


It’s better to refer the consistently used practice other than sticking to one example or 
statement.

Thilak Astro Books 





This is a unique book of cuspal interlinks method as no such book is published before 2000 
when “Principles of Cuspal Interlinks” was first published. It clearly points out the concepts 
to assess the potential of each Bhava and also provides an effective tool to predict the event 
by natal or Horary using the cuspal interlinks method invented by K. Baskaran. The cuspal 
interlinks method of K. Baskaran is known as KB, and it’s now called the Baskaran astrolo- 
gy. This is the first and basic book to learn the Baskaran astrology of cuspal interlinks. 


Although the Baskaran astrology of cuspal interlinks is based on KP, and "This Book 
(Principles of Cuspal Interlinks) is Dedicated to My Guru Jothida Mannan, Jothida Marthan- 
dan Sri. K.S. Krishnamoorthty" by the author K. Baskaran, at the end of the book, in Epi- 
logue (pp 224-226), "With tributes to my Guru” the author K. Baskaran has placed his 
points (KB) which differ from KP, among others: 


KP: For marriage, the 7th cusp sub lord should be the significator of 2 or 7 or 11 


house. 
KB: For marriage, the Lagna sub lord should be linked with 2 or 7 or 11. 


KP Ezine November 2013 58 


KP: In Horary chart, if the 5 cusp sub lord is a significator of 2 or 5 or 11, the pregnancy 
is assured. 

KB: In Horary chart, if the Ascendant sub lord is linked with 2 or 5 or 11, the pregnancy is 
assured. 


KP: Various bhavas would be studied for a single question. 
KB: A single bhava for single question, of course with the study of its inter-links to other 
cusps. 


KP: In horary, 11 house counted from the Ascendant would bring success. 
KB: 11 house counted from the concerned house in question would be studied for success 
for the concerned matter. 


KP: 1,2,3,6,10 &11 —Beneficial Houses / to ASC 
4,5,7,8,9 &12 — Maleficial Houses/to ASC 
KB: 1,2,3,5,9 &11 — Beneficial Houses / to Concerned House 
4,7,8 &12 — - - -Maleficial Houses 
6,10 -------- Beneficial only with the help of others/family/society 


KP: No mention about the potential of a horoscope. 
KB: Advocacy of determining the potential first, by using Lagna. 


etc. 
The last part of the book, “Question and Concerned Bhava” covers house grouping, such as: 


I Bhava — Accidents: 1,4 & 8 + Mars + Saturn 
II Bhava — Monetary income: 2 &11 

HI Bhava — Foreign: 3,9 &12 

IV Bhava — Sale of house: 4,3 & 12 + Venus 

V Bhava - Love marriage: 5,7 & 11 

VI Bhava — Winning litigation: 6,1 &11 

VII Bhava — Marriage: 7,2 & 11 

VUI Bhava —- Unexpected accidents: 8,4 & 12 
IX Bhava — 224 marriage: 9,2 & 11 + Dual sign 
X Bhava — Promotions: 10,2,6 &11 

XI Bhava — Return from foreign nation: 11,2 & 8 
XII Bhava _ Imprisonment: 12,3,8 & 9 + Rahu 


etc.

1) For long life of the Mangalyaan space mission, Ascendant cusp sub lord (CSL) Ketu sig- 
nifies the desirable houses 5,11, along with undesirable houses 2 Maraka, 6, 8, 9 
Badhaka for the fixed Capricorn Ascendant. 


2) For good and safe journey, 12th CSL Sun+ signifies the required houses 9 (long journey), 
12 (space), along with the undesirable house 8 (difficulties in journey). 


3) For peaceful journey, 3™4 CSL Jupiter signifies the desired house 9 (long journey); and 9t 
CSL Rahu also signifies the required house 12 (Space) but along with significant significa 
tion of house 8 (difficulties in journey). 


4) For safe journey, 8 CSL Mercury+ signifies the undesirable houses 8 (difficulties in jour 
ney), 12 (unexpected troubles), along with desirably danger saving houses 1,5,11. It is an 
auspicious time for muhurat, especially in combination of not so long life of the Man 
galyaan mission. 


5) Generally it is a positive indicator for muhrat that the Ascendant is in a fixed sign, not in 
a movable sign (Chara Lagna). 


6) According to the compressed 300 days Vimshottari Dasa, Saturn Dasa- Rahu Bhukti pe 
riod (02-Nov-2013 to 09-Nov-2013) was running at the time of launching Mangalyaan. 
Dasa lord Saturn signifies the desirable house 12 for long journey. Bhukti lord Rahu also 
signifies the required house 12, but along with significant signification of house 8. 


Future Prospects 

Among the coming Mercury to Jupiter Dasas of the compressed 300 days Vimshottari Dasa, 
Mercury (15-Nov-2013 - 27-Dec-2013) and Rahu Dasa (02-May-2014 - 16-Jun-2014) would 
be crucial because of repeated signification of house 8, but could be hopefully survived by 
signification of house 12 (long journey), along with danger saving houses 1,5,11. 

After some possible troubles, as discussed above, the final Jupiter Dasa (16-Jun-2014 - 26- 
Jul-2014) indicates the successful mission by signification of house 9 (long journey) and de- 


sirable houses 5, 11, although fulfillment of desire may be lower than expected. 


We wish and pray for the safe and successful completion of the Mangalyaan space mission.

Background Note: | have recently joined a new organization from 1st April 2013. As per HR 
policy, there is a minimum six months of probation period I have to complete to get confir- 
mation in company. And accordingly, I am under the probation period up to 30 September 
2013. The Company’s HR verbally informed about my confirmation that I will get the same 
after completion probation period. I am aware that my company’s full time Director is out of 
country on business travel abroad. Without his approval (which is pending yet), I will not 
get my confirmation letter through HR Department. My company’s Director is expected to 
be back in office on or after 274 September 2013. So, I am in opinion that I should get the 
confirmation letter on or after 30 September 2013. But there will be Puja holidays starting 
from 11 October 2013. During the period from 2"4 October 2013 to 20th October 2013, 
there will be only 6-7 working days because on all other days, office will remain close on ac- 
count of Saturday-Sunday (off days) and holidays (Mahatma Gandhi Birthday, Mahalya, 
DurgaPuja-Navaratra and Vijaya-Dashmi). During this particular period, maximum of my 
office colleagues (including HR colleague) have taken pre-approved leave for forthcoming 
working days and are not present in office. Thus, the chance to get confirmation letter are 
weak in the specified period. So, I am in doubt whether I will get the confirmation letter be- 
fore 11t October 2013 or not? 


Question of Querent — When I will get confirmation letter in my present employment?

Case Background: 

My brother who is studying B.Tech. final year in a reputed college was in his trials for cam-

him had to be started around 11 am on 22-10-2013 but it went late. Meanwhile there were 
several gossips about the selection procedure, the board members, influence etc., etc. So my 
brother phoned to my mother and expressed his depression. Exactly at the moment I was 
there and opened the time chart to know about the board interview. Let me share my find- 
ings with you sirs.

considering 10% house signification would be appropriate. 

5) Hence if the 34 CSL establishes a bondage with 9,10 and 11 houses, it shows suc- 
cess in a job related interview.

gain to the native) in 3 (one’s ability) closer to the 4 cusp (retention in the present place), in 
self star and in the sub of Jupiter (5-2, 11), clearly indicating his thinking about the success 
in the interview for his job.

conjoined with Saturn; no planet in the star of Saturn, and Saturn is the CSL of 11" , show-
