Background Note: A recent case came in front of me pertaining to reunion and enjoyment 
of sexual married life. A young couple, who loves each other and recently had married in 
court without giving knowledge or permission of their parents and family members. But af- 
ter the court marriage, the parents and family members of married couple did not accept 
this marriage as it was an inter-cast marriage and not according to their status level. As a 
result the couple (husband and wife) is bound forcefully to live separately after having a le- 
gal court marriage. The husband came to me and asked about the reunion and enjoyment 
of sexual married life. Though he hesitates to explain his question fully, after a long discus- 
sion with him, it was observed that his intention is to know when he will able to have reun- 
ion and bed pleasure with life-partner (wife). 


My difficulty is that I have to judge two different queries by a single horary number. One is 
related to reunion and another is related to enjoyment of married life sexually. As we know, 
for reunion with partner, 74 cuspal sub lord (CSL) must signify 2, 7 or 11. And for having 
bed comfort with own wife, 12: CSL must signify 1, 5, 7 or 12. After deep thinking logically, 
it was understood that there must be reunion of the married couple at first, and thereafter 
any chances of sexual married life will arises. Based on the above logical thinking the analy- 
sis is done as follows to make the preediction which later comes true. 


Querent: Mr. S. Agarwal 

Question: When I will be able to have reunion and bed comfort with my life partner (wife)? 
Horary Number: 110 (out of 249). 

Date & Time of Judgment: 05-09-2013, 20:09:21 Hrs. (IST). 

Place of Judgment: Park Street (Long/Lat: 22N27, 88E20), Kolkata, West Bengal, India. 


Hint: 

If the 7+ or 11 CSL signifies 2 (family), 5 (love & romance), 7 (life-partner, wife), 11 
(fulfillment of desire, success) or 12 (bed comforts, sexual attachments), reunion along-with 
enjoyment of sexual married life (bed comfort) is assured during the joint period of significa- 
tors of 2, 5, 7, 1l and 12. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon (Leo 20-44-08) is in the star of Venus and sub of Jupiter. Planet Moon, being unten- 
anted, is the occupant of 12, owner of 11 and the CSL of 2. Starlord Venus is the occupant 
of 1, owner of 2 and 9. Sublord Jupiter is the occupant of 10, owner of 4, 7. Moon signifies 
or is in connection with the relevant houses, hence query is genuine. 


Gulberga Theory 

If the sublord of horary number furnished happens to be either Moon starlord or Lagna 
starlord among ruling planets, then the query is to be answered affirmative, otherwise not. 
In the case under reference, sublord of horary number (110) is Ketu, and Lagna starlord of 
ruling planets is also Ketu. Hence I told the querent that the answer to his query is positive 
according to his desire.

In the words of famous astrologer Sir ALAN LEO- “Horary Astrology, as the term implies, de- 


pends upon the hourly movement of the planets. Horary astrology as it means of divination 
is an art quite separate and distinct from Natal Astrology. The former is used solely for the 


purpose of answering questions and divining the future. It is therefore concerned with the 
birth of an idea , or a fancy , a thought , or an opinion and all those enquiries concerning 
subjects and objects; matters and forms; hopes and fears; and everything relating to things, 
animate or inanimate.” It is also said, as a matter of abundant caution, that “it is important 
to remember that no question should be asked, nor any Horary figure cast, unless the mind 
is truly serious and quite anxious concerning the matter upon which the information is 
sought. Otherwise disappointment and erroneous judgment will certainly result.” 


With this introduction on Horary Astrology, I would like to discuss a horary question-“when 
will I receive my pen parcel through courier?” which I sent on 19-12-2013. 

This question was raised in my mind on 21 December 2013, that is after the confirmation of 
the receipt of the parcel by M/S RATNAM PEN COMPANY- Rajahmundry to whom I had sent 
the pen for repair. Horary number I got by opening my astrology book lying on my table, at 
random was no. 63. Immediately I took it for judgment at 11.27.50 noon hours on 21-12- 
2013 at my residence Hyderabad. The chart is attached for ready reference. 


The ruling planets arrived on 21-12-2013 at 11:27:50 noon hours at Hyderabad are — 
ASC — Aquarius-- SAT-JUP-MER: 

RASI— Cancer-MOON-MER-MER: 

Daylord— SAT: 

RAHU represents- SAT-JUP-VEN, KETHU represents- SAT-MARS. 


Since Jupiter is retrograde and is in own star, it is removed from the RPs, and Rahu is taken 
instead of Jupiter. 

For answering such horary question, K.P rules say— 

“If 34 cusp sub lord signifies 3 and 11 houses and the star lord and sub lord of 3™4 cusp be 
in direct motion at the time of judgment— the answer is YES and it will be received.” 


Analysis as per the horary chart— 

3™4d cusp sub lord is Mercury. Mercury is the lord 4 & 12, placed in 6, Mercury is in Kethu 
star and Venus sub. Kethu represents Saturn and Mars. It is in O% house. Kethu is aspected 
by Mars lord of 11, in 3™ house. Sub lord Venus is the lord of 5, in 7, 

So 3rd cusp sub lord Mercury signifies 3 and 11t houses, and it means the pen parcel will 
be received back definitely. 

Since Saturn is aspecting 11 cusp and Moon it clearly indicates some delay in receiving the 
parcel. 

But when is the question? Since the event (repairing of Gold nib is a small job which in- 
volves short time) has to take place in few days' time, we have to consider the transit of 
Moon for arriving at the day of receipt of the parcel. I expected it to take place within 15 
days. Leaving a breathing time seven days to do the repairing work and I expected to arrive 
on the following probable days—

Clients ask all sorts of queries according to their requirements. One of my students residing 
in US asked about a person who had earlier asked whether he will get bail or not. As per the 
query my student noted the date, time and place of query and asked me to judge the Prash- 
na chart. Let us see how the Krishnamurti Paddhati reveals the truth. 


Query: Will I get bail? 

Date: 12-02-2014; Time: 23:15:13 

Place: Vallejo, California USA; Long/Lat: 122:15 W , 38:06 N 
Ayanamsa: 23:57:50 


(Editor’s note: This is a time chart at the time of query and not the chart at the time, date 
and place of judgment of the astrologer.) 


Hints 


As bail is a sort of application being forwarded in front of the judge, the prime cusps are 34 
and 9th, As 11 house is for fulfillment of desire, it must connect to both the houses 34 
and 9th for favourable judgement. 11 house is not an independent house, it is cross 
checked to confirm the matters of the prime cusp. 


Moon & Ascendant Sublord 


For this chart for the time, date and place of querist, Moon gives the indication of state of 
mind of the querist. Here Moon is placed in 9» house and it is placed in the star of Saturn 
which is placed in 1st house. So Moon is strongly signifying the houses 1 and 9. Ascendant 
cuspal sublord is Rahu and placed in 12‘ indicating that the person is in prison. As per the 
analysis the query is indicated strongly in the Prashna chart. 


Cuspal analysis 


374 Cusp - Sagittarius -08:58:00 (Ju - Ke - Ju) 

Jupiter is the cuspal sublord of the 3 house, it is placed in 9t+ house; it is in the star of 
Rahu which is placed in 12‘ house. So Jupiter is signifying houses 12 and 9 strongly; it is 
also lord of 3™4 and 6th. Hence Jupiter is favoring for bail. Let us see how its sublord is func- 
tioning. Jupiter's sublord is Venus which is placed in 3" house, and so it is favourable for 
the houses under consideration. 


9th Cusp - Gemini - 08:58:00 (Me - Ra - Ju) 
Jupiter is the cuspal sublord of the 9t house. As discussed above both Jupiter and its sub- 
lord are favourable for the query. 


11% Cusp - Leo - 16:21:26 (Su - Ve - Mo) 

Moon is the cuspal sublord of the 11 house. It is placed in the 9t house and in the star of 
Saturn which is placed in 1st house, strongly signifying house 1st and 9th. Moon is in its own 
sub and hence it also favours the client.

Question-Answer 


By: Tin Win

Question - 1: KP is 3- step up to the Sub. 


In the book “ STELLAR EFFECTS ON HUMAN LIFE” published by 

Krishnamurty Publications, by edt. Prof. K. HARIHARAN S/o Prof. K.S.K. 

First Edition: April 2006, on page 110 under topic “ Stellar Astrology- Its Role and Signifi- 
cance in Vimshottari Dasa “ , it is writen: 


“The matters signified by the houses owned by the lord of the constellation will be mainly 
the matters promised by the planet in its Dasa. Whether the matter is advantageous or 
not, is definitely decided by the lord of the SUB in that constellation. Here also note 
which houses are owned or occupied by the Sub-Lord. 

Do not scrutinize further.” 


In the Book “ KP 5th Reader- TRANSIT, Ninth Edition : 2004 — page 274 
under heading SATURN —- RAHU CONJUNCTION, it is written: 


Hence Mercury, ruling the star Ravathi, ...... indicates different nature of results to the peo- 
ple and Rahu sub shows whether it is advantageous or not, depending on the lord of the 
Constellation in which Rahu was posited. Rahu might be in the 11th house but 

it could be in the constellation of the planet occupying 12th house ; there by Rahu is inca- 
pable of giving a profit, whereas loss will be the experience. 

Also Rahu may be in 8th Bhava ; ... but Rahu may be in the Constellation of the planet in 
11th , when Rahu brings fortune. 

Hence, one should not pass a judgment whether a planet is a benefic or a malefic , only 
from the house occupied by it, but one is to note where the lord of the constellation is de- 
posited.” 


Sir, From the above statements , if we mix them, it shows the sub lord should be noted 
for its owned and occupied houses , also its constellation lord’s occupied house to decide 
whether the matter is advantageous or not , 


Sir, please clarify whether to follow both statements mixed or only one of them. 

Answer - 1: 

Basically it is to follow the following KP fundamental rule: 

"The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a deciding 
factor whether the matter is favourable or not.” 

--Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, p 41/ KP Reader III, p 136 / p 
129 (1971 Edition)/ KP Reader V p 136 (1971 Edition p 129)/ KP Reader VI p 91 


It is also important to note that without considering the signification of sub, it is not a KP 
analysis, since KP is the sub lord theory only, nothing else. 


“In order to know what each planet can contribute always consider its sub lord”. 
-KP Reader III page 362 (1971 Edition, Practical Part page 194) 


KP Ezine March 2014 41 


The occupied and owned houses of the planet, its star lord and its sub lord should be con- 
sidered at all three levels. It is to stop at the 3- step, i.e. not to scrutinize further to the 4- 
step: sub lord’s star lord. 


Question - 2: Promise and Timing of Marriage 


I shall be much obliged, if you will kindly spare your most valuable time and I seek your 
suidance regarding predicting separation / divorce in one's family life. I find in most of 
the articles that 7th cuspal sub lord signifying 6, 1-6, 6-10, 6-12, 1-12, 10-12, houses, but 
still only marriage has been predicted. The significators of 2-7-11 are also signifying 1,6 
or 10. Is it sure that 7th cuspal sub lord signifying these houses do certainly bring out 
separation? 


It is also specifically laid down that if the significators of 2-7-11 are also signifying 1-6-10, 
divorce / separation surely takes place. In most of the articles this do indicate. But only 
marriage timing is predicted. When all the 9 planets signify 2-7-11, automatically they be- 
come the significators of 1-6-10th houses. In such cases how to proceed. 


Kindly guide me in detail on the subject. 
Answer -— 2: 


“The cuspal sub lord of a house indicates whether the matter of the house is favorable 
(promised) or not. The significators point the time of event. Both dasa, bhukti and gochara 
(transit) must agree.” 

-KP Reader V page 224 (1971 Edition p 211), KP Reader HI pp 226, 362 (1971 Edition, 
Practical Part pp 68, 194) 


As long as the 7 cusp sub lord signifies any of marriage houses 2,7,11, marriage is prom- 
ised, regardless of its signification of negative houses 1,6,10 (12 to 2,7,11) and 12, during 
the joint dasa period of significators of houses 2,7,11. 


However when the dasa period (DBAS) lords signify marriage houses 2,7,11, along with 
marriage denial houses 1,6,10,12, the negative effect should be taken into consideration in 
deciding whether the dasa period lords are conducive to marriage or not. The signification 
by occupied and owned houses at three levels of planet, its star lord and its sub lord 
should be considered according to the fundamental rule of planet being the source, star 
lord - nature of the result and the sub lord - the decider. 


When many planets are the significators of houses, for the timing of event the fruitful sig- 

nificators can be chosen by: 

1. rejecting those planets which are in the sub of the planets signifying marriage denial 
houses 1,6, 10; 

2. selecting those planets which are in the sub of the planets signifying marriage houses 
27,11; 

3. selecting those planets which are in the ruling planets at the time of judgment; 

4. selecting the common planets among the chosen significators and the ruling planets. 


The 7‘ cusp sub lord’s signification of separation houses 1,6,10 or 12, along with marriage 
houses 2,7,11, indicates the possibility of separation after marriage during the joint dasa 
period of the significators of houses 1,6,10,12. The 6 house significators bring about sep- 
aration due to partner’s desertion. The 12‘ house significators denote that the native will 
seek separation. 


As the divorce will be finalized during the joint dasa period (DBAS) of the significators of 
houses 6,12,10,8 (KP Reader V, p 176/ 1971 Edition p 168), the 8 house (disharmony 


KP Ezine March 2014 42 


and quarrel in married life) is finally combined with other divorce houses. Moreover it is 
worthy to note that the 8th as house of delay, dejection and disappointment can not be sup- 
portive to marriage in consideration of timing of marriage. 


Question- 3: Giving Preference to Rahu/ Ketu 


Thank you very much for explaining the step by step method for selection of fruitful signifi- 
cators in February 2014 issue of KP Ezine responding to my request made by Email. 


Sir, I need to understand the 6th Step (Preference Should be given to Rahu or Ketu if it 
represents any Significator ) clearly. 
I do not have clear idea How this Preference is to be given. 


Question 1 


After what step should we consider the Node's representation ? After elimination of unim- 
portant Significators ( by step 1 ), can we consider the Node's representation and then fol- 
low the other steps in order ? or Should we follow all other steps until we get 3 or 4 Fruit- 
ful significators and then apply the Node's representations ? 


Question 2 


Let us say before considering the Node's representations, we have Rahu , Ketu, Sun, Jupi- 
ter, Mercury & Venus in the List of Significators. Now If Rahu & Ketu represent Jupiter & 
Venus respectively, should we retain Rahu & Ketu and omit Jupiter & Venus ? 


Let us say we have Sun, Jupiter, Mercury & Venus in the List of Significators ( Rahu & 
Ketu not in the List ). Now what should we do? Should we add Rahu and Ketu to the list 
while keeping Jupiter & Venus ? or Should we replace Jupiter & Venus with Rahu & 
Ketu ? 


I will be obliged if you kindly explain this. 

If you can give an example Birth Chart and explain all the steps (in order ) for selection of 
Fruitful significators ( including the method of considering Node's representations ) , it 
would be much helpful to beginners like me (I am staying in a country where no KP Gurus 
are available ). 

Answer- 3: 

The Node (Rahu/Ketu) represents the planet conjoined or aspecting the node and the lord 
of the sign where the node is located. The node’s representation for its star lord does not 
make sense because Rahu representing Rahu when Rahu is in the star of own does not 
make sense. 

Whenever Rahu/Ketu in the list of significators represents any selected significator plan- 
ets, Sun to Saturn, preference is to be given to Rahu/Ketu as fruitful significator in place 
of those planets because Rahu/Ketu is stronger than other planets. 

Further explanation with another example chart would be given another time.

time presentation of relocation chart (p 181), based on “One should not always calculate the

Introduction to KP relationship method of composite 
charts (KPCC)- Part 1 


By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 
Sahakar-2, Flat No: 28 
Jagabhai Park, Ram Baug 
Maninagar, Ahnmedabad—380008 
Mobile : +91-98 2531165. 
Email : kanakbosmia@yahoo.com 
I have found the technique of composite charts, as mention in this article, to be a more 
reliable new astrological technique in KP system. Generally this system used in western 
system. New astrological methods are constantly being developed and promoted by their 
discoverers, but no other method of relation checking like marriage matching, father-son 
relation, business partner relations, two country's relations etc by composite chart system. 
By using composite charts, we can predict very imaging result about relations, then any 
other system now used by KP community. 





The composite chart gives accurate indication with relationships in a new way. This method 
takes into account the fact that a relationship of any kind like marriage matching, father- 
son relation, business partner relations, and two country's relations is not simply two or 
more people or country or organization together. If two people or countries or organizations, 
involved with each other in some way, we can judge its relations by composite chart. 


When I first try with composite charts I was not satisfied and having many doubts. My main 
doubt is why two chart composite gives result, when there is no much sense to get midpoint 
of two charts. Later when I check many charts with various kind of relations I was wonder- 
ing how this composite chart as per KP System developed by me, gives me accurate and 
amazing result. I have introduced this technique of creating multiple composites, as per KP 
first time to the KP community. The KP relationship method of composite chart is some 
complex, but I will try to introduce it in this article in a simplified way. 


People who are familiar with mathematics will understand what I am mention in this article. 
Before someone start criticism on this article let me say, the only test is to try out a KP 
relationship method of composite chart (KPCC) and then criticize with valid proof of tested 
examples not copy of old pages. 


This article is in two parts. In first part, a complete details of the math's aspects of creating 
a composite horoscope. The second part of the article is how to read the composite chart. 
More experienced KP astrologers will find it very easy to follow KP relationship method of 
composite chart (KPCC). 


Part 1: Casting the Chart 

The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets 
and twelve bhava of the two natal horoscopes, Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon of 
one and the Moon of the other, like this all nine planets and twelve bhavas. The composite 
Sun is the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the two Moons; 
and so on for all the other planets. 


In all horoscope, Sun, Venus and Mercury are generally together, and are always in approxi- 
mately the same bhava or one bhava before and after. In the composite chart, we found 
some wonder as a Sun-Mercury opposition or a Venus-Mercury opposition, which are 
clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 
After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, find out relevant sub lord and check 
occupants and ownership in individual chart; if it is positive then matching good. 


KP Ezine Avril 2014 4 


Part 3: Checking the Dasa 

After calculating the midpoints of cusps and planets, and checking of relevant sub lord we 
have to find out the midpoint date of both. Details are given in the practical part. 

Now let me give one math's example practically.

By: Er. V.K Sharma, B.E. (Elect), 
JYOTISHVID (PRASHER), K.P HORARATNA

Punjab State Electricity Board,

A querent who was trying for change his job since long asked me to check astrologically 
when she will change the job. I asked her to intimate any horary number between 1 to 
249. Accordingly I casted the horary chart on dated 21-7-2013 as per horary number 35 
intimated by the querent. 


Horaray number: 35 [1 to 249] 
Date of judgement: 21-7-2013; 
Time of judgement: 7:12 P.M 
Place of judgement: Chandigarh 


Moon's Indication 

Moon is lord of 3 in 8. Starlord Venus is in 4 lord of 1-6 and it is in the sub of Mars in 2 
lord of 12 and 7. Hence Moon has linkage with 3, 5, 9 which indicates change in job (as 
3,5 and 9 happens to be 6,8 and 12 to 10 of profession or occupation) So Moon reveals the 
true nature of query for change of job [3,5,9] and 8 [tension]. 


Confirmation through Ascendant Sub lord 

In the case under reference Ascendant cusp sublord is Ketu in 12 in the star of Venus in 
4 lord of 1-6 and it is in the sub of Rahu in 6. Rahu is conjoined with Saturn in 5 lord of 9 
and 10. Hence Asc. cusp sublord signifies 5,9,10 which shows efforts of querent in respect 
of changing job. 


K.P. Rule for change of Job [Pages 296-297 Sixth Reader by K.S.K.] 

The 2nd house of horoscope stands for financial gains. The 6th governs service and 10th 
house denotes occupation, trade, business, profession etc. It is said that planets which 
are 6,8 and 12 to any house do not contribute to the matters influenced by that house. 
The houses which are in 6,8 and 12 to any house are considered to negate the affairs in- 
fluenced by the house concerned. On the basis of houses 3,5 and 9 respectively happens 
to be in 6,8 and 12 to the house of profession or occupation, and consequently the planets 
signifying these houses will contribute in their conjoint period to change in profession that 
he will change job/profession in the joint period of significators of 3,5 and 9. 


10ts Cuspal sub lord 

Here 10 cusp sublord is Mercury in 2 lord of 2-5; as Mercury having no planet in its star 
it becomes the strong significator of houses 2, 3, 8, 9, 10 and 12 by being the cusp sub 
lord. Further Mercury is in the star of Rahu in 6 and it is in the sub of Mars in 2 lord of 
7 and 12. Hence 10 cusp sublord is the significator of 3, 5 and 9 which fulfills the nec- 
essary condition for change of service or job.

By: Gunti Nagaraju

Education can be classified into three categories- primary, higher and advanced. Normal- 
ly primary education, now-a-days extends up to graduation levels, higher education goes 
up to post graduation levels, and advanced education to research (and Phd) and even 
more. 

PhD is a demonstration of research competence. There are certain things that the student 

likes to demonstrate through his dissertation: 


e Mastery of his subject 

Research insight 

Respect for the discipline 

Capacity for independent research 

Ability to communicate results and relate them to the broader discourse.. 


So, a PhD is research training leading to a professional research qualification. A PhD can 
be a deep, specific education in a discipline, preceding a postdoctoral period of on-the-job 
training. It involves doing a substan-tial chunk of research, writing it up and then dis- 
cussing it with professional academicians before submitting his thesis. 


In astrology this aspect of education can be studied from the fourth, ninth and eleventh 
houses of the native’s chart. 


What K.P rules say on this -- 

1)For education we have to see the Ascendant sub lord as it speaks about the studious 
and industrious nature of the native. The 4th house indicates the native’s regular attend- 
ance in a school or college, aptitude, general education and studious habits. The 9t® house 


speaks about higher education and 11+ house indicates success in education. 


2) Mercury and Jupiter as significators indicate the native’s mind and interest to study, 
while Saturn throws some obstacles during the period of studies. 


3) If the 4t» cusp sub lord is connected to 4 and 11, it shows completion of general 
education. 


4) If 9 cusp sub lord is connected to 4 or 11, it indicates success in higher education. 

5) Alternatively if 11tt cusp sub lord is connected to 9, it indicates higher education and 
if connected to 4% only without having any connection to 9, it indicates general educa- 
tion. 

6) 3™¢4 house indicates specialization or special subject when connected to 4 or 9 or 11. 

7) 4 cusp sub lord when connected to 3, 8 & 12 indicates failure in education. 

8) K.P rule says about the foreign travel for the purpose of higher education is— 


(A) 12th cusp sub lord signifies 3,9,6,11 and 12-one will go to foreign for higher studies

By: Dr. Nirmal Kothari | 
Doctorate of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Astrology & Vastu Sciences

Hints: 


Consider the houses 2, 5 and 11 for child birth. Cancer, Scorpio and Pieces are the fruitful 
signs and important for assessment for child birth matters. Jupiter is the natural significa- 
tor (Karaka) of child birth. 


2nd house denotes increase in the number of the members of family due to birth of a child. 
5th house considered for child birth. It indicates first conception or pregnancy, progeny or 
child. 11 house indicates fulfillment of desire. 11 is 5 from 7th. The 5th for female and 
11t for male is important. Thus, in a female chart 5 cuspal sublord is the guide and ina 
male chart 11 cuspal sublord is the guide for child birth. 


Considerer the houses 1, 4 and 10 (being 12 from 2, 5 and 11 respectively) for absence of 
children or for separation from children. Aries, Gemini, Leo and Virgo are the barren signs. 
Saturn and Ketu are the natural malefic planets for child birth. 


Name & Sex of the Querent: Mrs. M. Nayak. 

Question of the Querent — Whether child birth is promised or not? If yes, when? 

Date, Time & Place of Birth: 18-04-1982, 01:30:00 AM (IST), Bhopal — 23N16, 77E24, 
M.P., India. 


Cuspal analysis 


5th Cusp (Taurus 17-41-54): The 5 cusp sub lord (CSL) Saturn is in the star of Mars and 

sub of Rahu. Planet Saturn is the occupant of 9, owner of 1 and 2. Saturn is untenanted 

(there is no planet in the stars of Saturn), and it is the CSL of 4, 5, 6, 10. Starlord Mars is 

the occupant of 8, owner of 4 and 11. Sublord Rahu is the occupant of 6. Rahu is in Gemini 

and thus acts as an agent of Mercury. Mercury, being untenanted, is the occupant of 3, 

owner of 6, 9 and the CSL of 11, 12. Thus, 5 CSL signifies 2, 5, 11 and is in connection 

with 11, generally indicating that child birth is promised. But in fact child birth is not prom- 

ised due to the following reasons: 

¢ 5th CSL Saturn is a restricted planet as well as a natural malefic planet for child birth. 
Saturn is posited in Barren Sign (Virgo); 

¢ 5th CSL is in star of Mars. Mars posited in the barren sign (Virgo); 

¢ 5th CSL is in the sub of Rahu which is posited in the barren sign (Gemini). Rahu acts an 
agent of Mercury. Mercury is also posited in the barren sign (Aries). 


My Opinion: Child birth is not promised. 


Actual Fact: The above query was judged about 4 years ago, and till date the native has not 
been blessed with child.

If the 10th (one’s position in politics) cusp sub lord signifies house 10 (one’s reputation), 3 
(one’s ability), 11 (one’s reputation as winner) in the DBAS of significators of houses 3-10- 
11, one can win in elections.

Venus. Venus is the cuspal sub lord of 1-5-9. Thus the 10 cusp sub lord Jupiter (for oppo- 
nent) too signifies houses 3-10-11.

Question -1: What is the original Gulbarga Theory? 
A reader’s view: 


I read with interest in the morning a few articles and the mistake crept in the article is given 
below: 
The article by Er. V.K.Sharma on Foreign Assignment 


//Gulbarga theory: As per Gulbarga theory, if Ascendant sub lord of horary number fur- 
nished happens to be either Moon star lord or Lagna sub lord of Ruling Planets, then an- 
swer to the query is affirmative, otherwise not.// 


The Gulbarga theory does not take into account the lagna sub lord but it takes into account 
only Lagna star lord. 


In another article, page No 16 has the Gulbarga theory as said by me. Page No 28 too tells 
about Gulbarga Theory //12th Cusp Sub Lord In this case 12th cusp sub lord is Venus in 
12, lord of 2 and 7; it is in the star of own and in the sub of Rahu in 7. Rahu is conjoined 
with Saturn in 6, lord of 10 and 11, and Saturn aspects 9//. 

As Venus is in its own star, it gets signified to 12 - foreign assignment is assured in the 
DBA. Saturn’s aspect in this case is not considered in KP by Prof KSK.

If the sub lord of the horary number is the same as of Lagna star or moon star the native 
can enjoy the fruits 100 per cent. If the sub lord of the horary number is the same as that 
Lagna sign or moon sign lords the native can derive success to the extent of 50 per 

cent. Depending on the nature of query, we have to take the sign lord of Lagna and 

Moon. Other wise we should stick to the star lord of Lagna and Moon. 


While the Gulbarga theory has been correctly stated in Page No 16 and Page No 28, this 
mistake may be kindly corrected. 


A line in reply is very much appreciated

Answer- 1: Original Gulbarga Theory 


According to the finding of the Gulbarga Astrological Association, the Gulbarga Theory 
states - 


If the sub lord of the Horary number given by the querent happens to be either the 
star lord of the Ascendant or the Moon (in the ruling planets), then the answer to the 
query is Yes, otherwise No. 


References: 
e Astrology and Athrishta October 1975 and July 1979 issues 


e RP & KP, Edt K. Subramniam, K. Hariharan, Hariman Publications, 1985, p 129 
Astro secrets & K.P. Part VI, pp 130, 195, 205

ant and Moon, as given under.

KP Ayanamsa 23:27: 

Asc sign lord: Saturn, Star lord: Mars 

Moon sign lord: Sun, Star lord: Mars 

Day lord: Sun 

So as per the Gulbarga Theory, the answer to the query is affirmative, Yes. 


There is no Gulbarga Theory approved by Guruji K.S.K. 

This Yes or No type of theory has been found not so reliable in practice. 

This theory is mostly applied as a supportive technique. 

Only the above original Gulbarga Theory will be allowed in the KP-Ezine.

is experienced. If this correct, it will be easy to note the matters of Dasha-Period 

Though this is logically seems to be correct, I need the advice of experts. 


Answer- 2: 

The dasa period DBAS lord or the cuspal sub lord is a planet. The signification of a planet 
should be considered at three levels of planet itself, its star and its sub by occupation and 
lordship according to the following KP fundamental rule: 


KP Ezine Avril 2014 48 


"The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is 

a deciding factor whether the matter ts favorable or not." 

-- Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, p 41/ KP Reader III, p 136 / p 
129 (1971 Edition)/ KP Reader V p 136 (1971 Edition p 129)/ KP Reader VI p 91 

Without considering the signification of sub, it is not a KP analysis, since KP is the sub lord 
theory only, nothing else. 


Question- 3: Planet in the Sub of Retrograde Planet 

Sir, Iam a learner in KP System and am encountering with different views and opinions 
about the planets in retrograde motion and their effects on fructification of events. In the 
horary chart analysis - 


i) Retrograde planets, if deposited in a star of a planet which is in direct motion, indicates 
that after some obstacles and delay, the matter will materialise when it becomes in di- 
rect motion and passes beyond the point wherefrom retrograde motion started. 


ii) Retrograde planet if deposited in a star of another retrograde planet or in its own when 
retrograde, promises only failure, never success. 


iii) Direct motion planet, if deposited in the star of a retrograde planet, one cannot have suc- 
cess. 


Whereas in the case analyzing 11th cusp for fulfillment of desire, it is stated that the three 
conditions must be fulfilled - i.e. (i) the 11th Cuspal Sub Lord should not be retrograde, (ii) 
Sub Lord should not be in the star of a retrograde planet and (iii) Sub Lord should signify 
11th or any one of the houses relevant to the query. 


All these rules ends only at Star level and no rules at sub level retrogradation. 


Referring to the KP E-zine April 2007 issue under Theory of Retrogradation, it is said - Ret- 
rograde planet in horary is nothing, and if it is posited in the star of which is again retro- 
grade, yet it is nothing (star lord is also a planet) but if it is posited in retrograde sub then it 
is a Red Light. 


It is therefore quite contradictory and confusing. It is not mentioned about the Sub Lord 
retrogradation i.e. while analysing the query through cuspal sub levels, we take the sub 
lord, its star lord and at sub level. In such cases the cuspal sub lord and its star lord be in 
direct motion and if it happens to be in the retrograde sub etc. what would be the effect of 
signification and result of that cusp/ planet. 


I would be much obliged if you will kindly clarify in detail. 


Answer-3: 
Choice of Astrologer 


In KP, retrogression does not matter in the natal chart analysis but it does not give the due 
result in the Horary analysis, if the sub lord of the concerned cusp is in the star or sub lord 
of retrograde planet. It has been found valid by many KP astrologers, and D.C. Ghose had 
found that the retrograde planet has failed to offer the due result in hundred of Horary cas- 
es. (K.P. & Astrology Year Book 1995 p 6) 


But based on their rationale and experience, retrogression has been ignored by some astrol- 
ogers, like K.M. Subramaniam (K.P. & Astrology Year Book 1997 p 51, Sublord Speaks- 1 p 
84-5), Kanak Bosmia (KP Muhurat p 3), Sunil Gondhalekar (Four StepTheory p 54), Umang 
Taneja (Prashna), S P Khullar (Horary Astrology p ix). 


KP Ezine Avril 2014 49 


As encouraged by Guruji KSK, "My friends, we have come up to this- you should continue 
the research and you may reach to further truth". (K.P. & Astrology Year Book 1995 p 7 and 
1996 p 63) So a research has been in progress in compilation of of a minimum of one hun- 
dred carefully documented Horary charts to form a credible opinion on retrogression wheth- 
er it does matter or not in the Horary analysis. 


It is therefore to follow whichever gives astrologer the better results based on own 
rational and experience, also depending on individual case and type of question. 


Cuspal Sub Lord in the Sub of Retrograde Planet 


See whether any of ruling planets is deposited either in the constellation or sub of a retro- 
grade planet. If there is any, reject it. (KP Reader VI, p 202) 


If you would have mentioned a number so that the sub lord of the 7th cusp is deposited in 
the constellation of a planet or node in 6 or 12 and in the sub of Jupiter (which is retro- 
grade), then there will be the mind to separate, but it will not materialize. (KP Reader VI, p 
254) 


In a word, the planet in the sub of a retrograde planet should be rejected or dropped. (Dr. 
Kar: Astrology & Athrishta - September 1978 issue, p 33) 


If retrogression of a planet and its star lord is nothing but if they are found in retrograde 
sub, planet in question for judgment should be rejected outright because sub is the final 
and deciding factor. (This is the vital suggestion in KP for hoary). (Dr. Kar, K.P. & Astrology 
1996, page 51) 


In example 7 (p 92) and example 24 (p 139) of Chandrakant R. Bhatt: Prashna Jyotish, 
2013, the prediction of negative result came correct based on the sub lords of the concerned 
cusps in the sub of retrograde planet. 


But in example 33 (p 162) of the same book, the prediction of positive result came correct 
based on the sub lords of the concerned cusps in the sub of retrograde planets which are 
the strong significators of the relevant houses. A similar case is in K.P. & Astrology Year 
Book 2009 p 12, by Pankaj Himvan. 


Question- 4: KP Learning 


I'm just started to read Astrology and after some basics I'm reading KP system. I got a doubt 
which I could not get answer in any websites or books etc. 


Let us take Naksatra Cintamani book by Bhat. He has give one example chart in the begin-

Jupiter is kept below the cusp degree of 11th house Scorpio and consider as Scorpio house 
for calculating Lord and sub lord. Means here also it is consider as in which house they are 
present as per KP system. 

However when finding significators, Jupiter is consider as occupant of 10th house. Though 
it is written below the cusp of 11th house it is consider as occupant of 10 th house and said 
as occupant of 10th house. 


Contrasting to this Mars is kept above the cusp position of 8th house, it is consider as oc- 
cupant of 7th house. 


KP Ezine Avril 2014 50 


I got confused. Please help to understand. 
Answer- 4: 


In “Nakshatra Chintamani” book by Chandrakant R. Bhatt, for the Example Birth Horo- 
scope No. 1 on p 1, Inserting the Signs and the Planets is explained on pp 2-4. 


In KP the beginning of each cusp is called the Cusp. A house covers from its cusp to the 
next cusp. The cusp of 7 house begins with Cancer 12° 25’ and the next cusp of 8th house 
begins with Leo 19° 44’. As per unequal Placidus house system used in KP, the 7 house is 
from the 7‘ cusp Cancer 12° 25’ to the next 8 cusp Leo 19° 44’. So Mars in Leo 1° 40' is 
placed in the 7 house. Similarly Mercury in Cancer 13° 2’ is also placed in the 7‘ house. 
Accordingly Mars and Mercury are the occupant of the 7‘* house. (p 3) Therefore it is said 
that Mars in Leo 1° 40' is placed behind Leo 19° 44’ the cusp of the 8t hose and it is said to 
be in the 7 house. (p 3) 


In the sub table D on p 9, the 7‘ cusp Cancer 12° 25’ is between Cancer 12° 6’ 40" Star Sat- 
urn- Sub Mars and Cancer 12° 53’ 20” Star Saturn- Sub Rahu, and so the 7‘ cusp is in 
the star of Saturn and sub of Mars, as shown on p 11. 


Jupiter in Scorpio 14° 2’ is placed behind the 11 cusp in Scorpio 21° 28' and after the 10% 
cusp in Libra 25° 44’ (p 1), and so Jupiter is placed in the 10th house which ranges from Li- 
bra 25° 44’ to Scorpio 21° 28’. Accordingly Jupiter is the occupant of 10th house. (p 3) 


In the sub table C on p 8, the 10 cusp Libra 25° 44' is between Libra 23° 53' 20" Star Jupi- 
ter- Sub Mercury and Libra 25° 46' 40" Star Jupiter - Sub Ketu, and so the 10% cusp is in 
the star of Jupiter and sub of Mercury, as shown on p 11. 


Question- 5: Promise of Higher Education 


In Astrology & Education by Sr K. Subramaniam , 2°4 Edition, May 2004. 
on page 73, para- 2 , he states as fallows: 


Fourth Bhava sub lord may be any planet, and that sub-lord should be deposited 

in the stars of lord of 4 - 9 - 11 OR the house it occupies OR co-joined with other 

planets with in 2 ° level OR the sub-lord stationed in one of the 9 divisions of that star the 
sub-lord signifying 4 —- 9 - 11 houses- all these levels when found connected to 4-9- 11 
houses, the Native is sure to have higher education. | have made it very clear. I am very 
assertive about it. 

All 4- Conditions should agree ? or any one condition is enough to promise Education. 


What is the meaning ? “the sub-lord stationed in one of the 9 divisions of that star the sub 
-lord signifying 4 — 9 —- 11 Houses” 


What this means ? “all these levels when found connected to 4-—9- 11 houses” 
Request you to help me to understand this thinking. 
Answer- 5: 


If the 4 cusp sub lord signifies 4 (education in general), 9 (higher education), 11 (Success) 
houses, then higher education is promised for the native. 


In other words, if the 4t cusp sub lord planet signifies 4, 9, 11 houses at three level of plan- 
et, its star, and its sub by occupation and ownership, then higher education is promised for 


KP Ezine Avril 2014 51 


the native. The signification of 4, 9, 11 houses can be at any level, out of three planet, its 
star lord and its sub lord level. The signification of planet conjoined or aspected by the 
grade A, B, C & D significators is a very weak grade E significator, and it is only used as the 
last resort. 


For higher education, the 9t CSL’s signification of houses 4,9,11 is also to be checked. 
In addition, in horary analysis the 11 (fulfillment of desire) CSL’s signification of houses 
4,9,11 is also to be cross checked. 


For example of “Chart: Two” in the above referred book page 139 - - 


4th cusp (Aqugqrius 16° 48' 20") sub lord Venus is in the star of Moon and sub of Mercury. 
Planet Venus is the occupant of house 3 and owner of houses 7 and 12. Star lord Moon is 
the occupant of house 10 and owner of house 9. Sub lord Mercury is in house 4, lord of 
houses 8, 11, no planet is in the stars of Mercury, and Mercury is the CSL of 11. So 4% CSL 
Venus signifies 9, 11, and indicates success in examination. 


Note: If a planet doesn’t have any planet in its stars, that planet becomes the significator of 
house(s) for which it is the cuspal sub lord. In the above example “Chart: Two”, Mercury 
doesn’t have any planet in its stars, and Mercury is the cuspal sub lord of 11 house. So 
Mercury becomes the strong signifcator of house 11. 


9th cusp (Cancer 14° 48' 20") sub lord Rahu is in 10, conjoined with Moon in 10, lord of 9, 
Rahu’s sign lord Mercury in 4, lord of 8,11, no planet is in the stars of Mercury, and Mercu- 
ry is the CSL of 11. Rahu is in the star of Venus in 3, lord of 7,12 , and sub of Saturn in 9, 
very close to 10 cusp, lord of 3,4. So 9 CSL Rahu signifies 4, 9, 11, and success in ex- 
amination is promised. 


11t cusp (Virgo 18° 48' 20") sub lord Mercury is in 4, lord of 8,11, no planet is in the stars 
of Mercury, and Mercury is the CSL of 11. Mercury is in the star of Saturn in 9, very close 
to 10 cusp, lord of 3,4, and sub of Jupiter in 8, lord of 2,5. So 11 CSL Mercury signifies 
4, 9, 11, and success in examination is promised. 


According to the KP fundamental rule: 


"The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is 
a deciding factor whether the matter ts favorable or not." - - 


Consideration of only two levels of planet and its star is stellar theory, but not KP. 
Consideration of three levels of planet, its star and its sub is KP of the sub lord theory. 
Consideration of the star lord of the planet’s star is not KP. 

Consideration of the star lord of the planet’s sub is not KP.

Book Review- 
Vedic Astrology- Stock Market Analysis 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Vedic Astrology- Stock Market Analysis 

by Jyotish Vachaspathi, R. G. Krishnan 

The Institute of Vedic Astrology 

3813 Bradford Dr., Richardson, TX 75082, USA 


1981, 135 pages 





Though Stock Market Astrology book was printed and published in USA in 2001, this book 
has the distinction of being produced by an astrologer of Indian origin based on Vedic as- 
trology. The various Vedic Astrology principles that affect the trends in the stock market are 
discussed with reference to astrological situations that occurred in the past, and have been 
exemplified on New York Stock Exchange. 

The book covers a wide range of topics to explain how to evaluate the long and short term 
projections in the stock market. Effective tools of important conjunctions and oppositions 
like that of Jupiter-Saturn, the volatile character of Mercury, eclipses, solar ingresses, luna- 
tion, Ashtaka varga and others are dealt with a number of examples. With useful hints as to 
when to buy or sell stocks, the various factors are correlated to help arrive at proper conclu- 
sions. Should the reader desire to focus on a specific company, a study is also devoted to 
planetary positions in the individual corporation’s natal chart which are conducive to suc- 
cess in stock trading. Stock market projections, month by month for the years 2001 and 
2002, have been given with astrological reasoning to verify the efficacy or otherwise of the 
hints given. 

This book may be a helpful basic for analysis of stock market fluctuations by KP principles.

Dasa and Transit 

At the time of the 2004 Indian general elections, the running Dasa lord Mercury is the sig- 
nificator of houses 6,10, Bhukti lord Mars 3,9,10,11, Antra lord Jupiter 6,10, and 
Sookshma lord Venus 9,10,11. 


On the first polling day of the 2004 general elections, the running Dasa lord Mercury was 
transiting in the star of Ketu, agent of Dasa lord Mercury and Bhukti lord Mars and sub of 
Sookshma lord Venus; Bhukti lord Mars in the star of own Mars and sub of Rahu, agent of 
Sookshma lord Venus; Antra lord Jupiter in the star and sub of Sookshma lord Venus; 
Sookshma lord Venus in the star of Moon in house 9, lord of house 11 and sub of Ketu, 
agent of Dasa lord Mercury and Bhukti lord Mars. 


At the time of the 2009 Indian general elections, the running Dasa lord Mercury is the sig- 
nificator of houses 6,10, Bhukti and Sookshma lord Jupiter 6,10, and Antra lord Moon 
9,11. 


On the first polling day of the 2009 general elections, the running Dasa lord Mercury was 
transiting in the star of Venus, significator of houses 9, 11 and in the sub of Rahu, signifi- 
cator of 9,11; Bhukti and Sookshma lord Jupiter in the star of Mars, significator of 3 and 
sub of own Jupiter; Antra lord Moon in the star of Venus, significator of 9,11 and sub of 
Rahu, significator of 9,11.

Introduction to KP relationship method of composite 
charts (KPCC)- Part 2 


By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 
Sahakar-2, Flat No: 28 
Jagabhai Park, Ram Baug 
Maninagar, Ahnmedabad—380008 
Mobile : +91-98 2531165. 


Email : kanakbosmia@yahoo.com 





Part 1: Casting the Chart 


The composite horoscope is created by calculating the midpoint between pairs of planets 
and twelve cusps of the two natal horoscopes, Sun of one and the Sun of the other, Moon 
of one and the Moon of the other, and so on for all nine planets and twelve cusps. The 
composite Sun is the midpoint of the two Suns; the composite Moon is the midpoint of the 
two Moons, and so on for all the other planets. 


A midpoint is a middle point in the zodiac from two other points. The whole system of as- 
trology has been created around these mid points. Generally in horoscopes, Sun, Venus 
and Mercury are together and are always in approximately in the same bhava or one bha- 
va before and after. In the composite chart, we have found a wonder of Sun-Mercury oppo- 
sition or Venus-Mercury opposition, which is clearly impossible in an ordinary chart. 


Part 2: Checking the Chart 


After calculating the midpoints of cups and planets, we have to find out relevant sub lord 
and check occupants and ownership in individual chart, if it is positive then matching is 
good. 


Part 3: Checking the Dasa 


After calculating the midpoints of cups and planets, and checking of relevant sub lords we 
have to find out the midpoint dates of both. Details are given in the practical part. 


New let me give one mathematical example practically.

Cuspal Positions for Opponent 
(Chart is rotated to 7 cusp as Lagna of Opponent) 


11%: Cusp (Capricorn 23-49-40): The sublord of 11 cusp Mars® is in the star of self (Mars) 
and sub of Mercury. Planet Mars® is the occupant of 7, owner 2 and 9. Starlord Mars® is 
the occupant of 7, owner 2 and 9. Sublord Mercury is the occupant of 11, owner of 4 and 7. 
There is no planet in the stars of Mercury, and Mercury is the CSL 6, 12. Thus 11th CSL 
Mars® is in connection with 6, 11. 

(Note: The 118 CSL and its Starlord Mars is retrograde at the time of judgment and will re- 
main retrograde during the period from voting to till the date of declaration of result). 


6s Cusp (Leo 24-24-35): The sublord of 6 cusp Mercury is in star and sub of Rahu. Plan- 
et Mercury is the occupant of 11, owner of 4 and 7. There is no planet in the stars of Mercu- 
ry, and Mercury is the CSL of 6, 12. Starlord Rahu is the occupant of 7. Rahu conjoined to 
Moon-Mars-Saturn and thus acts an agent of Moon-Mars-Saturn. Moon is the occupant of 
7, owner of 5. Mars® is the occupant of 7, owner 2 and 9. Saturn® is the occupant of 8, 
owner of 11, 12. So 6 CSL Mercury signifies 6, 11 and is in connection with 6, 11. 


10% Cusp (Sagittarius 22-40-26): The sublord of 10 cusp Saturn® is in star of Jupiter 
and sub of Sun. Planet Saturn® is the occupant of 8, owner of 11 and 12. Starlord Jupiter 
is the occupant of 3, owner of 1 and 10. Sublord Sun is the occupant of 12, owner of 6. 
There is no planet in the stars of Sun, and Sun is the CSL 7, 9. Thus 10 CSL Saturn® sig- 
nifies 10, 11 and is in connection with 6. 

(Note: 10% CSL Saturn is retrograde at the time of judgment and will remain retrograde dur- 
ing the period from voting to till the date of declaration of result). 


Conclusion: Congress Party will not win Odisha State Assembly Election 2014. Because 
both 11 and 6% CSLs signify 6, 10 and 11 for Congress Party and 6, 11 only for the oppo- 
nent, but 10 CSL signifies 6 only for Congress Party and 6, 10, 11 for the opponent.

There are many factors that influence the institution of the marriage and I feel that astrolo- 
gy to some extent plays an important role in finding some solutions. And here is one such 
case of a native which I would like to discuss applying K.P. rules. 


The birth details of the native are— 
Name- Ms JOJO: DOB-22MAY 1984: TOB-10:38:20 A.M: POB-HYDERABAD. 


What K.P. rules say regarding marriage and its related aspects --- 


Love marriage- For materialization of love affairs K.P. rules say — 
If 7th cusp sub lord signifies 2 or 7 or 11 marriage is promised. 


If 5th cusp sub lord is a strong significator of 7 and 11, love affair will materialize into 
marriage. 


If 5th and 7th cusps are interconnected, then the chance of materialization of love affair 
is confirmed provided they signify 2, 7 and 11 houses. 


If the 5th cusp sub lord is in any way connected to O6 and 12 along with the 
significations of 2, 5, 7 and 11, then the love affair will be a failure. 


(E) If 7th cusp sub lord is in any way connected to 5th along with 7 —- one may marry a 
boy/girl loved by her/him. 


If the 7th cusp sub lord is the significator of 5, it denotes love marriage and if it is 
connected with Rahu or Ketu, it indicates an inter cast marriage or /and unconvention- 
al marriage. 


As per the chart— 


(A) Marriage : 7‘ cusp sub lord is Jupiter. 

Jupiter is the lord of 6 and 9 placed in 6. Jupiter is in star of Venus lord of 4 and 11 
placed inlO“, Jupiter is in sub Rahu placed in 10, very close to 11 cusp. Rahu 
represents Sun, Mars and Venus. Sun is the lord of 24, Mars is the lord of 5s and Venus is 
the lord of 11. 7 cusp sub lord Jupiter signifies 2, 5 and 11, and so as per rule marriage 
took place. 


(B) Love Marriage: 5t cusp sub lord is Jupiter. As discussed above, Jupiter signifies 7, as 
per rule love marriage took place. 


(C) 5th and 7 cusp sub lord Jupiter signify 5,7 and 11 houses. So love affair materialized 
into marriage. 


(D) 7* cusp sub lord Jupiter is interconnected to 5 as co ruler and through its sub lord 
Rahu. So she married a boy whom she loved.

Name: Sunder Balakrishnan 

Question: | have just fought election from south central Mumbai from AAP. Let me know 
whether I will win? Election was on 24-4-2014. 

Number: 89 (out of 249) 

Time of Judgment: 29-04-2014, Tuesday; 19:24:57 PM; IST 

Place of Judgment: Kankariya- Anmedabad Long/Lat: 23° N 00', 72° E 36’ 

Ayanamsha: 23°.58'.01" 


Hint: 

If 10th (one’s position in politics) cusp sub lord signifies 10 (one’s reputation), 3 (one’s abil- 
ity), 11 (one’s reputation as a winner) in the DBAS of the significators of 3, 10, 11, then suc- 
cess is assured. 


Cuspal Sub lord for Sunder Balakrishnan: 

10%: Cusp (Taurus 04°.52’.29”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Saturn. Saturn is in the 
star of Jupiter and sub of Venus. Saturn is occupant of 3, owner of 6-7. No planet is in the 
star of Saturn, and Saturn is the CSL of 4-10. Star lord Jupiter is occupant of 11, owner of 
5-8. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 8, owner of 3-10. Thus 10 cusp sub lord Saturn is the 
significator of 5-8-11 and connected with 3-6-7-4-10-8. Hence, the wining in election is 
sure. 


Cuspal Sub lord for opponent: 

10% Cusp (Scorpio 04°.52’.29”): The sub lord of the 10 cusp is Saturn. Saturn is in the 
star of Jupiter and sub of Venus. Saturn is occupant of 9, owner of 1-12. No planet is in the 
star of Saturn, and Saturn is the CSL of 4-10. Star lord Jupiter is occupant of 5, owner of 2 
-11. Sub lord Venus is occupant of 2, owner of 4-9. Thus 10% cusp sub lord Saturn is the 
significator of 5-2-11 and connected with 9-12-1-4-10-2. Hence, the wining in election is 
sure. 


Joint period for Sunder Balakrishnan:

Question- 1: Houses for Siblings 


Sir, Iamakp student. Pl clarify my doubt. 

1. A person having 2 elder brothers and one elder sister (all are elder to him). What are hous- 
es to be considered for the three elders from the native’s birth chart? 

2. A person having 2 younger brothers and one younger sister (all are younger to him). What 
are houses to be considered for the three youngers from the native’s birth chart? 


Answer- lL: 


1. 11th house represents first elder sibling (brother or sister), still elder 9 house (11 from 
11) second elder sibling, further elder 7 (11 from 9) house third elder sibling, and so on. 


2. 3rd house represents first younger sibling, 5 house (3"4 from 3) second younger sibling, 
7th (3rd from 5) house third younger sibling, and so on. 


Question- 2: Which house is house of Father 9th or 10th? 
Answer- 2: 


1. According to Maharishi Parashara, the 9t» house represents one’s experience of father, 
while the 10 house governs matters pertaining father. This is how one could have a lot of 
care from the father even while one’s father is facing difficulties. In the Brihat Parashara 
Hora Shastra, Ch. 11: Judgement of Houses, father is indicated by the 10% house and 
Chapter 12: Effects of Houses, father is indicated by the 9 house. The actions of one's fa- 
ther and his place are judged from the tenth house in Varaha Mihira: Daivagyna Vallabha, 
Chapter 2. Umang Taneja’s opinion is to take 9 when native is dependent on father and 
10% when native is not dependent on father. 
2. It is a common practice of both KP and Vedic astrologers to consider the 9“ house to rep- 
resent the father. (Appendix- 1) The better and accurate results of 9th house for father 
are also supported by a KP study of 40 charts for the joint dasa period of death of father 
inflicted by Badhaka, Maraka and Moksha significators, a Vedic study of 10 cases by R. 
Santhanam on “Premature Loss of Father”, 9th house and Sun for father, and another Ve- 
dic study of 10 cases by Liana Haywath “Casting Father’s Unknown Horoope from Chil- 
dren’s Charts” . The reasons are as given under: 

1.In the ancient Hindu culture, one’s father used to give his knowledge to his offspring 

as a guru. In this light, dhama, pita (father) and guru are all seen from the 98 house; 

2.As the 10% house is taken for profession, name, fame, leaving it, the 9» house is taken 

for father; 

3.Counting the 9% house as the 1st, the 5 there from indicates the native. (However, 

such counting is not applicable to the 4» house of mother.) 
3. Only some astrologers take 10th house for father. (Appendix- 2) By taking the 9th house 
for father, promotion as a result of 10% house is Maraka for the parents. (10 is 24 for 9th 
and 7th for 4.) However, some argue mainly by counting house to house like M.P. 
Shanmugam that if the 4th house denotes mother, the 7 from 4th i.e., 10 would be more 
appropriate to denote father as taken by the Westerners.

Cusps and Houses 

1. The beginning degree of each house is called cusp. A house begins from the concerned 
cusp and ends at the next cusp. The cuspal degrees are like boundaries of the house. In 
the above Example Birth Horoscope No. 1, the Ist or Ascendant cusp is 12°Cap25' , 2nd 
cusp 19°Aq44' , 3rd cusp 25°Pi44' , and so on. The range of 1st house is from 1st cusp 12° 
Cap25' to 2nd cusp 19°Aq44' with dimension of 37° 19 '; 2nd house is from 2nd cusp 19° 
Ag44' to 3rd cusp 25°Pi44' with dimension of 36° ; 3rd house is from 3rd cusp 25°Pi44' to 
Ath cusp 25°Ar44' with dimension of 30° ; 4th house is from 4th cusp 25°Ar44' to 5th cusp 
21°Ta28' with dimension of 25° 44' , and so on, by counting from a cusp to the next cusp. 
As shown above, the dimension of each house is different in a KP chart. A house may be 
less or greater than 30° due to the application of the unequal Placidus House system. 

2. The lord of the house is the lord of rasi sign where the concerned cusp is located. In the 
above example chart, the 1st or Asc. cusp is located in Capricorn sign, and so the Capri- 
corn sign lord Saturn is the lord of the Asc or 1st house. Since the 2nd cusp falls in 
Aquarius, the lord of 2nd house is the Aquarius sign lord Saturn; the 3 cusp falls in Pi- 
sces, the lord of 3™4 house is the Pisces sign lord Jupiter, and and so on. 


Location of Planets in Houses 
3. In the above example chart, since the 1st house is from 1st cusp 12°Cap25' to 2nd cusp 
19°Aqg44' no planet is found located in the 1st house. The 2nd house is from 2nd cusp 19° 
Aqg44' to 3rd cusp 25°Pi44' , and Moon at 21°Pi49' and Rahu at 24°Pi36’ are found located 
in the 24 house. Moon and Rahu are the occupant of 294 house. The 34 house is from 
3rd cusp 25°Pi44' to 4th cusp 25°Ar44' , and no planet is found located in the 34 house. 
The 4 house is from 4 cusp 25°Ar44' to 5th cusp 21°Ta28' and so Saturn at 7°Ar30' is 
found located in the 4 house or Saturn is the occupant of 4t house, and so on. 
Order of Significators 
4. The order of grade A to E significators is as follows: 

¢Planets in the star of the occupant of house; 

¢Occupant of house; 

¢Planets in the star of house owner; 

¢ House owner; 

¢Planets which are in conjunction with or aspected by the above significators.

ter, as the occupant of 10 house and owner of 3" , 12th houses, are filled up in the row for

7. The house-wise basic significators in Table 2 are derived from the planet-wise basic sig- 
nificators in Table 1. It can be found in the above Table 1 that the lst house significators 
are none in the grade A and B columns, but Mercury and Jupiter in grade C column and

Significators of Rahu/Ketu 


8. The above charts details and the basic significators are the common print-out of any KP 
software. For Rahu/Ketu, the computerized table of significators usually shows its posi- 
tional house and the houses occupied and owned by its star lord only. In addition its signi- 
fication by the aspecting and conjoined planets and the sign lord by its location are to be 
considered. In the above example chart, Rahu is conjoined with Moon, occupant of 2nd 
house, owner of 7 house; aspected by Mars, occupant of 7 house and owner of 4 , 11th 
houses and aspected by Jupiter/ Rahu’s Pisces sign lord Jupiter, occupant of 10 house, 
owner of 34 , 12th houses, are also to be consider. For Ketu, its Virgo sign lord Mercury, 
occupant of 7 house and owner of 6. 9th houses are also to be considered. 


Grade E Significators by Conjunction/Aspects 


9. Planets which are in conjunction with or aspected by the Grade A, B, C, D significato 
are very weak significators, and they are used as the last resort only. 


Other Significators 


10. If there is no planet in the stars of a planet, that planet becomes the strong significators 
of houses for which it is the cuspal sub lord CSL). In the above example chart, there is no 
planet in the stars of Moon, but Moon is not the CSL of any house, and so there is no addi- 
tional house signification for Moon. There is no planet in the stars of Venus, and Venus is 
the the CSL of 5th , 6th and 11 houses, and so Venus becomes the strong significator of 
these three houses. There is no planet in the stars of Rahu, and Rahu is the the CSL of 1‘, 
3rd, 8th and 9th houses, and so Rahu becomes the strong significators of these four houses. 


11. If a planet is located very close to the next cusp within 3° 20' orb, that planet may be- 
come the significator of next house. In the above example chart, Rahu at 24°Pi36' is physi- 
cally located in the 24 house, but very close to the next 3" cusp 25°Pi44' within 3° 20' orb, 
and so it may also give the results of next 34 house. Similarly Ketu at 24°Vi36' is physically 
located in the 8 house, but very close to the next 9% cusp 25°Vi44' within 3° 20' orb, and 
so it may also give the results of next 9» house. 


12. Finally it is very important to consider the significators of the CSLs and the Dasa- 
Bhukti- Antra- Sookshma lords not only at the planet and star lord levels, as shown above, 
but also at the sub level by occupation and ownership, according to the following funda- 
mental principles of KP. 


“The planet signifies the source of the matter. The star lord of the planet reveals the na- 
ture of the results of the matter. The sub lord of the planet shows as the deciding factor 
whether the matter is favorable or not.” 


13. If the significators of sub lord is not considered, it is not KP because KP is the sub lord 
theory only, nothing else. 


14. In the above example chart, Sun is the occupant of 6 house, owner of 8 house, in the 
star of Jupiter, occupant of 10th house, owner of 34 , 12th house, and in the sub of Saturn, 
occupant of 4 house, owner of 1st , 224 houses. Whether a planet is the CSL or dasa period 
lord it’s significators are to be considered at the planet, its star and sub levels.

Stock Market Astrology & Astrological Theory of Business Cycles

SAGAR PUBLICATIONS. 





“Stock Market Astrology & Astrological theory of Business Cycles” is another Vedic work 
on the astrological influences on stock markets and the princes, with a different approach 


KP Ezine Mav 2014 70 


from “Vedic Astrology- Stock Market Analysis by Jyotish Vachaspathi, R. G. Krishnan”, 
which was reviewed in the last month April issue. 


The fundamental idea behind this book was that the stock markets are governed by the 
investor sentiments of greed and fear and the fact remains true that all the human senti- 
ments, whether the sentiment of greed or fear, are governed by the astrological influences 
on the human brains, which drives the brain to take any buying or selling decision in the 
markets. 


In this book the implications of all the planetary transits, along with the transit of the 
Moon through each of the 27 Nakshatras, are explained with real examples of intraday 
trading. Influence of any particular planet gets intensified during certain particular hours 
of a day which is known as Hora. Formulating the trading strategies in intraday with the 
help of Hora is explained with the real examples of intraday trading. An additional method 
for timing the price movements is also explained with the help of micro projection of the 
Vimshottari Dasha system. 

The intraday, short term and long term price movement in the stock prices for 30 different 
sectors of the market and the principles for determining the movements in gold prices and 
in crude oil prices have been explained in the book. 


The relationship between the astrological phenomenon and the business cycles has been 
thoroughly discussed with the help of historical evidences of major economic recessions, 
including great depression of 1930 and subprime mortgage crisis of 2008. The prediction 
for the forthcoming periods of economic recessions has also been made. 


Many such useful astrological principles that have been discussed in the book may be use- 
ful for any astrologer seriously interested in predicting the stock markets.

Longevity Analysis 
1st cuspal sub lord (CSL) Moon signifies life saving 1, 5, against unfavorable 6, 8, 12 without 
Maraka, Badhaka, which is inconclusive for 5-year full term longevity. 





Although 1st CSL is the most important cusp for longevity, as this cusp sub lord signifies 8 
house (danger to life, accident), the 3™ and 8th cusp sub lords are further scrutinized for 
longevity as follows: 


3rd CSL Jupiter signifies life saving house 5, against unfavorable houses 11 (Badhaka), 8. 
8th CSL Saturn signifies lifesaving houses 5 against unfavorable houses 11(Badhaka), 2, 4 
(End of everything, death), 8(danger to life, accident), 12(Moksha. end of life). 


In combination of results of the 1st, 3rd and 8t CSL, the longevity is not good enough for 
survival of 5-year full term.

Is it true that Abhishek Bachchan and Aishwarya Rai 
are going to be separated? 


By: Kanakkumar B. Bosmia 
Sahakar-2, Flat No: 28 
Jagabhai Park, Ram Baug 
Maninagar, Ahnmedabad—380008 
Mobile : +91-98 2531165. 


Email : kanakbosmia@yahoo.com 





Short history: 
(photo 2014 AFP) 


aishwarya-rai-to-divorce- 





Aishwarya Rai and Abhishek Bachchan are the golden couple of the Bollywood. Since their 
traditional and lavish marriage in 2007, they have maintained their status as one of the 
most lovable Bollywood couple with grace and dignity. 

However, if the latest reports and rumours are to be believed the couple’s marriage is rapid- 
ly going downhill. Some sections of media are also speculating that the popular jodi of Aish- 
warya Rain and Abhishek might be a thing of past. 

It is rumoured that Aishwarya is planning to file a divorce with her husband Abhishek 
Bachchan. This rumour has been more furiously gossiped in Bollywood circles where the 
recent differences between the couple has been visible during their presence at events and 
parties. 

The major reason for the discord between them is attributed to Jaya Bachchan’s incessant 
interference in their daily lives. It is rumoured that Aishwarya is annoyed and miffed with 
her mother-in-law’s overbearing behavior. They had also planned to move out of Bachchan 
residence to solve this problem. However, if reports are to believed it hasn’t solved problems 
for the star couple. 

However, keeping in mind that most of the rumors originating from Bollywood are rarely 
based on facts, it has to be seen whether they will actually follow into Hrithik and 
Sussanne’s footsteps.

Question-Answer 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Question — 1: Planet having no planet in its stars and planet in own star 
If [A ] a planet is not a star lord to any one in a horoscope, [B] same planet alone in its own 
star then what is the difference? 


Answer - 1: 

A planet with no planet in its stars has not only positional status but also is the strong 
significator of the houses under its sub lordship because there is no planet in the star level 
to give its result. In other words, the sub lord of a cusp is a strong significator of that cusp, 
if there is no planet in the stars of that sub lord (planet). If the planet is not the cuspal sub 
lord of any house, it will have only positional status, i.e. it will be the strong significator of 
the house occupied by that planet. For example, in the attached marriage (Female) chart, no 
planet is in the stars of Ketu, and Ketu is the cuspal sub lord of 44 and 10% houses, so 
Ketu becomes the strong significator of these houses. No planet is in the stars of Saturn but 
Saturn is not the cuspal sub lord of any house, and so Saturn is the strong significator of 
Sth house by occupation (positional status). 


A planet in its own stars, having no planet in its stars, can have positional status but 
cannot be the strong significator of the houses under its sub lordship because that planet 
has to give the result of own in the star level. For example, in the same attached marriage 
(Female) chart, Mercury is in the star of own, hence Mercury is the strong significator of 274 
house by occupation. 


A planet in its own stars also having any other planet(s) in its stars can have neither 
positional status nor the role of strong significator of the houses under its sub lordship 
because that planet has to give the results of own and other planet(s) in the star level. 


Question — 2: 8th house in marriage 
What is the role of 8th house in marriage, positive or negative? 


Answer - 2: 

8th is generally death, sex and money of others, especially partner. In perspective of 
marriage, it needs to be judged in combination of other prevailing houses. From negative 
side delay, dejection, disappointment, scandal, quarrel, and quarrel finally leading to 
divorce, Maraka of spouse to the positive side of partner's money. 


As per KP Reader V page 176 (168 in Old Edition), significators of houses 2,7,11 are to be 
considered for marriage and the houses 6,12,10,8 are for divorce. (The 8th house may not 
give the desirable result of marriage. - KP Reader III, pp 51, 58, 114/ 1971 original edition 
pp 49, 55. 108) 


The same is said in Astrosecrets & KP Part III page 11 that for marriage significators of 
houses 2,7,11 are beneficial; for divorce, 6,10,12 and 8 are beneficial; page 22, houses 


1,6,10 and 8 are not favorable for marriage. 


Separation from the partner due to disharmony or difference of opinion is to be considered 


KP Ezine lune 2014 23 


by 1,6,10 houses only and 8 is also to be considered, if quarrel is involved. Finally to get di- 
vorce after long quarrel and fighting in court 1,6,10,8,12 houses are to be considered, as 
found in divorce cases of Further Light of Nakshatra Chintamani by C.R. Bhatt, and in 
Sublord Speaks- 1 to 3, 1,6,8,10,12 houses are detrimental for marriage and matrimonial 
life which may head towards divorce. 

Hence 8t house (quarrel, disappointment) is found in support of divorce but not in support 
of marriage although it does not negate marriage and not threaten separation from the part- 
ner. 


Question — 3: 12th house in marriage 
Is 12th house detrimental for marriage? 


While reading a chart, often astrologers consider 12th house detrimental for marriage. 12th 
house indicates separation from family, in my opinion 12th should not be considered as 
negative house in marriage. in fact its 6th(12th from 7th) house which indicates separation 
from spouse, 12th has nothing to do with separation from spouse. 


It is well understood that 12th stands for separation from family. 12th if combined with 
6/8/10, also threatens married life. How should we treat if a planet signifies 2/7/12. Shall 
be very grateful if u put come light. 


Answer -— 3: 

Regarding marriage, 12th is detrimental for marriage, undesirable effects in married life, 
separation by natives’ walking out and finalization of divorce, please see... 

1. 6th house for separation due to partner’s walking out... and 

2. 12th house for separation due to natives’ walking out (KP Reader IV pp 154, 192/ KP 
Reader VI pp 250, 254) 

6, 10 and 12 houses for undesirable effects in married life (KP Reader IV pp 69) 

1, 6, 10 and 12 houses for detrimental for marriage (KP Reader IV pp 118) 

12th for separation (KP Reader IV pp 1938, 196) 

6, 12, 10 and 8 houses for finalization of divorce (KP Reader V p 176/ 1971 original edi- 
tion p 168)

Question — 5: Signification up to sub level of a planet 
Please help me understand this case. 


I am new to KP astrology. Recently I was reading a book by Shri. Suresh Shasane — KP 
jyotish Rahasya. I was reading a chapter where the author was explaining about how do we 
find marriage event in birth chart and how to determine the exact event date. After reading 
the chapter I took my brother’s birth chart. He recently got married on 23rd April 2014. 
While checking his birth chart I was unable to link it to KP rule. Please help me under- 
stand: 


His DOB is 3rd July 1978 at 7.40 am (in morning) at Pune. As per his birth chart 7th sub- 
lord is Venus, and Venus signifies 11h, hence marriage is promised. Now his marriage took 
place in Jupiter’s Mahadasa, Venus’ antardasa and Saturn’s diwdasa. Now as per the book 
while determining the date of event we should first see the mahadasa swami; he should sig- 
nifies 2, 7 or 11 h. In his case Jupiter is not signifying any of these houses. So how mar- 
riage took place in Jupiter mahadasha. Venus and Saturn are related hence that can be 
understood but why Jupiter? 


After that I took birth chart of my sister who is unmarried. Now in her chart 7H sublord is 
Jupiter. (Jupiter is in Nakshtra of Mercury and Mercury is sitting in 2h that means indi- 
rectly Jupiter is related to 2h), so the marriage event is fixed. Now the next step currently 
she is undergoing Mercury mahadasa. (sublord of Mercury is Jupiter), hence as per the 
book the ideal period for marriage should be Mercury Mahadasa and Jupiter antardasa 
which is coming in the year 2023, so does that means she will get marriage in the year 
2023. Her DOB is 11th April 1982 at. 2.30 am (early morning) at Pune. 


Please help me understand. 


Answer - 5: 

As per attached chart, Male, born on 3rd July 1978 at 7.40 am IST at Pune, 

7th cuspal sub lord (CSL) Venus in 1, owner of 4,11 is in the star of own Mercury in 12, 
owner of 3,12, and in the sub of Jupiter in 12, owner of 6,9, indicating promise of marriage 
by 11th house (out of 2,7,11) signification. 


At the time of marriage on 23rd April 2014, running Dasa lord Jupiter in 12, owner of 6,9 
is in the star of own Jupiter in 12, owner of 6,9, and in the sub of Saturn in 1, owner of 
7,8, and conducive to marriage by 7th house signification (at the sub level). 


Note: Without considering the sub it is not KP since KP is the sub lord theory only, nothing 
else, according to the following fundamental rule. 

"The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the sub is a de- 
ciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not."

Question - 6: Rule of twin birth 
What is the rule of twin birth? 


Answer -— 6: 

Twin or multiple birth is indicated if the 5th cuspal sub lord is connected to dual signs 
(Gemini, Sagittarius and Pisces) and also signifies house 2, 5 or 11 during the joint dasa 
period of significators of 2, 5 or 11 with connection to dual signs. (based on a study of 40 
twin’s mothers) 


Question — 7: Tropical ayanamsa 
What is the purpose of the tropical ayanamsa in astro softwares? 


Answer -— 7: 

The Tropical or Zero Ayanamsa Option in astro softwares is useful to:- 

1) cast the tropical chart for analysis by Western astrology; 

2) apply the user defined ayanamsa, for instance the KP new ayanamsa can be calculated 
from the link http://astrosage.com/kpastrology/ayanamsa.asp and added up to the Tropi- 
cal or Zero Ayanamsa for KP analysis. 


Question — 8: A Successful Astrologer 
What is the astrological pattern of a successful astrologer? 


Answer - 8: 

The 9th (astrology) cusp sub lord is generally connected to house 2 (speaking ability, predic- 
tion), 3 (mental inclination), 9 (astrology), 11 (Success and Siddhi), and also related to well 
placed Mercury (chief karaka for astrology, intellectual thought), Jupiter (chief karaka for 
higher learning and knowledge, intuition, ability to attract patronage), Ketu (occult 
knowledge, enlightener). (based on a study of 15 charts of astrologers)

Book Review- 
Planetary Stock Trading 


-Revised and updated 3rd edition 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 


Book Review O06 2014 


Planetary Stock Trading, revised and updated 3rd edition 
by Bill Meridian 

Cycles Research Publications, New York, 2002 

380 pages. oversize paper 





Planetary Stock Trading is a valuable book on astrology and investments, written by a stal- 
wart in the astro financial community. The author combines the astrological approach with 
the tools of technical analysis, for instance to buy stocks for cheap after they've been hit 
with Saturn, hold and sell when Jupiter runs their price up, and live on dividends between 
the two. 


The book provides a huge collection of about 1000 first-trade horoscopes, i.e. the moment 
the company began publicly trading. Unlike incorporation charts, first trade charts show the 
ups and downs of trading, i.e, stock prices, rather than the ups and downs of the corpora- 
tion behind the stock. In his research, the author has found first trade charts had a greater 
correlation to stock price movements than did the charts of incorporations. 


The book concludes with an extensive appendix listing the planets, lunar node, Ascendant 
and Midheaven in decimal notation of zodiacal order preceded by company ticker symbols. 


However it may not be easy to follow practically what the author is leading to in converting 
astrological knowledge into market methodology.

Deafness and Dumbness: A KP Analysis 


By: Gunti Nagaraju KP astrologer 
M.com CAIIB, Retired Bank officer 
12-13-668/5/2, Second floor, Nagarjuna Nagar, 
Tarnaka,Secunderabad- 500 017;
