What K.P Rules say in this regard - 

1) In case of defective speech and sense of hearing or deafness and dumbness, the Ascend- 
ant cusp sub lord or the cuspal sub lord of 6,8,12 is the significator of 6,8,12, and connect- 
ed with Mercury (speech and hearing), the 2™4 cusp (speech), the 3rd cusp (hearing) and 
mute signs Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces (dumbness). When it is connected to 8 it would be 
congenital, otherwise it would impair during D B A of the planets signifying 6, 8, &12 and 
badhaka sthana. 


2) House(s) to be analyzed for Deafness-- 

Ears and entire nervous system comes under the jurisdiction of third bhava (house) as well 
as third sign of natural Zodiac Gemini. Therefore Gemini, its ruler Mercury and Virgo (the 
other sign owned by Mercury) will naturally get the jurisdiction on hearing. 

Secondly Mercury (lord of Gemini and Virgo) controls entire nervous system of body. As a 
result Mercury has been accepted as chief Karaka for hearing and ear diseases. Therefore 
one needs to analyze 3 house, its cuspal sub lord, the planet Mercury and signs Gemini 
and Virgo for any afflictions by malefic planets. 


In “Medical Astrology for All” by Sri K. Subramaniam it is stated that: 

“As per K.P. one has to judge the sub lord of the second cusp for dumbness and of the third 
cusp for deafness. The sub division in the sign Taurus, i.e. Venus-Moon-Ketu — Taurus 
19° 40 00’ to 20° 26 40° tells about the defective voice or mute. 


3) Second sign in natural zodiac ~-Taurus- and its lord Venus which signify face, nose, 
mouth and ears; when afflicted would lead to ENT problems. 


4) K. P astrologer Sr C.R Bhatt says that “ if the sub lords of 2"4 and 34 cusps signify 6,8,12 
houses and also connected to the Mute signs — Cancer, Scorpio and Pisces- it would lead to 
defective speech and hearing. That is to say that the native would become Deaf and Dumb. 
From the above rules it is clear that — 

Second house and third house of the natal chart are the main houses connected with 
dumbness and deafness. Therefore we will have to check whether there is an affliction to 
2nd/ 3rd house, its cuspal sub lord, its connection with Mercury- significator of speech and 
hearing faculties and finally its connection with 6, 8 and 12 houses. 


5) Cure from diseases: 

If the sub lord of 6,8 &12 are the significators of 1,5 &11, then the person’ will have cure 
from diseases in the DBA (Dasa / Bhukti / Anthara) of significators of 1,5,11. For chara la- 
gnas 11 is badhaka sthana which is bad for health and longevity.

Infantile death and KP 


By: Sumanadasa Namarathna 


(Sunaparantha Kalyan) 
22/1, Marapola, Veyangoda, Sri Lanka 
sunaparantha@yahoo.com 





Brief Background 


A boy was born on O9 October 2004 by a forceps-assisted vaginal delivery. Since birth till 
death on 24th May 2014 for about 10 years, he was living with breathing only as a deformed 
baby, without speaking, sitting or walking. This article is to study the infantile death of this 
boy by KP longevity rules. 


KP Longevity Rules 
(a) Longevity is to be considered as follows: 


1) If Asc. cusp sub lord signifies Badhaka, Maraka and 6,8,12 houses, short life up to 33 
years. Three level signification of sub lord planet, its star and its sub is to be considered. 


2) If Asc. cusp sub lord signifies 1,5,9,10 houses and 6,8,12 houses, middle life up to 66 
years. 


3) If Asc. cusp sub lord signifies 1,5,9,10 houses, long life over 66 years up to 100 years. 


4) If 9th house is Badhaka, it is most harmful for longevity. If 11th house is not Badhaka, it 
is most helpful for longevity since 1,5,11 houses are saving houses from danger to life. 


If the longevity is still there, one can survive from danger to life during the conjoined dasa 
period of significtors of death inflicting houses. "If the longevity is promised, he will get over 
this (accident), and the conditions of the patient would be threatening..." (KP Reader VI p 
159, 2nd para) 


Death comes during the conjoined dasa period of significtors of primarily Badhaka (11 or 9 
or 7), Maraka (2,7), Moksha (12), along with terminal or trigonal houses 4 = end of every- 
thing including life, 8 = accident, danger to life, and 12= end of lie especially in serious acci- 
dents or unnatural death and in some cases also 10 = retirement from this world or life and 
6 = disease, injury in accident). Badhaka house is 11th for moving sign Asc., 9th for fixed 
sign and 7th for common sign according to the cusp position in the Placidus bhava chart, 
not rasi chart. (KP EZine June 2010 issue) 


(b) "If the cuspal sub lord of the Ascendant be the significtor of the Badhaka and Maraka 
houses, there is a danger to the life during the joint period of the significators of the Badha- 
ka and Maraka houses. If these significators be the cuspal joint rulers of the Ascendant or 
the 8th cusp, their joint period is very critical." (Nakshatra Chintamani, by Sri Chandrakant 
R. Bhatt)

Recovery from surgery of spinal chord 

One of my friends called me from Chennai on 05 Jan 2014 and I was told that his younger 
brother had undergone spinal surgery at L4-L5 level - discectomy. In fact he was admitted 
in the Hospital for spinal surgery due to his inability to walk since one week ago. He even 
had no control over his discharges i.e. urine and stools. This was the reason the doctors 
had advised to go for immediate surgery as the spinal MRI revealed severe jamming of the 
spinal nerves by the spinal disc at L4-L5 level of the spine. He was then immediately admit- 
ted in the hospital for spinal surgery. After the surgery the doctors told that it may take 
longer time for his brother for complete normalcy and cure. My friend’s brother asked me as 
to when he will recover completely after the surgery. I had asked my friend’s brother to give 
a number between 1 and 249. He gave the horary no. 132. 

I had cast the horary chart for hor. no.132 at the Longitude 79 E 32 and Latitude 18 N 03 
at 17 Hrs. 28 Min. 39 Secs. 


Moon’s indication: 

In the horary chart, Moon is placed in 5 house and is posited in Rahu star where Rahu is 
inl2th house. Hence the hospitalization (12) and cure (5) were in the querrent’s mind, the 
query is correct. 


Hints: 

If the 6 cusp sublord signifies houses 1,5,11, then there shall be cure. Else if 6 or 8 or 12 
houses are signified by the 6t cusp sub lord, then cure from illness will not be there. If 
both the houses 5/11 , 6/8/12 are signified, then the cure will be there depending upon 
the DBA running i.e., the DBA of 5/11 should be running. Also if 12* cusp sublord signifies 
6/12, then there shall be some defect. 


Analysis of the Horary chart: 

1. The 6 cusp sublord in the chart is Mars. Mars is the lord of 2,7 and is posited in the 
house 12. Mars is in the star of Moon in the 5 house and the lord of 10. Hence it is clear 
that 6 cusp sublord is connected to houses 2,7,10,5,12 which means both the houses of 
cure (5) and defect (12) are indicated by the signification of 6 cusp sublord Mars. Mars has 
positional status in 12th house, hence it strongly signifies 5 as well as 12 houses. 


2.The 12th cusp Sublord in the chart is Rahu. Rahu is in 12‘ house in the sign of Venus i.e, 
Libra. Rahu is in conjunction with Saturn, the lord of 4,5 in 1st house. Rahu also represents 
Venus which is lord of 1,8 posited in 3™ house. Rahu is aspected by 6 lord Jupiter. Rahu 
is in its own star. Hence 12th cusp sublord Rahu signifies 12,1,8,6 and 4,5,3. Since Rahu 
is strongly signifying 1,8,12,6, it means there shall be defect. 


3. From the above as the 6 cusp sublord is connecting to houses 5,12 and 12 th cusp 
sublord is connecting to houses 1,6,8,12 it is decided that there shall be partial cure with 
some defect. 


4. The 6thcusp sublord Mars is posited in 12th house and in the sign of Virgo in the star of 


Hasta . The star Hasta represents bowels, intestines, secreting glands, enzymes. It repre- 
sents gas formation, flatulence, loose bowels, pain and disorder of the bowels, obstructions,

number of people walk around in these regions without the characteristics of the signs of

that the signs Aries through Virgo are permanently above and the signs Libra through Pi- 
sces (Tropical) are permanently below the horizon. Not a single sign sets or rises, and the 
Ascendant is forever stationary. The situation is similar at the South Pole” As far as my un-

Question — 3: Role of the sub signification 


PLEASE EXPLAIN IF DASA LORD OR ANTHRA LORD SIGNIFIES REQUIRED HOUSES FOR 
A PARTICULAR QUESTION BUT IS IN THE SUB OF PLANET WHICH SIGNIFIES 8,12 
HOUSE, WHAT WILL BE THE RESULTS? 

IN KP IT IS MENTIONED SUB IS THE DECIDING FACTOR. 


Answer -— 3: 


KP fundamental rule: "The planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result 
and the sub is a deciding factor whether the matter is favorable or not." 


By mere signification of 8, 12" houses by the sub of a planet, it cannot be concluded what 
will be the results. It depends on not only the required houses to be signified for the matter 
under study but also the houses signified by the sub of planet. 


For example, for imprisonment requiring signification of house 2,3,8,12, the signification of 
house 8, 12 by the sub of a planet will support the imprisonment. 


For foreign going requiring signification of house 3,9,12, the signification of house 8 by the 
sub of planet will negate the required house 9 but signification of house 12 by the sub will 

support foreign going and 12 is also good for investment. 8 signification will be supportive 
for inheritance or getting other’s money but not good for health and longevity.

Question — 5: Lagna in ruling planets 


In finding RP for horary charts (1-249). Lagna is shifted as per the number communicated 
by the client. For RP we use original lagna details or we use the shifted lagna details. Was 
reading KPEzine-86 March 2014 article on Foreign Assignment by Mr V K Sharma. He has

ber. 


Answer -— 5: 
The original 5 ruling planets at the time of judgment by a astrologer are listed below: 


(KP Reader VI p 123, RP & KP pp ix, xvii, 32; Dr. Satya Prakash Chowdhary: Ruling Planets 
in KP, http://karmicrhythms.com/pel2.htm ) 


1) Lagna sign lord, 

2) Lagna star lord, 

3) Moon star lord, 

4) Moon sign lord, and 

5) Day Lord (Hindu Day from sunrise to next sunrise) 


So the Lagna at the time of judgment by a astrologer should be used for the ruling planets. 
Lagna fixed as per horary number given by the querent should not be used for the ruling 
planets. The horary chart with Lagna fixed as per horary number should be used for judg- 
ing the query. 


Question - 6: One side representation of Rahu/Ketu 


If Rahu is the RP at the time of judgement and Saturn is conjunct with Rahu, will Saturn 
also be considered as the ruling planet? 


Answer - 6: 


In this case a shadow planet Rahu without physical body like other planets acts as an 
agent of conjunct Saturn and gives the results of Saturn, but Saturn cannot give the re- 
sults of Rahu. It's to note that the results of conjunct Saturn are given by Rahu in one side 
direction but not in both reciprocal ways i.e. Saturn cannot give the results of Rahu. So 
Saturn should not be considered as a ruling planet by conjunction with the Rahu which is 
a ruling planet. 


Supposed, if Saturn were a RP and Rahu were not a RP, in the case of Saturn conj. Rahu, 
Rahu should be considered as a RP.

Book Review- 
Financial Astrology 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Financial Astrology, 

How to Forecast Business and Stock Market 

by LCdr. David Williams 

American Federation of Astrologers, Inc., Fourth Printing 2004 
242 pages, oversize 





In the book "Financial Astrology", first edition published in 1982, the author Lt. Cdr. David 
Williams discussed the theories of other financial astrologers as well as his own in forecast- 
ing business and the stock market. In using astrology in market analysis the author fo- 
cused mainly on the study of business cycles and of the relation between astrology and fi- 
nance. 


Based on his 30 years research in financial field, Williams shares the techniques he used in 
predicting the ups and downs of the U.S. economy in his magazine column. There is also a 
chart correlating USA economic activity to the solar cycles since the Revolutionary War. The 
author had gone to great pains to prove every one of his statements in great detail and as 
such the book is credible. 


Late in the nineteenth century the sunspots and the business cycle had been investigated 


and coherent correlation between them was found. Sir William Herschel the discoverer of 
the planet Uranus proved statistically that "in periods with littke or no sunspots, wheat was 


KP Ezine lulv 2014 47 


scare and prices were high; conversely, during the periods of abundant sunspots, crops 
were abundant and prices were low". (page 10) 


After much further research, Williams’ some findings like sunspot cycle have been found to 
be not so valid in market forecasting. However, what did stand out was his coverage of J M 
Funk’s 56 year panic cycle. This consisted of three sequences, in which major US financial 
distress occurred quite regularly in grid patterns based on 56 years and multiples of 9 
years. 


Anyway there is a lot of information for anyone interested in incorporating astrological con- 
siderations into research of business cycles and market forecasting.

Will I get transfer from my present place? 

My elder brother got transferred to a far off place from our home in January 2014. He was 
very upset and got confirmed that he would not get transferred again to a place near his 
hometown before 3 years of service. My elder brother asked me regarding his transfer from 
present place. He is currently away from home and wanted to get transferred to a place 
near hometown. I asked him to tell a number from 1-249. He gave number 9. 


Query : Will I get transfer? 

Horary No: 9 (1 -249) 

Date : 24-02-2014; Time: 13:00:57 
Place : JORHAT,ASSAM 94E13 , 26N45 ; 
Ayanamsa : KPNA 23:57:52 


Hints: 

(1) Consider the houses 3, 10 and 12 for transfer in service with change of place (3*4- 
journey: being 12th from the 4th shows absence of the present residence i.e. change of 
place); 10 employment; 12¢-(life in completely unfamiliar atmosphere). 

Ref: Nakshatra Chintamani, by C.R. Bhatt 


Moon reveals the nature of query: 


Moon represents mind, so in this chart Moon in 8 house means obstacles and frustration, 
tension regarding transfer. Moon is lord of 4. But Moon is aspected by Jupiter occupant of 
3rd house, lord of 9 and 12. It is also aspected by Saturn in 7 lord of 10 and 11. So Moon 
signifies 3, 10, 12, and the querent’s mind regarding transfer is seen. 


Cuspal analysis: 


34 Cusp-The sublord of 3% cusp Moon is in the star of Ketu and sub of Venus. Ketu 
occupies 12th house. Ketu is aspected by Saturn lord of 10% house. Venus is in 9 house, 
close to 10% cusp. Thus, transfer is seen by signification of 3™4, 10% and 12th houses. 


10% cusp- Rahu is 10% cusp sublord. Rahu is in its own star and sub. Rahu is in 6 
house. Rahu is aspected by Jupiter from 3™4 house owner of 9 and 12‘ houses. Rahu gives 
the results of Jupiter. Rahu is conjoined with Saturn (lord of 10s house) and in Libra sign 
of Venus in 9% house, close to 10% cusp. Its signification of 34, 10% and 12th houses 
clearly indicate transfer. 


12h cusp- Mars is the sublord of 12‘* cusp in its own star and Venus sub. Venus is in 9t 
house, close to 10 cusp. It signifies 10 house for transfer. 


Ruling planets at the time of judgment: 


Asc-Signlord- Mecuryr, Starlord- Rahu, Sublord- Moon 
Moon -Signlord - Jupiter, Starlord- Ketu, Sublord- Venus

Background Note: 


Subrata Roy Sahara is an Indian businessman and the founder and chairman of 
the Sahara India Pariwar, an Indian conglomerate with diversified ownership interests that 
includes London's Grosvenor House, New York's Plaza Hotel, Aamby Valley City and Force 
India. Roy founded the company in 1978. He was named among the 10 Most Powerful 
People of India in 2012 by India Today. In 2004, the group was termed by the Time 
magazine as ‘the second largest employer in India' after the Indian Railways. In 2014, 
Sahara was briefly jailed and then released on bail for contempt of court in a case involving 
alleged money laundering by the Sahara Group. 


On 26 February 2014, the Supreme Court of India ordered the arrest of Subrata Roy for 
failing to appear before it in connection with the Rs. 24,000 crore deposits his company has 
not refunded to its investors. He was eventually arrested on 28 February 2014 by Uttar 
Pradesh police on Supreme Court's warrant, in a dispute with Market Regulator - SEBI. Ina 
statement after the arrest, his lawyer said Mr. Roy's 92-year-old mother was in poor health 
and needed "her eldest son" by her side, and hence he failed to appear at the court. He was 
granted interim bail by Supreme Court of India for the same on 26 March 2014 on condition 
of depositing Rs 10,000 crore with the market regulator SEBI. As he has failed to appear in 
court during the ongoing legal battle, Mr. Roy has been in custody in a Delhi jail since 
March 4, 2014 and has been rejected his bail plea by the Supreme Court of India. Sahara 
was allowed to sell a part of its assets in India to raise part of the money in question.

Vijinigiri. He is the spiritual head of ‘Yoga Consciousness Trust’ and over sees many of its 
branches through his disciples including the author of this article.

M odi’s Swearing in Ceremony: 


- Different Opinion 
By: Dr. HS Nagi 
Professor, SCD Govt. College, Ludhiana, 


email : bkhardeep@yahoo.com, 
Mobile 09417717910) 





I have special respect for Tin Win Ji, who has very deep understanding of astrology, whom I 
consider as living encyclopaedia of KP astrology, and resource of all answers in KP. He puts 
his hard effort in providing treasures of KP astrological knowledge, I salute him. This article 
is not disregard for Tin Win Ji but I have different opinion which I am presenting here. 


Reference to Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi’s Swearing-in Chart by: Tin Win, 
KP-Ezine June 2014 issue, I disagree with his conclusion that “ In sum this swearing-in 
chart does not astrologically indicate a strong and stable government.” as it contradicts with 
10% house analyses: 


“10 th cuspal sub lord (CSL) Rahu signifies the winning houses 6, 11, against undesirable 
loosing houses 5, 8, 12, indicating strong power but with significant opposition.” 


Let us analyse 10 th CSL Rahu. There is no planet in the star of Rahu, so Rahu is the 
strong significator of 10 th house ( Govt. and Karma). 


Rahu holds strong positional strength in 11» house, though it is badhaka for moveable sign 
but it doesn’t apply for 10th house, so PM will take all decisions boldly. Sub lord of 10 th 
house Rahu in 11 indicates successful function of govt., therefore no danger for stability of 
govt. 


Checking Rahu’s sub: Rahu is in sub of Ketu. Ketu is in 5th and in its own star, and so gets 
strong positional status in house 5 (politics), which is good for govt. 


Other signification of Ketu: it is conjoined with Venus (Lagna lord, no harm and will save 
from enemies) and aspecting lagna and 12‘6 house (means secret inimical activity). 


Let us check Venus: Venus is in 5 house, as occupant of 5 . Venus has planets in its 
star, so weak power of positional situation. But Venus is in Ketu star, Ketu in 5 makes 
Venus strong significator of 5 (politics), so no danger to longevity of govt. as Venus is sub 
lord of Moon whois Lagna sub. 


Checking lordship of Venus: It is lord of houses 1-8-12, but 8 and 12 houses are occupied 
by planets, so Venus is weak significator of 8-12. Lagna is unoccupied , so Venus gets 
strong signification of Lagna by ownership and also aspecting it, and in addition Venus is 
star and sub lord of Moon (Lagna sub) which may support strong signification of Lagna. So 
there is no danger to longevity of govt.

Question & Answer 08 2014 

Question - 1: 

I am following the KP ezine and I am a new learner of KP system (6 months old, I have a 
query which I would like to verify and your answer will be greatly helpful. 

A) In your May 2014 issue on page 67, other significators (11.) , you mentioned that a plan- 
et "may" become significator if the next house. Could you elaborate on when the planet will 
be the significator surely and when it will not? 

B) Say during chart analysis we are looking for child birth (2,5,11), we found the 5th CSL 
signifying 2,5,11, and also 1,10 or 1,4,10 or 1,4. So now the significators are negating the 
fruitful houses along with signification of fruitful houses. How should a prediction be made 
in this case? 

C) someone who is interested in share trading as part-time income, should we consider 5th 
CSL or 10th CSL, and what combination of houses shows success and which shows failure? 


Answer: | - A: 

KP-Ezine May 2014 issue on page 67: 

11. If a planet is located very close to the next cusp within 3° 20' orb, that planet may be- 
come the significator of next house. In the above example chart, Rahu at 24°Pi36' is physi- 
cally located in the 2nd house, but very close to the next 3rd cusp 25°Pi44' within 3° 20' 
orb, and so it may also give the results of next 3rd house. Similarly Ketu at 24°Vi36' is 
physically located in the 8th house, but very close to the next 9th cusp 25°Vi44' within 3° 
20' orb, and so it may also give the results of next 9th house. 

In the above paragraph, the word "may" is used as a compromise because the theory of a 
planet near the house cusp giving the results of next house is not yet a commonly accepted 
rule, even though it is originated from the original Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966 of 
Sagar Publications, p 281 and KP Reader IV, page 108, and supported by many astrologers 
of East and West. 

As we follow this rule, those are the significators of next houses. 

Answer - 1- B: 

In checking the concerned CSL in order to know whether a matter under consideration is 
promised or not, generally as long as the CSL signifies any of required houses regardless of 
the simultaneous signification of negative houses. In this case of getting a child, as long as 
the 5th CSL for female signifies any of houses 2,5,11 regardless of signification of negative 
houses 1,4,10. The negative houses indicate difficulties in materialization of promise and 
problems after materialization. 


In checking the dasa period DBAS lords whether they are capable of materializing a prom- 
ised matter, the signification of negative houses, especially in the sub level, should be thor- 
oughly judged whether such negative signification is overriding the positive signification.s 
Answer I - C: 

If the 5th cuspal sub lord signifies houses 2,5,6,11, one can gain in stock market trading 
during the joint dasa period of significators of house 2,6,11; if this CSL signifies houses 
8,12, one can loss during the joint dasa period of significators of houses 5,8, 12.

Question - 2: Annual Horoscope 

Sir it is advised by few KP astrologers to see the solar return chart as advocated by Prof. 
KSK in private teaching. Does that have some significance and is it correct in you view but 
I'm not sure? 

Answer - 2: 

The annual horoscope or solar return chart was first published in the original Krshnamurti 
Padhdhati Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966, pages 389-394; reprinted in KP Reader III, 1971 
Edition, Practical Part pages 305-310 / new Edition pages 481-487. 

Annual Horoscope (An Example ) by Prof. KSK was first published in Astrology & Arthrishta 
July 1976 issue pages 3-8 , (on page 34) and reprinted in Stellar Effects in Human Life, edi- 
tor K Hariharan, pages 290-301, as shown by the attached first page of the article. 

The practical application of annual horoscope in KP has not been found published as far as 
my reading goes. An experiment has been tried to apply the annual or solar return or 
Tajaka or Varshphal horoscope in some Mandane predictions along with the Hindu or lunar 
new year chart, which is said by Dr. B V Raman as an excellent method of predicting events 
for the whole year. (KP Approach to Different Mundane Charts for Polish Parliamentary 
Elections 2011, KP-Ezine Oct 2011; Syrian Uprising: An Attempt for KP Appraisal, KP- 
Ezine June 2012 issue) 


An effort has been found to integrate Sahams of Tajika Neelkantha (shown in the Dr. BV 
Raman’s Varshaphal or Hindu Progressive Horoscope, pp 58-59) with KP. However in KP the 
role of the top saham — “Punya or Fortune” has been downplayed from - being written in a 
separate chapter under “Fortuna” in the original Krshnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 1, Sagar Pub- 
lications, 1966, pages 471-474, in addition to calculation on pages 176-177 - to mentioning 
only a little bit here and there in KP Readers. 

So the annual horoscope is not found so significant in practice of KP. 


Question - 3: Guruji KSK's Prediction of Plane Arrival Time and Numerology 

Has Prof. KSK mentioned anything about planets and their numbers (numerical values as 
per numerology) ? 

Regarding KP and numerology, I ask this question because of the following reason. This in-

this in a paper article which was written by a Sri Lankan astrologer named Mr. Sivapadam. 
He was the one who organized the Prof. KSK’s Sri Lanka visit. At the moment I do not have 
that article and trying to find it in archives. But it is very difficult as I do not remember the 
exact date of the paper. The article was published long after Prof. KSK’s visit. May be in 
80’s) Incident: When Prof. KSK was about to leave Sri Lanka after successful tour, at the 
airport it was announced that his plane was going to be delayed. (Navigation system was 
not advanced then and hence ATC was unable to predict the correct arrival time of the 
plane. Then one person had asked KSK whether he was able to predict the arrival time and 
Prof. KSK was able to predict it up to the second and that prediction was appeared in all 
leading newspaper in Sri Lanka. But according to Mr.Sivapadam’s article, Prof. KSK was not 
only able to predict arrival time but also his seat number and some other number related to 
the Captain of the aircraft. All these were came true. So by chance if you come across such 
article please share with us. 

Answer -— 3: 

The article "Exact time of plane touching air-port - revealed using ruling planets" pub- 
lished in "RP & KP" book, editors K. Subramaniam & K. Hariharan, Hariman Publications, 
1985, pp 85-89, was about Guruji KSK's correct prediction of the Air India plane arrival 
time on the day of his departure from Sri Lanka on 28-11-1970 at Katunayake airport. The 
numbers mentioned in the article appear to be the author’s view, but not said by Prof. KSK 
in the context of numerology, as shown in the attached pages of the article.(On page 35).

When exactly the two Zodiacs were in the first point is doubted by a number of astronomers 
and accordingly the Ayanamsa-precessional distance-varies from 19° to 23°. I do not wish to 
enter into explaining the complicated processes of astronomy at large which centre attention 
on the discussion of the exact nature of Ayanamsa but merely confine myself to giving a 
suitable and simple method for determining the Ayanamsa. 
First of all, cast the horoscope of birth according to the European manner and convert it in- 
to the terms of the Hindu Zodiac by the following process :- 
(1) Subtract 397 from the year of bitrh (A.D.). 
(2) Multiply the remainder by 50 1/3 seconds; and reduce the product into degrees, minutes 
and seconds. 
(3) Subtract this number of degrees, minutes, and seconds from the cusps of the houses 
and planets' positions in the European figure of birth and the figure thus obtained will be 
according to the Hindu system. 
Example:- 
Determine the Ayanamsa for 1912 A.D.? 

1912 - 397 = 1515 * 50 1/3 " = 76255" 

76255" = 21° 10° 55" 

This is the Ayanamsa for 1912 A.D.

Question — 5: Rules for Second Marriage 

What may be the rule for a divorcee girl to marry with an unmarried boy. Please provide 
some guidance or take this query for next issue of KP-Ezine - question & answer section. 
Answer - 5: 

Below is a note on general rules for more than one marriage. But no clear cut rule is not yet 
available to marry with the unmarried or divorcee, and it needs further analysis of the chart 
for partner’s position. 


Note on Rules/Guide Lines for Checking for More than one Marriage in a KP Chart 


(summarized by late Sri Raichur ji 
Shree Kanak Bosmia, under the guidance of Raichur and Tin Win,did a statistical study on 
the 3 guidelines mentioned below: 


KP Ezine Auaust 2014 36 


The assumptions ARE: GEMINI (Mithuna), SAGGITARIUS (Danhu), PISCES (Meena), are 
Dual SIGNS (for this study): MERC, JUP (Budha and Guru) owning these signs are consid- 
ered as DUAL Planets ( for these guidelines only). 
Hindoo Aspects (Vedic aspects) with no orbs, i.e. Sign to Sign are considered while finding 
or checking significators of houses. 

Within these parameters, the rules are: 

RULE-1: MORE THAN ONE marriage is indicated if the BOTH following two condi- 

tions ARE simultaneously satisfied: 

(i) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp ORits Starlord is deposited ina dual 

sign (Gemini, Sagittarius, 
Pisces) OR if the sub-lord of the 7th cusp is Mercury/JUP; and 


(ii) The sub-lord of the 7th cusp is also a significator of either of the houses 2 or 11 
or both. 


If any of the above two conditions is not satisfied, then second marriage is denied. 


RULE-2: Second marriage is indicated if the sub-lord of the 2nd cusp is also a significator 
of either of the houses 7 or 11. 

RULE-3: As per Kanak: ON ASSUMPTION 2ND WIFE IS CONSIDERED AS YOUNGERSIST- 
ER OF FIRST. 

Second marriage is indicated if The sub-lord of the 9th cusp is a_ significator of either of 
the houses 2 or 9 or 11. 

The study was done on 100 charts, where data were reliable. This was supplied from 
ASTRDATA BANK 4.0 and some by shri TIN WIN. 

THE RESULTS OF THE STUDY ARE AS UNDER: 
RULE 1: 74 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE 

RULE 2: 79 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE 

RULE 3: 93 PERCENT AGREE WITH THIS RULE No rule by itself gives a 100 percent co- 
relationship Final Recommendation: 

CHECK BY ALL 3 RULES, and then GIVE the prediction on more than one Marriage.

Book Review- 
Planetary cycles in the stock market, Volume 1 
By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Cykle planetarne na gieldzie, TOM 1 
(Planetary cycles in the stock market, Volume 1) 
by Wojciech Suchomski 

WIG Press, Warsaw, 2010, 199 pages 


WOTCIECH SUCHOMSKI 


eRe). 





Stock market analysts are trying to predict from year decreases and increases in the stock 
market, relying heavily on historical data. Stock market predictions will be more accurate if 
one can find correlations with the cycles of the planets, the position of which can be calcu- 
lated for decades ahead. This method, which first publications were created in the West 80 
years ago, was published for the first time in Poland in this book “Planetary cycles in the 
stock market”. 


This book review is just to give some hints on applied knowledge of planetary cycles of the 
author Wojciech Suchomski, who publishes the daily stock market commentaries, financial 
analysis, and articles on his website www.astrobiznes.p! since 2005. 


The first part of Planetary cycles contains useful information about investments, passive 
income, investment risk. It also is a lot of investment psychology, personality traits of a good 
investor, the 10 sins of loosing investors in stock trading (pp 39-40): 

1) Lack of knowledge of stock market rules 

2) A bit complicated decision taking system 

3) Taking unnecessary risk 

4) Entering into stock market with debt 

5) Chaotic action 

6) Ensiling losses and picking immature fruits 


KP Ezine Auaust 2014 39 


7) Wrong timing in taking decision 
8) Succumbing to emotions 

9) Disregard of transaction costs 
10) Greed 


and also ten commandments to gain in the stock market (pp 41-42): 

1) Explore market where one is trading 

2) Take care of credible and actual sources of information as well as data 

3) Trade with tested information only 

4) Accept realistic investment goals; must have a plan including - 

a) expected risk (daily, monthly, yearly 

b) maximum losses, for which one is ready to bear 

c) maximum amount of capital which is intended 

d) level of entrance and exit from transaction 

5) expect losses 

6) Open only such position for which one can afford 

7) Truncate losses 

8) Use stop-losses approach to be easier in cutting losses by trading stocks with limited 
losses 

9) Discipline, do not allow oneself to emotion and hold on with one's investment plan. 
10) Spread risk by buying different kinds of stocks other than from one company only 


In the second part you will learn the principles of financial astrology, for example, the astro- 
logical aspects of the planets indicating a collapse or boom in the stock market, or the cy- 
cles of the planets, symbolizing the reactions of markets. A lot of practical tips are discussed 
retrogression of the planets, Moon void of course, and many other important systems. There 
is also a glossary of astrology. 


The third part discusses the basic elements of Books business astrology: horoscope busi- 
ness aspects conducive to winning, it is also a chapter on the horoscope of Poland and one 
chapter specifically is addressed to women investors.

Double Role of the Sub as a Decider as 
well as an Event Indicator 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Sub as if a Significator 


At the early evolving stage of KP, in the original “Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar 
Publications, 1966”, the sub lord of a planet is mentioned as if a significator in “ 3 ” 
examples on pages 113-114, 274 and 318-319, as first example shown below: 


http: //id.scribd.com/doc/43833007/24500319-Krishnamurti-Padhdhati 
http: / /id.scribd.com /doc/7299 1742 /K-P-Reader-2-ok 


(Reprint of Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966) 
Pages 113-114 (Example chart: at 10 p.m. on 9-3-1923, p 110 under “Free from Debts") 
According to Krishnamurti Paddhathi, one can borrow money during the dasa and bhukti of: 
(a) planets in the constellation or the “sub” of the occupants of the 6th house; 
(b) occupants of the 6th house; 
(c) planets in the constellation or the “sub” of the lords of the 6th house; 
(d) the lords of the 6th house; 
(e) planets conjoined with or aspected by any of these planets. 


2. However, the significators without “sub" have been used in “ 13 ” examples on pages 57, 
74, 118, 139, 236, 244, 256, 269, 276-277, 301, 303, 308 and 333 of the same original 
“Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966”, as shown below: 

1.Planets in the stars of the occupant of house; 

2.Occupants of house; 

3.Planets in the star of owner of house; 

4.Owners of house; 

5.Planets conjoined with or aspected ‘by’ the above (A to D) significators. 


Sub is No More as a Significator 


3. The above significators without "sub" as significator have been used in the KP Reader III, 
pages 341-343/ original 1971 Edition, Practical Part pages 172-175; KP Reader IV, pages 
118, 128, 201; KP Reader V pages 154, 214/ original 1971 Edition pages 149, 201; KP 
Reader VI pages 157, 197, 247 etc. 


4. The above examples mentioning the “sub” of a planet as if a significator are no more 
included in the KP Readers. 


5. The main reason of not using the sub of a planet as a ‘straight significator in the "KP 
significator table” in the KP readers in particular and KP practice in general is that using 
the sub’s’ signication as a significator will contradict with the following KP 
fundamental principle of sub as a decider: 

"Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the results, and the SUB is deciding 
factor whether the matter is favourable or not." (Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar 
Publications, 1966, page 41; KP Reader III, page 136/ original 1971 Edition page 129; KP 
Reader V page 136 /original 1971 Edition page 129; KP Reader VI page 91) 


KP Ezine Sentember 2014 4 


2-Step is Stellar Theory and 3-Step is KP 


6. It has been found that the planet-wise standard ‘KP significator table’ of the grade A 
to D significators without sub has mislead some KP astrologers to use the 
signification of a planet and its star only, without taking the sub into consideration. 
Such 2-step consideration of a planet and its star only is the “stellar theory”, but not 
KP. Such 2-step stellar theory originated from Sage Satyacharya has been used by Dr. B 
V Raman in his “Notable Horoscopes, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. 1 & 2 and My 
Experience in Astrology” and also followed by other Vedic astrologers. Only 3-step 
consideration of the planet, its star and sub is KP as’ KP is the sub lord theory only, 
nothing else. Without consideration of sub it is not KP at all. 

Judge each planet. The planet signifies a matter. Whether it votes for the progress and 
prosperity or due to the “sub lord” it is not capable doing good, further it does harm to that 
bhava signified by the planet, is to be studied. 

"This discovery has crowned me with success." 

Therefore constellation lord shows whom or which matter it refers. But "the deciding factor, 
good or bad, success or failure is shown by the sub occupied by the significator.” 

(KP Reader III page 144/ Original 1971 Edition, Theory Part pages 137-138; KP Reader V 
page 144/ Original 1971 Edition pages 137-138; KP Reader VI page 81) 


7. It is therefore necessary to consider the signification of a planet, whether a cuspal 
sub lord (which is also a planet) or a Dasa/Bhukti/Antra/Sookshma lord, at three 
levels of planet, its star and sub, as consistently done in the books of Chandrakant R. 
Bhatt and Umang Taneja. 


References for Consideration of Sub 
8. Here are the references for consideration of the sub in the KP analysis: 


1. When majority of planets are connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11, select the useful 
ones which agree with ruling planets at the time of judgment. If a planet is in sucha 
position that its sub lord is connected with the houses 2, 7 and 11, then this planet is 
useful. But if the sub is lord of 1, 6, 10 and is the significator of 12 house, marriage cannot 
take place. (KP Reader IV, page 118) 

2. Now reject those planets which are in the “sub” of the planets in 1, 6 and 10, as these are 
the 12th house to the houses 2, 7 and 11, and select the planets that are on the sub of the 
planets signifying 2, 7 and 11. (KP Reader IV p 150) 

3. Venus is the sub lord of the 7th house. Venus in 12 in the star of Jupiter in 2 and "sub” of 
Saturn in 9. Saturn rules houses 7 and 8. So, according to Krishnamurti Padhdhati, we 
should hastily declare that Venus in 12 is bad. Actually, he signifies houses 2, 9, 7, 6, 8 in 
order of strength. Also Venus owns house 11 and is posited in 12. Hence even though 
matters appear unfavourable still Venus brings out success. (KP Reader IV page 173) 

4. Moon in the constellation of Jupiter in 11 indicates that Moon is connected with 11th house 
matters. But whether Moon will be favourable or not is to be decided by only the "sub” 
lord. Here Moon connected with 11th house, being deposited in the “sub” of Mercury in 6 is 
evil for marriage and married life. But, as regards profession it is good as houses 6 and 11 
denote promotion, success in competition, etc. (KP Reader IV page 183) 

5. One is to note the dasa period which one runs. Because in one period and subperiod, one 
may be in service; in another sub subperiod in the same major period keep idle; in the 
third subperiod do business; in the next subperiod, have gains, in another loose and so on. 
Hence one is to note what each planet can contribute always consider its "sub lord”. (KP 
Reader HI page 362 (Original 1971 Edition, Practical Part page 194) (Note: The cuspal 
sub lord of a house is also a planet.) 

6. It is necessary to judge a planet by the lord of costellation and “sub” when you can have 
the “correct results”. (Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, Sagar Publications, 1966, page 
314) 

7. In order to know what each planet can contribute always consider its sub lord. (KP 


KP Ezine Sentember 2014 5 


Reader III page 362/ original 1971 Edition, Practical Part page 194) 

8. Beneficial planets offer their results through the depositors in their constellation, only 
when the sub is also governed by a benefic. If the sub is ruled by a malefic, the depositor 
cannot bring out favourable results. 

9. "Hence Planet is the source, constellation indicates nature of the result and the SUB isa 
deciding factor whether the matter is favourable or not.” 

10.(Krishnamurti Padhdhati, Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, page 41; KP Reader III, page 
136/ Original 1971 Edition, Theory Part page 129; KP Reader V page 126/ Original 
1971 Edition page 129; KP Reader VI page 91) 

11.The planets deposited in a particular constellation can indicate only the nature of the 
event ie. which house matter the planets indicate due to the lord of constellation by its 
occupation. It does not mean that a planet deposited in a constellation should 
necessarily be favourable and contribute for the benefit of the matters signified 
by a bhava occupied by the lord of constellation. For example, Guru and Sani were 
in the same constellation. Guru is in the "beneficial sub”, whereas Sani is in an “adverse 
sub”. So during Guru period one enjoys the results of the bhava occupied by the lord of 
constellation whereas during the period of Sani he faces just diametrically opposite results 
in the same matter. If in the Guru sub period, a child is born, during Sani the same child 
dies. It means Guru and Sani are in one constellation and the lord of constellation is in 5. 
Guru was in a favourable sub and Sani was in an unfavourable one. (Krishnamurti 
Padhdhati or Guruji's self written biography dated June 30, 1969 in R. Eshwara Manu's 
"Astrological Tables for All") 

12.Whether it is a planet or CUSPAL SUB LORD (also a planet) these are ‘controlled’ by the 
relevant sub lord and its signification only. 

13.As regards to a planet, the matter is seen through the star lord of that planet and the SUB 
LORD of that planet ‘decides’ the result & how the matter is altered & enjoyed and 
suffered by the native.(K.M. Subramaniam: last article of 'Sublord Speaks' LX in the 
“K.P. & Astrology Year Book 1998” page 69/ reprinted in “SUBLORD SPEAKS” 
book — part 3, page 141) 

14.The sub lord of the significator is the deciding factor regarding the matters of star lord. If 
the sub lord is harmonious to the matters indicated by the star lord, the significator gives 

favorable results. If the sub lord is detrimental to the matters indicated by the star lord, 
the significator gives unfavorable results. (Chandrakant R. Bhatt: ‘Nakshatra 
Chintamani’, pages 23-24) 

15. Almost all KP astrologers, article contributors in the 2011 K.P. & Astrology Year Book 
2011, have been found considering the SUB whenever it is relevant. 
https: roups.yahoo.com/neo/groups/k p system/conversations/topics/37032? 
threaded=1&l=1

beyond KP for better understanding of the sub’s signification, he reminded in his last 60 
article that the sub is a ‘decider’, as shown in the above point 8. 11)

Role of Sub in Promise of Event and Timing of Event 

12. As mentioned in the above point 8: 9, the star lord signification of 2,7 or 11 does not 
mean a favorable outcome of the marriage matter depending on the positive or negative 
signfication of the sub. In consideration of timing of event, if the sub stronly signifies the 
direct negative houses 1,6,10 (12th to 2,7,11), the DBAS lords cannot be conducive to the 
materialization of marriage event. Here the sub signification can be used as tool of selection 
of fruitful significators without using the ruling planets, as mentioned in the above point 8: 
1, 2, 3. However in the cosideration of promise of marriage event, as long as the 7th cuspal 
sub lord signifies 2,7 or 11 at any level of 3-step (planet, star and sub), it is generally 
considered as promised of marrige, except when the sub is completely negating. Here the 
negating houses 1,6,10 and 12 can indicate difficulties for marriage and seperation after 
marraige which may lead to a divorce in some cases. 


Conclusion 

13. It is to consider the signification of a planet, whether a cuspal sub lord or a Dasa/ 
Bhukti/Antra/Sookshma lord, at 3-step of a planet, its star and sub, cautiously keeping in 
mind that the sub plays the double role of a decider in choosing fruitful significators as 
well as an event indicator which can make the event happen without signification of the 
required houses by the planet and star lord.

(Question asked by father on behalf of daughter) 
Horary Number: 71 (out of 249).

Consider the houses 2, 7 and 11 for marriage (24 increase in family members; 7 wife or 
husband, legal tie, prime house for marriage; 11t* permanent ties of friendship). 5 house is 
for love & romance. Venus is the chief governor of marriage-love-romance. 


Consider the houses 1, 6 and 10 (being 12th from 2, 7 and 11 respectively) for absence of 
marriage life. 


Hints: 


1. If the cuspal sub lord of 74 house be the significator of 2, 7 or 11, marriage will take

owner) 2, 7 or 11 and connected with Rahu or Ketu, chances of inter-community 
marriage are indicated. 


Moon reveals the nature of query. 

Moon (Taurus 24-47-01) is in the star of Mars and sub of Rahu. Planet Moon is the 
occupant of 11, owner of 1. Moon is untenanted (there is no planet in the stars of Moon)

the occupant of 4, owner of 3-12. Saturn is the occupant of 4, owner of 7-8. Moon signifies 
and is in connection with the relevant houses (2-5-7-11), hence query is genuine. 


Whether love or arranged marriage?

the chart is rotated to 5th (children) treated as Lagna of daughter).

the occupant of 8, owner of 2 and 5. Sublord Saturn is the occupant of 4, owner of 7-8.

Question-Answer 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Question - 1: Depression 
Can you explain how to check for mental misbalances like depression, anxiety from KP 
perspective? 


Answer- 1: 

Based on the “medical astrology' books by H.N. Cornell, K. Subramaniam, Dr. K.S. Charak, 
Shanker Adawal, S.K. Duggal, and after looking at some horoscopes of depression, the 
following astrological pattern has been generally found for depression: 

The 6th (disease, sickness) cuspal sub lord signification of 1 (head, brain, mental stability), 
3 (mental tendency), 5 (intelligence, emotional peace of mind and depression), 8 (serious ill- 
ness, disappointment) houses, and connection to Moon (significator of mind, giver of visions 
and imagination), Saturn (ruler of sorrow, gloom and depression, obstruction) and Mercury 
(nervous system and mental activity) can cause depression. In addition, Moon connection to 
Saturn or Uranus (erratic and fanatic) and Mars (impulse and recklessness) connection to 
the Ascendant may also give rise to depression. 


Question - 2: Rule for Return to Homeland 
In dealing with a horary chart, the querent wants to know whether he can return to 
homeland, if so, when? In such cases which cusp sub lord to be judged first? 


Answer -— 2: 

Based on a small study of twenty charts, if 12‘* cuspal sub lord be a significator of house 3, 
9 or 11, one can return to homeland during the joint dasa period (DBAS) of significators of 
houses 3, 9, 11. 

After living a long time in foreign land, foreign residence becomes his present residence (4 
house), and now homeland looks like different environment (12 house). Leaving the 
present residence for homeland is 3™4 house. 9 is long journey and 11 is reunion with 
kith and kin. 


Question - 3: Guruji KSK’s View on Remedies 

Without giving own view, can anyone clarify whether Shri KSK ji is advocating or denying 
remedies by the following statement: 

"Whether you pray or not, the chart shows that exactly in 3 years, you will have a child and 
thus become a father." 

in Astrology & Athrishta, June 1965 Issue pages 23-25, titled “Prayer and Progeny” (same 
published in KP Reader- 6 pages 195- 200 ) 


Answer -3: 

The article titled “Prayer and Progeny” by KSK was first published in the "Astrology & 
Athrishta" June 1965 issue on pages 23-25, and reprinted in the "KP Reader VI" on pages 
195-200 under the same title. That is why this article was not reprinted in “Progeny and 
Romance” book edited by KSK's second son K. Subramaniam, 2007, which is a collection of 
refreshing old articles. 

In this article some remedies to get a child are mentioned, but at the end of the article 
Guruji KSK gives his view as follows:: 


KP Ezine Sentember 2014 41 


"Whether you pray or not, the chart shows that exactly in 3 years, you will have a child 
and thus become a father." (page 25 of A & A magazine, page 25/ KP Reader VI page 200) 
In Guruji's view, getting a child exactly in 3 years is destined by the chart whether the 
native prays or not, and so he is not advocating remedies to get a child. Here telling about 
remedies doesn’t mean advocating remedies. 


Similarly explaining choice of gems in KP Reader HI pages 414-419/ original 1971 Edition, 
Part 2, pages 242-246, KP Reader VI, pages 318-320 and KSK: How to Judge a Nativity in 
KP & Astrology Year Book 1995, page 44-45, reprinted in K. Hariharan: How to Judge a 
Nativity, pages 8-9, doesn’t mean that Guruji KSK is recommending gems therapy. 


Because his concluding remarks indicate that wearing gems is destined by saying, “Only 
when luck is to be enjoyed shortly, he will or she will acquire this color; we attribute the 
luck to the gem. . .Truth is this: Acquisition of any Gem is indicated mostly by a benefic. 
So one acquires when the period of that planet operates. So, when you put the gem, that 
good period operates and so you enjoy and you attribute to the gem.” 


Also writing about the traditional criteria of Mars Dosha in details first in the original 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati Vol. 2, 1966, Sagar Publications, pages 215-228/ then KP Reader 
IV pages 51-69 ‘up to 4th paragraph’ doesn't mean that Guruji KSK accepts the traditional 
Mars Dosha. To make it clear and to give his view on Mars Dosha, three new paragraphs 
are added in the same concluding page 69 of KP Reader IV, saying that “not Mars alone, 
any planet can cause such undesirable effect of disagreement, dispute, divorce etc among 
the couple provided they happen to be deposited in such a position of the significator of 6 
or 10 or 12. 


Referring the following Guruji KSK's views: 

a. "If a horoscope shows a tendency and if one can change the event by one's will, then as- 
trology has no place." (KP Reader V, page 178/ 1971 Original Edition, p 170) 

b. “Accurate results by an able astrologer will surely come to pass whether one does Shanti 
or not. In al cases, Shnati cannot offer complete protection from evils. It does not give 
guarantee to all” (KP reader II page 28); 


if the astrological prediction could be changed by remedies, then remedies are effective and 
astrology is wrong; if remedies could not change the astrological prediction, then remedies 
are not effective and astrology is correct. So choice is astrology or remedies. 


Question - 4: Aspects from Bhava or Rasi chart?. 

Should the aspects be seen from Bhava or Rasi chart?. The doubt arises because, once you 
cast the bhava, the bhava chart becomes final for prediction. If suppose, as per Hindu as- 
trology, Jupiter is in lagna, where as if it is turned to Bhava, then there is a chance that 
Jupiter gets 12th position in the Bhava which is final chart for prediction. 


Answer -— 4: 
In the solved examples of the KP Readers, only the Hindu aspects ‘from rasi to rasi’ are 
used without considering the orb, although it is encouraged to study the Western aspects. 


As shown in the KP example chart below, the South Indian ‘rasi chart’ gives the relative 
rasi positions with boundary lines of ‘rasi after rasi’ of Hindu zodiac for correct use of rasi- 
based Hindu aspects. By inserting the Placidus cusps and placing the planets in the hous- 
es, the house-based chart denotes the correct occupation and lordship of planets in finding 
the significators.

Book Review- 


Financial Astrology 


By: Tin Win 
Email: tw853@yahoo.com 





Financial Astrology 

(Llewellyn's New World Astrology Series) 
by Joan McEvers (Editor) 

Llewellyn Publications, 1989, 368 pages 


Mallcore me) 
Joan McEvers 





This is a basic, all-in-one collection book of articles contributed by financial astrologers with 
knowledge and experience in the field. With knowledgeable understanding of your own 
astrological potential and judicious application of the astro-trading techniques presented in 
this book, you can find what resonates best with you and pursue additional reading. 


In the introduction editor Joan McEvers discusses what is financial astrology, who should 
invest, horoscopes of successful investors and what this book is all about. According to her, 
your luck and money factors are quite visible in your horoscope and often relate to the plan- 
et Jupiter, Saturn and Venus as well as the 24, 5th and 8 houses. Having the rulers of 
those houses or planets in them making strong aspects to each other can be indicative of 
good luck in speculation or investing. The Sun or chart ruler in similar positions is also 
quite fortunate. 


Michael Munkasey offers “A Primer on Market Forecasting” which is an overall introduction 
to forecasting method, emphasizing the role of astrology. It characterizes where financial 
astrology should fit into the realm of economics and market theory. 

Pat Esclavon Hardy interprets the American Stock Exchange chart, providing us with a 
history of the stock market and examining key years by progression and transits. Using the 
7 Sagittarius rising chart, she examines the US chart and points out what was occurring in 
it at these critical times in the US history. 


Jeanne Long explicitly details the ups and downs of commodities market and explains how 


KP Ezine Sentember 2014 45 


to draw trend lines. Her techniques include the use of both heliocentric and geocentric 
placements and insights into combining astrological periods with technical analysis for 
greater profit. 


Describing how Saturn is the designated ruler of real estate (land), Georgia Stathis analyzes 
the effect of planetary and nodal cycles on the real estate market. In addition, she has con- 
tributed another article on delineating corporate charts and explaining how to choose astro- 
logical timing for business success. 


Mary B. Downing explores the most effective way to track a corporation chart using the 
graphic ephemeris, harmonic and helio placements as well as older tried and true astrologi- 
cal methods 


Judy Johns discusses legendary investor W.D. Gann’s techniques and describes his system 
of timing and relates it to astrological circles. 


Blending almost 30 factors in predicting the Dow Jones Industrial Averages is right up Carol 
S. Mull’s alley. She discusses the cycles and sub-cycles which affect the U.S. stock market 
and feels the most reliable are McWhirter’s Moon Node cycle, the 28-day Moon cycle and the 
four-year cycle. 


Bill Meridian outlines how periods of planetary retrogradation affect the U.S. stock market

William Shakespeare in his famous work Hamlet says “Mind in its own place is a hell or 
heaven”. How true it is! In deed as long as the mind is sound and balanced it gives all the 
happiness and peace in the world or else it can create a hell in its own place. 

The dictionary meaning of insanity is that it is the state of being seriously mentally ill; mad- 
ness. Insanity also means mental illness of such a severe nature that a person cannot dis- 
tinguish fantasy from reality, cannot conduct her/his affairs due to psychosis, or is subject 
to uncontrollable impulsive behavior. Insanity is distinguished from low intelligence or men- 
tal deficiency due to age or injury. In short we may say that the problem of insanity pertains 
to the head and mental disorders which arise due to weak / damaged brain, weak nerves, 
and weak mind or imbalanced power of thinking. 

If we have to analyze the problem of “Insanity” through science of astrology we have to dis- 
cuss the following astrological indications for the same. Here is a chart of an individual who 
has become insane in his mid age, due to some extraneous conditions and external factors. 
The birth particulars of the said native are - (chart is attached)

cusp falls in Aries sign, it causes health problems pertaining to head, pain in nerves, brain 
and blood vessels connecting to the brain, brain faculties and distribution of mental activi- 
ties. 

2) Third house is the mental house which speaks of memory power, stability of the mind, 
strength of the nervous system and mental courage to face the life and its events. The third 
in the natural zodiac is Gemini. 

3) Fifth house which speaks of mind and intelligence needs to be studied. Fifth in the nat- 
ural zodiac is Leo. Any affliction to this house will not be good for mental health of the na- 
tive, and indicates disease caused by blood cells and failure of blood circulation to the rele- 
vant parts. 

4) Sixth house shows disease and its sub lord is the final deciding authority to show the 
disease. 

5) Ninth house speaks of mental intuition. Ninth and twelfth in natural zodiac are Sagittari- 
us and Pisces. 

6) Twelfth house speaks of secret working and hidden things especially the mental working 
on unseen matters. 

7) The tendency to the disease also depends upon both the Dasa, Bhukti and Anthara lords. 
Planets connected with the 6 house and lagna will produce disease during their conjoined 
period. 

8) Diseases as per the Characteristics of the signs-

health has its origins in such things as violent exertion and out bursts of anger. The Aries 
person should seek poise at all costs. The sign Aries, the first house in the zodiac controls 
over the head. And when ever in the birth chart, Aries is afflicted, one naturally gets the dis- 
ease of the head, and when is adversely disposed, one gets affliction of the brain and mind.

M ental IlIness- A Case Study 


By: G.Subramanian 
13,S econd Cross St., 
Chennai-35 





The great Tamil Poetess, Avvaiyar has sung that it is rare to be born as a human being out 
of all living beings and that too being born as one without physical deformity or disease is 
real divine blessing. True, everyone wants to be healthy bodily and mentally. Healthy mind 
in a healthy body is what everyone strongly aspires for. 


But in actual life we come across people who suffer from mental and/or physical diseases 
and lead a miserable life. Mental illness is something-severe and serious- an unfortunate 
stigma for the individual. Not only does he suffers for long periods, but he also makes the 
whole family suffer from grief and agony. Society also shuns such poor souls and they 
become objects of public gossip and ridicule. 


Mental disorder has been described by Wikipedia as follows: 

“Amental disorder, also called amental_ illnessor psychiatric disorder, is a 
mental or behavioral pattern or anomaly that causes either suffering or an impaired ability 
to function in ordinary life (disability), and which is not developmentally or socially 
normative. Mental disorders are generally defined by a combination of how a person 
feels, acts, thinks or perceives. This may be associated with particular regions or functions 
of the brain or rest of the nervous system, and in a social context.” 





A horoscope is a map of the heavens at the time of birth of a child and in astrology it is 
widely used to predict the various facets of life. It is only natural to expect it to throw some 
light on the health and sickness aspect of an individual. Mental alertness, clear 
understanding, intelligence and analytical powers are the traits which differentiate man 
from other living beings. It is strongly believed by the astrological practitioners that our 
physical and mental fitness are determined by the interplay of planetary interactions in the 
signs of the Zodiac. 


Broadly, the following are the indications of mental illness in a chart: 

1. Lagna is the main pillar of a horoscope and apart from other things it also indicates 
whether the person will be hale and healthy or sickly. Lagna, its condition and condition of 
its lord certainly play a vital role in shaping the mental health of a person. Lagna or the first 
house also represents the brain, the prime functional organ of the body. The first house of 
the Kala Purusha Aries (head& brain) is also to be examined for this purpose. 


2. Moon is the Karaka of the mind and rules attachments, feelings, sentiments, mental and 
emotional states of mind, etc. Hence, it acquires importance while deciding about mental 
malfunctioning. 


3. Mercury represents intelligence, skill and communications and when it is seriously 
afflicted results in low levels of intelligence and concentration and comprehension. 


4. The fifth house in a horoscope stands for wisdom, power of understanding analysis and 
discrimination. 


In this context, it should be said to the credit of the great and illustrious Shri K.S. 
Krishnamurthy, that after extensive research laid down in his Padhdhathi some simple,

unambiguous and unfailing rules to predict the disease from which a person is likely to

1 According to K.P. system, 6t house shows the nature of disease. If the 6 house sub-lord 
is connected to Lagna in any way., then the native will suffer from upset of health disease 
and be sickly. 


2 To predict the nature of disease, one should note the sub-lord of the sixth cusp, the 
constellation in which the sublord is posited and the sign where the constellation lord is 
posited and also the sign where the 6 cusp sublord is posited, and all these have to be 
examined thoroughly . 


3 The fatal disease is shown by the eighth cusp. 


4 The planets are said to be adverse for health only when they establish some connection 
with the 6t (disease), 8» (danger or surgery) and 12 (defect, hospitalization and medical 
treatment). 


5 One is to note which planet will cause disease, in which sign it is posited and which sign 
is tenanted by the lord of the constellation occupied by the significators of both Lagna and 
6th house. 


6 Considering all these facts, one has to come to a decision and predict the nature of 
disease from which one will suffer and then calculate the time when the significators of 6, 8, 
12 operate. 


7 Planets connected with cure are the significators of five and eleven. 


To illustrate these principles, I am presenting before our readers a case study. For obvious 
reasons, the real name of the patient has been withheld. The chart of the person is 
appended at the end of the article for reference. 


In this case, the Lagna falls in Taurus with Venus as sign lord, Moon as starlord and Venus 
as sublord. Lagna lord and cuspal sublord Venus is placed second house of Maraka and 
also lord of sixth house of disease. Attention is drawn to the fact that Venus is conjoined 
with Saturn, a powerful malefic as a Bhadaka ninth by lordship and a Maraka by 
occupation of second house, thus indicating that the disease is chronic and longstanding. 


Moon is a significator of Mraka by occupation of seventh house and being the the cuspal 
sub lord of second house having no planet in its stars. Moon is in the star of Mercury, 
owner of second Maraka house and in sub of Venus in second Maraka house, lord of sixth 
disease house. Thus the weak Moon shows a weak and affected mind more so due to the 
aspect thrown by Mars, lord of seventh Maraka and twelfth defect houses.

disease house, in the star of Mars and sub of Rahu aspected by Jupiter. Apart from the

Repayment of Loan (Debt)

back the principle and interest. To the querent, the 12‘* cusp is the guide which indicates 
expenses or repaying loan. And 5-8-12 houses indicate repayment of loan (debt). But one 
will able to repay the same when the native have the actual capability i.e. having adequate 
money for repayment of loan (debt). The 24 house indicates liquid wealth like money. 6% 
house indicates money earned from hardship and the 11 house shows gains or profits and 
fulfillment of desire. When the DBA of common significators both 5-8-12 and 2-6-11 houses 
operate, one can able to repay loan (debt).

connection with 6, hence query is genuine.

Question- 1: Litigation Matters 
In litigation matters there are following rules in the reputed KP books :- 


1. Appeal — Successful or not- If the sub lord of the 3rd cusp is deposited in the 
constellation of planet which the significator of 6 and 11 then one will have success. But if 
the sub lord of the 3rd cusp is deposited in the constellation of a planet who the significator 
of the houses 5 and 12, can not have success. (KP Reader-6 page No. 168) 


2. Court Case- As a general rule houses 1,2,3,6,10,11 are favorable for a success in 
litigation, competition or election etc. of which 6 and 11 are the principal houses. 6th house 
is for winning over the opponents and 11th house is for fulfillment of desire. The same 
houses for opponents are 12 and 5. Generally planets will not be favorable to one party 
only. In such a case we have to observe to which party planets are more favorable. Sign lord 
has also taken.(Case study 129-130 in KP bookpage No. 505 to511) Professor Hariharn. 


3. Hints: House 6 indicates loss of opponent (12th from 7th , 7th indicates litigation, 
opponent, opposite party and court matter), 11th indicates success. If the cuspal sub lord of 
the 6th or 11 be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 1,2,3,6,10,11, then 
one can win in court case during the joint period of 6,11. Sub lord, its star lord both must 
be in direct motion. (Page 185, Example 41 Prashna Jyotish late Shri Chandrakant 
Ratneshwar Bhatt BA.,LLB) and translated by Sh. Kanakkumar B. Bosmia. 


4. Winning in court case- Example No.18 Page No.82 If the cuspal sub lord of the 4 (Result 
of lawsuit) be the significator (in the star of the occupant or owner) of 2nd (Winning), 10th 
(success), 11th (Gain) one will be able to win the lawsuit during the joing period of the 
significator of 2,10 and 11. by Shri Kanakkumar B.Bosmia. 


5. Last one is: If 6th CSL signifies 6, 1 and11 and Jupiter favorable, person will get success 
in court case. Please look into the matter and give your advice. 


Answer- 1: 
Some more views are given below for better understanding before giving suggestion: 


1. Criminal Proceedings 

Hint: If the sub lord of the 10 cusp (status) be the significator of 7 (court proceedings), 8 
(infamy) or 12 (crimes), the native will be involved in court proceedings relating to crimes, 
will be ill-reputed and will be inflicted with punishment, during the joint period of the 
significators of 7, 8 and 12. (Prashna Jyotish, by C.R. Bhatt, page 316) 


2. Litigation- An Approach through K.P. 

Rules in K.P. for Success or Failure in Litigation 

1) Success is indicated when the 1st and 11 houses comes under the sway of houses 
1,2,3,6,10 and 11 which are improving houses in any chart. 

2) Success or failure in litigation can also be judged from the Lords of the Ascendant, 10th 
and the 11. 

3) Failure is certain when the 1st and 11 come under the sway of houses 4,5,7,8,9 and 12, 


in a strong manner. 
KP Ezine October 2014 50 


4) What are the houses involved in Litigation and in what respect: 

6 = represents litigation as such 

7 = opponent in litigation, lawyer etc. 

10 = judge 

1 = judgement of the court 

11 = success in litigation and also in legislation 

9 = law 

12 = expenditure by way of court fees, lawyers fee etc. 

(K.P. & Astrology Year Book 20014, page 42, by K.P. Kuppu Ganapathi) 


3. Success in Litigation 

The 76 house show the person or persons with whom one is in litigation. If he were to lose, 
the 6 house will operate, along with the 11 house (because the querent 11* house shows 
fulfillment of desire, and the 12 to 7 i.e. 6 for the querist shows loss for the opponent. 
On the other hand , if houses 5 and 12 operate, the querent will lose. (K.P. & Astrology Year 
Book 20014, page 67) 


4. Success in Litigation and Financial Loss 

For any question, the sub lord of respective cusp and its signification should be given prime 
importance. So, for success in litigation we have to consider the sub lords of 6 and 1]1t 
cusps. The sub lord of 6 or 11 cusps should be placed in the constellation of a planet 
who must be a significator of houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 in any manner according to the 
Krishnamurti Padhdhati. (Timing of Evemts, edt. K. Hariharan,2008, pages 254-255) 


©. On Success in Litigation and Second Marriage 

According to the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, the 6 house stands for litigation and 7 house 
for the opponent in litigation. It would be initiated when the significators of 6 and 7 
house operate together, during their conjoined period according to the Vimsotari Dasa. 

The cause of litigation will be indicated by the nature of those planets which are associated 
with the 6th bhava/cusp or planets posited in the constellation of the occupant of lord of 6 
bhava. 

Prof. Krishnamurti has explained that success and failure in litigation will depend upon the 
relationship of planets signifying 6% and 7+ houses. When the 6t and 7 houses come 
under the sway of lords of the constellation or occupants of houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11, 
success is ensured, whereas failure would be indicated in the case of 4.5.7.8.9.and 12. 
(Stellar Effects on Human Life, 2006, edt. K. Hariharan, pages 92-93) 


6. Litigation: Krishnamurti Padhdhati 

According to the Krishnamurti Padhdhati, sixth house represents litigation and the seventh 
house indicates the opponent in litigation. Therefore, the litigation would be imminent 
whenever the significators of the sixth and seventh houses would operate in life. 

The cause of the litigation rests with the planets connected or associated with the sixth 
house or its lord. 

The success in litigation is promised by the lord of eleventh house or planets in the eleventh 
house. The success is also ensured if the sixth and seventh houses come under the sway of 
the lords of constellation or occupants of 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 houses. If the lord of the sixth 
house is connected with the eleventh house or the eleventh house with the lord of sixth 
house the success in litigation is sure. This means that the connection of the lords of 
twelfth and fifth houses causes failure in absolute term. (Krishnamurti Padhdhati, K. 
Hariharan, 1999, pages 97-100) 


7. Litigation- Win or What? 

Lagna indicates the native; 7‘ house shows the party with whom the native is to fight out in 
the court of law; 24 , 6 and 11 houses indicate success and the houses 5t , 8th and 12th 
denote failure. . . if this (joint dasa) period is governed by the planets connected with houses 
5, 8 and 12, one will lose in this period. (My Experience with Krishnamurti Padhdhati, by K. 


Hariharan, 1995, pages 73-74) 
KP Ezine October 2014 51 


General Rule 

Houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11, receiving aspects promise victory over enemies; success in 
litigation; win in competition and gain in lottery, games, etc. 

Houses 4,5,7,8,9 and 12 receiving good aspects threaten loss and when the aspects are 
adverse, promise gain. 

Planets in 4,5,7,8,9 or 12 to your lagna will cause loss to you and show disappointment. 
But planets in 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 indicate gains to you. 

(KP Reader III, pages 197-198/ original 1971 edition, practical part, pages 41-42) 


It is said by Krishnamurti that houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 are the houses which will promise 
success in one’s competition, election, litigation etc. (KP Reader V page 249/ original 1971 
edition page 222) 


Out of improving houses 1,2,3,6,10 and 11, houses 6 and 11 are mostly considered as the 
principal gaining houses. The 6th house is for winning over the opponents or loss of oppo- 
nent (12th from 7th , 7th indicates litigation, opponent, opposite party and court matter), 
and 11th house is for success and fulfillment of desire. Houses 12 and 5 are principal 
losing houses for the querent as these houses are 6 and 11 gaining houses for the 
Opponent. 


If the running joint dasa period lords signifies houses 6 and 11, success in litigation for the 
querent; whereas failure in the case of 5 and 12 houses. 


It can be extended to houses 2,6 and 11 for success and 5,8 and 12 for failure in litigation. 
10 is also can be added as houses 6, 10 and 11 fro success. It is up to the preference of 
which houses and how many houses from 1,2,3,6,10 and 11 are to be considered as 
principal houses. 


If joint dasa periods lords signify houses 3 and 9 for negotiation and also 5 and 11, out of 
court settlement is indicated; but if the signification of houses 8 and 12 are combined with 
2 and 3, it may lead to imprisonment after loosing the case. 


Cuspal Sub Lords 

The most considered cuspal sub lords are 6 and 11 . If 6 or 11 cuspal sub lord (CSL) 
signifies house 2,6,11, then one can win in court case during the joint dasa period of sig- 
nificators of 2, 6, 11. If the CSL signifies houses 5,8,12, one can lose the court case during 
the joint dasa period of significators of houses 5,8,12. Here 11» CSL is especially important 
in the horary analysis. 


If 1st house is considered as judgment of the court (KP Kuppu Ganapathi)/ decision or 
sentence of the court in lawsuits (Rex E. Bills: Rulership Book), 1st cuspal sub lord is also 
judged as a principal house. 

If 4th house is considered as result of lawsuit or ruling from a court (Kanak Bosmia/ 
Michael Munkasey: Astrological Thesaurus, House Keywords), 4 cuspal sub lord is also 


judged asa principal house. 


10th CSL’s signification of houses 7,8 and 12 is considered in losing reputation. 3™ CSL’s 
signification of houses 6 and 11 is considered in the case of appeal. 


If 7h CSL signifies houses 6,8 and 12, one may be involved in litigation or court case 
during the joint dasa period of houses 6,8 and 12. 


So it is suggested to be considered on case by case basis.

Question- 3: Indicators of Diabetes 
What are the astrological indicators of diabetes. 


Answer- 3: 

Rulers of Diabetes: The commonly accepted rulers of diabetes are Jupiter, Venus and Libra 
sign by Dr. C N Cornell, Rex Bills, J. Lee Lehman, Noel Tyl and J.N. Bhasin. Noel Tyl noted 
that among several thousand clients, over 80 % of diabetics had strong Venus and Jupiter 
aspects. (Astrological Timing of Critical Illness) 


Common Indicators: Jupiter-Venus connection is found in 18 charts (90%) out of twenty di- 
abetes charts under study. The rationale is that the pancreas produces hormones essential 
to the digestion of food and the hormones regulate how we use glucose. Insulin is one of the 
hormones produced by the pancreas when the concentration of glucose (Venus) in the blood 
increases. Surplus glucose is stored by the liver (Jupiter). Diabetes results when there is an 
imbalance of insulin supply from the pancreas causing a tension between Venus and 
Jupiter. Thus Venus and Jupiter are diabetes indicators. 


Timing of Ailment: Ailment has been found starting during Dasa-Bhukti-Antra signifying 
Maraka, Badhaka, 6,8,12 houses in connection with Jupiter and Venus in 16 charts (80%).

Athrishta, August 1980 issue/ Astro secret & KP Part III, page 49)

This analysis revisits the Shrien Dewani murder case that is now under trial as of the 6th 
October 2014 in the Western Cape High Court of South Africa. I had earlier analysed this 
case when it occured in the year 2010 and I had predicted that Shrien would be extradited 
to South Africa to stand trial and would be found guilty. (Please refer to the January 2011 
issue of the KP-Ezine). At the time of that analysis, I had correctly predicted the various 
outcomes of legal proceedings against Shrien Dewani. However, I had not been able to 
accurately work out the timing of the events. (Since then I have been studying and revisiting 
many previous analyses of horary questions, (done by me and others in the KP-Ezine), to un- 
derstand the timing of events better). After a long drawn extradition court battle that took 
nearly 3 years, Shrien was _ finally 
extradited to South Africa this year to 
stand trial. I have again taken up this 
issue as the topic is now current once 
more. 


The question I have posed is really to 
confirm what I had initially analysed 
in 2010. The question is whether 
Shrien Dewani would be punished by 
the High Court in Cape Town and be 
given jail time as punishment.

generated number for this horary chart 
(#244/249), taken on 6-10-2014, at

case will take time to decide. Please note that Moon is a fast moving planet and rules the 
movable sign of Cancer but is now placed in the fixed sign of Aquarius. Thus it shows delay 
but not an inordinate amount of it. 


The first thing to do would be, as always, to check the authenticity of this horary chart. 
Taking Moon as the indicator of the affairs under consideration the positions are as follows:

orb) and he rules 1 and 10. Moon is in the sub of strong Saturn (no planets in its stars) 
who is in the 8th and rules the 11th and 12th. Bhavas 8 and 12 show untoward results for 
Shrien and the 12th shows life behind bars.

The rules relating to imprisonment are as follows: 


According to Guruji KSK's original surmise of the rules: 

(ij) © 12th Cuspal Sub Lord should signify bhavas 2, 3, 8 and 12 

(ii) 12th Cuspal Sub Lord should be Rahu; and 

(iii) 12th Cuspal Sub lord should not be in the star of a retrograde planet. 


Later modifications have been taken into account. Shri Kanak Bosmia does not give 
importance to the retrogression of the planet. Also it must be understood that the 
12th Cuspal Sub Lord can be any planet and not just Rahu. The critical point is that 
the 12» cuspal sub lord should signify bhavas 2, 3, 8 and 12. 


Let us deal with these classical rules. 


In the above Chart, the 12th Cuspal Sub Lord is strong Saturn (no planets in its stars). Sat- 
urn is posited in the 8th and aspects the 2nd very strongly (with its 7th aspect).

and rules 1 and 10. Saturn is in the sub of strong Venus (no planets in its stars) who is in 
the 6th and rules 3rd and 8th. 


As can be seen Saturn brings out all the relevant bhavas i.e. 2 (by aspect), 3 (by rulership), 
8 (by occupation), and 12 (by rulership). Saturn is not retrograde, nor is its star lord Jupiter 
retrograde. 


Therefore, by this analysis, Shrien Dewani will definitely be punished and imprisoned for
